`.env.example`:

```example
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Minecraft Network Manager – environment configuration
# Copy to .env and replace every CHANGE_ME value. Never commit .env.
# Generate secrets with: sh infrastructure/scripts/generate-secrets.sh
# Passwords are embedded in connection URLs: use only [A-Za-z0-9] (hex is ideal).
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Database (MySQL 8.4, internal network only)
MYSQL_DATABASE=mnm
MYSQL_USER=mnm
MYSQL_PASSWORD=CHANGE_ME
MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=CHANGE_ME

# Redis (internal network only)
REDIS_PASSWORD=CHANGE_ME

# Signs dashboard session tokens. At least 32 random characters.
JWT_SECRET=CHANGE_ME

# Optional fixed setup code (min. 16 chars). Leave empty to print a random one
# to the backend log on startup: docker compose logs backend
SETUP_TOKEN=

# Dashboard exposure
DASHBOARD_BIND=0.0.0.0
DASHBOARD_PORT=3000

# Session cookies: auto = Secure flag when served over HTTPS. Use "true" behind HTTPS.
COOKIE_SECURE=auto
# Proxies whose X-Forwarded-For headers the backend trusts (Express syntax).
TRUST_PROXY=loopback, linklocal, uniquelocal

# Optional MaxMind GeoLite2 databases (approximate IP location), mounted from ./geoip
# See docs/architecture/player-profiles.md
GEOIP_CITY_DB=
GEOIP_ASN_DB=

# OpenAPI docs at /api/docs
API_DOCS_ENABLED=true
# error | warn | log | debug | verbose
LOG_LEVEL=log

# Optional HTTPS via Caddy (docker compose --profile https up -d)
DASHBOARD_DOMAIN=dashboard.example.com
ACME_EMAIL=

# Container images. Point MNM_IMAGE_PREFIX at a registry to use prebuilt images
# (e.g. ghcr.io/<owner>/minecraft-network-manager); otherwise images are built locally.
MNM_IMAGE_PREFIX=mnm
MNM_VERSION=latest

```

`README.md`:

```md
# Minecraft Network Manager

A self-hosted administration and player-intelligence platform for Minecraft networks running **Velocity** (proxy) and **Paper** (backend servers): network-wide punishments, player profiles and statistics, AntiCheat integration, inventory management, server monitoring and a multilingual web dashboard. Everything is deployed with Docker Compose.

> **Status: v0.8.0 – Phase 8 (Configuration and setup).** The web platform, the Velocity and Paper plugins, network-wide moderation, player profiles, statistics, the AntiCheat integration, inventory management and central configuration are implemented. Production hardening is scheduled for the next phase – see [Roadmap](#roadmap). Modules that do not exist yet are shown as "Not available yet" in the dashboard and never display placeholder data.

## Features in this release

| Area | What works today |
| --- | --- |
| Deployment | Docker Compose stack (MySQL 8.4, Redis 7.4, backend, dashboard), healthchecks, automatic migrations, optional HTTPS via Caddy |
| Setup wizard | Service checks, migration status, Owner creation protected by a one-time setup code, network configuration, Velocity registration token |
| Authentication | Argon2id passwords, short-lived access tokens + rotating refresh tokens in `HttpOnly`/`SameSite=Strict` cookies, CSRF header check, per-IP rate limits (Redis) and per-account lockout |
| Authorization | Role-based access control with six default roles, custom roles, wildcard permissions, privilege-escalation prevention, enforced server-side |
| Audit log | Every administrative action is recorded and searchable |
| Internationalization | `en-US` default, `de-DE` bundled, per-user language with instant switching, ICU plurals, locale-aware numbers/dates, time-zone aware timestamps, catalogue validation (no HTML/script injection) |
| Minecraft plugins | Velocity 4 and Paper 26 plugins (Java 25): token registration, HMAC-signed requests with replay protection, ordered event buffering during outages, periodic sync, heartbeats (TPS, MSPT, memory, CPU), `/networkmanager` status command |
| Players | Search by name, previous name or UUID; live online list; profiles with tabs (Overview, Moderation, Connections, Activity, Notes); 3D skin preview and heads served without third-party requests from the browser; daily playtime chart and weekday/hour heatmap; connection history with IP summary and alternate-account hints (`players.view.ip`); optional approximate GeoLite2 location (`players.view.location`); configurable IP retention |
| Servers | Registration tokens, live status, credential rotation/revocation, enable/disable, rename, delete; crashed proxies detected and their sessions closed |
| Statistics | Movement, combat, blocks (per type, ores) and general statistics from Minecraft's own counters plus active/AFK time, chat messages and XP; tick-spread collection; hourly history with 24 h / 7 d / 30 d / custom ranges (partial coverage flagged, resets handled); daily charts; network totals and leaderboards |
| AntiCheat | Java API for allow-listed AntiCheat plugins and console-only `/anticheatban`; dashboard rule engine per check (action, duration, VL threshold, cooldown), safe defaults (log only), rate limits, idempotent reports, evidence on punishments, event history and daily counters |
| Inventories | View and edit inventories and Ender Chests per server in a Minecraft-style editor (drag & drop, amount, name, lore, enchantments); per-slot compare-and-set applied atomically on the server thread (no duplication or loss), offline edits queued until the next join, revision history with rollback, full audit trail |
| Configuration | Setup wizard; guided server registration with Velocity/Paper config generator (copy, download, ZIP package with instructions, live registration status); plugin settings and in-game messages managed centrally and applied live without restarts; punishment templates; language management with catalogue import/export and runtime-added languages |
| Realtime | Server-Sent Events with Redis fan-out; permission-filtered |
| Moderation | Bans, temp bans, IP blacklists, mutes, temp mutes, kicks, warnings; `/ban /tempban /unban /mute /tempmute /unmute /kick /warn /history /check`; login checks from a local, disk-persisted cache (no network on join, works during outages); mutes enforced on Paper; duplicate prevention and idempotency; dashboard moderation page, player history, revoke, internal notes; full audit trail |
| Dashboard | Live overview, players, online players, player profiles, servers, users & roles, audit log, settings; dark/light theme; responsive |
| API | REST with OpenAPI docs at `/api/docs` |

## Quick start

Requirements: Docker Engine 24+ with the Compose plugin. Nothing else needs to be installed on the host.

```sh
git clone <repository-url> minecraft-network-manager
cd minecraft-network-manager
sh infrastructure/scripts/generate-secrets.sh   # creates .env with random secrets
docker compose up -d --build
docker compose logs backend | grep "Setup code"   # one-time code for the wizard
```

Open `http://<host>:3000` and complete the setup wizard. Full guide: [docs/installation](docs/installation/README.md).

## Repository layout

```
apps/
  backend/          NestJS API, Prisma schema & migrations
  dashboard/        Next.js dashboard (App Router, Tailwind, next-intl)
  plugin-common/    Shared Java code: backend client, signing, event queue, messages
  velocity-plugin/  Velocity 4 proxy plugin
  paper-plugin/     Paper 26 server plugin
packages/
  shared-types/     Permissions, roles, locales and shared contracts
  translations/     Dashboard catalogues (JSON) + plugin messages (YAML) + validator
infrastructure/
  docker/           Dockerfiles, entrypoint, Caddyfile
  scripts/          Operational scripts
docs/               Architecture, installation, API and development docs
```

`apps/backend/prisma.config.ts`:

```ts
import { defineConfig } from 'prisma/config';

// DATABASE_URL is only required for commands that talk to the database
// (migrate deploy/dev). `prisma generate` and `prisma validate` work without it.
export default defineConfig({
  schema: 'prisma/schema.prisma',
  migrations: { path: 'prisma/migrations' },
  datasource: {
    url: process.env.DATABASE_URL ?? 'mysql://unset:unset@localhost:3306/unset',
  },
});

```

`apps/backend/prisma/schema.prisma`:

```prisma
// Minecraft Network Manager – database schema (MySQL 8.4 LTS).
// See docs/architecture/database.md for design decisions.
// Conventions: snake_case table/column names, UTC timestamps (DATETIME(3)),
// Minecraft UUID (dashed, lowercase, CHAR(36)) as stable player identity.

generator client {
  provider     = "prisma-client"
  output       = "../src/generated/prisma"
  moduleFormat = "cjs"
  importFileExtension = "js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "mysql"
}

// ───────────────────────────── Players ─────────────────────────────

model Player {
  uuid                  String    @id @db.Char(36)
  username              String    @db.VarChar(16)
  firstSeenAt           DateTime  @map("first_seen_at") @db.DateTime(3)
  lastSeenAt            DateTime  @map("last_seen_at") @db.DateTime(3)
  online                Boolean   @default(false)
  currentServerId       String?   @map("current_server_id") @db.VarChar(32)
  /// Seconds connected to the network; null until the proxy reports sessions.
  totalPlaytimeSeconds  BigInt    @default(0) @map("total_playtime_seconds")
  activePlaytimeSeconds BigInt?   @map("active_playtime_seconds")
  afkSeconds            BigInt?   @map("afk_seconds")
  connectionCount       Int       @default(0) @map("connection_count")
  rank                  String?   @db.VarChar(64)
  gamemode              String?   @db.VarChar(16)
  clientProtocol        Int?      @map("client_protocol")
  clientVersion         String?   @map("client_version") @db.VarChar(32)
  clientBrand           String?   @map("client_brand") @db.VarChar(128)
  locale                String?   @db.VarChar(16)
  /// Skin texture reported by the proxy (only textures.minecraft.net URLs are accepted).
  skinTextureUrl        String?   @map("skin_texture_url") @db.VarChar(255)
  /// "classic" or "slim" arm model.
  skinModel             String?   @map("skin_model") @db.VarChar(8)
  createdAt             DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.DateTime(3)
  updatedAt             DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.DateTime(3)

  currentServer      Server?                   @relation("PlayerCurrentServer", fields: [currentServerId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  names              PlayerName[]
  sessions           PlayerSession[]
  connections        PlayerConnection[]
  serverVisits       PlayerServerVisit[]
  statistics         PlayerStatistic[]
  statisticSnapshots PlayerStatisticSnapshot[]
  inventories        PlayerInventory[]
  punishments        Punishment[]              @relation("PunishmentTarget")
  antiCheatEvents    AntiCheatEvent[]
  notes              PlayerNote[]

  @@index([username])
  @@index([online])
  @@index([lastSeenAt])
  @@index([firstSeenAt])
  @@map("players")
}

model PlayerName {
  id          BigInt   @id @default(autoincrement())
  playerUuid  String   @map("player_uuid") @db.Char(36)
  username    String   @db.VarChar(16)
  firstSeenAt DateTime @map("first_seen_at") @db.DateTime(3)
  lastSeenAt  DateTime @map("last_seen_at") @db.DateTime(3)

  player Player @relation(fields: [playerUuid], references: [uuid], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([playerUuid, username])
  @@index([username])
  @@map("player_names")
}

/// One network session: from proxy login to proxy disconnect.
model PlayerSession {
  id              BigInt    @id @default(autoincrement())
  /// Generated by the proxy plugin; makes join/leave events idempotent across retries.
  sessionKey      String?   @unique @map("session_key") @db.Char(36)
  playerUuid      String    @map("player_uuid") @db.Char(36)
  proxyServerId   String?   @map("proxy_server_id") @db.VarChar(32)
  startedAt       DateTime  @map("started_at") @db.DateTime(3)
  endedAt         DateTime? @map("ended_at") @db.DateTime(3)
  durationSeconds Int?      @map("duration_seconds")
  afkSeconds      Int?      @map("afk_seconds")

  player       Player              @relation(fields: [playerUuid], references: [uuid], onDelete: Cascade)
  proxyServer  Server?             @relation(fields: [proxyServerId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  connection   PlayerConnection?
  serverVisits PlayerServerVisit[]

  @@index([playerUuid, startedAt])
  @@index([startedAt])
  @@index([endedAt])
  @@index([proxyServerId, endedAt])
  @@map("player_sessions")
}

/// Connection metadata. IP data is personal data: access requires players.view.ip
/// and rows are subject to the configured retention period.
model PlayerConnection {
  id             BigInt   @id @default(autoincrement())
  playerUuid     String   @map("player_uuid") @db.Char(36)
  sessionId      BigInt?  @unique @map("session_id")
  ipAddress      String?  @map("ip_address") @db.VarChar(45)
  /// Approximate, IP-derived. Never an exact location.
  countryCode    String?  @map("country_code") @db.Char(2)
  region         String?  @db.VarChar(128)
  city           String?  @db.VarChar(128)
  isp            String?  @db.VarChar(255)
  /// Autonomous system number of the IP (approximate network operator).
  asn            Int?
  virtualHost    String?  @map("virtual_host") @db.VarChar(255)
  clientProtocol Int?     @map("client_protocol")
  clientBrand    String?  @map("client_brand") @db.VarChar(128)
  connectedAt    DateTime @map("connected_at") @db.DateTime(3)

  player  Player         @relation(fields: [playerUuid], references: [uuid], onDelete: Cascade)
  session PlayerSession? @relation(fields: [sessionId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([playerUuid, connectedAt])
  @@index([ipAddress])
  @@index([connectedAt])
  @@map("player_connections")
}

/// Time spent on a specific backend server inside a network session.
model PlayerServerVisit {
  id         BigInt    @id @default(autoincrement())
  playerUuid String    @map("player_uuid") @db.Char(36)
  sessionId  BigInt?   @map("session_id")
  serverId   String    @map("server_id") @db.VarChar(32)
  joinedAt   DateTime  @map("joined_at") @db.DateTime(3)
  leftAt     DateTime? @map("left_at") @db.DateTime(3)

  player  Player         @relation(fields: [playerUuid], references: [uuid], onDelete: Cascade)
  session PlayerSession? @relation(fields: [sessionId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  server  Server         @relation(fields: [serverId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([playerUuid, joinedAt])
  @@index([serverId, joinedAt])
  @@map("player_server_visits")
}

model PlayerNote {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid()) @db.VarChar(32)
  playerUuid   String   @map("player_uuid") @db.Char(36)
  authorUserId String?  @map("author_user_id") @db.VarChar(32)
  content      String   @db.Text
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.DateTime(3)
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.DateTime(3)

  player Player         @relation(fields: [playerUuid], references: [uuid], onDelete: Cascade)
  author DashboardUser? @relation(fields: [authorUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([playerUuid, createdAt])
  @@map("player_notes")
}

// ──────────────────────────── Statistics ────────────────────────────

/// Current value of one statistic. `scope` is "network" or a server id;
/// statKey uses Minecraft keys where possible (e.g. minecraft:custom/minecraft:jump).
/// A missing row means "never collected" – never zero-filled.
model PlayerStatistic {
  playerUuid String   @map("player_uuid") @db.Char(36)
  scope      String   @default("network") @db.VarChar(32)
  statKey    String   @map("stat_key") @db.VarChar(191)
  value      BigInt
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.DateTime(3)

  player Player @relation(fields: [playerUuid], references: [uuid], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([playerUuid, scope, statKey])
  @@index([statKey, value])
  @@map("player_statistics")
}

/// Hourly history of the core statistics, used for time ranges and charts.
model PlayerStatisticSnapshot {
  id         BigInt   @id @default(autoincrement())
  playerUuid String   @map("player_uuid") @db.Char(36)
  scope      String   @default("network") @db.VarChar(32)
  statKey    String   @map("stat_key") @db.VarChar(191)
  value      BigInt
  capturedAt DateTime @map("captured_at") @db.DateTime(3)

  player Player @relation(fields: [playerUuid], references: [uuid], onDelete: Cascade)

  /// One row per player, scope, key and hour (captured_at is truncated to the hour).
  @@unique([playerUuid, scope, statKey, capturedAt])
  @@index([playerUuid, statKey, capturedAt])
  @@index([capturedAt])
  @@map("player_statistic_snapshots")
}

// ──────────────────────────── Inventories ───────────────────────────

enum InventoryKind {
  INVENTORY
  ENDER_CHEST
}

enum InventoryRevisionStatus {
  SNAPSHOT
  PENDING
  APPLIED
  CONFLICT
  REJECTED
  ROLLED_BACK
  CANCELLED
}

/// Latest known inventory state. `revision` increments on every accepted
/// change and is used for optimistic concurrency (no duplication on conflict).
model PlayerInventory {
  id         String        @id @default(cuid()) @db.VarChar(32)
  playerUuid String        @map("player_uuid") @db.Char(36)
  scope      String        @default("network") @db.VarChar(32)
  kind       InventoryKind
  revision   Int           @default(0)
  contents   Json
  capturedAt DateTime      @map("captured_at") @db.DateTime(3)
  updatedAt  DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.DateTime(3)

  player    Player              @relation(fields: [playerUuid], references: [uuid], onDelete: Cascade)
  revisions InventoryRevision[]

  @@unique([playerUuid, scope, kind])
  @@map("player_inventories")
}

model InventoryRevision {
  id            String                  @id @default(cuid()) @db.VarChar(32)
  inventoryId   String                  @map("inventory_id") @db.VarChar(32)
  baseRevision  Int                     @map("base_revision")
  revision      Int?
  status        InventoryRevisionStatus
  /// Slot-level diff: [{ slot, before, after }]
  changes       Json
  actorUserId   String?                 @map("actor_user_id") @db.VarChar(32)
  reason        String?                 @db.VarChar(500)
  /// Why the server rejected or could not apply the change (conflict details).
  resultMessage String?                 @map("result_message") @db.VarChar(500)
  /// Set when this revision undoes another one.
  rollbackOfId  String?                 @map("rollback_of_id") @db.VarChar(32)
  createdAt     DateTime                @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.DateTime(3)
  appliedAt     DateTime?               @map("applied_at") @db.DateTime(3)

  inventory PlayerInventory @relation(fields: [inventoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  actor     DashboardUser?  @relation(fields: [actorUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([inventoryId, createdAt])
  @@index([status])
  @@map("inventory_revisions")
}

// ──────────────────────────── Punishments ───────────────────────────

enum PunishmentType {
  BAN
  TEMP_BAN
  MUTE
  TEMP_MUTE
  KICK
  WARNING
  BLACKLIST
}

enum PunishmentStatus {
  ACTIVE
  EXPIRED
  REVOKED
}

enum PunishmentSource {
  COMMAND
  DASHBOARD
  ANTICHEAT
  API
  CONSOLE
}

enum ActorType {
  USER
  PLAYER
  CONSOLE
  SERVER
  SYSTEM
}

model Punishment {
  id              String           @id @default(cuid()) @db.VarChar(32)
  targetUuid      String           @map("target_uuid") @db.Char(36)
  type            PunishmentType
  reason          String           @db.VarChar(500)
  status          PunishmentStatus @default(ACTIVE)
  source          PunishmentSource
  createdAt       DateTime         @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.DateTime(3)
  /// Null = permanent (or not applicable, e.g. kick/warning).
  expiresAt       DateTime?        @map("expires_at") @db.DateTime(3)
  issuerType      ActorType        @map("issuer_type")
  issuerUserId    String?          @map("issuer_user_id") @db.VarChar(32)
  issuerUuid      String?          @map("issuer_uuid") @db.Char(36)
  issuerName      String           @map("issuer_name") @db.VarChar(64)
  serverId        String?          @map("server_id") @db.VarChar(32)
  /// Client-supplied key making creation idempotent across retries.
  idempotencyKey  String?          @unique @map("idempotency_key") @db.VarChar(64)
  revokedAt       DateTime?        @map("revoked_at") @db.DateTime(3)
  revokedReason   String?          @map("revoked_reason") @db.VarChar(500)
  revokedByType   ActorType?       @map("revoked_by_type")
  revokedByUserId String?          @map("revoked_by_user_id") @db.VarChar(32)
  revokedByUuid   String?          @map("revoked_by_uuid") @db.Char(36)
  revokedByName   String?          @map("revoked_by_name") @db.VarChar(64)
  /// BLACKLIST only: IP address blocked together with the account (personal data).
  targetIp        String?          @map("target_ip") @db.VarChar(45)

  target          Player               @relation("PunishmentTarget", fields: [targetUuid], references: [uuid], onDelete: Cascade)
  issuerUser      DashboardUser?       @relation("PunishmentIssuer", fields: [issuerUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  revokedByUser   DashboardUser?       @relation("PunishmentRevoker", fields: [revokedByUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  server          Server?              @relation(fields: [serverId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  evidence        PunishmentEvidence[]
  changes         PunishmentChange[]
  antiCheatEvents AntiCheatEvent[]

  @@index([targetUuid, type, status])
  @@index([targetIp, type, status])
  @@index([status, type, expiresAt])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("punishments")
}

`apps/backend/src/anticheat/anticheat-rules.ts`:

```ts
import { z } from 'zod';
import { MAX_DURATION_SECONDS, MIN_DURATION_SECONDS } from '../punishments/punishment-rules';

export const ANTICHEAT_ACTIONS = ['NONE', 'WARNING', 'KICK', 'TEMP_BAN', 'BAN'] as const;
export type AntiCheatAction = (typeof ANTICHEAT_ACTIONS)[number];

export const cheatTypeSchema = z.string().trim().min(1).max(64).regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9 _.:-]+$/, 'Letters, digits, space, "_", ".", ":" and "-" only');

export const ruleSchema = z
  .object({
    action: z.enum(ANTICHEAT_ACTIONS),
    durationSeconds: z.number().int().min(MIN_DURATION_SECONDS).max(MAX_DURATION_SECONDS).nullable().default(null),
    /** Reports below this violation level are only logged. */
    minViolationLevel: z.number().min(0).max(1_000_000).default(0),
    /** No further automatic punishment for the same player and cheat type within this window. */
    cooldownSeconds: z.number().int().min(0).max(30 * 86_400).default(300),
  })
  .refine((r) => (r.action === 'TEMP_BAN') === (r.durationSeconds !== null), { message: 'A duration is required for TEMP_BAN and only allowed there', path: ['durationSeconds'] });

export const cheatRuleSchema = z.intersection(ruleSchema, z.object({ cheatType: cheatTypeSchema, enabled: z.boolean().default(true) }));

export const antiCheatSettingsSchema = z.object({
  enabled: z.boolean().default(true),
  /** Store evidence and metadata sent by integrations (may contain gameplay details). */
  collectEvidence: z.boolean().default(true),
  /** Applied to automatic reports without a matching rule. Default: log only. */
  defaultRule: ruleSchema.default({ action: 'NONE', durationSeconds: null, minViolationLevel: 0, cooldownSeconds: 300 }),
  /** Applied to explicit /anticheatban requests without a matching rule. */
  commandFallback: ruleSchema.default({ action: 'TEMP_BAN', durationSeconds: 30 * 86_400, minViolationLevel: 0, cooldownSeconds: 0 }),
  rules: z
    .array(cheatRuleSchema)
    .max(200)
    .default([])
    .refine((rules) => new Set(rules.map((r) => r.cheatType.toLowerCase())).size === rules.length, 'Cheat types must be unique'),
  /** Upper bound of automatic punishments per server and minute (protects against misbehaving integrations). */
  maxPunishmentsPerMinute: z.number().int().min(1).max(1000).default(30),
});

export type AntiCheatSettings = z.infer<typeof antiCheatSettingsSchema>;
export type Rule = z.infer<typeof ruleSchema>;

/** Example rules from the specification. Offered as a template in the dashboard, never applied automatically. */
export const EXAMPLE_RULES = [
  { cheatType: 'Speed', action: 'TEMP_BAN', durationSeconds: 30 * 86_400, minViolationLevel: 0, cooldownSeconds: 300, enabled: true },
  { cheatType: 'Fly', action: 'TEMP_BAN', durationSeconds: 14 * 86_400, minViolationLevel: 0, cooldownSeconds: 300, enabled: true },
  { cheatType: 'KillAura', action: 'BAN', durationSeconds: null, minViolationLevel: 0, cooldownSeconds: 300, enabled: true },
] as const;

export type Outcome =
  | AntiCheatAction
  | 'LOGGED'
  | 'DISABLED'
  | 'SKIPPED_THRESHOLD'
  | 'SKIPPED_COOLDOWN'
  | 'SKIPPED_RATE_LIMIT'
  | 'SKIPPED_DUPLICATE'
  | 'SKIPPED_OFFLINE';

export interface Decision {
  outcome: Outcome;
  rule: Rule | null;
  matchedCheatType: string | null;
}

/** Finds the enabled rule for a cheat type (case-insensitive). */
export function findRule(settings: AntiCheatSettings, cheatType: string): AntiCheatSettings['rules'][number] | null {
  const key = cheatType.trim().toLowerCase();
  return settings.rules.find((r) => r.enabled && r.cheatType.toLowerCase() === key) ?? null;
}

/** The rule that applies to a report: matching cheat-type rule, else the fallback for its kind. */
export function resolveRule(settings: AntiCheatSettings, cheatType: string, explicit: boolean): { rule: Rule; matchedCheatType: string | null } {
  const matched = findRule(settings, cheatType);
  return { rule: matched ?? (explicit ? settings.commandFallback : settings.defaultRule), matchedCheatType: matched?.cheatType ?? null };
}

/**
 * Pure decision step. Results of side-effect checks (cooldown, rate limit)
 * are passed in so the logic stays testable. Explicit requests skip the
 * violation-level threshold.
 */
export function decide(
  settings: AntiCheatSettings,
  report: { cheatType: string; violationLevel: number | null; explicit: boolean },
  checks: { inCooldown: boolean; rateLimited: boolean },
): Decision {
  if (!settings.enabled) return { outcome: 'DISABLED', rule: null, matchedCheatType: null };
  const { rule, matchedCheatType } = resolveRule(settings, report.cheatType, report.explicit);
  const base = { rule, matchedCheatType };
  if (rule.action === 'NONE') return { outcome: 'LOGGED', ...base };
  if (!report.explicit && (report.violationLevel ?? 0) < rule.minViolationLevel) return { outcome: 'SKIPPED_THRESHOLD', ...base };
  if (checks.inCooldown) return { outcome: 'SKIPPED_COOLDOWN', ...base };
  if (checks.rateLimited) return { outcome: 'SKIPPED_RATE_LIMIT', ...base };
  return { outcome: rule.action, ...base };
}

`apps/backend/src/anticheat/anticheat.controller.ts`:

```ts
import { Body, Controller, Get, HttpCode, Param, Post, Put, Query, Req, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { Throttle } from '@nestjs/throttler';
import { PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import type { Request } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { SkipCsrf } from '../auth/guards';
import { type AuthenticatedUser, clientIp, CurrentUser, Public, RequirePermissions } from '../common/auth-context';
import { startOfDayInTimezone } from '../common/time';
import { paginationSchema, ZodBody, ZodQuery } from '../common/zod';
import { AuditService, userActor } from '../audit/audit.service';
import { type PluginRequest, PluginAuthGuard } from '../plugin-api/plugin-auth.guard';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { SettingsService } from '../settings/settings.service';
import { antiCheatSettingsSchema, cheatTypeSchema, EXAMPLE_RULES } from './anticheat-rules';
import { ANTICHEAT_SETTINGS_KEY, AntiCheatService } from './anticheat.service';

const reportSchema = z.object({
  target: z.string().trim().min(1).max(36),
  provider: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64).regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9 _.-]+$/),
  cheatType: cheatTypeSchema,
  violationLevel: z.number().min(0).max(1_000_000).optional(),
  reason: z.string().trim().max(500).optional(),
  evidence: z.string().max(10_000).optional(),
  metadata: z
    .record(z.string().max(64), z.union([z.string().max(1000), z.number(), z.boolean(), z.null()]))
    .refine((m) => Object.keys(m).length <= 50, 'Too many metadata entries')
    .optional(),
  explicit: z.boolean().default(false),
  eventKey: z.string().min(8).max(64),
});

const eventsQuery = paginationSchema.extend({
  provider: z.string().max(64).optional(),
  cheatType: z.string().max(64).optional(),
  punished: z.enum(['true', 'false']).optional(),
});

/** Reports from AntiCheat integrations on Paper servers (signed plugin API). */
@ApiTags('plugin')
@Public()
@SkipCsrf()
@UseGuards(PluginAuthGuard)
@Throttle({ default: { limit: 600, ttl: 60_000 } })
@Controller('plugin/v1/anticheat')
export class PluginAntiCheatController {
  constructor(private readonly anticheat: AntiCheatService) {}

  @Post('reports')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @ZodBody(reportSchema)
  report(@Req() req: PluginRequest, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof reportSchema>) {
    const server = req.pluginServer!;
    return this.anticheat.report({ id: server.id, name: server.name }, body);
  }
}

@ApiTags('anticheat')
@Controller()
export class AntiCheatController {
  constructor(
    private readonly anticheat: AntiCheatService,
    private readonly settings: SettingsService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly audit: AuditService,
  ) {}

  @Get('anticheat/events')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.ANTICHEAT_VIEW)
  @ZodQuery(eventsQuery)
  events(@Query() q: z.infer<typeof eventsQuery>) {
    return this.anticheat.list({ ...q, punishedOnly: q.punished === 'true' });
  }

  @Get('anticheat/summary')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.ANTICHEAT_VIEW)
  async summary(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const timezone = user.timezone ?? (await this.settings.getNetwork()).defaultTimezone;
    return this.anticheat.summary(startOfDayInTimezone(timezone));
  }

  @Get('players/:uuid/anticheat')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.ANTICHEAT_VIEW)
  @ZodQuery(paginationSchema)
  forPlayer(@Param('uuid') raw: string, @Query() q: z.infer<typeof paginationSchema>) {
    return this.anticheat.list({ ...q, uuid: AntiCheatService.uuid(raw) });
  }

  @Get('anticheat/settings')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.ANTICHEAT_VIEW)
  async getSettings() {
    return { settings: await this.anticheat.getSettings(), examples: EXAMPLE_RULES };
  }

  /** Replaces rules and options. Takes effect for the next report (no plugin restart needed). */
  @Put('anticheat/settings')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.ANTICHEAT_MANAGE)
  @ZodBody(antiCheatSettingsSchema)
  async putSettings(@CurrentUser() actor: AuthenticatedUser, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof antiCheatSettingsSchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    const before = await this.anticheat.getSettings();
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await this.settings.set(ANTICHEAT_SETTINGS_KEY, body, actor.id, tx);
      await this.audit.record({ actor: userActor(actor), action: 'anticheat.settings_updated', targetType: 'setting', targetId: ANTICHEAT_SETTINGS_KEY, metadata: { before, after: body }, ipAddress: clientIp(req) }, tx);
    });
    return body;
  }
}

```ts
import { ConflictException, Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ActorType, type Prisma, PunishmentSource, PunishmentType } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { normalizeUuid } from '../players/players.controller';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { PunishmentsService } from '../punishments/punishments.service';
import { RealtimeService } from '../realtime/realtime.service';
import { SettingsService } from '../settings/settings.service';
import { type AntiCheatSettings, antiCheatSettingsSchema, decide, type Outcome, resolveRule } from './anticheat-rules';

export const ANTICHEAT_SETTINGS_KEY = 'anticheat';
const PUNISHING_OUTCOMES: Outcome[] = ['WARNING', 'KICK', 'TEMP_BAN', 'BAN'];
const ACTION_TO_TYPE: Record<'WARNING' | 'KICK' | 'TEMP_BAN' | 'BAN', PunishmentType> = {
  WARNING: PunishmentType.WARNING,
  KICK: PunishmentType.KICK,
  TEMP_BAN: PunishmentType.TEMP_BAN,
  BAN: PunishmentType.BAN,
};

export interface AntiCheatReport {
  target: string;
  provider: string;
  cheatType: string;
  violationLevel?: number;
  reason?: string;
  evidence?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  explicit: boolean;
  eventKey: string;
}

@Injectable()
export class AntiCheatService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly settings: SettingsService,
    private readonly punishments: PunishmentsService,
    private readonly realtime: RealtimeService,
  ) {}

  async getSettings(): Promise<AntiCheatSettings> {
    const parsed = antiCheatSettingsSchema.safeParse((await this.settings.get<unknown>(ANTICHEAT_SETTINGS_KEY)) ?? {});
    return parsed.success ? parsed.data : antiCheatSettingsSchema.parse({});
  }

  /**
   * Records a report and applies the matching rule. Idempotent per eventKey:
   * a retried report returns the original outcome without punishing twice.
   */
  async report(server: { id: string; name: string }, input: AntiCheatReport) {
    const eventKey = `${server.id}:${input.eventKey}`;
    const existing = await this.prisma.antiCheatEvent.findUnique({ where: { eventKey } });
    if (existing) return this.result(existing.id, existing.outcome as Outcome, existing.punishmentId);

    const player = await this.punishments.resolvePlayer(input.target);
    const settings = await this.getSettings();
    const now = new Date();
    const cheatType = input.cheatType.trim();

    const { rule } = resolveRule(settings, cheatType, input.explicit);
    const [inCooldown, recentPunishments] = await Promise.all([
      rule.cooldownSeconds > 0
        ? this.prisma.antiCheatEvent
            .count({ where: { playerUuid: player.uuid, cheatType, outcome: { in: PUNISHING_OUTCOMES }, createdAt: { gt: new Date(now.getTime() - rule.cooldownSeconds * 1000) } } })
            .then((n) => n > 0)
        : Promise.resolve(false),
      this.prisma.antiCheatEvent.count({ where: { serverId: server.id, outcome: { in: PUNISHING_OUTCOMES }, createdAt: { gt: new Date(now.getTime() - 60_000) } } }),
    ]);
    const decision = decide(settings, { cheatType, violationLevel: input.violationLevel ?? null, explicit: input.explicit }, { inCooldown, rateLimited: recentPunishments >= settings.maxPunishmentsPerMinute });
    let outcome = decision.outcome;

    let punishmentId: string | null = null;
    if (PUNISHING_OUTCOMES.includes(outcome) && decision.rule) {
      const action = outcome as keyof typeof ACTION_TO_TYPE;
      if (action === 'KICK' && !player.online) {
        outcome = 'SKIPPED_OFFLINE';
      } else {
        try {
          const created = await this.punishments.create({
            type: ACTION_TO_TYPE[action],
            targetUuid: player.uuid,
            reason: (input.reason?.trim() || `[AntiCheat] ${cheatType}`).slice(0, 500),
            durationSeconds: action === 'TEMP_BAN' ? (decision.rule.durationSeconds ?? undefined) : undefined,
            source: PunishmentSource.ANTICHEAT,
            issuer: { type: ActorType.SERVER, name: `AntiCheat (${input.provider})`.slice(0, 64) },
            serverId: server.id,
            idempotencyKey: `ac:${eventKey}`.slice(0, 64),
          });
          punishmentId = created.id;
          if (settings.collectEvidence) {
            await this.prisma.punishmentEvidence.create({
              data: {
                punishmentId,
                kind: 'anticheat',
                content: input.evidence?.slice(0, 10_000) ?? null,
                metadata: { provider: input.provider, cheatType, violationLevel: input.violationLevel ?? null, rule: decision.matchedCheatType, details: (input.metadata ?? {}) as Prisma.InputJsonValue },
              },
            });
          }
        } catch (err) {
          if (err instanceof ConflictException) outcome = 'SKIPPED_DUPLICATE';
          else throw err;
        }
      }
    }

    const event = await this.prisma.antiCheatEvent.create({
      data: {
        playerUuid: player.uuid,
        serverId: server.id,
        provider: input.provider,
        cheatType,
        violationLevel: input.violationLevel ?? null,
        outcome,
        reason: input.reason?.slice(0, 500) ?? null,
        explicit: input.explicit,
        eventKey,
        punishmentId,
        metadata: settings.collectEvidence ? ({ evidence: input.evidence?.slice(0, 10_000) ?? null, ...(input.metadata ?? {}) } as Prisma.InputJsonValue) : undefined,
      },
    });
    this.realtime.publish({ type: 'anticheat.event', uuid: player.uuid });
    return this.result(event.id, outcome, punishmentId);
  }

  async list(filter: { page: number; pageSize: number; uuid?: string; provider?: string; cheatType?: string; punishedOnly?: boolean }) {
    const where: Prisma.AntiCheatEventWhereInput = {
      ...(filter.uuid ? { playerUuid: filter.uuid } : {}),
      ...(filter.provider ? { provider: filter.provider } : {}),
      ...(filter.cheatType ? { cheatType: filter.cheatType } : {}),
      ...(filter.punishedOnly ? { punishmentId: { not: null } } : {}),
    };
    const [total, rows] = await this.prisma.$transaction([
      this.prisma.antiCheatEvent.count({ where }),
      this.prisma.antiCheatEvent.findMany({
        where,
        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
        skip: (filter.page - 1) * filter.pageSize,
        take: filter.pageSize,
        include: { player: { select: { uuid: true, username: true, online: true } }, server: { select: { id: true, name: true } } },
      }),
    ]);
    return {
      total,
      page: filter.page,
      pageSize: filter.pageSize,
      items: rows.map((e) => ({
        id: e.id,
        player: e.player,
        server: e.server,
        provider: e.provider,
        cheatType: e.cheatType,
        violationLevel: e.violationLevel,
        outcome: e.outcome,
        explicit: e.explicit,
        reason: e.reason,
        punishmentId: e.punishmentId,
        metadata: e.metadata,
        createdAt: e.createdAt.toISOString(),
      })),
    };
  }

  /** Counters for the AntiCheat page header. */
  async summary(since: Date) {
    const [events, punished, byType, providers] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.antiCheatEvent.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: since } } }),
      this.prisma.antiCheatEvent.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: since }, punishmentId: { not: null } } }),
      this.prisma.antiCheatEvent.groupBy({ by: ['cheatType'], where: { createdAt: { gte: since } }, _count: { _all: true }, orderBy: { _count: { cheatType: 'desc' } }, take: 8 }),
      this.prisma.antiCheatEvent.findMany({ distinct: ['provider'], select: { provider: true }, take: 50 }),
    ]);
    return {
      since: since.toISOString(),
      events,
      punished,
      topCheatTypes: byType.map((t) => ({ cheatType: t.cheatType, count: t._count._all })),
      providers: providers.map((p) => p.provider).sort(),
    };
  }

  private result(eventId: string, outcome: Outcome, punishmentId: string | null) {
    return { eventId, outcome, punishmentId };
  }

  /** Validates a dashboard UUID parameter. */
  static uuid(raw: string): string {
    const uuid = normalizeUuid(raw);
    if (!uuid) throw new NotFoundException();
    return uuid;
  }
}

`apps/backend/src/audit/audit.service.ts`:

```ts
import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { AuthenticatedUser } from '../common/auth-context';
import { ActorType, type Prisma } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';

export interface AuditActor {
  type: ActorType;
  userId?: string | null;
  name: string;
}

export interface AuditEntry {
  actor: AuditActor;
  action: string;
  targetType?: string;
  targetId?: string;
  metadata?: Prisma.InputJsonValue;
  ipAddress?: string | null;
}

export const SYSTEM_ACTOR: AuditActor = { type: ActorType.SYSTEM, name: 'system' };

export function userActor(user: Pick<AuthenticatedUser, 'id' | 'username'>): AuditActor {
  return { type: ActorType.USER, userId: user.id, name: user.username };
}

/** Append-only audit trail. Pass a transaction client to make the entry atomic with the change. */
@Injectable()
export class AuditService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(AuditService.name);

  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  async record(entry: AuditEntry, tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient): Promise<void> {
    const client = tx ?? this.prisma;
    await client.auditLog.create({
      data: {
        actorType: entry.actor.type,
        actorUserId: entry.actor.userId ?? null,
        actorName: entry.actor.name.slice(0, 64),
        action: entry.action,
        targetType: entry.targetType ?? null,
        targetId: entry.targetId ?? null,
        metadata: entry.metadata,
        ipAddress: entry.ipAddress ?? null,
      },
    });
    this.logger.debug(`${entry.actor.name} → ${entry.action} ${entry.targetType ?? ''}:${entry.targetId ?? ''}`);
  }

  async list(params: { page: number; pageSize: number; action?: string; actorUserId?: string; targetType?: string; targetId?: string }) {
    const where: Prisma.AuditLogWhereInput = {
      ...(params.action ? { action: { startsWith: params.action } } : {}),
      ...(params.actorUserId ? { actorUserId: params.actorUserId } : {}),
      ...(params.targetType ? { targetType: params.targetType } : {}),
      ...(params.targetId ? { targetId: params.targetId } : {}),
    };
    const [total, rows] = await this.prisma.$transaction([
      this.prisma.auditLog.count({ where }),
      this.prisma.auditLog.findMany({
        where,
        orderBy: { id: 'desc' },
        skip: (params.page - 1) * params.pageSize,
        take: params.pageSize,
      }),
    ]);
    return {
      total,
      page: params.page,
      pageSize: params.pageSize,
      items: rows.map((r) => ({
        id: r.id.toString(),
        actorType: r.actorType,
        actorUserId: r.actorUserId,
        actorName: r.actorName,
        action: r.action,
        targetType: r.targetType,
        targetId: r.targetId,
        metadata: r.metadata,
        createdAt: r.createdAt.toISOString(),
      })),
    };
  }
}

`apps/backend/src/auth/auth.controller.ts`:

```ts
import { BadRequestException, Body, Controller, Get, HttpCode, Patch, Post, Req, Res, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { Throttle } from '@nestjs/throttler';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { type AuthenticatedUser, clientIp, CurrentUser, Public } from '../common/auth-context';
import { localeSchema, passwordSchema, themeSchema, timezoneSchema } from '../common/validation';
import { ZodBody } from '../common/zod';
import { AppConfig } from '../config/app-config';
import { AuditService, userActor } from '../audit/audit.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { clearSessionCookies, REFRESH_COOKIE, setSessionCookies } from './cookies';
import { PasswordService } from './password.service';

const loginSchema = z.object({
  identifier: z.string().trim().min(1).max(254),
  password: z.string().min(1).max(256),
});

const preferencesSchema = z
  .object({
    locale: localeSchema.nullable().optional(),
    theme: themeSchema.nullable().optional(),
    timezone: timezoneSchema.nullable().optional(),
  })
  .strict();

const changePasswordSchema = z.object({ currentPassword: z.string().min(1).max(256), newPassword: passwordSchema });

@ApiTags('auth')
@Controller('auth')
export class AuthController {
  constructor(
    private readonly auth: AuthService,
    private readonly config: AppConfig,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly passwords: PasswordService,
    private readonly audit: AuditService,
  ) {}

  @Public()
  @Post('login')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @Throttle({ default: { limit: 5, ttl: 60_000, blockDuration: 300_000 } })
  @ZodBody(loginSchema)
  async login(@Body() body: z.infer<typeof loginSchema>, @Req() req: Request, @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response) {
    const session = await this.auth.login(body.identifier, body.password, { ip: clientIp(req), userAgent: req.header('user-agent') ?? null });
    setSessionCookies(res, req, this.config, session);
    return { ok: true };
  }

  @Public()
  @Post('refresh')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @Throttle({ default: { limit: 30, ttl: 60_000 } })
  async refresh(@Req() req: Request, @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response) {
    const token = req.cookies?.[REFRESH_COOKIE] as string | undefined;
    if (!token) throw new UnauthorizedException({ code: 'SESSION_INVALID', message: 'No session' });
    try {
      const session = await this.auth.refresh(token);
      setSessionCookies(res, req, this.config, session);
      return { ok: true };
    } catch (err) {
      clearSessionCookies(res, req, this.config);
      throw err;
    }
  }

  @Post('logout')
  @HttpCode(200)
  async logout(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser, @Req() req: Request, @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response) {
    await this.auth.logout(user, clientIp(req));
    clearSessionCookies(res, req, this.config);
    return { ok: true };
  }

  @Get('me')
  me(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const { sessionId: _sessionId, ...profile } = user;
    return profile;
  }

  @Patch('me')
  @ZodBody(preferencesSchema)
  async updatePreferences(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof preferencesSchema>) {
    if (body.locale) {
      const language = await this.prisma.languageSetting.findUnique({ where: { locale: body.locale } });
      if (!language?.enabled) throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'LOCALE_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'Language is not enabled' });
    }
    const updated = await this.prisma.dashboardUser.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: { locale: body.locale, theme: body.theme, timezone: body.timezone },
      select: { locale: true, theme: true, timezone: true },
    });
    return updated;
  }

  @Post('me/password')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @Throttle({ default: { limit: 5, ttl: 60_000 } })
  @ZodBody(changePasswordSchema)
  async changePassword(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Body() body: z.infer<typeof changePasswordSchema>,
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response,
  ) {
    const record = await this.prisma.dashboardUser.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: user.id } });
    if (!(await this.passwords.verify(record.passwordHash, body.currentPassword))) {
      throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'INVALID_PASSWORD', message: 'Current password is incorrect' });
    }
    await this.prisma.dashboardUser.update({ where: { id: user.id }, data: { passwordHash: await this.passwords.hash(body.newPassword) } });
    // Invalidate every other session, then issue a fresh one for this browser.
    await this.auth.revokeAllSessions(user.id);
    const session = await this.auth.issueSession(user.id, { ip: clientIp(req), userAgent: req.header('user-agent') ?? null });
    setSessionCookies(res, req, this.config, session);
    await this.audit.record({ actor: userActor(user), action: 'auth.password_changed', targetType: 'dashboard_user', targetId: user.id, ipAddress: clientIp(req) });
    return { ok: true };
  }
}

`apps/backend/src/auth/auth.service.ts`:

```ts
import { ForbiddenException, HttpException, HttpStatus, Injectable, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import type { AuthenticatedUser } from '../common/auth-context';
import { randomToken, sha256Hex } from '../common/crypto';
import { AppConfig } from '../config/app-config';
import { ActorType } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { AuditService } from '../audit/audit.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { RedisService } from '../redis/redis.service';
import { PasswordService } from './password.service';

/** Failed logins per account before a temporary lock. */
export const MAX_LOGIN_FAILURES = 10;
export const LOGIN_LOCKOUT_SECONDS = 15 * 60;

interface AccessTokenPayload {
  sub: string;
  sid: string;
}

export interface IssuedSession {
  accessToken: string;
  refreshToken: string;
  refreshExpiresAt: Date;
}

const JWT_AUDIENCE = 'mnm-dashboard';

@Injectable()
export class AuthService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly jwt: JwtService,
    private readonly passwords: PasswordService,
    private readonly audit: AuditService,
    private readonly config: AppConfig,
    private readonly redis: RedisService,
  ) {}

  async login(identifier: string, password: string, meta: { ip: string | null; userAgent: string | null }): Promise<IssuedSession> {
    const normalized = identifier.trim();
    // Per-account lockout, independent of the client IP (which may be spoofable
    // when no trusted reverse proxy is in front of the dashboard).
    const failureKey = `mnm:login-failures:${sha256Hex(normalized.toLowerCase())}`;
    const failures = Number((await this.redis.client.get(failureKey).catch(() => null)) ?? 0);
    if (failures >= MAX_LOGIN_FAILURES) {
      throw new HttpException({ code: 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED', message: 'Too many failed attempts. Try again later.' }, HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS);
    }

    const user = await this.prisma.dashboardUser.findFirst({
      where: normalized.includes('@') ? { email: normalized.toLowerCase() } : { username: normalized },
    });
    const valid = await this.passwords.verify(user?.passwordHash ?? null, password);

    if (!user || !valid) {
      await this.redis.client
        .multi()
        .incr(failureKey)
        .expire(failureKey, LOGIN_LOCKOUT_SECONDS)
        .exec()
        .catch(() => undefined);
      await this.audit.record({
        actor: { type: ActorType.SYSTEM, name: 'auth' },
        action: 'auth.login_failed',
        targetType: user ? 'dashboard_user' : undefined,
        targetId: user?.id,
        metadata: { identifier: normalized.slice(0, 64) },
        ipAddress: meta.ip,
      });
      throw new UnauthorizedException({ code: 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS', message: 'Invalid username or password' });
    }
    if (user.disabled) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'ACCOUNT_DISABLED', message: 'This account is disabled' });
    }

    await this.redis.client.del(failureKey).catch(() => undefined);
    const session = await this.issueSession(user.id, meta);
    await this.prisma.dashboardUser.update({ where: { id: user.id }, data: { lastLoginAt: new Date() } });
    await this.audit.record({
      actor: { type: ActorType.USER, userId: user.id, name: user.username },
      action: 'auth.login',
      targetType: 'dashboard_user',
      targetId: user.id,
      ipAddress: meta.ip,
    });
    return session;
  }

  async issueSession(userId: string, meta: { ip: string | null; userAgent: string | null }): Promise<IssuedSession> {
    const refreshToken = randomToken(48);
    const refreshExpiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + this.config.env.REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_DAYS * 86_400_000);
    const session = await this.prisma.dashboardSession.create({
      data: {
        userId,
        refreshTokenHash: sha256Hex(refreshToken),
        expiresAt: refreshExpiresAt,
        ipAddress: meta.ip,
        userAgent: meta.userAgent?.slice(0, 255) ?? null,
      },
    });
    return { accessToken: await this.signAccessToken({ sub: userId, sid: session.id }), refreshToken, refreshExpiresAt };
  }

  /** Rotates the refresh token. A token can only be used once. */
  async refresh(refreshToken: string): Promise<IssuedSession> {
    const session = await this.prisma.dashboardSession.findUnique({
      where: { refreshTokenHash: sha256Hex(refreshToken) },
      include: { user: true },
    });
    if (!session || session.revokedAt || session.expiresAt < new Date() || session.user.disabled) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException({ code: 'SESSION_INVALID', message: 'Session expired' });
    }
    const nextRefresh = randomToken(48);
    const rotated = await this.prisma.dashboardSession.updateMany({
      where: { id: session.id, refreshTokenHash: session.refreshTokenHash, revokedAt: null },
      data: { refreshTokenHash: sha256Hex(nextRefresh), lastUsedAt: new Date() },
    });
    if (rotated.count !== 1) throw new UnauthorizedException({ code: 'SESSION_INVALID', message: 'Session expired' });
    return {
      accessToken: await this.signAccessToken({ sub: session.userId, sid: session.id }),
      refreshToken: nextRefresh,
      refreshExpiresAt: session.expiresAt,
    };
  }

  async logout(user: AuthenticatedUser, ip: string | null): Promise<void> {
    await this.prisma.dashboardSession.updateMany({ where: { id: user.sessionId, revokedAt: null }, data: { revokedAt: new Date() } });
    await this.audit.record({ actor: { type: ActorType.USER, userId: user.id, name: user.username }, action: 'auth.logout', ipAddress: ip });
  }

  async revokeAllSessions(userId: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.prisma.dashboardSession.updateMany({ where: { userId, revokedAt: null }, data: { revokedAt: new Date() } });
  }

  /** Verifies an access token and loads the live user, role and permissions. */
  async authenticate(accessToken: string): Promise<AuthenticatedUser | null> {
    let payload: AccessTokenPayload;
    try {
      payload = await this.jwt.verifyAsync<AccessTokenPayload>(accessToken, { audience: JWT_AUDIENCE });
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
    return this.authenticateSession(payload.sid, payload.sub);
  }

  /** Loads a live session with the user's current role and permissions; null when revoked, expired or disabled. */
  async authenticateSession(sessionId: string, userId: string): Promise<AuthenticatedUser | null> {
    const session = await this.prisma.dashboardSession.findUnique({
      where: { id: sessionId },
      include: { user: { include: { role: { include: { permissions: true } } } } },
    });
    if (!session || session.userId !== userId || session.revokedAt || session.expiresAt < new Date() || session.user.disabled) {
      return null;
    }
    const { user } = session;
    return {
      id: user.id,
      username: user.username,
      email: user.email,
      roleId: user.roleId,
      roleKey: user.role.key,
      rolePriority: user.role.priority,
      permissions: user.role.permissions.map((p) => p.permission),
      sessionId: session.id,
      locale: user.locale,
      theme: user.theme,
      timezone: user.timezone,
    };
  }

  private signAccessToken(payload: AccessTokenPayload): Promise<string> {
    return this.jwt.signAsync(payload, { audience: JWT_AUDIENCE, expiresIn: this.config.env.ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS });
  }
}

`apps/backend/src/auth/cookies.ts`:

```ts
import type { CookieOptions, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { AppConfig } from '../config/app-config';

export const ACCESS_COOKIE = 'mnm_access';
export const REFRESH_COOKIE = 'mnm_refresh';
/** Mutating requests authenticated by cookie must carry this header (CSRF defence). */
export const CSRF_HEADER = 'x-mnm-csrf';

function baseOptions(config: AppConfig, req: Request): CookieOptions {
  const mode = config.env.COOKIE_SECURE;
  const secure = mode === 'true' || (mode === 'auto' && req.secure);
  return { httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'strict', secure };
}

export function setSessionCookies(
  res: Response,
  req: Request,
  config: AppConfig,
  tokens: { accessToken: string; refreshToken: string; refreshExpiresAt: Date },
): void {
  const base = baseOptions(config, req);
  res.cookie(ACCESS_COOKIE, tokens.accessToken, { ...base, path: '/', maxAge: config.env.ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS * 1000 });
  res.cookie(REFRESH_COOKIE, tokens.refreshToken, { ...base, path: '/api/auth', expires: tokens.refreshExpiresAt });
}

export function clearSessionCookies(res: Response, req: Request, config: AppConfig): void {
  const base = baseOptions(config, req);
  res.clearCookie(ACCESS_COOKIE, { ...base, path: '/' });
  res.clearCookie(REFRESH_COOKIE, { ...base, path: '/api/auth' });
}

`apps/backend/src/auth/guards.ts`:

```ts
import { type CanActivate, type ExecutionContext, ForbiddenException, Injectable, SetMetadata, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { hasPermission } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { type AuthenticatedRequest, IS_PUBLIC_KEY, PERMISSIONS_KEY } from '../common/auth-context';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { ACCESS_COOKIE, CSRF_HEADER } from './cookies';

export const SKIP_CSRF_KEY = 'mnm:skipCsrf';
/** For machine-to-machine routes (plugins) that never use cookies. */
export const SkipCsrf = () => SetMetadata(SKIP_CSRF_KEY, true);

const SAFE_METHODS = new Set(['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS']);

/**
 * Authenticates dashboard sessions (cookie or Bearer token) and enforces the
 * CSRF header on state-changing requests. Public routes still get `req.user`
 * attached when a valid session is present.
 */
@Injectable()
export class SessionGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(
    private readonly reflector: Reflector,
    private readonly auth: AuthService,
  ) {}

  async canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): Promise<boolean> {
    if (context.getType() !== 'http') return true;
    const req = context.switchToHttp().getRequest<AuthenticatedRequest>();
    const targets = [context.getHandler(), context.getClass()];
    const isPublic = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<boolean>(IS_PUBLIC_KEY, targets) ?? false;
    const skipCsrf = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<boolean>(SKIP_CSRF_KEY, targets) ?? false;

    if (!skipCsrf && !SAFE_METHODS.has(req.method) && req.header(CSRF_HEADER) !== '1') {
      throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'CSRF_HEADER_MISSING', message: 'Missing CSRF header' });
    }

    const header = req.header('authorization');
    const token = header?.startsWith('Bearer ') ? header.slice(7) : (req.cookies?.[ACCESS_COOKIE] as string | undefined);
    if (token) {
      const user = await this.auth.authenticate(token);
      if (user) req.user = user;
    }
    if (!isPublic && !req.user) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException({ code: 'UNAUTHENTICATED', message: 'Authentication required' });
    }
    return true;
  }
}

/** Enforces @RequirePermissions on the server; frontend checks are cosmetic only. */
@Injectable()
export class PermissionsGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(private readonly reflector: Reflector) {}

  canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): boolean {
    const required = this.reflector.getAllAndMerge<string[]>(PERMISSIONS_KEY, [context.getHandler(), context.getClass()]) ?? [];
    if (required.length === 0) return true;
    const req = context.switchToHttp().getRequest<AuthenticatedRequest>();
    const granted = req.user?.permissions ?? [];
    const missing = required.filter((p) => !hasPermission(granted, p));
    if (missing.length > 0) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: `Missing permission: ${missing.join(', ')}` });
    }
    return true;
  }
}

`apps/backend/src/auth/password.service.ts`:

```ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import argon2 from 'argon2';

export const MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 12;

/** Argon2id hashing with OWASP-recommended parameters. */
@Injectable()
export class PasswordService {
  private static readonly options = { type: argon2.argon2id, memoryCost: 19456, timeCost: 2, parallelism: 1 } as const;
  // Pre-computed hash used to keep timing uniform when a user does not exist.
  private dummyHash: Promise<string> | null = null;

  hash(password: string): Promise<string> {
    return argon2.hash(password, PasswordService.options);
  }

  async verify(hash: string | null, password: string): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!hash) {
      this.dummyHash ??= this.hash('timing-equalisation-placeholder');
      await argon2.verify(await this.dummyHash, password).catch(() => false);
      return false;
    }
    return argon2.verify(hash, password).catch(() => false);
  }
}

import { createParamDecorator, type ExecutionContext, SetMetadata } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Request } from 'express';

export interface AuthenticatedUser {
  id: string;
  username: string;
  email: string;
  roleId: string;
  roleKey: string;
  rolePriority: number;
  permissions: string[];
  sessionId: string;
  locale: string | null;
  theme: string | null;
  timezone: string | null;
}

export type AuthenticatedRequest = Request & { user?: AuthenticatedUser };

export const IS_PUBLIC_KEY = 'mnm:isPublic';
export const PERMISSIONS_KEY = 'mnm:permissions';

/** Marks a route as reachable without a dashboard session. */
export const Public = () => SetMetadata(IS_PUBLIC_KEY, true);

/** All listed permissions are required (checked server-side by PermissionsGuard). */
export const RequirePermissions = (...permissions: string[]) => SetMetadata(PERMISSIONS_KEY, permissions);

export const CurrentUser = createParamDecorator((_data: unknown, ctx: ExecutionContext): AuthenticatedUser => {
  const req = ctx.switchToHttp().getRequest<AuthenticatedRequest>();
  if (!req.user) throw new Error('CurrentUser used on a public route');
  return req.user;
});

/** Client IP as resolved by Express (honours the configured trust proxy). */
export function clientIp(req: Request): string | null {
  return req.ip ?? null;
}

`apps/backend/src/common/crypto.ts`:

```ts
import { createHash, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';

/** URL-safe random token with `bytes` bytes of entropy. */
export function randomToken(bytes = 32): string {
  return randomBytes(bytes).toString('base64url');
}

/** Human-friendly code (no ambiguous characters), grouped as XXXX-XXXX-... */
export function randomCode(groups = 4, groupLength = 4): string {
  const alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
  const bytes = randomBytes(groups * groupLength);
  const chars = Array.from(bytes, (b) => alphabet[b % alphabet.length]);
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < groups; i++) parts.push(chars.slice(i * groupLength, (i + 1) * groupLength).join(''));
  return parts.join('-');
}

export function sha256Hex(value: string): string {
  return createHash('sha256').update(value, 'utf8').digest('hex');
}

/** Constant-time comparison of two strings via their SHA-256 digests. */
export function safeEqual(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  return timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(sha256Hex(a), 'hex'), Buffer.from(sha256Hex(b), 'hex'));
}

`apps/backend/src/common/http-exception.filter.ts`:

```ts
import { type ArgumentsHost, Catch, type ExceptionFilter, HttpException, HttpStatus, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Response } from 'express';
import { Prisma } from '../generated/prisma/client';

/**
 * Converts every error into a stable JSON shape without leaking stack traces,
 * SQL or internal messages to clients.
 */
@Catch()
export class AllExceptionsFilter implements ExceptionFilter {
  private readonly logger = new Logger('ExceptionFilter');

  catch(exception: unknown, host: ArgumentsHost): void {
    const res = host.switchToHttp().getResponse<Response>();

    if (exception instanceof HttpException) {
      const status = exception.getStatus();
      const body = exception.getResponse();
      const payload =
        typeof body === 'string'
          ? { message: body }
          : (body as Record<string, unknown>);
      res.status(status).json({
        statusCode: status,
        code: (payload.code as string | undefined) ?? HttpStatus[status] ?? 'ERROR',
        message: Array.isArray(payload.message) ? payload.message.join(', ') : (payload.message ?? exception.message),
        ...(payload.issues ? { issues: payload.issues } : {}),
      });
      return;
    }

    if (exception instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && exception.code === 'P2002') {
      res.status(HttpStatus.CONFLICT).json({ statusCode: 409, code: 'CONFLICT', message: 'A record with these values already exists' });
      return;
    }
    if (exception instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && exception.code === 'P2025') {
      res.status(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND).json({ statusCode: 404, code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Record not found' });
      return;
    }

    this.logger.error(exception instanceof Error ? (exception.stack ?? exception.message) : String(exception));
    res.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).json({ statusCode: 500, code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: 'Internal server error' });
  }
}

`apps/backend/src/common/time.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Returns the UTC instant at which the current calendar day began in `timeZone`.
 * Handles DST transitions by measuring the zone offset at the computed instant.
 */
export function startOfDayInTimezone(timeZone: string, now: Date = new Date()): Date {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone,
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit',
  }).formatToParts(now);
  const get = (type: string) => Number(parts.find((p) => p.type === type)?.value);
  const midnightAsUtc = Date.UTC(get('year'), get('month') - 1, get('day'));
  // Offset of the zone at (approximately) local midnight.
  const offset = zoneOffsetMs(timeZone, new Date(midnightAsUtc));
  const candidate = new Date(midnightAsUtc - offset);
  // Re-check in case the offset changed between UTC midnight and local midnight.
  const offset2 = zoneOffsetMs(timeZone, candidate);
  return offset2 === offset ? candidate : new Date(midnightAsUtc - offset2);
}

function zoneOffsetMs(timeZone: string, at: Date): number {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
    timeZone,
    hourCycle: 'h23',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    second: '2-digit',
  }).formatToParts(at);
  const get = (type: string) => Number(parts.find((p) => p.type === type)?.value);
  const asUtc = Date.UTC(get('year'), get('month') - 1, get('day'), get('hour'), get('minute'), get('second'));
  return asUtc - Math.floor(at.getTime() / 1000) * 1000;
}

`apps/backend/src/common/zod.ts`:

```ts
import { applyDecorators, BadRequestException, Injectable, type PipeTransform, UsePipes } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiBody, ApiQuery } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { z, type ZodType } from 'zod';

@Injectable()
export class ZodValidationPipe<T extends ZodType> implements PipeTransform {
  constructor(
    private readonly schema: T,
    private readonly target: 'body' | 'query',
  ) {}

  transform(value: unknown, metadata: { type: string }) {
    if (metadata.type !== this.target) return value;
    const result = this.schema.safeParse(value ?? {});
    if (!result.success) {
      throw new BadRequestException({
        code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED',
        message: 'Request validation failed',
        issues: result.error.issues.map((i) => ({ path: i.path.join('.'), message: i.message })),
      });
    }
    return result.data;
  }
}

/** Validates the request body with a Zod schema and documents it in OpenAPI. */
export function ZodBody(schema: ZodType) {
  return applyDecorators(
    UsePipes(new ZodValidationPipe(schema, 'body')),
    ApiBody({ schema: z.toJSONSchema(schema, { io: 'input', unrepresentable: 'any' }) as object }),
  );
}

/** Validates query parameters with a Zod object schema. */
export function ZodQuery(schema: z.ZodObject) {
  const decorators = [UsePipes(new ZodValidationPipe(schema, 'query'))];
  for (const [name, field] of Object.entries(schema.shape)) {
    decorators.push(ApiQuery({ name, required: !(field as ZodType).safeParse(undefined).success, type: String }));
  }
  return applyDecorators(...decorators);
}

export const paginationSchema = z.object({
  page: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).default(1),
  pageSize: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(25),
});

`apps/backend/src/config/app-config.ts`:

```ts
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import type { Env } from './env';

/** Injectable, typed access to validated configuration. */
export class AppConfig {
  readonly version: string;

  constructor(readonly env: Env) {
    this.version = readVersion();
  }

  get isProduction(): boolean {
    return this.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';
  }
}

function readVersion(): string {
  if (process.env.APP_VERSION) return process.env.APP_VERSION;
  try {
    // dist/config/app-config.js -> ../../package.json
    const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(__dirname, '..', '..', 'package.json'), 'utf8')) as { version?: string };
    return pkg.version ?? '0.0.0';
  } catch {
    return '0.0.0';
  }
}

`apps/backend/src/config/env.ts`:

```ts
import { z } from 'zod';

const booleanString = z.enum(['true', 'false', '1', '0']).transform((v) => v === 'true' || v === '1');

/** Environment schema. The process refuses to start when required values are missing or weak. */
export const envSchema = z.object({
  NODE_ENV: z.enum(['development', 'production', 'test']).default('production'),
  PORT: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(65535).default(4000),
  DATABASE_URL: z.string().regex(/^mysql:\/\//, 'DATABASE_URL must be a mysql:// URL'),
  REDIS_URL: z.string().regex(/^rediss?:\/\//, 'REDIS_URL must be a redis:// URL'),
  JWT_SECRET: z.string().min(32, 'JWT_SECRET must be at least 32 characters'),
  /** auto = set the Secure cookie flag when the request arrived over HTTPS (honours TRUST_PROXY). */
  COOKIE_SECURE: z.enum(['auto', 'true', 'false']).default('auto'),
  TRUST_PROXY: z.string().default('loopback, linklocal, uniquelocal'),
  /** Optional fixed setup code. When empty a random code is generated and logged at startup. */
  SETUP_TOKEN: z
    .string()
    .optional()
    .transform((v) => (v ? v : undefined))
    .refine((v) => v === undefined || v.length >= 16, 'SETUP_TOKEN must be at least 16 characters'),
  API_DOCS_ENABLED: booleanString.default(true),
  ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS: z.coerce.number().int().min(60).max(3600).default(900),
  REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_DAYS: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(90).default(14),
  REGISTRATION_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES: z.coerce.number().int().min(5).max(1440).default(30),
  /** Optional MaxMind GeoLite2 databases for approximate IP geolocation. */
  GEOIP_CITY_DB: z.string().optional().transform((v) => v || undefined),
  GEOIP_ASN_DB: z.string().optional().transform((v) => v || undefined),
});

export type Env = z.infer<typeof envSchema>;

export function parseEnv(source: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): Env {
  const result = envSchema.safeParse(source);
  if (!result.success) {
    const details = result.error.issues.map((i) => `  - ${i.path.join('.')}: ${i.message}`).join('\n');
    throw new Error(`Invalid environment configuration:\n${details}`);
  }
  return result.data;
}

`apps/backend/src/dashboard/dashboard.controller.ts`:

```ts
import { Controller, Get } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { hasPermission, PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { type AuthenticatedUser, CurrentUser } from '../common/auth-context';
import { startOfDayInTimezone } from '../common/time';
import { AuditService } from '../audit/audit.service';
import { PunishmentSource, PunishmentStatus, PunishmentType } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { serializeServer } from '../servers/servers.service';
import { SETTING_KEYS, SettingsService } from '../settings/settings.service';

/** Aggregated home-page figures. Every value comes from recorded data; nothing is estimated. */
@ApiTags('dashboard')
@Controller('dashboard')
export class DashboardController {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly settings: SettingsService,
    private readonly audit: AuditService,
  ) {}

  @Get('summary')
  async summary(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const network = await this.settings.getNetwork();
    const timezone = user.timezone ?? network.defaultTimezone;
    const dayStart = startOfDayInTimezone(timezone);
    const now = new Date();
    const notExpired = { OR: [{ expiresAt: null }, { expiresAt: { gt: now } }] };

    const [onlinePlayers, totalPlayers, newPlayersToday, connectionsToday, activeBans, activeMutes, anticheatToday, servers, record] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.player.count({ where: { online: true } }),
      this.prisma.player.count(),
      this.prisma.player.count({ where: { firstSeenAt: { gte: dayStart } } }),
      this.prisma.playerConnection.count({ where: { connectedAt: { gte: dayStart } } }),
      this.prisma.punishment.count({ where: { status: PunishmentStatus.ACTIVE, type: { in: [PunishmentType.BAN, PunishmentType.TEMP_BAN, PunishmentType.BLACKLIST] }, ...notExpired } }),
      this.prisma.punishment.count({ where: { status: PunishmentStatus.ACTIVE, type: { in: [PunishmentType.MUTE, PunishmentType.TEMP_MUTE] }, ...notExpired } }),
      this.prisma.punishment.count({ where: { source: PunishmentSource.ANTICHEAT, createdAt: { gte: dayStart } } }),
      hasPermission(user.permissions, PERMISSIONS.SERVERS_VIEW) ? this.prisma.server.findMany({ orderBy: [{ type: 'asc' }, { name: 'asc' }] }) : Promise.resolve(null),
      this.settings.get<{ count: number; at: string }>(SETTING_KEYS.PLAYER_RECORD),
    ]);

    const recentActivity = hasPermission(user.permissions, PERMISSIONS.AUDIT_VIEW) ? (await this.audit.list({ page: 1, pageSize: 8 })).items : null;

    return {
      generatedAt: now.toISOString(),
      dayStart: dayStart.toISOString(),
      timezone,
      onlinePlayers,
      totalPlayers,
      newPlayersToday,
      connectionsToday,
      playerRecord: record,
      activeBans,
      activeMutes,
      anticheatToday,
      servers: servers?.map(serializeServer) ?? null,
      recentActivity,
    };
  }
}

`apps/backend/src/health/health.controller.ts`:

```ts
import { Controller, Get, ServiceUnavailableException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { SkipThrottle } from '@nestjs/throttler';
import { Public } from '../common/auth-context';
import { HealthService } from './health.service';

@ApiTags('health')
@SkipThrottle()
@Public()
@Controller('health')
export class HealthController {
  constructor(private readonly health: HealthService) {}

  /** Liveness: the process is running and able to serve HTTP. */
  @Get('live')
  live() {
    return { status: 'ok' };
  }

  /** Readiness: database and Redis are reachable. Returns 503 otherwise. */
  @Get('ready')
  async ready() {
    const report = await this.health.report();
    if (report.status !== 'ok') {
      // Do not expose internal error strings on the public readiness probe.
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException({
        code: 'NOT_READY',
        message: `database=${report.components.database.state}, redis=${report.components.redis.state}`,
      });
    }
    return { status: report.status, version: report.version, uptimeSeconds: report.uptimeSeconds };
  }
}

`apps/backend/src/health/health.service.ts`:

```ts
import { readdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { HealthReport } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { AppConfig } from '../config/app-config';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { RedisService } from '../redis/redis.service';

export interface DatabaseStatus {
  connected: boolean;
  version: string | null;
  latencyMs: number | null;
  migrationsApplied: number | null;
  migrationsAvailable: number | null;
  pendingMigrations: boolean | null;
  error?: string;
}

@Injectable()
export class HealthService {
  private readonly startedAt = Date.now();

  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly redis: RedisService,
    private readonly config: AppConfig,
  ) {}

  async database(): Promise<DatabaseStatus> {
    try {
      const started = performance.now();
      const [row] = await this.prisma.$queryRaw<{ version: string }[]>`SELECT VERSION() AS version`;
      const latencyMs = Math.round(performance.now() - started);
      const [applied] = await this.prisma.$queryRaw<{ count: bigint }[]>`
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM _prisma_migrations WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL AND rolled_back_at IS NULL`;
      const available = await this.countBundledMigrations();
      const appliedCount = Number(applied?.count ?? 0);
      return {
        connected: true,
        version: row?.version ?? null,
        latencyMs,
        migrationsApplied: appliedCount,
        migrationsAvailable: available,
        pendingMigrations: available === null ? null : appliedCount < available,
      };
    } catch (err) {
      return {
        connected: false,
        version: null,
        latencyMs: null,
        migrationsApplied: null,
        migrationsAvailable: null,
        pendingMigrations: null,
        error: err instanceof Error ? err.message.split('\n')[0] : 'unknown error',
      };
    }
  }

  async redisStatus(): Promise<{ connected: boolean; latencyMs: number | null; error?: string }> {
    try {
      return { connected: true, latencyMs: await this.redis.ping() };
    } catch (err) {
      return { connected: false, latencyMs: null, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'unknown error' };
    }
  }

  async report(): Promise<HealthReport> {
    const [db, redis] = await Promise.all([this.database(), this.redisStatus()]);
    return {
      status: db.connected && redis.connected ? 'ok' : 'degraded',
      version: this.config.version,
      uptimeSeconds: Math.round((Date.now() - this.startedAt) / 1000),
      components: {
        database: { state: db.connected ? 'up' : 'down', version: db.version ?? undefined, latencyMs: db.latencyMs ?? undefined, error: db.error },
        redis: { state: redis.connected ? 'up' : 'down', latencyMs: redis.latencyMs ?? undefined, error: redis.error },
      },
    };
  }

  private async countBundledMigrations(): Promise<number | null> {
    try {
      const entries = await readdir(join(process.cwd(), 'prisma', 'migrations'), { withFileTypes: true });
      return entries.filter((e) => e.isDirectory()).length;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
}
