`apps/backend/src/i18n/i18n.controller.ts`:

```ts
import { BadRequestException, Body, ConflictException, Controller, Delete, Get, HttpCode, NotFoundException, Param, Patch, Post, Put, Req } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { hasPermission, isValidLocaleCode, PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { bundledCatalogs, DEFAULT_LOCALE, findMissingKeys, findUnknownKeys, type MessageTree, validateCatalog } from '@mnm/translations';
import type { Request } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { type AuthenticatedRequest, type AuthenticatedUser, clientIp, CurrentUser, Public, RequirePermissions } from '../common/auth-context';
import { ZodBody } from '../common/zod';
import { localeSchema } from '../common/validation';
import { AuditService, userActor } from '../audit/audit.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';

const updateLanguageSchema = z.object({ enabled: z.boolean().optional(), isDefault: z.literal(true).optional(), name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64).optional() }).strict();
const createLanguageSchema = z.object({ locale: localeSchema, name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64) }).strict();
const importCatalogSchema = z.object({ messages: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()) }).strict();

/**
 * Languages and dashboard translations. Bundled catalogues ship with the
 * platform; administrators can add languages and import catalogues at runtime
 * (validated: no markup, known keys only). Missing keys fall back to en-US.
 */
@ApiTags('i18n')
@Controller('i18n')
export class I18nController {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly audit: AuditService,
  ) {}

  /** Public: enabled languages (needed by the login page). Managers also see disabled ones and completeness. */
  @Public()
  @Get('languages')
  async languages(@Req() req: AuthenticatedRequest) {
    const canManage = req.user ? hasPermission(req.user.permissions, PERMISSIONS.TRANSLATIONS_MANAGE) : false;
    const [rows, custom] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.languageSetting.findMany({ where: canManage ? {} : { enabled: true }, orderBy: { locale: 'asc' } }),
      this.prisma.translationCatalog.findMany({ select: { locale: true, messages: true, updatedAt: true } }),
    ]);
    const customByLocale = new Map(custom.map((c) => [c.locale, c]));
    const reference = bundledCatalogs[DEFAULT_LOCALE];
    return rows.map((row) => {
      const imported = customByLocale.get(row.locale);
      const catalog = effectiveCatalog(row.locale, imported?.messages as MessageTree | undefined);
      return {
        locale: row.locale,
        name: row.name,
        nativeName: (catalog?.meta as { nativeName?: string } | undefined)?.nativeName ?? row.name,
        enabled: row.enabled,
        isDefault: row.isDefault,
        ...(canManage
          ? {
              bundled: Boolean(bundledCatalogs[row.locale]),
              customized: Boolean(imported),
              customUpdatedAt: imported?.updatedAt ?? null,
              missingKeys: catalog ? findMissingKeys(reference, catalog).length : findMissingKeys(reference, {}).length,
            }
          : {}),
      };
    });
  }

  /**
   * Public: imported messages of an enabled language. The dashboard merges them
   * over the bundled catalogue when rendering; `revision` lets it cache.
   */
  @Public()
  @Get('messages/:locale')
  async messages(@Param('locale') locale: string) {
    if (!isValidLocaleCode(locale)) throw new NotFoundException();
    const language = await this.prisma.languageSetting.findUnique({ where: { locale } });
    if (!language?.enabled) throw new NotFoundException();
    const custom = await this.prisma.translationCatalog.findUnique({ where: { locale } });
    return { locale, revision: custom?.updatedAt.getTime() ?? 0, messages: (custom?.messages as MessageTree | undefined) ?? {} };
  }

  @Get('languages/:locale/missing')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.TRANSLATIONS_MANAGE)
  async missing(@Param('locale') locale: string) {
    const catalog = await this.catalogOf(locale);
    return findMissingKeys(bundledCatalogs[DEFAULT_LOCALE], catalog);
  }

  /** Export the effective catalogue (bundled + imported) as JSON, the basis for translating. */
  @Get('catalogs/:locale')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.TRANSLATIONS_MANAGE)
  catalog(@Param('locale') locale: string) {
    return this.catalogOf(locale);
  }

  @Post('languages')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.TRANSLATIONS_MANAGE)
  @ZodBody(createLanguageSchema)
  async create(@CurrentUser() actor: AuthenticatedUser, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof createLanguageSchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    if (await this.prisma.languageSetting.findUnique({ where: { locale: body.locale } })) {
      throw new ConflictException({ code: 'LANGUAGE_EXISTS', message: 'This language already exists' });
    }
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      // New languages start disabled: enable them once a catalogue was imported.
      await tx.languageSetting.create({ data: { locale: body.locale, name: body.name, enabled: false } });
      await this.audit.record({ actor: userActor(actor), action: 'i18n.language_created', targetType: 'language', targetId: body.locale, metadata: { name: body.name }, ipAddress: clientIp(req) }, tx);
    });
    return { ok: true };
  }

  @Delete('languages/:locale')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.TRANSLATIONS_MANAGE)
  async remove(@CurrentUser() actor: AuthenticatedUser, @Param('locale') locale: string, @Req() req: Request) {
    const language = await this.prisma.languageSetting.findUnique({ where: { locale } });
    if (!language) throw new NotFoundException();
    if (bundledCatalogs[locale]) throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'BUNDLED_LANGUAGE', message: 'Bundled languages can be disabled but not deleted' });
    if (language.isDefault) throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'DEFAULT_LANGUAGE', message: 'The default language cannot be deleted' });
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      // Users of the removed language fall back to the network default.
      const users = await tx.dashboardUser.updateMany({ where: { locale }, data: { locale: null } });
      await tx.translationCatalog.deleteMany({ where: { locale } });
      await tx.languageSetting.delete({ where: { locale } });
      await this.audit.record({ actor: userActor(actor), action: 'i18n.language_deleted', targetType: 'language', targetId: locale, metadata: { usersReset: users.count }, ipAddress: clientIp(req) }, tx);
    });
    return { ok: true };
  }

  /** Imports a catalogue. Validated like bundled files; unknown keys are rejected, missing keys fall back to en-US. */
  @Put('catalogs/:locale')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.TRANSLATIONS_MANAGE)
  @ZodBody(importCatalogSchema)
  async import(@CurrentUser() actor: AuthenticatedUser, @Param('locale') locale: string, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof importCatalogSchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    const language = await this.prisma.languageSetting.findUnique({ where: { locale } });
    if (!language) throw new NotFoundException();
    const issues = validateCatalog(body.messages);
    const messages = body.messages as MessageTree;
    const unknown = issues.length ? [] : findUnknownKeys(bundledCatalogs[DEFAULT_LOCALE], messages);
    if (issues.length || unknown.length) {
      throw new BadRequestException({
        code: 'INVALID_CATALOG',
        message: 'The catalogue is invalid',
        issues: [...issues, ...unknown.map((key) => ({ key, problem: 'unknown-key' }))].slice(0, 50).map((i) => ({ path: i.key, message: i.problem })),
      });
    }
    // meta.locale always names the language it is stored for.
    const meta = typeof messages.meta === 'object' ? (messages.meta as MessageTree) : {};
    const stored: MessageTree = { ...messages, meta: { ...meta, locale } };
    const missingKeys = findMissingKeys(bundledCatalogs[DEFAULT_LOCALE], effectiveCatalog(locale, stored) ?? {}).length;
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.translationCatalog.upsert({
        where: { locale },
        create: { locale, messages: stored, updatedByUserId: actor.id },
        update: { messages: stored, updatedByUserId: actor.id },
      });
      await this.audit.record(
        {
          actor: userActor(actor),
          action: 'i18n.catalog_imported',
          targetType: 'language',
          targetId: locale,
          metadata: { missingKeys },
          ipAddress: clientIp(req),
        },
        tx,
      );
    });
    return { ok: true, missingKeys };
  }

  /** Removes imported messages (bundled languages return to the shipped catalogue). */
  @Delete('catalogs/:locale')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.TRANSLATIONS_MANAGE)
  async reset(@CurrentUser() actor: AuthenticatedUser, @Param('locale') locale: string, @Req() req: Request) {
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const removed = await tx.translationCatalog.deleteMany({ where: { locale } });
      if (removed.count === 0) throw new NotFoundException();
      await this.audit.record({ actor: userActor(actor), action: 'i18n.catalog_reset', targetType: 'language', targetId: locale, ipAddress: clientIp(req) }, tx);
    });
    return { ok: true };
  }

  @Patch('languages/:locale')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.TRANSLATIONS_MANAGE)
  @ZodBody(updateLanguageSchema)
  async update(@CurrentUser() actor: AuthenticatedUser, @Param('locale') locale: string, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof updateLanguageSchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    const language = await this.prisma.languageSetting.findUnique({ where: { locale } });
    if (!language) throw new NotFoundException();
    if (body.enabled === false && (language.isDefault || body.isDefault)) {
      throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'DEFAULT_LANGUAGE', message: 'The default language cannot be disabled' });
    }
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      if (body.isDefault) await tx.languageSetting.updateMany({ data: { isDefault: false } });
      await tx.languageSetting.update({
        where: { locale },
        data: { enabled: body.isDefault ? true : body.enabled, isDefault: body.isDefault, name: body.name },
      });
      await this.audit.record({ actor: userActor(actor), action: 'i18n.language_updated', targetType: 'language', targetId: locale, metadata: body, ipAddress: clientIp(req) }, tx);
    });
    return { ok: true };
  }

  private async catalogOf(locale: string): Promise<MessageTree> {
    const language = await this.prisma.languageSetting.findUnique({ where: { locale } });
    if (!language) throw new NotFoundException();
    const custom = await this.prisma.translationCatalog.findUnique({ where: { locale } });
    return effectiveCatalog(locale, custom?.messages as MessageTree | undefined) ?? { meta: { locale } };
  }
}

/** Bundled catalogue with imported messages merged over it (null when neither exists). */
function effectiveCatalog(locale: string, imported: MessageTree | undefined): MessageTree | null {
  const bundled = bundledCatalogs[locale];
  if (!bundled && !imported) return null;
  if (!bundled) return imported!;
  // Imported keys may also fill gaps the bundled catalogue has, so merge over the
  // union of keys rather than only the bundled ones.
  return mergeTrees(bundled, imported);
}

function mergeTrees(base: MessageTree, overrides: MessageTree | undefined): MessageTree {
  if (!overrides) return base;
  const result: MessageTree = { ...base };
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(overrides)) {
    const current = result[key];
    result[key] = typeof value === 'string' || typeof current !== 'object' ? value : mergeTrees(current, value);
  }
  return result;
}
```

`apps/backend/src/inventory/inventory-model.ts`:

```ts
import { z } from 'zod';

/**
 * Inventory snapshots and edits. Every slot change is a compare-and-set on the
 * server: "slot N holds fingerprint X → replace it". The Paper plugin applies
 * all changes of a revision or none, so concurrent changes by the player can
 * never duplicate or delete items.
 */
export type Kind = 'INVENTORY' | 'ENDER_CHEST';
/** Player inventory: 0–8 hotbar, 9–35 main, 36–39 armor (boots → helmet), 40 offhand. Ender chest: 0–26. */
export const SLOT_COUNT: Record<Kind, number> = { INVENTORY: 41, ENDER_CHEST: 27 };

const fingerprint = z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
const itemId = z.string().regex(/^[a-z0-9_.-]+:[a-z0-9_./-]+$/).max(128);
const enchantments = z
  .record(itemId, z.number().int().min(1).max(255))
  .refine((e) => Object.keys(e).length <= 64, 'Too many enchantments');
const name = z.string().max(100);
const lore = z.array(z.string().max(200)).max(20);

/** Item as reported by the plugin (incl. full-fidelity serialized data). */
export const snapshotItemSchema = z.object({
  slot: z.number().int().min(0).max(40),
  id: itemId,
  amount: z.number().int().min(1).max(127),
  name: name.nullable().optional(),
  lore: lore.optional(),
  enchantments: enchantments.optional(),
  damage: z.number().int().min(0).optional(),
  maxDamage: z.number().int().min(0).optional(),
  fp: fingerprint,
  /** Base64 of ItemStack#serializeAsBytes (≤ 64 KiB). */
  data: z.string().max(87_400),
});
export type SnapshotItem = z.infer<typeof snapshotItemSchema>;

export const snapshotSchema = z.object({ items: z.array(snapshotItemSchema).max(41), fp: fingerprint });
export type Snapshot = z.infer<typeof snapshotSchema>;

/** Desired slot content from the dashboard. Raw item data is never accepted from clients. */
export const editItemSchema = z.object({
  id: itemId,
  amount: z.number().int().min(1).max(99),
  /** undefined = keep (when based on an existing item), null = remove the custom name. */
  name: name.nullable().optional(),
  lore: lore.optional(),
  enchantments: enchantments.optional(),
  /** Fingerprint of an existing item of this player and server to start from (keeps all other components). */
  base: fingerprint.optional(),
});
export type EditItem = z.infer<typeof editItemSchema>;

export const editSchema = z.object({
  baseRevision: z.number().int().min(0),
  reason: z.string().trim().max(500).optional(),
  changes: z
    .array(z.object({ slot: z.number().int().min(0).max(40), before: fingerprint.nullable(), after: editItemSchema.nullable() }))
    .min(1)
    .max(100)
    .refine((c) => new Set(c.map((x) => x.slot)).size === c.length, 'Each slot may only be changed once'),
});
export type EditInput = z.infer<typeof editSchema>;

/** A resolved change as stored and delivered to the plugin. */
export interface ResolvedChange {
  slot: number;
  before: string | null;
  beforeItem: SnapshotItem | null;
  after: (EditItem & { data?: string }) | null;
  /** Fingerprint after application (filled in from the plugin's result). */
  afterFp?: string | null;
}

export class InventoryEditError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly code: string,
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
  }
}

/**
 * Validates an edit against the current snapshot and resolves `base` items to
 * their server-side data. `pool` holds all known items of this player on this
 * server (inventory and ender chest) so items can be moved between them.
 */
export function resolveEdit(kind: Kind, current: Snapshot, pool: SnapshotItem[], input: EditInput): ResolvedChange[] {
  const bySlot = new Map(current.items.map((i) => [i.slot, i]));
  return input.changes.map((change) => {
    if (change.slot >= SLOT_COUNT[kind]) throw new InventoryEditError('INVALID_SLOT', `Slot ${change.slot} does not exist`);
    const existing = bySlot.get(change.slot) ?? null;
    if ((existing?.fp ?? null) !== change.before) {
      throw new InventoryEditError('STALE_SLOT', `Slot ${change.slot} changed since the snapshot was loaded`);
    }
    let after: ResolvedChange['after'] = null;
    if (change.after) {
      after = { ...change.after };
      if (change.after.base) {
        const base = pool.find((i) => i.fp === change.after!.base);
        if (!base) throw new InventoryEditError('UNKNOWN_BASE_ITEM', 'The referenced item is not part of this player\'s inventories');
        if (base.id !== change.after.id) throw new InventoryEditError('BASE_TYPE_MISMATCH', 'The item type of a based item cannot be changed');
        after.data = base.data;
      }
    }
    return { slot: change.slot, before: change.before, beforeItem: existing, after };
  });
}

/** Inverse of an applied revision: restores every slot's previous item exactly (from its serialized data). */
export function inverseChanges(applied: ResolvedChange[]): ResolvedChange[] {
  return applied.map((c) => {
    if (c.afterFp === undefined) throw new InventoryEditError('NOT_APPLIED', 'Only applied revisions can be rolled back');
    const restore = c.beforeItem;
    return {
      slot: c.slot,
      before: c.afterFp,
      beforeItem: null,
      after: restore ? { id: restore.id, amount: restore.amount, base: restore.fp, data: restore.data } : null,
    };
  });
}

/** Snapshot for dashboards: identical but without serialized data. */
export function publicItems(snapshot: Snapshot) {
  return snapshot.items.map(({ data: _data, ...item }) => item);
}
```

```ts
import { Body, Controller, ForbiddenException, Get, HttpCode, NotFoundException, Param, Post, Req, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { Throttle } from '@nestjs/throttler';
import { PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import type { Request } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { SkipCsrf } from '../auth/guards';
import { type AuthenticatedUser, clientIp, CurrentUser, Public, RequirePermissions } from '../common/auth-context';
import { ZodBody } from '../common/zod';
import { userActor } from '../audit/audit.service';
import { ServerType } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { type PluginRequest, PluginAuthGuard } from '../plugin-api/plugin-auth.guard';
import { uuidSchema } from '../plugin-api/plugin-events';
import { normalizeUuid } from '../players/players.controller';
import { editSchema, type Kind, snapshotSchema } from './inventory-model';
import { InventoryService } from './inventory.service';

const ingestSchema = z.object({
  capturedAt: z.number().int().positive(),
  players: z.array(z.object({ uuid: uuidSchema, inventory: snapshotSchema.optional(), enderChest: snapshotSchema.optional() })).min(1).max(50),
});

const resultSchema = z.object({
  status: z.enum(['APPLIED', 'CONFLICT', 'REJECTED']),
  message: z.string().max(500).optional(),
  appliedFps: z.record(z.string().regex(/^\d{1,2}$/), z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/).nullable()).optional(),
  snapshot: snapshotSchema.optional(),
});

const reasonSchema = z.object({ reason: z.string().trim().max(500).optional() });
const KINDS: Record<string, Kind> = { inventory: 'INVENTORY', 'ender-chest': 'ENDER_CHEST' };

/** Paper servers: snapshots, pending edits and their results (signed plugin API). */
@ApiTags('plugin')
@Public()
@SkipCsrf()
@UseGuards(PluginAuthGuard)
@Throttle({ default: { limit: 1200, ttl: 60_000 } })
@Controller('plugin/v1/inventories')
export class PluginInventoryController {
  constructor(private readonly inventories: InventoryService) {}

  @Post()
  @HttpCode(200)
  @ZodBody(ingestSchema)
  ingest(@Req() req: PluginRequest, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof ingestSchema>) {
    return this.inventories.ingest(this.paper(req), body.players, new Date(Math.min(body.capturedAt, Date.now())));
  }

  @Get('pending')
  pending(@Req() req: PluginRequest) {
    return this.inventories.pendingFor(this.paper(req));
  }

  @Post('revisions/:id/result')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @ZodBody(resultSchema)
  result(@Req() req: PluginRequest, @Param('id') id: string, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof resultSchema>) {
    return this.inventories.complete(this.paper(req), id, body);
  }

  private paper(req: PluginRequest): string {
    const server = req.pluginServer!;
    if (server.type !== ServerType.PAPER) throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'PAPER_ONLY', message: 'Inventories are handled by Paper servers' });
    return server.id;
  }
}

@ApiTags('inventory')
@Controller('players/:uuid/inventories')
export class InventoryController {
  constructor(private readonly inventories: InventoryService) {}

  @Get()
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW_INVENTORY)
  overview(@Param('uuid') raw: string) {
    return this.inventories.overview(uuidOf(raw));
  }

  @Get(':scope/:kind')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW_INVENTORY)
  view(@Param('uuid') raw: string, @Param('scope') scope: string, @Param('kind') kind: string) {
    return this.inventories.view(uuidOf(raw), scope, kindOf(kind));
  }

  @Post(':scope/refresh')
  @HttpCode(202)
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW_INVENTORY)
  refresh(@Param('uuid') raw: string, @Param('scope') scope: string) {
    return this.inventories.requestSnapshot(uuidOf(raw), scope);
  }

  @Post(':scope/:kind/revisions')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_EDIT_INVENTORY)
  @ZodBody(editSchema)
  edit(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser, @Param('uuid') raw: string, @Param('scope') scope: string, @Param('kind') kind: string, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof editSchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    return this.inventories.edit(uuidOf(raw), scope, kindOf(kind), body, { ...userActor(user), userId: user.id }, clientIp(req));
  }

  @Post('revisions/:id/rollback')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_EDIT_INVENTORY)
  @ZodBody(reasonSchema)
  rollback(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser, @Param('uuid') raw: string, @Param('id') id: string, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof reasonSchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    return this.inventories.rollback(uuidOf(raw), id, body.reason, { ...userActor(user), userId: user.id }, clientIp(req));
  }

  @Post('revisions/:id/cancel')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_EDIT_INVENTORY)
  cancel(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser, @Param('uuid') raw: string, @Param('id') id: string, @Req() req: Request) {
    return this.inventories.cancel(uuidOf(raw), id, userActor(user), clientIp(req));
  }
}

function uuidOf(raw: string): string {
  const uuid = normalizeUuid(raw);
  if (!uuid) throw new NotFoundException();
  return uuid;
}

function kindOf(raw: string): Kind {
  const kind = KINDS[raw];
  if (!kind) throw new NotFoundException();
  return kind;
}
```

`apps/backend/src/inventory/inventory.service.ts`:

```ts
import { BadRequestException, ConflictException, Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { type AuditActor, AuditService } from '../audit/audit.service';
import { ActorType, type InventoryKind, InventoryRevisionStatus, type Prisma } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { RealtimeService } from '../realtime/realtime.service';
import { RedisService } from '../redis/redis.service';
import { type EditInput, inverseChanges, InventoryEditError, type Kind, publicItems, resolveEdit, type ResolvedChange, type Snapshot, snapshotSchema, type SnapshotItem } from './inventory-model';

const REQUEST_KEY = (serverId: string) => `mnm:inventory:requests:${serverId}`;

function parseSnapshot(value: Prisma.JsonValue): Snapshot {
  const parsed = snapshotSchema.safeParse(value);
  return parsed.success ? parsed.data : { items: [], fp: '0'.repeat(64) };
}

@Injectable()
export class InventoryService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly redis: RedisService,
    private readonly audit: AuditService,
    private readonly realtime: RealtimeService,
  ) {}

  // ── Plugin side ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /** Stores snapshots from a Paper server. The revision only increases when the content changed. */
  async ingest(serverId: string, players: { uuid: string; inventory?: Snapshot; enderChest?: Snapshot }[], capturedAt: Date) {
    const known = new Set((await this.prisma.player.findMany({ where: { uuid: { in: players.map((p) => p.uuid) } }, select: { uuid: true } })).map((p) => p.uuid));
    let changed = 0;
    for (const p of players.filter((x) => known.has(x.uuid))) {
      for (const [kind, snapshot] of [['INVENTORY', p.inventory], ['ENDER_CHEST', p.enderChest]] as const) {
        if (!snapshot) continue;
        if (await this.store(p.uuid, serverId, kind, snapshot, capturedAt)) changed++;
      }
    }
    return { changed };
  }

  private async store(uuid: string, scope: string, kind: Kind, snapshot: Snapshot, capturedAt: Date, tx: Prisma.TransactionClient = this.prisma): Promise<boolean> {
    const existing = await tx.playerInventory.findUnique({ where: { playerUuid_scope_kind: { playerUuid: uuid, scope, kind } } });
    if (existing && parseSnapshot(existing.contents).fp === snapshot.fp) {
      await tx.playerInventory.update({ where: { id: existing.id }, data: { capturedAt } });
      return false;
    }
    await tx.playerInventory.upsert({
      where: { playerUuid_scope_kind: { playerUuid: uuid, scope, kind } },
      create: { playerUuid: uuid, scope, kind, revision: 1, contents: snapshot, capturedAt },
      update: { revision: { increment: 1 }, contents: snapshot, capturedAt },
    });
    this.realtime.publish({ type: 'inventory.changed', uuid });
    return true;
  }

  /** Pending edits for players currently online on this server, plus requested snapshots. */
  async pendingFor(serverId: string) {
    const revisions = await this.prisma.inventoryRevision.findMany({
      where: { status: InventoryRevisionStatus.PENDING, inventory: { scope: serverId, player: { online: true, currentServerId: serverId } } },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
      take: 50,
      include: { inventory: { select: { playerUuid: true, kind: true } } },
    });
    const requests = await this.redis.client.spop(REQUEST_KEY(serverId), 100).catch(() => [] as string[]);
    return {
      snapshotRequests: requests,
      revisions: revisions.map((r) => ({
        id: r.id,
        playerUuid: r.inventory.playerUuid,
        kind: r.inventory.kind,
        changes: (r.changes as unknown as ResolvedChange[]).map((c) => ({ slot: c.slot, before: c.before, after: c.after })),
      })),
    };
  }

  /** Result reported by the plugin after trying to apply a revision. */
  async complete(serverId: string, revisionId: string, result: { status: 'APPLIED' | 'CONFLICT' | 'REJECTED'; message?: string; appliedFps?: Record<string, string | null>; snapshot?: Snapshot }) {
    const revision = await this.prisma.inventoryRevision.findUnique({ where: { id: revisionId }, include: { inventory: true } });
    if (!revision || revision.inventory.scope !== serverId) throw new NotFoundException();
    if (revision.status !== InventoryRevisionStatus.PENDING) return { status: revision.status };

    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      let changes = revision.changes as unknown as ResolvedChange[];
      if (result.status === 'APPLIED') {
        changes = changes.map((c) => ({ ...c, afterFp: result.appliedFps?.[String(c.slot)] ?? null }));
        if (result.snapshot) await this.store(revision.inventory.playerUuid, serverId, revision.inventory.kind, result.snapshot, new Date(), tx);
        const inventory = await tx.playerInventory.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: revision.inventoryId } });
        await tx.inventoryRevision.update({
          where: { id: revisionId },
          data: { status: InventoryRevisionStatus.APPLIED, appliedAt: new Date(), revision: inventory.revision, changes: changes as unknown as Prisma.InputJsonValue, resultMessage: null },
        });
        if (revision.rollbackOfId) await tx.inventoryRevision.update({ where: { id: revision.rollbackOfId }, data: { status: InventoryRevisionStatus.ROLLED_BACK } });
      } else {
        await tx.inventoryRevision.update({ where: { id: revisionId }, data: { status: result.status, resultMessage: result.message?.slice(0, 500) ?? null } });
        if (result.snapshot) await this.store(revision.inventory.playerUuid, serverId, revision.inventory.kind, result.snapshot, new Date(), tx);
      }
      await this.audit.record(
        {
          actor: { type: ActorType.SERVER, name: 'inventory' },
          action: `inventory.revision_${result.status.toLowerCase()}`,
          targetType: 'player',
          targetId: revision.inventory.playerUuid,
          metadata: { revisionId, kind: revision.inventory.kind, scope: serverId, message: result.message ?? null },
        },
        tx,
      );
    });
    this.realtime.publish({ type: 'inventory.changed', uuid: revision.inventory.playerUuid });
    return { status: result.status };
  }

  // ── Dashboard side ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  /** Servers with stored inventories for a player. */
  async overview(uuid: string) {
    const [inventories, player] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.playerInventory.findMany({ where: { playerUuid: uuid }, select: { scope: true, kind: true, revision: true, capturedAt: true } }),
      this.prisma.player.findUnique({ where: { uuid }, select: { online: true, currentServerId: true } }),
    ]);
    const servers = await this.prisma.server.findMany({ where: { id: { in: [...new Set(inventories.map((i) => i.scope))] } }, select: { id: true, name: true } });
    return servers.map((s) => ({
      serverId: s.id,
      serverName: s.name,
      online: Boolean(player?.online && player.currentServerId === s.id),
      kinds: inventories.filter((i) => i.scope === s.id).map((i) => ({ kind: i.kind, revision: i.revision, capturedAt: i.capturedAt.toISOString() })),
    }));
  }

  async view(uuid: string, scope: string, kind: Kind) {
    const inventory = await this.prisma.playerInventory.findUnique({ where: { playerUuid_scope_kind: { playerUuid: uuid, scope, kind } } });
    if (!inventory) throw new NotFoundException({ code: 'NO_SNAPSHOT', message: 'No snapshot recorded for this server yet' });
    const revisions = await this.prisma.inventoryRevision.findMany({
      where: { inventoryId: inventory.id },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      take: 25,
      include: { actor: { select: { id: true, username: true } } },
    });
    return {
      revision: inventory.revision,
      capturedAt: inventory.capturedAt.toISOString(),
      items: publicItems(parseSnapshot(inventory.contents)),
      pending: revisions.find((r) => r.status === InventoryRevisionStatus.PENDING)?.id ?? null,
      revisions: revisions.map((r) => ({
        id: r.id,
        status: r.status,
        reason: r.reason,
        resultMessage: r.resultMessage,
        rollbackOfId: r.rollbackOfId,
        actor: r.actor,
        createdAt: r.createdAt.toISOString(),
        appliedAt: r.appliedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
        changes: (r.changes as unknown as ResolvedChange[]).map((c) => ({
          slot: c.slot,
          before: c.beforeItem ? { id: c.beforeItem.id, amount: c.beforeItem.amount, name: c.beforeItem.name ?? null } : null,
          after: c.after ? { id: c.after.id, amount: c.after.amount, name: c.after.name ?? null } : null,
        })),
      })),
    };
  }

  /** Asks the Paper server to send a fresh snapshot (only possible while the player is online there). */
  async requestSnapshot(uuid: string, scope: string) {
    const player = await this.prisma.player.findUnique({ where: { uuid }, select: { online: true, currentServerId: true } });
    if (!player?.online || player.currentServerId !== scope) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'PLAYER_NOT_ON_SERVER', message: 'The player is not online on this server' });
    await this.redis.client.sadd(REQUEST_KEY(scope), uuid);
    await this.redis.client.expire(REQUEST_KEY(scope), 300);
    return { requested: true };
  }

  /** Queues an edit. Applied immediately if the player is online on that server, otherwise on their next join. */
  async edit(uuid: string, scope: string, kind: Kind, input: EditInput, actor: AuditActor & { userId: string }, ip: string | null) {
    const inventory = await this.prisma.playerInventory.findUnique({ where: { playerUuid_scope_kind: { playerUuid: uuid, scope, kind } } });
    if (!inventory) throw new NotFoundException({ code: 'NO_SNAPSHOT', message: 'No snapshot recorded for this server yet' });
    if (inventory.revision !== input.baseRevision) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'STALE_REVISION', message: 'The inventory changed; reload and try again' });
    await this.assertNoPending(inventory.id);

    const pool = await this.itemPool(uuid, scope);
    let changes: ResolvedChange[];
    try {
      changes = resolveEdit(kind, parseSnapshot(inventory.contents), pool, input);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof InventoryEditError) throw (err.code === 'STALE_SLOT' ? new ConflictException({ code: err.code, message: err.message }) : new BadRequestException({ code: err.code, message: err.message }));
      throw err;
    }
    return this.createRevision(inventory.id, uuid, kind, scope, changes, input.reason, actor, ip, null);
  }

  async rollback(uuid: string, revisionId: string, reason: string | undefined, actor: AuditActor & { userId: string }, ip: string | null) {
    const revision = await this.prisma.inventoryRevision.findUnique({ where: { id: revisionId }, include: { inventory: true } });
    if (!revision || revision.inventory.playerUuid !== uuid) throw new NotFoundException();
    if (revision.status !== InventoryRevisionStatus.APPLIED) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'NOT_APPLIED', message: 'Only applied revisions can be rolled back' });
    await this.assertNoPending(revision.inventoryId);
    const changes = inverseChanges(revision.changes as unknown as ResolvedChange[]);
    return this.createRevision(revision.inventoryId, uuid, revision.inventory.kind, revision.inventory.scope, changes, reason ?? `Rollback of ${revisionId}`, actor, ip, revisionId);
  }

  async cancel(uuid: string, revisionId: string, actor: AuditActor, ip: string | null) {
    const revision = await this.prisma.inventoryRevision.findUnique({ where: { id: revisionId }, include: { inventory: true } });
    if (!revision || revision.inventory.playerUuid !== uuid) throw new NotFoundException();
    const result = await this.prisma.inventoryRevision.updateMany({ where: { id: revisionId, status: InventoryRevisionStatus.PENDING }, data: { status: InventoryRevisionStatus.CANCELLED } });
    if (result.count !== 1) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'NOT_PENDING', message: 'Only pending revisions can be cancelled' });
    await this.audit.record({ actor, action: 'inventory.revision_cancelled', targetType: 'player', targetId: uuid, metadata: { revisionId }, ipAddress: ip });
    this.realtime.publish({ type: 'inventory.changed', uuid });
    return { ok: true };
  }

  private async createRevision(inventoryId: string, uuid: string, kind: InventoryKind, scope: string, changes: ResolvedChange[], reason: string | undefined, actor: AuditActor & { userId: string }, ip: string | null, rollbackOfId: string | null) {
    const inventory = await this.prisma.playerInventory.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: inventoryId } });
    const revision = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const created = await tx.inventoryRevision.create({
        data: {
          inventoryId,
          baseRevision: inventory.revision,
          status: InventoryRevisionStatus.PENDING,
          changes: changes as unknown as Prisma.InputJsonValue,
          actorUserId: actor.userId,
          reason: reason?.slice(0, 500) ?? null,
          rollbackOfId,
        },
      });
      await this.audit.record(
        {
          actor,
          action: rollbackOfId ? 'inventory.rollback_requested' : 'inventory.edit_requested',
          targetType: 'player',
          targetId: uuid,
          metadata: {
            revisionId: created.id,
            kind,
            scope,
            reason: reason ?? null,
            rollbackOf: rollbackOfId,
            slots: changes.map((c) => ({ slot: c.slot, before: c.beforeItem ? `${c.beforeItem.amount}× ${c.beforeItem.id}` : null, after: c.after ? `${c.after.amount}× ${c.after.id}` : null })),
          },
          ipAddress: ip,
        },
        tx,
      );
      return created;
    });
    this.realtime.publish({ type: 'inventory.changed', uuid });
    return { id: revision.id, status: revision.status };
  }

  private async assertNoPending(inventoryId: string) {
    if (await this.prisma.inventoryRevision.count({ where: { inventoryId, status: InventoryRevisionStatus.PENDING } })) {
      throw new ConflictException({ code: 'PENDING_EDIT', message: 'Another change is still waiting to be applied' });
    }
  }

  /** All items of the player on this server (both containers), for move operations. */
  private async itemPool(uuid: string, scope: string): Promise<SnapshotItem[]> {
    const all = await this.prisma.playerInventory.findMany({ where: { playerUuid: uuid, scope } });
    return all.flatMap((i) => parseSnapshot(i.contents).items);
  }
}
```

```ts
import 'reflect-metadata';
import { Logger, type LogLevel } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';

const LOG_LEVELS: Record<string, LogLevel[]> = {
  error: ['fatal', 'error'],
  warn: ['fatal', 'error', 'warn'],
  log: ['fatal', 'error', 'warn', 'log'],
  debug: ['fatal', 'error', 'warn', 'log', 'debug'],
  verbose: ['fatal', 'error', 'warn', 'log', 'debug', 'verbose'],
};

async function bootstrap(): Promise<void> {
  const app = await NestFactory.create<NestExpressApplication>(AppModule, {
    logger: LOG_LEVELS[process.env.LOG_LEVEL ?? 'log'] ?? LOG_LEVELS.log,
    // Raw body is required to verify plugin request signatures.

  app.disable('x-powered-by');

  app.use(cookieParser());
  app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
  app.enableShutdownHooks();

  if (config.env.API_DOCS_ENABLED) {

        .addBearerAuth()
        .build(),
    );

  }

  Logger.log(`Backend v${config.version} listening on port ${config.env.PORT}`, 'Bootstrap');
}

bootstrap().catch((err: unknown) => {
  console.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : err);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

`apps/backend/src/maintenance/maintenance.service.ts`:

```ts
import { Injectable, Logger, type OnApplicationBootstrap, type OnApplicationShutdown } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { RedisService } from '../redis/redis.service';
import { SettingsService } from '../settings/settings.service';

const INTERVAL_MS = 60 * 60_000;
const EXPIRED_SESSION_GRACE_DAYS = 30;

/**
 * Periodic housekeeping (one replica at a time):
 * - removes IP addresses older than the configured retention period from
 *   connection records and the audit log (approximate country/ASN are kept),
 * - deletes dashboard sessions that expired more than 30 days ago.
 * Blacklist entries keep their IP because enforcement depends on it.
 */
@Injectable()
export class MaintenanceService implements OnApplicationBootstrap, OnApplicationShutdown {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(MaintenanceService.name);
  private timer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;

  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly redis: RedisService,
    private readonly settings: SettingsService,
  ) {}

  onApplicationBootstrap(): void {
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test') return;
    const run = () => void this.run().catch((err: Error) => this.logger.warn(`Maintenance failed: ${err.message}`));
    setTimeout(run, 60_000);
    this.timer = setInterval(run, INTERVAL_MS);
  }

  onApplicationShutdown(): void {
    if (this.timer) clearInterval(this.timer);
  }

  async run(now = new Date(), force = false): Promise<{ connections: number; auditLogs: number; sessions: number }> {
    if (!force) {
      const lock = await this.redis.client.set('mnm:lock:maintenance', '1', 'PX', INTERVAL_MS - 60_000, 'NX');
      if (lock !== 'OK') return { connections: 0, auditLogs: 0, sessions: 0 };
    }
    const { ipRetentionDays } = await this.settings.getPrivacy();
    let connections = 0;
    let auditLogs = 0;
    if (ipRetentionDays !== null) {
      const cutoff = new Date(now.getTime() - ipRetentionDays * 86_400_000);
      connections = (await this.prisma.playerConnection.updateMany({ where: { connectedAt: { lt: cutoff }, ipAddress: { not: null } }, data: { ipAddress: null, virtualHost: null } })).count;
      auditLogs = (await this.prisma.auditLog.updateMany({ where: { createdAt: { lt: cutoff }, ipAddress: { not: null } }, data: { ipAddress: null } })).count;
    }
    const sessions = (
      await this.prisma.dashboardSession.deleteMany({ where: { expiresAt: { lt: new Date(now.getTime() - EXPIRED_SESSION_GRACE_DAYS * 86_400_000) } } })
    ).count;
    if (connections || auditLogs || sessions) {
      this.logger.log(`Retention: anonymised ${connections} connection(s) and ${auditLogs} audit entr(y/ies), removed ${sessions} expired session(s)`);
    }
    return { connections, auditLogs, sessions };
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/players/activity.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Player activity aggregation from recorded sessions, in a given time zone.
 * Only real session time is counted; nothing is interpolated.
 */
export interface SessionSpan {
  startedAt: Date;
  endedAt: Date | null;
}

export interface ActivityReport {
  timezone: string;
  from: string;
  to: string;
  /** One entry per local calendar day in the range (oldest first), seconds played. */
  daily: { date: string; seconds: number }[];
  /** 7 × 24 matrix [weekday 0=Mon … 6=Sun][hour], seconds played. */
  heatmap: number[][];
  totalSeconds: number;
  sessions: number;
  averageSessionSeconds: number | null;
}

const SLICE_MS = 5 * 60_000;
const WEEKDAYS = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];

function formatterFor(timeZone: string) {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit', hour: '2-digit', hourCycle: 'h23', weekday: 'short' });
}

/**
 * Splits sessions into 5-minute slices and assigns each slice to its local day
 * and weekday/hour bucket. Accurate to the slice size, also across DST changes.
 */
export function buildActivity(sessions: SessionSpan[], options: { timezone: string; days: number; now?: Date }): ActivityReport {
  const now = options.now ?? new Date();
  const fmt = formatterFor(options.timezone);
  const partsOf = (ms: number) => {
    const parts = fmt.formatToParts(new Date(ms));
    const get = (t: string) => parts.find((p) => p.type === t)?.value ?? '';
    return { date: `${get('year')}-${get('month')}-${get('day')}`, hour: Number(get('hour')), weekday: WEEKDAYS.indexOf(get('weekday')) };
  };

  // Local calendar days covering the range, newest = today.
  const dayKeys: string[] = [];
  for (let i = options.days - 1; i >= 0; i--) dayKeys.push(partsOf(now.getTime() - i * 86_400_000).date);
  const uniqueDays = [...new Set(dayKeys)];
  const daily = new Map(uniqueDays.map((d) => [d, 0]));
  const heatmap = Array.from({ length: 7 }, () => Array.from({ length: 24 }, () => 0));
  const fromMs = now.getTime() - options.days * 86_400_000;

  let total = 0;
  let counted = 0;
  let countedSeconds = 0;
  for (const s of sessions) {
    const start = Math.max(s.startedAt.getTime(), fromMs);
    const end = Math.min((s.endedAt ?? now).getTime(), now.getTime());
    if (end <= start) continue;
    counted++;
    countedSeconds += Math.floor(((s.endedAt ?? now).getTime() - s.startedAt.getTime()) / 1000);
    for (let t = start; t < end; t += SLICE_MS) {
      const seconds = Math.min(SLICE_MS, end - t) / 1000;
      const p = partsOf(t);
      if (daily.has(p.date)) daily.set(p.date, (daily.get(p.date) ?? 0) + seconds);
      if (p.weekday >= 0) heatmap[p.weekday][p.hour] += seconds;
      total += seconds;
    }
  }

  return {
    timezone: options.timezone,
    from: new Date(fromMs).toISOString(),
    to: now.toISOString(),
    daily: uniqueDays.map((date) => ({ date, seconds: Math.round(daily.get(date) ?? 0) })),
    heatmap: heatmap.map((row) => row.map((v) => Math.round(v))),
    totalSeconds: Math.round(total),
    sessions: counted,
    averageSessionSeconds: counted ? Math.round(countedSeconds / counted) : null,
  };
}
```

`apps/backend/src/players/geoip.service.ts`:

```ts
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { isIP } from 'node:net';
import { Injectable, Logger, type OnModuleInit } from '@nestjs/common';
import maxmind, { type AsnResponse, type CityResponse, type Reader } from 'maxmind';
import { AppConfig } from '../config/app-config';

export interface GeoResult {
  countryCode: string | null;
  region: string | null;
  city: string | null;
  asn: number | null;
  isp: string | null;
}

/** Private, loopback, link-local and CGNAT ranges are never looked up. */
export function isPublicIp(ip: string): boolean {
  const version = isIP(ip);
  if (version === 4) {
    const [a, b] = ip.split('.').map(Number);
    return !(a === 10 || a === 127 || a === 0 || (a === 172 && b >= 16 && b <= 31) || (a === 192 && b === 168) || (a === 169 && b === 254) || (a === 100 && b >= 64 && b <= 127) || a >= 224);
  }
  if (version === 6) {
    const lower = ip.toLowerCase();
    return !(lower === '::1' || lower.startsWith('fc') || lower.startsWith('fd') || lower.startsWith('fe80') || lower.startsWith('::ffff:'));
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * Optional, offline IP geolocation using MaxMind GeoLite2 databases (City and
 * ASN). Results are approximate by nature and are presented as such. When no
 * database is configured, no location data is stored.
 */
@Injectable()
export class GeoIpService implements OnModuleInit {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(GeoIpService.name);
  private city: Reader<CityResponse> | null = null;
  private asn: Reader<AsnResponse> | null = null;

  constructor(private readonly config: AppConfig) {}

  async onModuleInit(): Promise<void> {
    this.city = await this.open<CityResponse>(this.config.env.GEOIP_CITY_DB, 'City');
    this.asn = await this.open<AsnResponse>(this.config.env.GEOIP_ASN_DB, 'ASN');
  }

  get enabled(): boolean {
    return this.city !== null || this.asn !== null;
  }

  lookup(ip: string | null | undefined): GeoResult | null {
    if (!ip || !this.enabled || !isPublicIp(ip)) return null;
    try {
      const city = this.city?.get(ip) ?? null;
      const asn = this.asn?.get(ip) ?? null;
      return {
        countryCode: city?.country?.iso_code ?? city?.registered_country?.iso_code ?? null,
        region: city?.subdivisions?.[0]?.names?.en ?? null,
        city: city?.city?.names?.en ?? null,
        asn: asn?.autonomous_system_number ?? null,
        isp: asn?.autonomous_system_organization ?? null,
      };
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  private async open<T extends CityResponse | AsnResponse>(path: string | undefined, label: string): Promise<Reader<T> | null> {
    if (!path) return null;
    if (!existsSync(path)) {
      this.logger.warn(`GeoIP ${label} database not found at ${path}; location data is disabled`);
      return null;
    }
    try {
      const reader = await maxmind.open<T>(path, { watchForUpdates: true });
      this.logger.log(`GeoIP ${label} database loaded`);
      return reader;
    } catch (err) {
      this.logger.warn(`Could not open GeoIP ${label} database: ${(err as Error).message}`);
      return null;
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Controller, Get, NotFoundException, Param, Query, Res } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { hasPermission, PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { type AuthenticatedUser, CurrentUser, RequirePermissions } from '../common/auth-context';
import { paginationSchema, ZodQuery } from '../common/zod';
import type { Prisma } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import type { Response } from 'express';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { SettingsService } from '../settings/settings.service';
import { buildActivity } from './activity';
import { GeoIpService } from './geoip.service';
import { SkinService } from './skin.service';

const listQuery = paginationSchema.extend({
  search: z.string().trim().max(36).optional(),
  online: z.enum(['true', 'false']).optional(),
  sort: z.enum(['lastSeen', 'firstSeen', 'username', 'playtime']).default('lastSeen'),
});

const activityQuery = z.object({ days: z.coerce.number().int().min(7).max(365).default(30) });

const UUID_LOOSE = /^[0-9a-f]{32}$|^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

/** Normalises dashed or undashed UUIDs to the dashed lowercase form used as primary key. */
export function normalizeUuid(value: string): string | null {
  if (!UUID_LOOSE.test(value)) return null;
  const hex = value.replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase();
  return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
}

const listSelect = {
  uuid: true,
  username: true,
  online: true,
  firstSeenAt: true,
  lastSeenAt: true,
  totalPlaytimeSeconds: true,
  connectionCount: true,
  currentServer: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
} as const;

type ListRow = Prisma.PlayerGetPayload<{ select: typeof listSelect }>;

/** Adds the running session to the stored playtime so online players show live totals. */
function serializeListRow(p: ListRow, openSessionStart?: Date) {
  const running = p.online && openSessionStart ? Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - openSessionStart.getTime()) / 1000)) : 0;
  return {
    uuid: p.uuid,
    username: p.username,
    online: p.online,
    currentServer: p.currentServer,
    firstSeenAt: p.firstSeenAt.toISOString(),
    lastSeenAt: p.lastSeenAt.toISOString(),
    totalPlaytimeSeconds: Number(p.totalPlaytimeSeconds) + running,
    connectionCount: p.connectionCount,
  };
}

@ApiTags('players')
@Controller('players')
export class PlayersController {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly skins: SkinService,
    private readonly settings: SettingsService,
    private readonly geoip: GeoIpService,
  ) {}

  /** Search by current name, previous names or UUID (dashed or undashed). */
  @Get()
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW)
  @ZodQuery(listQuery)
  async list(@Query() q: z.infer<typeof listQuery>) {
    const where: Prisma.PlayerWhereInput = {};
    if (q.online) where.online = q.online === 'true';
    if (q.search) {
      const uuid = normalizeUuid(q.search);
      where.OR = uuid
        ? [{ uuid }]
        : [{ username: { startsWith: q.search } }, { names: { some: { username: { startsWith: q.search } } } }];
    }
    const orderBy: Prisma.PlayerOrderByWithRelationInput =
      q.sort === 'username' ? { username: 'asc' } : q.sort === 'firstSeen' ? { firstSeenAt: 'desc' } : q.sort === 'playtime' ? { totalPlaytimeSeconds: 'desc' } : { lastSeenAt: 'desc' };

    const [total, rows] = await this.prisma.$transaction([
      this.prisma.player.count({ where }),
      this.prisma.player.findMany({ where, select: listSelect, orderBy, skip: (q.page - 1) * q.pageSize, take: q.pageSize }),
    ]);
    const starts = await this.openSessionStarts(rows.filter((r) => r.online).map((r) => r.uuid));
    return { total, page: q.page, pageSize: q.pageSize, items: rows.map((r) => serializeListRow(r, starts.get(r.uuid))) };
  }

  @Get(':uuid')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW)
  async profile(@Param('uuid') raw: string, @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const uuid = normalizeUuid(raw);
    if (!uuid) throw new NotFoundException();
    const player = await this.prisma.player.findUnique({
      where: { uuid },
      include: {
        currentServer: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
        names: { orderBy: { firstSeenAt: 'desc' } },
      },
    });
    if (!player) throw new NotFoundException();

    const canSeeIp = hasPermission(user.permissions, PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW_IP);
    const sessions = await this.prisma.playerSession.findMany({
      where: { playerUuid: uuid },
      orderBy: { startedAt: 'desc' },
      take: 20,
      include: {
        proxyServer: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
        serverVisits: { orderBy: { joinedAt: 'asc' }, include: { server: { select: { id: true, name: true } } } },
        connection: true,
      },
    });
    const open = sessions.find((s) => !s.endedAt);

    return {
      ...serializeListRow(player, open?.startedAt),
      gamemode: player.gamemode,
      clientVersion: player.clientVersion,
      clientProtocol: player.clientProtocol,
      clientBrand: player.clientBrand,
      rank: player.rank,
      skinModel: player.skinModel,
      // Not collected yet (requires AFK tracking on Paper, Phase 5): null means "not recorded".
      activePlaytimeSeconds: player.activePlaytimeSeconds === null ? null : Number(player.activePlaytimeSeconds),
      afkSeconds: player.afkSeconds === null ? null : Number(player.afkSeconds),
      names: player.names.map((n) => ({ username: n.username, firstSeenAt: n.firstSeenAt.toISOString(), lastSeenAt: n.lastSeenAt.toISOString() })),
      canViewConnectionData: canSeeIp,
      sessions: sessions.map((s) => ({
        id: s.id.toString(),
        proxy: s.proxyServer,
        startedAt: s.startedAt.toISOString(),
        endedAt: s.endedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
        durationSeconds: s.durationSeconds,
        servers: s.serverVisits.map((v) => ({ server: v.server, joinedAt: v.joinedAt.toISOString(), leftAt: v.leftAt?.toISOString() ?? null })),
        connection: s.connection
          ? {
              clientProtocol: s.connection.clientProtocol,
              clientBrand: s.connection.clientBrand,
              // Personal data: only with players.view.ip.
              ...(canSeeIp ? { ipAddress: s.connection.ipAddress, virtualHost: s.connection.virtualHost } : {}),
            }
          : null,
      })),
    };
  }

  /** Skin texture (64×64 PNG), resolved and cached server-side. 404 when unknown. */
  @Get(':uuid/skin')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW)
  async skin(@Param('uuid') raw: string, @Res() res: Response) {
    const uuid = normalizeUuid(raw);
    const skin = uuid ? await this.skins.getSkin(uuid) : null;
    if (!skin) throw new NotFoundException({ code: 'SKIN_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'No skin available' });
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'image/png');
    res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'private, max-age=3600');
    res.setHeader('X-Skin-Model', skin.model);
    res.setHeader('Content-Security-Policy', "default-src 'none'");
    res.send(skin.png);
  }

  /** Daily playtime and weekday/hour heatmap from recorded sessions, in the viewer's time zone. */
  @Get(':uuid/activity')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW)
  @ZodQuery(activityQuery)
  async activity(@Param('uuid') raw: string, @Query() q: z.infer<typeof activityQuery>, @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const uuid = normalizeUuid(raw);
    if (!uuid || !(await this.prisma.player.findUnique({ where: { uuid }, select: { uuid: true } }))) throw new NotFoundException();
    const timezone = user.timezone ?? (await this.settings.getNetwork()).defaultTimezone;
    const from = new Date(Date.now() - q.days * 86_400_000);
    const sessions = await this.prisma.playerSession.findMany({
      where: { playerUuid: uuid, startedAt: { lt: new Date() }, OR: [{ endedAt: null }, { endedAt: { gt: from } }] },
      select: { startedAt: true, endedAt: true },
      take: 10_000,
    });
    return buildActivity(sessions, { timezone, days: q.days });
  }

  /**
   * Connection history. IP addresses require players.view.ip, approximate
   * location requires players.view.location; other fields players.view.
   */
  @Get(':uuid/connections')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW)
  @ZodQuery(paginationSchema)
  async connections(@Param('uuid') raw: string, @Query() q: z.infer<typeof paginationSchema>, @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const uuid = normalizeUuid(raw);
    if (!uuid || !(await this.prisma.player.findUnique({ where: { uuid }, select: { uuid: true } }))) throw new NotFoundException();
    const canIp = hasPermission(user.permissions, PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW_IP);
    const canLocation = hasPermission(user.permissions, PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW_LOCATION);

    const [total, rows] = await this.prisma.$transaction([
      this.prisma.playerConnection.count({ where: { playerUuid: uuid } }),
      this.prisma.playerConnection.findMany({
        where: { playerUuid: uuid },
        orderBy: { connectedAt: 'desc' },
        skip: (q.page - 1) * q.pageSize,
        take: q.pageSize,
        include: { session: { select: { endedAt: true, durationSeconds: true, proxyServer: { select: { name: true } } } } },
      }),
    ]);
    const location = (c: { countryCode: string | null; region: string | null; city: string | null; isp: string | null; asn: number | null }) =>
      canLocation ? { countryCode: c.countryCode, region: c.region, city: c.city, isp: c.isp, asn: c.asn } : undefined;

    const items = rows.map((c) => ({
      id: c.id.toString(),
      connectedAt: c.connectedAt.toISOString(),
      endedAt: c.session?.endedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      durationSeconds: c.session?.durationSeconds ?? null,
      proxy: c.session?.proxyServer?.name ?? null,
      clientProtocol: c.clientProtocol,
      clientBrand: c.clientBrand,
      ...(canIp ? { ipAddress: c.ipAddress, virtualHost: c.virtualHost } : {}),
      ...(canLocation ? { location: location(c) } : {}),
    }));

    let ipSummary: unknown = undefined;
    let relatedAccounts: unknown = undefined;
    if (canIp) {
      const groups = await this.prisma.playerConnection.groupBy({
        by: ['ipAddress'],
        where: { playerUuid: uuid, ipAddress: { not: null } },
        _count: { _all: true },
        _min: { connectedAt: true },
        _max: { connectedAt: true },
        orderBy: { _max: { connectedAt: 'desc' } },
        take: 50,
      });
      const ips = groups.map((g) => g.ipAddress!).filter(Boolean);
      const latest = canLocation
        ? await this.prisma.playerConnection.findMany({ where: { playerUuid: uuid, ipAddress: { in: ips } }, orderBy: { connectedAt: 'desc' }, distinct: ['ipAddress'] })
        : [];
      ipSummary = groups.map((g) => {
        const loc = latest.find((l) => l.ipAddress === g.ipAddress);
        return {
          ipAddress: g.ipAddress,
          connections: g._count._all,
          firstSeenAt: g._min.connectedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
          lastSeenAt: g._max.connectedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
          ...(canLocation && loc ? { location: location(loc) } : {}),
        };
      });
      // Other accounts that connected from the same addresses (possible alternate accounts).
      const shared = ips.length
        ? await this.prisma.playerConnection.groupBy({
            by: ['playerUuid'],
            where: { ipAddress: { in: ips }, playerUuid: { not: uuid } },
            _count: { _all: true },
            _max: { connectedAt: true },
            orderBy: { _max: { connectedAt: 'desc' } },
            take: 25,
          })
        : [];
      const players = await this.prisma.player.findMany({ where: { uuid: { in: shared.map((s) => s.playerUuid) } }, select: { uuid: true, username: true, online: true } });
      relatedAccounts = shared.map((s) => ({
        ...players.find((p) => p.uuid === s.playerUuid),
        connections: s._count._all,
        lastSeenAt: s._max.connectedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      }));
    }

    return { total, page: q.page, pageSize: q.pageSize, items, canViewIp: canIp, canViewLocation: canLocation, geoipEnabled: this.geoip.enabled, ipSummary, relatedAccounts };
  }

  private async openSessionStarts(uuids: string[]): Promise<Map<string, Date>> {
    if (!uuids.length) return new Map();
    const open = await this.prisma.playerSession.findMany({
      where: { playerUuid: { in: uuids }, endedAt: null },
      select: { playerUuid: true, startedAt: true },
      orderBy: { startedAt: 'asc' },
    });
    const map = new Map<string, Date>();
    for (const s of open) if (!map.has(s.playerUuid)) map.set(s.playerUuid, s.startedAt);
    return map;
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/players/skin.service.ts`:

```ts
import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { RedisService } from '../redis/redis.service';
import { isPremiumUuid, isSkinPng, normalizeTextureUrl, parseTexturesProperty, type SkinTexture } from './skins';

const MAX_SKIN_BYTES = 64 * 1024;
const FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000;
const TEXTURE_TTL_SECONDS = 30 * 86_400; // texture URLs are content-addressed and immutable
const PROFILE_TTL_SECONDS = 6 * 3600;
const NEGATIVE_TTL_SECONDS = 3600;

export interface Skin {
  png: Buffer;
  model: 'classic' | 'slim';
}

/**
 * Resolves and caches player skins on the server, so dashboard users' browsers
 * never contact third-party services. Sources, in order: texture URL reported by
 * the proxy at login, then Mojang's session server (premium UUIDs only).
 */
@Injectable()
export class SkinService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(SkinService.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly redis: RedisService,
  ) {}

  async getSkin(uuid: string): Promise<Skin | null> {
    const texture = await this.resolveTexture(uuid);
    if (!texture) return null;
    const png = await this.fetchTexture(texture.url);
    return png ? { png, model: texture.model } : null;
  }

  private async resolveTexture(uuid: string): Promise<SkinTexture | null> {
    const player = await this.prisma.player.findUnique({ where: { uuid }, select: { skinTextureUrl: true, skinModel: true } });
    const known = normalizeTextureUrl(player?.skinTextureUrl);
    if (known) return { url: known, model: player?.skinModel === 'slim' ? 'slim' : 'classic' };
    if (!player || !isPremiumUuid(uuid)) return null;

    const cacheKey = `mnm:skin:profile:${uuid}`;
    const cached = await this.redis.client.get(cacheKey).catch(() => null);
    if (cached) return cached === 'none' ? null : (JSON.parse(cached) as SkinTexture);

    let texture: SkinTexture | null = null;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`https://sessionserver.mojang.com/session/minecraft/profile/${uuid.replace(/-/g, '')}`, {
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS),
        redirect: 'error',
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const body = (await res.json()) as { properties?: { name: string; value: string }[] };
        texture = parseTexturesProperty(body.properties?.find((p) => p.name === 'textures')?.value);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      this.logger.debug(`Session server lookup failed for ${uuid}: ${(err as Error).message}`);
      return null; // transient: do not cache
    }
    await this.redis.client.set(cacheKey, texture ? JSON.stringify(texture) : 'none', 'EX', texture ? PROFILE_TTL_SECONDS : NEGATIVE_TTL_SECONDS).catch(() => undefined);
    return texture;
  }

  private async fetchTexture(url: string): Promise<Buffer | null> {
    const allowed = normalizeTextureUrl(url);
    if (!allowed) return null;
    const cacheKey = `mnm:skin:texture:${allowed.slice(allowed.lastIndexOf('/') + 1)}`;
    const cached = await this.redis.client.getBuffer(cacheKey).catch(() => null);
    if (cached) return cached;

    try {
      const res = await fetch(allowed, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS), redirect: 'error' });
      if (!res.ok) return null;
      const length = Number(res.headers.get('content-length') ?? 0);
      if (length > MAX_SKIN_BYTES) return null;
      const png = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
      if (png.length > MAX_SKIN_BYTES || !isSkinPng(png)) return null;
      await this.redis.client.set(cacheKey, png, 'EX', TEXTURE_TTL_SECONDS).catch(() => undefined);
      return png;
    } catch (err) {
      this.logger.debug(`Texture download failed: ${(err as Error).message}`);
      return null;
    }
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/players/skins.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Minecraft skin texture handling. Only textures hosted on Mojang's texture
 * server are ever fetched by the backend (prevents server-side request forgery
 * through crafted profile properties).
 */
const TEXTURE_URL = /^https?:\/\/textures\.minecraft\.net\/texture\/([0-9a-f]{16,128})$/;

export interface SkinTexture {
  url: string;
  model: 'classic' | 'slim';
}

/** Normalises a texture URL to https, or returns null when it is not an allowed Mojang texture. */
export function normalizeTextureUrl(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') return null;
  const match = TEXTURE_URL.exec(value.trim());
  return match ? `https://textures.minecraft.net/texture/${match[1]}` : null;
}

/** Parses the base64 "textures" game-profile property. Returns null for missing/invalid data. */
export function parseTexturesProperty(base64: string | undefined | null): SkinTexture | null {
  if (!base64 || base64.length > 8192) return null;
  try {
    const decoded = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(base64, 'base64').toString('utf8')) as {
      textures?: { SKIN?: { url?: string; metadata?: { model?: string } } };
    };
    const url = normalizeTextureUrl(decoded.textures?.SKIN?.url);
    if (!url) return null;
    return { url, model: decoded.textures?.SKIN?.metadata?.model === 'slim' ? 'slim' : 'classic' };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Mojang only issues version-4 (random) UUIDs for premium accounts; offline-mode UUIDs are version 3. */
export function isPremiumUuid(uuid: string): boolean {
  return uuid.length === 36 && uuid[14] === '4';
}

/** PNG signature check plus the dimensions Minecraft skins use (64×64 or legacy 64×32). */
export function isSkinPng(data: Buffer): boolean {
  if (data.length < 24 || data.readUInt32BE(0) !== 0x89504e47 || data.readUInt32BE(4) !== 0x0d0a1a0a) return false;
  const width = data.readUInt32BE(16);
  const height = data.readUInt32BE(20);
  return width === 64 && (height === 64 || height === 32);
}
```

`apps/backend/src/plugin-api/player-tracking.service.ts`:

```ts
import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Prisma } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { GeoIpService } from '../players/geoip.service';
import { parseTexturesProperty } from '../players/skins';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { RealtimeService } from '../realtime/realtime.service';
import { SETTING_KEYS, SettingsService } from '../settings/settings.service';
import type { JoinEvent, PluginEvent, SyncInput } from './plugin-events';

type Tx = Prisma.TransactionClient;

/**
 * Network session tracking driven by proxy events. Every operation is
 * idempotent (keyed by the plugin-generated session key) so buffered events
 * can be retried safely after outages.
 */
@Injectable()
export class PlayerTrackingService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(PlayerTrackingService.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly realtime: RealtimeService,
    private readonly settings: SettingsService,
    private readonly geoip: GeoIpService,
  ) {}

  /** Applies a batch of proxy events in order. Returns how many were applied vs. skipped as duplicates. */
  async applyEvents(proxyId: string, events: PluginEvent[]): Promise<{ applied: number; skipped: number }> {
    let applied = 0;
    let joined = false;
    for (const event of events) {
      const changed = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        switch (event.type) {
          case 'player.join':
            return this.join(tx, proxyId, event);
          case 'player.switch':
            return this.switchServer(tx, event.sessionKey, event.uuid, event.server, event.at);
          case 'player.brand':
            return this.brand(tx, event.uuid, event.brand);
          case 'player.leave':
            return this.leave(tx, event.sessionKey, event.at);
        }
      });
      if (!changed) continue;
      applied++;
      if (event.type === 'player.join') joined = true;
      this.realtime.publish({
        type: event.type === 'player.join' ? 'player.online' : event.type === 'player.leave' ? 'player.offline' : 'player.updated',
        uuid: event.uuid,
      });
    }
    if (joined) await this.updatePlayerRecord();
    return { applied, skipped: events.length - applied };
  }

  private async join(tx: Tx, proxyId: string, e: JoinEvent): Promise<boolean> {
    if (await tx.playerSession.findUnique({ where: { sessionKey: e.sessionKey }, select: { id: true } })) return false;

    const skin = parseTexturesProperty(e.textures);
    const skinData = skin ? { skinTextureUrl: skin.url, skinModel: skin.model } : {};
    const geo = this.geoip.lookup(e.ip);

    await tx.player.upsert({
      where: { uuid: e.uuid },
      create: {
        uuid: e.uuid,
        username: e.username,
        firstSeenAt: e.at,
        lastSeenAt: e.at,
        online: true,
        connectionCount: 1,
        clientProtocol: e.protocol,
        clientVersion: e.clientVersion,
        ...skinData,
      },
      update: {
        username: e.username,
        lastSeenAt: e.at,
        online: true,
        connectionCount: { increment: 1 },
        clientProtocol: e.protocol,
        clientVersion: e.clientVersion,
        ...skinData,
      },
    });
    await tx.playerName.upsert({
      where: { playerUuid_username: { playerUuid: e.uuid, username: e.username } },
      create: { playerUuid: e.uuid, username: e.username, firstSeenAt: e.at, lastSeenAt: e.at },
      update: { lastSeenAt: e.at },
    });
    const session = await tx.playerSession.create({
      data: { sessionKey: e.sessionKey, playerUuid: e.uuid, proxyServerId: proxyId, startedAt: e.at },
    });
    await tx.playerConnection.create({
      data: {
        playerUuid: e.uuid,
        sessionId: session.id,
        ipAddress: e.ip ?? null,
        virtualHost: e.virtualHost ?? null,
        clientProtocol: e.protocol ?? null,
        connectedAt: e.at,
        // Approximate, IP-derived location (only when a GeoIP database is configured).
        countryCode: geo?.countryCode ?? null,
        region: geo?.region ?? null,
        city: geo?.city ?? null,
        asn: geo?.asn ?? null,
        isp: geo?.isp ?? null,
      },
    });
    return true;
  }

  private async switchServer(tx: Tx, sessionKey: string, uuid: string, serverName: string, at: Date): Promise<boolean> {
    const session = await tx.playerSession.findUnique({ where: { sessionKey } });
    if (!session || session.endedAt) return false;

    const server = await tx.server.findUnique({ where: { name: serverName }, select: { id: true } });
    const open = await tx.playerServerVisit.findFirst({ where: { sessionId: session.id, leftAt: null }, orderBy: { joinedAt: 'desc' } });
    if (open && server && open.serverId === server.id) return false;
    if (open) await tx.playerServerVisit.update({ where: { id: open.id }, data: { leftAt: at } });

    if (server) {
      await tx.playerServerVisit.create({ data: { playerUuid: uuid, sessionId: session.id, serverId: server.id, joinedAt: at } });
    } else {
      // Backend servers must be registered under the same name as in velocity.toml.
      this.logger.debug(`Player ${uuid} switched to unregistered server "${serverName}"`);
    }
    await tx.player.update({ where: { uuid }, data: { currentServerId: server?.id ?? null } });
    return true;
  }

  private async brand(tx: Tx, uuid: string, brand: string): Promise<boolean> {
    // Only a real change counts, so retried batches are reported as skipped.
    const result = await tx.player.updateMany({
      where: { uuid, OR: [{ clientBrand: null }, { clientBrand: { not: brand } }] },
      data: { clientBrand: brand },
    });
    if (result.count) {
      const connection = await tx.playerConnection.findFirst({ where: { playerUuid: uuid }, orderBy: { connectedAt: 'desc' }, select: { id: true } });
      if (connection) await tx.playerConnection.update({ where: { id: connection.id }, data: { clientBrand: brand } });
    }
    return result.count > 0;
  }

  private async leave(tx: Tx, sessionKey: string, at: Date): Promise<boolean> {
    const session = await tx.playerSession.findUnique({ where: { sessionKey } });
    if (!session || session.endedAt) return false;
    await this.closeSession(tx, session, at);
    return true;
  }

  /** Ends a session, accumulates playtime and recomputes the player's online state. */
  private async closeSession(tx: Tx, session: { id: bigint; playerUuid: string; startedAt: Date }, at: Date): Promise<void> {
    const endedAt = at < session.startedAt ? session.startedAt : at;
    const duration = Math.floor((endedAt.getTime() - session.startedAt.getTime()) / 1000);
    await tx.playerSession.update({ where: { id: session.id }, data: { endedAt, durationSeconds: duration } });
    await tx.playerServerVisit.updateMany({ where: { sessionId: session.id, leftAt: null }, data: { leftAt: endedAt } });

    const stillOnline = (await tx.playerSession.count({ where: { playerUuid: session.playerUuid, endedAt: null } })) > 0;
    await tx.player.update({
      where: { uuid: session.playerUuid },
      data: {
        totalPlaytimeSeconds: { increment: BigInt(duration) },
        lastSeenAt: endedAt,
        online: stillOnline,
        ...(stillOnline ? {} : { currentServerId: null }),
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Reconciles the proxy's authoritative list of connected players with the
   * database: closes sessions the proxy no longer has and opens missing ones.
   */
  async sync(proxyId: string, input: SyncInput): Promise<{ closed: number; opened: number; moved: number }> {
    const now = new Date();
    const reported = new Map(input.sessions.map((s) => [s.sessionKey, s]));
    const open = await this.prisma.playerSession.findMany({ where: { proxyServerId: proxyId, endedAt: null } });
    let closed = 0;
    let opened = 0;
    let moved = 0;

    for (const session of open) {
      if (session.sessionKey && reported.has(session.sessionKey)) continue;
      await this.prisma.$transaction((tx) => this.closeSession(tx, session, now));
      this.realtime.publish({ type: 'player.offline', uuid: session.playerUuid });
      closed++;
    }

    const known = new Set(open.map((s) => s.sessionKey));
    for (const s of input.sessions) {
      if (!known.has(s.sessionKey)) {
        const created = await this.prisma.$transaction((tx) =>
          this.join(tx, proxyId, { type: 'player.join', sessionKey: s.sessionKey, uuid: s.uuid, username: s.username, at: now }),
        );
        if (created) {
          opened++;
          this.realtime.publish({ type: 'player.online', uuid: s.uuid });
        }
      }
      if (s.server) {
        const server = s.server;
        if (await this.prisma.$transaction((tx) => this.switchServer(tx, s.sessionKey, s.uuid, server, now))) moved++;
      }
    }
    if (opened) await this.updatePlayerRecord();
    return { closed, opened, moved };
  }

  /** Closes every open session of a proxy (shutdown or lost heartbeat). */
  async closeProxySessions(proxyId: string, at: Date): Promise<number> {
    const open = await this.prisma.playerSession.findMany({ where: { proxyServerId: proxyId, endedAt: null } });
    for (const session of open) {
      await this.prisma.$transaction((tx) => this.closeSession(tx, session, at));
      this.realtime.publish({ type: 'player.offline', uuid: session.playerUuid });
    }
    return open.length;
  }

  async updateGamemodes(players: { uuid: string; gamemode: string }[]): Promise<void> {
    const byMode = new Map<string, string[]>();
    for (const p of players) byMode.set(p.gamemode, [...(byMode.get(p.gamemode) ?? []), p.uuid]);
    for (const [gamemode, uuids] of byMode) {
      await this.prisma.player.updateMany({ where: { uuid: { in: uuids }, NOT: { gamemode } }, data: { gamemode } });
    }
  }

  /** Network-wide concurrent player record (measured, never estimated). */
  private async updatePlayerRecord(): Promise<void> {
    const online = await this.prisma.player.count({ where: { online: true } });
    const record = await this.settings.get<{ count: number; at: string }>(SETTING_KEYS.PLAYER_RECORD);
    if (!record || online > record.count) {
      await this.settings.set(SETTING_KEYS.PLAYER_RECORD, { count: online, at: new Date().toISOString() }, null);
    }
  }
}
```
