`apps/backend/src/plugin-api/plugin-api.controller.ts`:

```ts
import { Body, Controller, ForbiddenException, Get, HttpCode, Post, Req, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiHeader, ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { Throttle } from '@nestjs/throttler';
import { SkipCsrf } from '../auth/guards';
import { Public } from '../common/auth-context';
import { ZodBody } from '../common/zod';
import { ServerStatus, ServerType } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { RealtimeService } from '../realtime/realtime.service';
import { SettingsService } from '../settings/settings.service';
import { type PluginRequest, PluginAuthGuard, type PluginServer } from './plugin-auth.guard';
import { eventBatchSchema, type HeartbeatInput, heartbeatSchema, type PluginEvent, syncSchema, type SyncInput } from './plugin-events';
import { PlayerTrackingService } from './player-tracking.service';

/** Recommended heartbeat interval returned to plugins. */
export const HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 15;

/** Signed machine-to-machine API used by the Velocity and Paper plugins. */
@ApiTags('plugin')
@ApiHeader({ name: 'X-MNM-Key-Id', required: true })
@ApiHeader({ name: 'X-MNM-Timestamp', required: true })
@ApiHeader({ name: 'X-MNM-Nonce', required: true })
@ApiHeader({ name: 'X-MNM-Signature', required: true })
@Public()
@SkipCsrf()
@UseGuards(PluginAuthGuard)
@Throttle({ default: { limit: 1200, ttl: 60_000 } })
@Controller('plugin/v1')
export class PluginApiController {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly tracking: PlayerTrackingService,
    private readonly realtime: RealtimeService,
    private readonly settings: SettingsService,
  ) {}

  /** Lets a plugin verify its credentials and clock. */
  @Get('ping')
  async ping(@Req() req: PluginRequest) {
    const server = req.pluginServer!;
    const configRevision = await this.settings.pluginSettingsRevision();
    return { serverId: server.id, serverName: server.name, serverType: server.type, serverTime: Date.now(), heartbeatIntervalSeconds: HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS, configRevision };
  }

  /**
   * Centrally managed settings. Plugins fetch them on start and whenever the
   * configRevision in a heartbeat response changes; null fields keep the
   * server's local value.
   */
  @Get('config')
  async config() {
    const { revision, settings } = await this.settings.getPluginSettings();
    return { revision, ...settings };
  }

  @Post('heartbeat')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @ZodBody(heartbeatSchema)
  async heartbeat(@Req() req: PluginRequest, @Body() body: HeartbeatInput) {
    const server = req.pluginServer!;
    await this.prisma.server.update({
      where: { id: server.id },
      data: {
        status: ServerStatus.ONLINE,
        lastHeartbeatAt: new Date(),
        pluginVersion: body.pluginVersion,
        platformVersion: body.platformVersion,
        minecraftVersion: body.minecraftVersion,
        onlinePlayers: body.onlinePlayers,
        maxPlayers: body.maxPlayers ?? null,
        tps: body.tps ?? null,
        mspt: body.mspt ?? null,
        memoryUsedBytes: body.memoryUsedBytes === undefined ? null : BigInt(body.memoryUsedBytes),
        memoryMaxBytes: body.memoryMaxBytes === undefined ? null : BigInt(body.memoryMaxBytes),
        cpuLoad: body.cpuLoad ?? null,
      },
    });
    if (server.type === ServerType.PAPER && body.players?.length) await this.tracking.updateGamemodes(body.players);
    this.realtime.publish({ type: 'server.updated', serverId: server.id });
    return { serverTime: Date.now(), heartbeatIntervalSeconds: HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS, configRevision: await this.settings.pluginSettingsRevision() };
  }

  /** Ordered batch of player events from the proxy (join, server switch, client brand, leave). */
  @Post('events')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @ZodBody(eventBatchSchema)
  events(@Req() req: PluginRequest, @Body() body: { events: PluginEvent[] }) {
    return this.tracking.applyEvents(this.requireProxy(req.pluginServer!).id, body.events);
  }

  /** Full list of players currently connected to the proxy; reconciles state after outages. */
  @Post('sync')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @ZodBody(syncSchema)
  sync(@Req() req: PluginRequest, @Body() body: SyncInput) {
    return this.tracking.sync(this.requireProxy(req.pluginServer!).id, body);
  }

  /** Graceful shutdown: marks the server offline and ends the proxy's open sessions. */
  @Post('shutdown')
  @HttpCode(200)
  async shutdown(@Req() req: PluginRequest) {
    const server = req.pluginServer!;
    await this.prisma.server.update({ where: { id: server.id }, data: { status: ServerStatus.OFFLINE, onlinePlayers: 0 } });
    const closedSessions = server.type === ServerType.VELOCITY ? await this.tracking.closeProxySessions(server.id, new Date()) : 0;
    this.realtime.publish({ type: 'server.updated', serverId: server.id });
    return { closedSessions };
  }

  private requireProxy(server: PluginServer): PluginServer {
    if (server.type !== ServerType.VELOCITY) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'PROXY_ONLY', message: 'Only Velocity proxies may report player sessions' });
    }
    return server;
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/plugin-api/plugin-auth.guard.ts`:

```ts
import { type CanActivate, type ExecutionContext, ForbiddenException, Injectable, Logger, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Request } from 'express';
import type { ServerType } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { RedisService } from '../redis/redis.service';
import { checkSignature, NONCE_TTL_SECONDS, SIGNATURE_HEADERS } from './plugin-signature';

export interface PluginServer {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: ServerType;
  credentialId: string;
}

export type PluginRequest = Request & { pluginServer?: PluginServer; rawBody?: Buffer };

/** Authenticates Velocity/Paper plugins by HMAC request signature with replay protection. */
@Injectable()
export class PluginAuthGuard implements CanActivate {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(PluginAuthGuard.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly redis: RedisService,
  ) {}

  async canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): Promise<boolean> {
    const req = context.switchToHttp().getRequest<PluginRequest>();
    const keyId = req.header(SIGNATURE_HEADERS.keyId);
    if (!keyId || keyId.length > 64) throw this.unauthorized('MISSING_KEY');

    const credential = await this.prisma.serverCredential.findUnique({ where: { keyId }, include: { server: true } });
    if (!credential || credential.revokedAt) throw this.unauthorized('UNKNOWN_KEY');

    const check = checkSignature({
      signingKeyHex: credential.secretHash,
      method: req.method,
      path: req.originalUrl,
      timestamp: req.header(SIGNATURE_HEADERS.timestamp),
      nonce: req.header(SIGNATURE_HEADERS.nonce),
      signature: req.header(SIGNATURE_HEADERS.signature),
      body: req.rawBody ?? Buffer.alloc(0),
    });
    if (!check.ok) {
      this.logger.warn(`Rejected plugin request from ${credential.server.name}: ${check.reason}`);
      throw this.unauthorized(check.reason);
    }

    // Single-use nonce (replay protection). SET NX succeeds only the first time.
    const fresh = await this.redis.client.set(`mnm:nonce:${keyId}:${req.header(SIGNATURE_HEADERS.nonce)}`, '1', 'EX', NONCE_TTL_SECONDS, 'NX');
    if (fresh !== 'OK') throw this.unauthorized('REPLAYED');

    if (!credential.server.enabled) throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'SERVER_DISABLED', message: 'This server connection is disabled' });

    req.pluginServer = { id: credential.server.id, name: credential.server.name, type: credential.server.type, credentialId: credential.id };
    void this.prisma.serverCredential.update({ where: { id: credential.id }, data: { lastUsedAt: new Date() } }).catch(() => undefined);
    return true;
  }

  private unauthorized(code: string) {
    return new UnauthorizedException({ code: `PLUGIN_AUTH_${code}`, message: 'Plugin authentication failed' });
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/plugin-api/plugin-events.ts`:

```ts
import { z } from 'zod';

const UUID = /^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$/;

export const uuidSchema = z.string().regex(UUID, 'Expected a dashed UUID').transform((v) => v.toLowerCase());

/** Epoch milliseconds from the plugin clock. Future values (clock drift) are clamped to "now". */
export const instantSchema = z
  .number()
  .int()
  .positive()
  .transform((ms) => new Date(Math.min(ms, Date.now())));

// Minecraft names are 3–16 chars [A-Za-z0-9_]; offline-mode/Bedrock proxies may use other characters.
const usernameSchema = z.string().min(1).max(16).regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_.*-]+$/);
const serverNameSchema = z.string().min(1).max(64);

export const joinEventSchema = z.object({
  type: z.literal('player.join'),
  sessionKey: uuidSchema,
  uuid: uuidSchema,
  username: usernameSchema,
  at: instantSchema,
  ip: z.union([z.ipv4(), z.ipv6()]).optional(),
  virtualHost: z.string().max(255).optional(),
  protocol: z.number().int().min(0).max(1_000_000).optional(),
  clientVersion: z.string().max(32).optional(),
  /** Base64 'textures' game-profile property (skin). */
  textures: z.string().max(8192).optional(),
});

export const switchEventSchema = z.object({
  type: z.literal('player.switch'),
  sessionKey: uuidSchema,
  uuid: uuidSchema,
  server: serverNameSchema,
  at: instantSchema,
});

export const brandEventSchema = z.object({
  type: z.literal('player.brand'),
  sessionKey: uuidSchema,
  uuid: uuidSchema,
  brand: z.string().max(128),
});

export const leaveEventSchema = z.object({
  type: z.literal('player.leave'),
  sessionKey: uuidSchema,
  uuid: uuidSchema,
  at: instantSchema,
});

export const pluginEventSchema = z.discriminatedUnion('type', [joinEventSchema, switchEventSchema, brandEventSchema, leaveEventSchema]);
export type PluginEvent = z.infer<typeof pluginEventSchema>;
export type JoinEvent = z.infer<typeof joinEventSchema>;

export const eventBatchSchema = z.object({ events: z.array(pluginEventSchema).min(1).max(500) });

export const syncSchema = z.object({
  sessions: z
    .array(
      z.object({
        sessionKey: uuidSchema,
        uuid: uuidSchema,
        username: usernameSchema,
        server: serverNameSchema.optional(),
      }),
    )
    .max(100_000),
});
export type SyncInput = z.infer<typeof syncSchema>;

export const heartbeatSchema = z.object({
  pluginVersion: z.string().min(1).max(32),
  platformVersion: z.string().max(128).optional(),
  minecraftVersion: z.string().max(32).optional(),
  onlinePlayers: z.number().int().min(0).max(1_000_000),
  maxPlayers: z.number().int().min(0).max(1_000_000).optional(),
  tps: z.number().min(0).max(1000).optional(),
  mspt: z.number().min(0).max(1_000_000).optional(),
  memoryUsedBytes: z.number().int().min(0).optional(),
  memoryMaxBytes: z.number().int().min(0).optional(),
  cpuLoad: z.number().min(0).max(1).optional(),
  /** Paper only: per-player state that is only known on the backend server. */
  players: z
    .array(z.object({ uuid: uuidSchema, gamemode: z.enum(['SURVIVAL', 'CREATIVE', 'ADVENTURE', 'SPECTATOR']) }))
    .max(10_000)
    .optional(),
});
export type HeartbeatInput = z.infer<typeof heartbeatSchema>;
```

`apps/backend/src/plugin-api/plugin-signature.ts`:

```ts
import { createHash, createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';

/**
 * Plugin request signing (shared contract with apps/plugin-common: RequestSigner.java).
 *
 *   signingKey = SHA-256(secret)                       (raw 32 bytes; the backend stores it as hex)
 *   canonical  = METHOD \n PATH \n TIMESTAMP \n NONCE \n hex(SHA-256(body))
 *   signature  = hex(HMAC-SHA256(signingKey, canonical))
 *
 * Headers: X-MNM-Key-Id, X-MNM-Timestamp (epoch ms), X-MNM-Nonce, X-MNM-Signature.
 * The secret itself never travels after registration; timestamp + single-use
 * nonce make captured requests unusable for replay.
 */
export const SIGNATURE_HEADERS = {
  keyId: 'x-mnm-key-id',
  timestamp: 'x-mnm-timestamp',
  nonce: 'x-mnm-nonce',
  signature: 'x-mnm-signature',
} as const;

/** Maximum accepted clock difference between plugin and backend. */
export const MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_MS = 5 * 60_000;
/** Nonces are remembered at least as long as a timestamp stays acceptable. */
export const NONCE_TTL_SECONDS = Math.ceil((2 * MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_MS) / 1000);

const NONCE_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,64}$/;

export function canonicalRequest(method: string, path: string, timestamp: string, nonce: string, body: Buffer | string): string {
  const bodyHash = createHash('sha256').update(body).digest('hex');
  return [method.toUpperCase(), path, timestamp, nonce, bodyHash].join('\n');
}

export function sign(signingKeyHex: string, canonical: string): string {
  return createHmac('sha256', Buffer.from(signingKeyHex, 'hex')).update(canonical, 'utf8').digest('hex');
}

export type SignatureCheck =
  | { ok: true }
  | { ok: false; reason: 'MISSING_HEADERS' | 'BAD_TIMESTAMP' | 'CLOCK_SKEW' | 'BAD_NONCE' | 'BAD_SIGNATURE' };

export function checkSignature(input: {
  signingKeyHex: string;
  method: string;
  path: string;
  timestamp: string | undefined;
  nonce: string | undefined;
  signature: string | undefined;
  body: Buffer | string;
  now?: number;
}): SignatureCheck {
  const { timestamp, nonce, signature } = input;
  if (!timestamp || !nonce || !signature) return { ok: false, reason: 'MISSING_HEADERS' };
  if (!/^\d{10,16}$/.test(timestamp)) return { ok: false, reason: 'BAD_TIMESTAMP' };
  if (Math.abs((input.now ?? Date.now()) - Number(timestamp)) > MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_MS) return { ok: false, reason: 'CLOCK_SKEW' };
  if (!NONCE_PATTERN.test(nonce)) return { ok: false, reason: 'BAD_NONCE' };
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(signature)) return { ok: false, reason: 'BAD_SIGNATURE' };

  const expected = sign(input.signingKeyHex, canonicalRequest(input.method, input.path, timestamp, nonce, input.body));
  const valid = timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(expected, 'hex'), Buffer.from(signature, 'hex'));
  return valid ? { ok: true } : { ok: false, reason: 'BAD_SIGNATURE' };
}

```

`apps/backend/src/plugin-api/stale-server.monitor.ts`:

```ts
import { Injectable, Logger, type OnApplicationBootstrap, type OnApplicationShutdown } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ServerStatus, ServerType } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { RealtimeService } from '../realtime/realtime.service';
import { RedisService } from '../redis/redis.service';
import { HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_MS } from '../servers/servers.service';
import { PlayerTrackingService } from './player-tracking.service';

const INTERVAL_MS = 30_000;
/** A proxy silent for this long is considered crashed; its sessions are closed at its last heartbeat. */
export const PROXY_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS = 3 * 60_000;

/**
 * Detects servers that stopped sending heartbeats without a graceful shutdown.
 * Runs on one replica at a time (Redis lock).
 */
@Injectable()
export class StaleServerMonitor implements OnApplicationBootstrap, OnApplicationShutdown {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(StaleServerMonitor.name);
  private timer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;

  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly redis: RedisService,
    private readonly tracking: PlayerTrackingService,
    private readonly realtime: RealtimeService,
  ) {}

  onApplicationBootstrap(): void {
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test') return;
    this.timer = setInterval(() => void this.run().catch((err: Error) => this.logger.warn(`Stale server check failed: ${err.message}`)), INTERVAL_MS);
  }

  onApplicationShutdown(): void {
    if (this.timer) clearInterval(this.timer);
  }

  async run(now = new Date()): Promise<{ markedOffline: number; closedSessions: number }> {
    const lock = await this.redis.client.set('mnm:lock:stale-servers', '1', 'PX', INTERVAL_MS - 1000, 'NX');
    if (lock !== 'OK') return { markedOffline: 0, closedSessions: 0 };

    const stale = await this.prisma.server.findMany({
      where: { status: ServerStatus.ONLINE, lastHeartbeatAt: { lt: new Date(now.getTime() - HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_MS) } },
      select: { id: true, name: true },
    });
    for (const server of stale) {
      await this.prisma.server.update({ where: { id: server.id }, data: { status: ServerStatus.OFFLINE } });
      this.realtime.publish({ type: 'server.updated', serverId: server.id });
      this.logger.warn(`Server "${server.name}" stopped sending heartbeats`);
    }

    let closedSessions = 0;
    const silentProxies = await this.prisma.server.findMany({
      where: {
        type: ServerType.VELOCITY,
        OR: [{ lastHeartbeatAt: null }, { lastHeartbeatAt: { lt: new Date(now.getTime() - PROXY_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS) } }],
        proxySessions: { some: { endedAt: null } },
      },
      select: { id: true, name: true, lastHeartbeatAt: true },
    });
    for (const proxy of silentProxies) {
      const closed = await this.tracking.closeProxySessions(proxy.id, proxy.lastHeartbeatAt ?? now);
      closedSessions += closed;
      this.logger.warn(`Closed ${closed} session(s) of unresponsive proxy "${proxy.name}"`);
    }
    return { markedOffline: stale.length, closedSessions };
  }
}

```

`apps/backend/src/prisma/prisma.service.ts`:

```ts
import { Injectable, Logger, type OnModuleDestroy, type OnModuleInit } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaMariaDb } from '@prisma/adapter-mariadb';
import { AppConfig } from '../config/app-config';
import { PrismaClient } from '../generated/prisma/client';

/** Builds MariaDB-connector pool options from a mysql:// URL (compatible with MySQL 8.4). */
export function poolConfigFromUrl(databaseUrl: string) {
  const url = new URL(databaseUrl);
  return {
    host: url.hostname,
    port: url.port ? Number(url.port) : 3306,
    user: decodeURIComponent(url.username),
    password: decodeURIComponent(url.password),
    database: url.pathname.replace(/^\//, ''),
    connectionLimit: Number(url.searchParams.get('connection_limit') ?? 10),
    // MySQL 8 defaults to caching_sha2_password; inside the private Docker
    // network the RSA public key may be fetched from the server.
    allowPublicKeyRetrieval: true,
    timezone: 'Z',
  };
}

@Injectable()
export class PrismaService extends PrismaClient implements OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(PrismaService.name);

  constructor(config: AppConfig) {
    super({ adapter: new PrismaMariaDb(poolConfigFromUrl(config.env.DATABASE_URL)) });
  }

  async onModuleInit(): Promise<void> {
    await this.$connect();
    this.logger.log('Database connection established');
  }

  async onModuleDestroy(): Promise<void> {
    await this.$disconnect();
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/punishments/player-moderation.controller.ts`:

```ts
import { Body, Controller, Delete, ForbiddenException, Get, HttpCode, NotFoundException, Param, Post, Query, Req } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { hasPermission, PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import type { Request } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { type AuthenticatedUser, clientIp, CurrentUser, RequirePermissions } from '../common/auth-context';
import { paginationSchema, ZodBody, ZodQuery } from '../common/zod';
import { AuditService, userActor } from '../audit/audit.service';
import { normalizeUuid } from '../players/players.controller';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { PunishmentsService } from './punishments.service';

const noteSchema = z.object({ content: z.string().trim().min(1).max(4000) });

/** Moderation data on a player profile: punishment history, active status and internal staff notes. */
@ApiTags('punishments')
@Controller('players/:uuid')
export class PlayerModerationController {
  constructor(
    private readonly punishments: PunishmentsService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly audit: AuditService,
  ) {}

  @Get('punishments')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_HISTORY)
  @ZodQuery(paginationSchema)
  async history(@Param('uuid') raw: string, @Query() q: z.infer<typeof paginationSchema>) {
    const uuid = this.uuid(raw);
    const [list, active] = await Promise.all([this.punishments.list({ ...q, targetUuid: uuid }), this.punishments.activeFor(uuid)]);
    return { ...list, active };
  }

  @Get('notes')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_NOTES)
  async notes(@Param('uuid') raw: string) {
    const notes = await this.prisma.playerNote.findMany({
      where: { playerUuid: this.uuid(raw) },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      include: { author: { select: { id: true, username: true } } },
    });
    return notes.map((n) => ({ id: n.id, content: n.content, author: n.author, createdAt: n.createdAt.toISOString() }));
  }

  @Post('notes')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_NOTES)
  @ZodBody(noteSchema)
  async addNote(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser, @Param('uuid') raw: string, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof noteSchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    const uuid = this.uuid(raw);
    if (!(await this.prisma.player.findUnique({ where: { uuid }, select: { uuid: true } }))) throw new NotFoundException();
    const note = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const created = await tx.playerNote.create({ data: { playerUuid: uuid, authorUserId: user.id, content: body.content } });
      await this.audit.record({ actor: userActor(user), action: 'players.note_added', targetType: 'player', targetId: uuid, metadata: { noteId: created.id }, ipAddress: clientIp(req) }, tx);
      return created;
    });
    return { id: note.id, content: note.content, author: { id: user.id, username: user.username }, createdAt: note.createdAt.toISOString() };
  }

  /** Authors may delete their own notes; others need dashboard.manage. */
  @Delete('notes/:noteId')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_NOTES)
  async deleteNote(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser, @Param('uuid') raw: string, @Param('noteId') noteId: string, @Req() req: Request) {
    const uuid = this.uuid(raw);
    const note = await this.prisma.playerNote.findFirst({ where: { id: noteId, playerUuid: uuid } });
    if (!note) throw new NotFoundException();
    if (note.authorUserId !== user.id && !hasPermission(user.permissions, PERMISSIONS.DASHBOARD_MANAGE)) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Only the author can delete this note' });
    }
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.playerNote.delete({ where: { id: noteId } });
      await this.audit.record({ actor: userActor(user), action: 'players.note_deleted', targetType: 'player', targetId: uuid, metadata: { noteId, content: note.content }, ipAddress: clientIp(req) }, tx);
    });
    return { ok: true };
  }

  private uuid(raw: string): string {
    const uuid = normalizeUuid(raw);
    if (!uuid) throw new NotFoundException();
    return uuid;
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/punishments/plugin-punishments.controller.ts`:

```ts
import { BadRequestException, Body, Controller, Get, HttpCode, Post, Query, Req, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { Throttle } from '@nestjs/throttler';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { SkipCsrf } from '../auth/guards';
import { Public } from '../common/auth-context';
import { ZodBody, ZodQuery } from '../common/zod';
import { ActorType, PunishmentSource, PunishmentType } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { type PluginRequest, PluginAuthGuard, type PluginServer } from '../plugin-api/plugin-auth.guard';
import { uuidSchema } from '../plugin-api/plugin-events';
import { MAX_DURATION_SECONDS, MIN_DURATION_SECONDS } from './punishment-rules';
import { reasonSchema } from './punishments.controller';
import { type Issuer, PunishmentsService } from './punishments.service';

const actorSchema = z.object({ uuid: uuidSchema.optional(), name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(32) });

const createSchema = z.object({
  type: z.enum([PunishmentType.BAN, PunishmentType.TEMP_BAN, PunishmentType.MUTE, PunishmentType.TEMP_MUTE, PunishmentType.KICK, PunishmentType.WARNING]),
  target: z.string().trim().min(1).max(36),
  reason: reasonSchema,
  durationSeconds: z.number().int().min(MIN_DURATION_SECONDS).max(MAX_DURATION_SECONDS).optional(),
  issuer: actorSchema,
  /** One key per command invocation; retries return the original punishment. */
  idempotencyKey: z.string().min(8).max(64),
});

const revokeSchema = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(['BAN', 'MUTE']),
  target: z.string().trim().min(1).max(36),
  reason: z.string().trim().max(500).optional(),
  revoker: actorSchema,
});

const changesQuery = z.object({ after: z.string().regex(/^\d{1,19}$/).default('0') });
const lookupQuery = z.object({ target: z.string().trim().min(1).max(36), limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(50).default(10) });

/** In-game moderation and the punishment feed for the plugins' local enforcement caches. */
@ApiTags('plugin')
@Public()
@SkipCsrf()
@UseGuards(PluginAuthGuard)
@Throttle({ default: { limit: 1200, ttl: 60_000 } })
@Controller('plugin/v1')
export class PluginPunishmentsController {
  constructor(private readonly punishments: PunishmentsService) {}

  @Get('punishments/active')
  snapshot() {
    return this.punishments.pluginSnapshot();
  }

  @Get('punishments/changes')
  @ZodQuery(changesQuery)
  changes(@Query() q: z.infer<typeof changesQuery>) {
    return this.punishments.pluginChanges(BigInt(q.after));
  }

  @Post('punishments')
  @ZodBody(createSchema)
  async create(@Req() req: PluginRequest, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof createSchema>) {
    const server = req.pluginServer!;
    const player = await this.punishments.resolvePlayer(body.target);
    return this.punishments.create({
      type: body.type,
      targetUuid: player.uuid,
      reason: body.reason,
      durationSeconds: body.durationSeconds,
      source: body.issuer.uuid ? PunishmentSource.COMMAND : PunishmentSource.CONSOLE,
      issuer: issuerFor(body.issuer, server),
      serverId: server.id,
      idempotencyKey: `${server.id}:${body.idempotencyKey}`,
    });
  }

  @Post('punishments/revoke')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @ZodBody(revokeSchema)
  async revoke(@Req() req: PluginRequest, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof revokeSchema>) {
    const player = await this.punishments.resolvePlayer(body.target);
    return this.punishments.revokeActive(player.uuid, body.kind, issuerFor(body.revoker, req.pluginServer!), body.reason || undefined);
  }

  /** Data for /history and /check. */
  @Get('players/lookup')
  @ZodQuery(lookupQuery)
  async lookup(@Query() q: z.infer<typeof lookupQuery>) {
    if (!q.target) throw new BadRequestException();
    const player = await this.punishments.resolvePlayer(q.target);
    const [active, history] = await Promise.all([
      this.punishments.activeFor(player.uuid),
      this.punishments.list({ page: 1, pageSize: q.limit, targetUuid: player.uuid }),
    ]);
    return { player: { uuid: player.uuid, username: player.username, online: player.online }, active, total: history.total, history: history.items };
  }
}

function issuerFor(actor: { uuid?: string; name: string }, server: PluginServer): Issuer {
  return actor.uuid
    ? { type: ActorType.PLAYER, uuid: actor.uuid, name: actor.name }
    : { type: ActorType.CONSOLE, name: `console@${server.name}`.slice(0, 64) };
}
```

`apps/backend/src/punishments/punishment-rules.ts`:

```ts
import { PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { type Punishment, PunishmentStatus, PunishmentType } from '../generated/prisma/client';

export const BAN_TYPES: readonly PunishmentType[] = [PunishmentType.BAN, PunishmentType.TEMP_BAN, PunishmentType.BLACKLIST];
export const MUTE_TYPES: readonly PunishmentType[] = [PunishmentType.MUTE, PunishmentType.TEMP_MUTE];
/** Types the plugins enforce from their local cache. */
export const ENFORCEABLE_TYPES: readonly PunishmentType[] = [...BAN_TYPES, ...MUTE_TYPES];
export const TEMPORARY_TYPES: readonly PunishmentType[] = [PunishmentType.TEMP_BAN, PunishmentType.TEMP_MUTE];

export const MIN_DURATION_SECONDS = 60;
export const MAX_DURATION_SECONDS = 10 * 365 * 86_400;

/** Permission required to issue each punishment type. */
export const ISSUE_PERMISSION: Record<PunishmentType, string> = {
  BAN: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_BAN,
  TEMP_BAN: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_BAN,
  MUTE: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_MUTE,
  TEMP_MUTE: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_MUTE,
  KICK: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_KICK,
  WARNING: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_WARN,
  BLACKLIST: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_BLACKLIST,
};

/** Permission required to revoke each punishment type. */
export const REVOKE_PERMISSION: Record<PunishmentType, string> = {
  BAN: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_UNBAN,
  TEMP_BAN: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_UNBAN,
  BLACKLIST: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_BLACKLIST,
  MUTE: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_UNMUTE,
  TEMP_MUTE: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_UNMUTE,
  WARNING: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_WARN,
  KICK: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_KICK,
};

/** Status as of `now`: active temporary punishments past their expiry are EXPIRED. */
export function effectiveStatus(p: Pick<Punishment, 'status' | 'expiresAt'>, now = Date.now()): PunishmentStatus {
  if (p.status === PunishmentStatus.ACTIVE && p.expiresAt && p.expiresAt.getTime() <= now) return PunishmentStatus.EXPIRED;
  return p.status;
}

/** Kicks are instantaneous: they are never "active" afterwards. */
export function isRevocable(p: Pick<Punishment, 'type' | 'status' | 'expiresAt'>, now = Date.now()): boolean {
  return p.type !== PunishmentType.KICK && effectiveStatus(p, now) === PunishmentStatus.ACTIVE;
}

/** Validates the duration for the type and returns the expiry (null = permanent / not applicable). */
export function computeExpiry(type: PunishmentType, durationSeconds: number | undefined, now = new Date()): { ok: true; expiresAt: Date | null } | { ok: false; reason: string } {
  const temporary = TEMPORARY_TYPES.includes(type);
  if (temporary) {
    if (durationSeconds === undefined) return { ok: false, reason: 'A duration is required for temporary punishments' };
    if (durationSeconds < MIN_DURATION_SECONDS || durationSeconds > MAX_DURATION_SECONDS) {
      return { ok: false, reason: `Duration must be between ${MIN_DURATION_SECONDS} seconds and 10 years` };
    }
    return { ok: true, expiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + durationSeconds * 1000) };
  }
  if (durationSeconds !== undefined) return { ok: false, reason: `${type} does not take a duration` };
  return { ok: true, expiresAt: null };
}
```

```ts
import { Body, Controller, ForbiddenException, Get, HttpCode, Param, Post, Query, Req } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { hasPermission, PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import type { Request } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { type AuthenticatedUser, clientIp, CurrentUser, RequirePermissions } from '../common/auth-context';
import { paginationSchema, ZodBody, ZodQuery } from '../common/zod';
import { ActorType, PunishmentSource, PunishmentType } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { ISSUE_PERMISSION, MAX_DURATION_SECONDS, MIN_DURATION_SECONDS, REVOKE_PERMISSION } from './punishment-rules';
import { type Issuer, PunishmentsService } from './punishments.service';

export const reasonSchema = z.string().trim().min(1).max(500);

const listQuery = paginationSchema.extend({
  type: z.enum(PunishmentType).optional(),
  status: z.enum(['active', 'expired', 'revoked']).optional(),
  search: z.string().trim().max(64).optional(),
});

const createSchema = z.object({
  type: z.enum(PunishmentType),
  target: z.string().trim().min(1).max(36),
  reason: reasonSchema,
  durationSeconds: z.number().int().min(MIN_DURATION_SECONDS).max(MAX_DURATION_SECONDS).optional(),
});

const revokeSchema = z.object({ reason: z.string().trim().max(500).optional() });

function dashboardIssuer(user: AuthenticatedUser): Issuer {
  return { type: ActorType.USER, userId: user.id, name: user.username };
}

@ApiTags('punishments')
@Controller('punishments')
export class PunishmentsController {
  constructor(
    private readonly punishments: PunishmentsService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
  ) {}

  @Get()
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_HISTORY)
  @ZodQuery(listQuery)
  list(@Query() q: z.infer<typeof listQuery>) {
    return this.punishments.list(q);
  }

  /** Issue a punishment. The required permission depends on the type (checked here, server-side). */
  @Post()
  @ZodBody(createSchema)
  async create(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof createSchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    this.require(user, ISSUE_PERMISSION[body.type]);
    const player = await this.punishments.resolvePlayer(body.target);
    return this.punishments.create({
      type: body.type,
      targetUuid: player.uuid,
      reason: body.reason,
      durationSeconds: body.durationSeconds,
      source: PunishmentSource.DASHBOARD,
      issuer: dashboardIssuer(user),
      ipAddress: clientIp(req),
    });
  }

  @Post(':id/revoke')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @ZodBody(revokeSchema)
  async revoke(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof revokeSchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    const punishment = await this.prisma.punishment.findUnique({ where: { id }, select: { type: true } });
    if (punishment) this.require(user, REVOKE_PERMISSION[punishment.type]);
    return this.punishments.revokeById(id, dashboardIssuer(user), body.reason || undefined, clientIp(req));
  }

  private require(user: AuthenticatedUser, permission: string): void {
    if (!hasPermission(user.permissions, permission)) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: `Missing permission: ${permission}` });
    }
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/punishments/punishments.service.ts`:

```ts
import { BadRequestException, ConflictException, Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ActorType, type Prisma, type Punishment, PunishmentChangeKind, type PunishmentSource, PunishmentStatus, PunishmentType } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { type AuditActor, AuditService } from '../audit/audit.service';
import { normalizeUuid } from '../players/players.controller';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { RealtimeService } from '../realtime/realtime.service';
import { BAN_TYPES, computeExpiry, effectiveStatus, ENFORCEABLE_TYPES, isRevocable, MUTE_TYPES } from './punishment-rules';

export interface Issuer {
  type: ActorType;
  userId?: string | null;
  uuid?: string | null;
  name: string;
}

export interface CreatePunishmentInput {
  type: PunishmentType;
  targetUuid: string;
  reason: string;
  durationSeconds?: number;
  source: PunishmentSource;
  issuer: Issuer;
  serverId?: string | null;
  idempotencyKey?: string;
  ipAddress?: string | null;
}

const withNames = {
  target: { select: { uuid: true, username: true, online: true } },
  server: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
} as const;

type PunishmentWithNames = Prisma.PunishmentGetPayload<{ include: typeof withNames }>;

export function serializePunishment(p: PunishmentWithNames, options: { includeIp?: boolean } = {}) {
  return {
    id: p.id,
    type: p.type,
    status: effectiveStatus(p),
    revocable: isRevocable(p),
    reason: p.reason,
    source: p.source,
    target: { uuid: p.target.uuid, username: p.target.username, online: p.target.online },
    issuer: { type: p.issuerType, name: p.issuerName, uuid: p.issuerUuid, userId: p.issuerUserId },
    server: p.server,
    createdAt: p.createdAt.toISOString(),
    expiresAt: p.expiresAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    revokedAt: p.revokedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    revokedBy: p.revokedByName,
    revokedReason: p.revokedReason,
    ...(options.includeIp ? { targetIp: p.targetIp } : {}),
  };
}

/** Compact form consumed by the plugins' local cache. */
export function pluginPunishment(p: Punishment & { target: { username: string } }) {
  return {
    id: p.id,
    type: p.type,
    targetUuid: p.targetUuid,
    targetName: p.target.username,
    targetIp: p.type === PunishmentType.BLACKLIST ? p.targetIp : null,
    reason: p.reason,
    issuerName: p.issuerName,
    createdAt: p.createdAt.getTime(),
    expiresAt: p.expiresAt?.getTime() ?? null,
  };
}

function auditActor(issuer: Issuer): AuditActor {
  return { type: issuer.type, userId: issuer.userId ?? null, name: issuer.name };
}

const notExpired = (now: Date): Prisma.PunishmentWhereInput => ({ OR: [{ expiresAt: null }, { expiresAt: { gt: now } }] });

@Injectable()
export class PunishmentsService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly audit: AuditService,
    private readonly realtime: RealtimeService,
  ) {}

  /** Resolves a player by UUID (dashed or not) or by current username (most recently seen wins). */
  async resolvePlayer(target: string) {
    const uuid = normalizeUuid(target);
    const player = uuid
      ? await this.prisma.player.findUnique({ where: { uuid } })
      : await this.prisma.player.findFirst({ where: { username: target }, orderBy: { lastSeenAt: 'desc' } });
    if (!player) throw new NotFoundException({ code: 'PLAYER_NOT_FOUND', message: 'This player has never joined the network' });
    return player;
  }

  async create(input: CreatePunishmentInput) {
    if (input.idempotencyKey) {
      const existing = await this.prisma.punishment.findUnique({ where: { idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey }, include: withNames });
      if (existing) return serializePunishment(existing);
    }
    const expiry = computeExpiry(input.type, input.durationSeconds);
    if (!expiry.ok) throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'INVALID_DURATION', message: expiry.reason });

    const now = new Date();
    const player = await this.prisma.player.findUnique({ where: { uuid: input.targetUuid } });
    if (!player) throw new NotFoundException({ code: 'PLAYER_NOT_FOUND', message: 'This player has never joined the network' });

    // Duplicate prevention: one active ban (incl. blacklist) and one active mute per player.
    if (BAN_TYPES.includes(input.type) || MUTE_TYPES.includes(input.type)) {
      const group = BAN_TYPES.includes(input.type) ? BAN_TYPES : MUTE_TYPES;
      const active = await this.prisma.punishment.findFirst({
        where: { targetUuid: input.targetUuid, type: { in: [...group] }, status: PunishmentStatus.ACTIVE, ...notExpired(now) },
      });
      if (active) {
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: BAN_TYPES.includes(input.type) ? 'ALREADY_BANNED' : 'ALREADY_MUTED',
          message: 'The player already has an active punishment of this kind',
          punishmentId: active.id,
        });
      }
    }
    if (input.type === PunishmentType.KICK && !player.online) {
      throw new ConflictException({ code: 'PLAYER_OFFLINE', message: 'Only online players can be kicked' });
    }

    let targetIp: string | null = null;
    if (input.type === PunishmentType.BLACKLIST) {
      const last = await this.prisma.playerConnection.findFirst({ where: { playerUuid: input.targetUuid, ipAddress: { not: null } }, orderBy: { connectedAt: 'desc' } });
      targetIp = last?.ipAddress ?? null;
    }

    const created = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const punishment = await tx.punishment.create({
        data: {
          type: input.type,
          targetUuid: input.targetUuid,
          reason: input.reason,
          source: input.source,
          expiresAt: expiry.expiresAt,
          issuerType: input.issuer.type,
          issuerUserId: input.issuer.userId ?? null,
          issuerUuid: input.issuer.uuid ?? null,
          issuerName: input.issuer.name.slice(0, 64),
          serverId: input.serverId ?? null,
          idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey ?? null,
          targetIp,
          // Kicks take effect once; they are recorded but never "active".
          status: input.type === PunishmentType.KICK ? PunishmentStatus.EXPIRED : PunishmentStatus.ACTIVE,
        },
        include: withNames,
      });
      await tx.punishmentChange.create({ data: { punishmentId: punishment.id, kind: PunishmentChangeKind.CREATED } });
      await this.audit.record(
        {
          actor: auditActor(input.issuer),
          action: `punishments.${input.type.toLowerCase()}`,
          targetType: 'player',
          targetId: input.targetUuid,
          metadata: { punishmentId: punishment.id, reason: input.reason, expiresAt: expiry.expiresAt?.toISOString() ?? null, source: input.source },
          ipAddress: input.ipAddress ?? null,
        },
        tx,
      );
      return punishment;
    });
    this.realtime.publish({ type: 'punishment.changed', uuid: input.targetUuid });
    return serializePunishment(created);
  }

  async revokeById(id: string, revoker: Issuer, reason: string | undefined, ipAddress?: string | null) {
    const punishment = await this.prisma.punishment.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!punishment) throw new NotFoundException();
    if (!isRevocable(punishment)) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'NOT_ACTIVE', message: 'This punishment is not active' });
    return this.revoke(punishment, revoker, reason, ipAddress);
  }

  /** Revokes the player's active ban (incl. blacklist) or mute. */
  async revokeActive(targetUuid: string, kind: 'BAN' | 'MUTE', revoker: Issuer, reason: string | undefined, ipAddress?: string | null) {
    const punishment = await this.prisma.punishment.findFirst({
      where: { targetUuid, type: { in: [...(kind === 'BAN' ? BAN_TYPES : MUTE_TYPES)] }, status: PunishmentStatus.ACTIVE, ...notExpired(new Date()) },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
    if (!punishment) throw new ConflictException({ code: kind === 'BAN' ? 'NOT_BANNED' : 'NOT_MUTED', message: 'No active punishment of this kind' });
    return this.revoke(punishment, revoker, reason, ipAddress);
  }

  private async revoke(punishment: Punishment, revoker: Issuer, reason: string | undefined, ipAddress?: string | null) {
    const updated = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      // Conditional update guards against concurrent double revocation.
      const result = await tx.punishment.updateMany({
        where: { id: punishment.id, status: PunishmentStatus.ACTIVE },
        data: {
          status: PunishmentStatus.REVOKED,
          revokedAt: new Date(),
          revokedReason: reason ?? null,
          revokedByType: revoker.type,
          revokedByUserId: revoker.userId ?? null,
          revokedByUuid: revoker.uuid ?? null,
          revokedByName: revoker.name.slice(0, 64),
        },
      });
      if (result.count !== 1) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'NOT_ACTIVE', message: 'This punishment is not active' });
      await tx.punishmentChange.create({ data: { punishmentId: punishment.id, kind: PunishmentChangeKind.REVOKED } });
      await this.audit.record(
        {
          actor: auditActor(revoker),
          action: 'punishments.revoked',
          targetType: 'player',
          targetId: punishment.targetUuid,
          metadata: { punishmentId: punishment.id, type: punishment.type, reason: reason ?? null },
          ipAddress: ipAddress ?? null,
        },
        tx,
      );
      return tx.punishment.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: punishment.id }, include: withNames });
    });
    this.realtime.publish({ type: 'punishment.changed', uuid: punishment.targetUuid });
    return serializePunishment(updated);
  }

  async list(filter: { page: number; pageSize: number; type?: PunishmentType; status?: 'active' | 'expired' | 'revoked'; search?: string; targetUuid?: string }) {
    const now = new Date();
    const where: Prisma.PunishmentWhereInput = {};
    if (filter.type) where.type = filter.type;
    if (filter.targetUuid) where.targetUuid = filter.targetUuid;
    if (filter.status === 'active') Object.assign(where, { status: PunishmentStatus.ACTIVE, type: filter.type ?? { not: PunishmentType.KICK }, ...notExpired(now) });
    if (filter.status === 'revoked') where.status = PunishmentStatus.REVOKED;
    if (filter.status === 'expired') {
      where.OR = [{ status: PunishmentStatus.EXPIRED }, { status: PunishmentStatus.ACTIVE, expiresAt: { lte: now } }];
    }
    if (filter.search) {
      const uuid = normalizeUuid(filter.search);
      where.AND = [
        uuid
          ? { targetUuid: uuid }
          : { OR: [{ target: { username: { startsWith: filter.search } } }, { issuerName: { startsWith: filter.search } }, { id: filter.search }, { reason: { contains: filter.search } }] },
      ];
    }
    const [total, rows] = await this.prisma.$transaction([
      this.prisma.punishment.count({ where }),
      this.prisma.punishment.findMany({ where, include: withNames, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: (filter.page - 1) * filter.pageSize, take: filter.pageSize }),
    ]);
    return { total, page: filter.page, pageSize: filter.pageSize, items: rows.map((r) => serializePunishment(r)) };
  }

  async activeFor(targetUuid: string) {
    const now = new Date();
    const active = await this.prisma.punishment.findMany({
      where: { targetUuid, type: { in: [...ENFORCEABLE_TYPES] }, status: PunishmentStatus.ACTIVE, ...notExpired(now) },
      include: withNames,
    });
    return {
      ban: active.filter((p) => BAN_TYPES.includes(p.type)).map((p) => serializePunishment(p))[0] ?? null,
      mute: active.filter((p) => MUTE_TYPES.includes(p.type)).map((p) => serializePunishment(p))[0] ?? null,
    };
  }

  /** Full snapshot of enforceable punishments plus the feed cursor to continue from. */
  async pluginSnapshot() {
    const now = new Date();
    const [latest, active] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.punishmentChange.findFirst({ orderBy: { id: 'desc' }, select: { id: true } }),
      this.prisma.punishment.findMany({
        where: { type: { in: [...ENFORCEABLE_TYPES] }, status: PunishmentStatus.ACTIVE, ...notExpired(now) },
        include: { target: { select: { username: true } } },
      }),
    ]);
    return { cursor: (latest?.id ?? 0n).toString(), punishments: active.map(pluginPunishment) };
  }

  /** Ordered changes after `cursor` (exclusive). */
  async pluginChanges(cursor: bigint, limit = 500) {
    const changes = await this.prisma.punishmentChange.findMany({
      where: { id: { gt: cursor } },
      orderBy: { id: 'asc' },
      take: limit,
      include: { punishment: { include: { target: { select: { username: true } } } } },
    });
    return {
      cursor: (changes.at(-1)?.id ?? cursor).toString(),
      hasMore: changes.length === limit,
      changes: changes.map((c) => ({ id: c.id.toString(), kind: c.kind, at: c.createdAt.getTime(), punishment: pluginPunishment(c.punishment) })),
    };
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/rbac/bootstrap.service.ts`:

```ts
import { Injectable, Logger, type OnApplicationBootstrap } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ALL_PERMISSIONS, DEFAULT_LOCALE, DEFAULT_ROLES, WILDCARD_PERMISSION } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { bundledCatalogs } from '@mnm/translations';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';

/**
 * Idempotent startup synchronisation of reference data: permission catalogue,
 * default system roles and bundled languages. Existing customisations of
 * non-owner roles are never overwritten.
 */
@Injectable()
export class BootstrapService implements OnApplicationBootstrap {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(BootstrapService.name);

  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  async onApplicationBootstrap(): Promise<void> {
    await this.syncPermissions();
    await this.ensureSystemRoles();
    await this.ensureLanguages();
  }

  private async syncPermissions(): Promise<void> {
    await this.prisma.dashboardPermission.createMany({
      data: ALL_PERMISSIONS.map((key) => ({ key })),
      skipDuplicates: true,
    });
  }

  private async ensureSystemRoles(): Promise<void> {
    for (const def of DEFAULT_ROLES) {
      const existing = await this.prisma.dashboardRole.findUnique({ where: { key: def.key } });
      if (!existing) {
        await this.prisma.dashboardRole.create({
          data: {
            key: def.key,
            name: def.name,
            priority: def.priority,
            isSystem: true,
            permissions: { create: def.permissions.map((permission) => ({ permission })) },
          },
        });
        this.logger.log(`Created system role "${def.key}"`);
      } else if (def.key === 'owner') {
        await this.prisma.dashboardRolePermission.createMany({
          data: [{ roleId: existing.id, permission: WILDCARD_PERMISSION }],
          skipDuplicates: true,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  private async ensureLanguages(): Promise<void> {
    for (const [locale, catalog] of Object.entries(bundledCatalogs)) {
      const meta = catalog.meta as { name?: string } | undefined;
      await this.prisma.languageSetting.upsert({
        where: { locale },
        create: { locale, name: meta?.name ?? locale, enabled: true, isDefault: locale === DEFAULT_LOCALE },
        update: {},
      });
    }
    const defaults = await this.prisma.languageSetting.count({ where: { isDefault: true } });
    if (defaults !== 1) {
      await this.prisma.$transaction([
        this.prisma.languageSetting.updateMany({ data: { isDefault: false } }),
        this.prisma.languageSetting.update({ where: { locale: DEFAULT_LOCALE }, data: { isDefault: true, enabled: true } }),
      ]);
    }
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/rbac/rbac.policy.ts`:

```ts
import { hasPermission, WILDCARD_PERMISSION } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import type { AuthenticatedUser } from '../common/auth-context';

export const OWNER_ROLE_KEY = 'owner';

type Actor = Pick<AuthenticatedUser, 'roleKey' | 'rolePriority' | 'permissions'>;

/** An actor may manage users/roles strictly below their own priority. Owners may manage everything. */
export function canManagePriority(actor: Actor, targetPriority: number): boolean {
  return actor.roleKey === OWNER_ROLE_KEY || actor.rolePriority > targetPriority;
}

/** Prevents privilege escalation: nobody can grant a permission they do not hold themselves. */
export function ungrantablePermissions(actor: Actor, requested: readonly string[]): string[] {
  if (actor.roleKey === OWNER_ROLE_KEY) return [];
  return requested.filter((p) => p === WILDCARD_PERMISSION || p.endsWith('.*') || !hasPermission(actor.permissions, p));
}
```

`apps/backend/src/rbac/roles.controller.ts`:

```ts
import { BadRequestException, Body, ConflictException, Controller, Delete, ForbiddenException, Get, HttpCode, NotFoundException, Param, Patch, Post, Req } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { ALL_PERMISSIONS, isKnownPermission, PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import type { Request } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { type AuthenticatedUser, clientIp, CurrentUser, RequirePermissions } from '../common/auth-context';
import { ZodBody } from '../common/zod';
import { AuditService, userActor } from '../audit/audit.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { canManagePriority, OWNER_ROLE_KEY, ungrantablePermissions } from './rbac.policy';

const permissionList = z
  .array(z.string().refine(isKnownPermission, 'Unknown permission'))
  .max(ALL_PERMISSIONS.length)
  .transform((list) => [...new Set(list)]);

const createRoleSchema = z.object({
  key: z.string().trim().min(2).max(32).regex(/^[a-z0-9-]+$/, 'Use lowercase letters, digits and "-"'),
  name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64),
  description: z.string().trim().max(255).optional(),
  priority: z.number().int().min(1).max(999),
  permissions: permissionList.default([]),
});

const updateRoleSchema = z
  .object({
    name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64).optional(),
    description: z.string().trim().max(255).nullable().optional(),
    priority: z.number().int().min(1).max(999).optional(),
    permissions: permissionList.optional(),
  })
  .strict();

@ApiTags('roles')
@Controller()
export class RolesController {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly audit: AuditService,
  ) {}

  @Get('permissions')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.USERS_VIEW)
  permissions() {
    return ALL_PERMISSIONS;
  }

  @Get('roles')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.USERS_VIEW)
  async list() {
    const roles = await this.prisma.dashboardRole.findMany({
      orderBy: { priority: 'desc' },
      include: { permissions: true, _count: { select: { users: true } } },
    });
    return roles.map((r) => ({
      id: r.id,
      key: r.key,
      name: r.name,
      description: r.description,
      priority: r.priority,
      isSystem: r.isSystem,
      userCount: r._count.users,
      permissions: r.permissions.map((p) => p.permission).sort(),
    }));
  }

  @Post('roles')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.ROLES_MANAGE)
  @ZodBody(createRoleSchema)
  async create(@CurrentUser() actor: AuthenticatedUser, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof createRoleSchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    if (!canManagePriority(actor, body.priority)) throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'PRIORITY_TOO_HIGH', message: 'Role priority must be below your own' });
    this.assertGrantable(actor, body.permissions);
    const role = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const created = await tx.dashboardRole.create({
        data: {
          key: body.key,
          name: body.name,
          description: body.description,
          priority: body.priority,
          permissions: { create: body.permissions.map((permission) => ({ permission })) },
        },
      });
      await this.audit.record(
        { actor: userActor(actor), action: 'roles.created', targetType: 'dashboard_role', targetId: created.id, metadata: { key: body.key, permissions: body.permissions }, ipAddress: clientIp(req) },
        tx,
      );
      return created;
    });
    return { id: role.id };
  }

  @Patch('roles/:id')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.ROLES_MANAGE)
  @ZodBody(updateRoleSchema)
  async update(@CurrentUser() actor: AuthenticatedUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof updateRoleSchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    const role = await this.prisma.dashboardRole.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { permissions: true } });
    if (!role) throw new NotFoundException();
    if (role.key === OWNER_ROLE_KEY) throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'OWNER_ROLE_LOCKED', message: 'The Owner role cannot be modified' });
    if (!canManagePriority(actor, role.priority) || (body.priority !== undefined && !canManagePriority(actor, body.priority))) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'PRIORITY_TOO_HIGH', message: 'You cannot manage this role' });
    }
    if (body.permissions) this.assertGrantable(actor, body.permissions);

    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.dashboardRole.update({
        where: { id },
        data: { name: body.name, description: body.description, priority: body.priority },
      });
      if (body.permissions) {
        await tx.dashboardRolePermission.deleteMany({ where: { roleId: id } });
        await tx.dashboardRolePermission.createMany({ data: body.permissions.map((permission) => ({ roleId: id, permission })) });
      }
      await this.audit.record(
        {
          actor: userActor(actor),
          action: 'roles.updated',
          targetType: 'dashboard_role',
          targetId: id,
          metadata: { before: { name: role.name, priority: role.priority, permissions: role.permissions.map((p) => p.permission) }, changes: body },
          ipAddress: clientIp(req),
        },
        tx,
      );
    });
    return { ok: true };
  }

  @Delete('roles/:id')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.ROLES_MANAGE)
  async remove(@CurrentUser() actor: AuthenticatedUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Req() req: Request) {
    const role = await this.prisma.dashboardRole.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { _count: { select: { users: true } } } });
    if (!role) throw new NotFoundException();
    if (role.isSystem) throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'SYSTEM_ROLE', message: 'System roles cannot be deleted' });
    if (!canManagePriority(actor, role.priority)) throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'PRIORITY_TOO_HIGH', message: 'You cannot manage this role' });
    if (role._count.users > 0) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'ROLE_IN_USE', message: 'Reassign users before deleting this role' });
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.dashboardRole.delete({ where: { id } });
      await this.audit.record({ actor: userActor(actor), action: 'roles.deleted', targetType: 'dashboard_role', targetId: id, metadata: { key: role.key }, ipAddress: clientIp(req) }, tx);
    });
    return { ok: true };
  }

  private assertGrantable(actor: AuthenticatedUser, permissions: string[]): void {
    const denied = ungrantablePermissions(actor, permissions);
    if (denied.length) throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'PERMISSION_ESCALATION', message: `You cannot grant: ${denied.join(', ')}` });
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/realtime/realtime.controller.ts`:

```ts
import { Controller, Get, Req, Res } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { SkipThrottle } from '@nestjs/throttler';
import { hasPermission } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { AuthService } from '../auth/auth.service';
import { type AuthenticatedUser, CurrentUser } from '../common/auth-context';
import { EVENT_PERMISSION, type RealtimeEvent, RealtimeService } from './realtime.service';

const KEEPALIVE_MS = 25_000;
const REVALIDATE_MS = 60_000;

/**
 * Server-Sent Events stream for live dashboard updates. SSE travels through the
 * dashboard's same-origin /api proxy, so no extra port or upgrade handling is
 * needed (see docs/architecture/realtime.md).
 */
@ApiTags('realtime')
@SkipThrottle()
@Controller('events')
export class RealtimeController {
  constructor(
    private readonly realtime: RealtimeService,
    private readonly auth: AuthService,
  ) {}

  @Get()
  stream(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser, @Req() req: Request, @Res() res: Response): void {
    res.status(200);
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/event-stream; charset=utf-8');
    // no-transform keeps intermediaries (incl. compression) from buffering the stream.
    res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-cache, no-transform');
    res.setHeader('Connection', 'keep-alive');
    res.setHeader('X-Accel-Buffering', 'no');
    res.flushHeaders();
    res.write(`retry: 5000\nevent: ready\ndata: {}\n\n`);

    let permissions = user.permissions;
    const send = (event: RealtimeEvent) => {
      if (hasPermission(permissions, EVENT_PERMISSION[event.type])) {
        res.write(`event: ${event.type}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(event)}\n\n`);
      }
    };
    const unsubscribe = this.realtime.subscribe(send);
    const keepAlive = setInterval(() => res.write(`: keep-alive\n\n`), KEEPALIVE_MS);

    // Long-lived streams outlive the access token: re-check the session so
    // logout, disabling or permission changes take effect.
    const revalidate = setInterval(() => {
      void this.auth.authenticateSession(user.sessionId, user.id).then((current) => {
        if (!current) close();
        else permissions = current.permissions;
      });
    }, REVALIDATE_MS);

    const close = () => {
      clearInterval(keepAlive);
      clearInterval(revalidate);
      unsubscribe();
      res.end();
    };
    req.on('close', close);
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/realtime/realtime.service.ts`:

```ts
import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';
import { Injectable, Logger, type OnModuleDestroy, type OnModuleInit } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { RedisService } from '../redis/redis.service';

/** Events pushed to dashboards. Payloads carry identifiers only; clients refetch details with their own permissions. */
export type RealtimeEvent =
  | { type: 'server.updated'; serverId: string }
  | { type: 'server.removed'; serverId: string }
  | { type: 'player.online'; uuid: string }
  | { type: 'player.offline'; uuid: string }
  | { type: 'player.updated'; uuid: string }
  | { type: 'punishment.changed'; uuid: string }
  | { type: 'anticheat.event'; uuid: string }
  | { type: 'inventory.changed'; uuid: string };

/** Permission needed to receive each event type. */
export const EVENT_PERMISSION: Record<RealtimeEvent['type'], string> = {
  'server.updated': PERMISSIONS.SERVERS_VIEW,
  'server.removed': PERMISSIONS.SERVERS_VIEW,
  'player.online': PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW,
  'player.offline': PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW,
  'player.updated': PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW,
  'punishment.changed': PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_HISTORY,
  'anticheat.event': PERMISSIONS.ANTICHEAT_VIEW,
  'inventory.changed': PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW_INVENTORY,
};

const CHANNEL = 'mnm:realtime';

/**
 * Fan-out of domain events to every backend replica via Redis pub/sub and from
 * there to connected dashboard streams (Server-Sent Events).
 */
@Injectable()
export class RealtimeService implements OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(RealtimeService.name);
  private readonly local = new EventEmitter().setMaxListeners(0);
  private subscriber: RedisService['client'] | null = null;

  constructor(private readonly redis: RedisService) {}

  async onModuleInit(): Promise<void> {
    this.subscriber = this.redis.client.duplicate();
    this.subscriber.on('message', (_channel: string, message: string) => {
      try {
        this.local.emit('event', JSON.parse(message) as RealtimeEvent);
      } catch {
        this.logger.warn('Discarded malformed realtime message');
      }
    });
    this.subscriber.on('error', (err: Error) => this.logger.warn(`Realtime subscriber error: ${err.message}`));
    await this.subscriber.subscribe(CHANNEL).catch((err: Error) => this.logger.warn(`Realtime subscribe failed: ${err.message}`));
  }

  async onModuleDestroy(): Promise<void> {
    await this.subscriber?.quit().catch(() => undefined);
  }

  /** Fire-and-forget: realtime delivery must never fail the originating request. */
  publish(event: RealtimeEvent): void {
    void this.redis.client.publish(CHANNEL, JSON.stringify(event)).catch((err: Error) => this.logger.warn(`Realtime publish failed: ${err.message}`));
  }

  subscribe(listener: (event: RealtimeEvent) => void): () => void {
    this.local.on('event', listener);
    return () => this.local.off('event', listener);
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/redis/redis-throttler.storage.ts`:

```ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { ThrottlerStorage } from '@nestjs/throttler';
import { RedisService } from './redis.service';

/**
 * Fixed-window rate-limit storage in Redis so limits hold across backend replicas.
 * `ttl` and `blockDuration` are milliseconds; returned times are seconds, matching
 * @nestjs/throttler's in-memory storage.
 */
@Injectable()
export class RedisThrottlerStorage implements ThrottlerStorage {
  constructor(private readonly redis: RedisService) {}

  async increment(key: string, ttl: number, limit: number, blockDuration: number, throttlerName: string) {
    const hitsKey = `mnm:throttle:${throttlerName}:${key}`;
    const blockKey = `${hitsKey}:blocked`;
    const r = this.redis.client;

    const blockTtl = await r.pttl(blockKey);
    if (blockTtl > 0) {
      const seconds = Math.ceil(blockTtl / 1000);
      return { totalHits: limit + 1, timeToExpire: seconds, isBlocked: true, timeToBlockExpire: seconds };
    }

    const results = await r.multi().incr(hitsKey).pttl(hitsKey).exec();
    const hits = Number(results?.[0]?.[1] ?? 1);
    let remaining = Number(results?.[1]?.[1] ?? -1);
    if (remaining < 0) {
      await r.pexpire(hitsKey, ttl);
      remaining = ttl;
    }
    if (hits > limit) {
      await r.set(blockKey, '1', 'PX', blockDuration);
      return {
        totalHits: hits,
        timeToExpire: Math.ceil(remaining / 1000),
        isBlocked: true,
        timeToBlockExpire: Math.ceil(blockDuration / 1000),
      };
    }
    return { totalHits: hits, timeToExpire: Math.ceil(remaining / 1000), isBlocked: false, timeToBlockExpire: 0 };
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/redis/redis.service.ts`:

```ts
import { Injectable, Logger, type OnModuleDestroy } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Redis } from 'ioredis';
import { AppConfig } from '../config/app-config';

@Injectable()
export class RedisService implements OnModuleDestroy {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(RedisService.name);
  readonly client: Redis;

  constructor(config: AppConfig) {
    this.client = new Redis(config.env.REDIS_URL, {
      maxRetriesPerRequest: 2,
      retryStrategy: (attempt: number) => Math.min(attempt * 500, 5000),
    });
    this.client.on('error', (err: Error) => this.logger.warn(`Redis error: ${err.message}`));
    this.client.on('ready', () => this.logger.log('Redis connection established'));
  }

  /** Round-trip latency in milliseconds. Throws when Redis is unreachable. */
  async ping(): Promise<number> {
    const started = performance.now();
    await this.client.ping();
    return Math.round(performance.now() - started);
  }

  async onModuleDestroy(): Promise<void> {
    await this.client.quit().catch(() => undefined);
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/servers/servers.service.ts`:

```ts
import { ConflictException, Injectable, NotFoundException, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { randomToken, sha256Hex } from '../common/crypto';
import { AppConfig } from '../config/app-config';
import { ActorType, type Server, ServerStatus, type ServerType } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { AuditService, type AuditActor } from '../audit/audit.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { RealtimeService } from '../realtime/realtime.service';

/** A server whose last heartbeat is older than this is reported as offline. */
export const HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;

export function effectiveStatus(server: Pick<Server, 'status' | 'enabled' | 'lastHeartbeatAt'>, now = Date.now()): ServerStatus {
  if (!server.enabled) return ServerStatus.DISABLED;
  if (server.status === ServerStatus.PENDING) return ServerStatus.PENDING;
  if (!server.lastHeartbeatAt || now - server.lastHeartbeatAt.getTime() > HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_MS) return ServerStatus.OFFLINE;
  return server.status;
}

export function serializeServer(s: Server) {
  return {
    id: s.id,
    name: s.name,
    type: s.type,
    status: effectiveStatus(s),
    enabled: s.enabled,
    minecraftVersion: s.minecraftVersion,
    pluginVersion: s.pluginVersion,
    platformVersion: s.platformVersion,
    onlinePlayers: s.onlinePlayers,
    maxPlayers: s.maxPlayers,
    tps: s.tps,
    mspt: s.mspt,
    memoryUsedBytes: s.memoryUsedBytes?.toString() ?? null,
    memoryMaxBytes: s.memoryMaxBytes?.toString() ?? null,
    cpuLoad: s.cpuLoad,
    lastHeartbeatAt: s.lastHeartbeatAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    createdAt: s.createdAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

const TOKEN_PREFIX = 'mnm_reg_';
const SECRET_PREFIX = 'mnm_sk_';
const KEY_PREFIX = 'mnm_key_';

@Injectable()
export class ServersService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly audit: AuditService,
    private readonly config: AppConfig,
    private readonly realtime: RealtimeService,
  ) {}

  async list() {
    const servers = await this.prisma.server.findMany({ orderBy: [{ type: 'asc' }, { name: 'asc' }] });
    return servers.map(serializeServer);
  }


  async detail(id: string) {
    const server = await this.prisma.server.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: { credentials: { orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, select: { id: true, keyId: true, createdAt: true, lastUsedAt: true, revokedAt: true } } },
    });
    if (!server) throw new NotFoundException();
    const [connectedPlayers, openProxySessions] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.player.count({ where: { currentServerId: id, online: true } }),
      this.prisma.playerSession.count({ where: { proxyServerId: id, endedAt: null } }),
    ]);
    return {
      ...serializeServer(server),
      connectedPlayers,
      openProxySessions,
      credentials: server.credentials.map((c) => ({
        id: c.id,
        keyId: c.keyId,
        createdAt: c.createdAt.toISOString(),
        lastUsedAt: c.lastUsedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
        revokedAt: c.revokedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      })),
    };
  }

  /** Rename or enable/disable. Disabled servers are rejected by the plugin API. */
  async update(id: string, changes: { name?: string; enabled?: boolean }, actor: AuditActor, ip: string | null) {
    const before = await this.prisma.server.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!before) throw new NotFoundException();
    const updated = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const server = await tx.server.update({ where: { id }, data: changes });
      await this.audit.record(
        { actor, action: 'servers.updated', targetType: 'server', targetId: id, metadata: { before: { name: before.name, enabled: before.enabled }, changes }, ipAddress: ip },
        tx,
      );
      return server;
    });
    this.realtime.publish({ type: 'server.updated', serverId: id });
    return serializeServer(updated);
  }

  async remove(id: string, actor: AuditActor, ip: string | null) {
    const server = await this.prisma.server.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!server) throw new NotFoundException();
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.server.delete({ where: { id } });
      await this.audit.record({ actor, action: 'servers.deleted', targetType: 'server', targetId: id, metadata: { name: server.name, type: server.type }, ipAddress: ip }, tx);
    });
    this.realtime.publish({ type: 'server.removed', serverId: id });
  }

  /** Revokes all active credentials and issues a new one. The secret is returned once. */
  async rotateCredentials(id: string, actor: AuditActor, ip: string | null) {
    const server = await this.prisma.server.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!server) throw new NotFoundException();
    const secret = SECRET_PREFIX + randomToken(32);
    const keyId = KEY_PREFIX + randomToken(12);
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.serverCredential.updateMany({ where: { serverId: id, revokedAt: null }, data: { revokedAt: new Date() } });
      await tx.serverCredential.create({ data: { serverId: id, keyId, secretHash: sha256Hex(secret) } });
      await this.audit.record({ actor, action: 'servers.credentials_rotated', targetType: 'server', targetId: id, metadata: { keyId }, ipAddress: ip }, tx);
    });
    return { serverId: id, serverName: server.name, keyId, secret };
  }

  async revokeCredentials(id: string, actor: AuditActor, ip: string | null) {
    const server = await this.prisma.server.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!server) throw new NotFoundException();
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const result = await tx.serverCredential.updateMany({ where: { serverId: id, revokedAt: null }, data: { revokedAt: new Date() } });
      await this.audit.record({ actor, action: 'servers.credentials_revoked', targetType: 'server', targetId: id, metadata: { revoked: result.count }, ipAddress: ip }, tx);
    });
  }

  /** Creates a single-use registration token. The plaintext is returned once and never stored. */
  async createRegistrationToken(type: ServerType, name: string, actor: AuditActor, ip: string | null) {
    if (await this.prisma.server.findUnique({ where: { name } })) {
      throw new ConflictException({ code: 'SERVER_NAME_TAKEN', message: 'A server with this name is already registered' });
    }
    const token = TOKEN_PREFIX + randomToken(24);
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + this.config.env.REGISTRATION_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES * 60_000);
    const record = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const created = await tx.registrationToken.create({
        data: { tokenHash: sha256Hex(token), serverType: type, serverName: name, expiresAt, createdByUserId: actor.userId ?? null },
      });
      await this.audit.record(
        { actor, action: 'servers.registration_token_created', targetType: 'registration_token', targetId: created.id, metadata: { type, name, expiresAt: expiresAt.toISOString() }, ipAddress: ip },
        tx,
      );
      return created;
    });
    return { id: record.id, token, serverType: type, serverName: name, expiresAt: expiresAt.toISOString() };
  }

  async listPendingTokens() {
    const tokens = await this.prisma.registrationToken.findMany({
      where: { usedAt: null, expiresAt: { gt: new Date() } },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      select: { id: true, serverType: true, serverName: true, expiresAt: true, createdAt: true },
    });
    return tokens;
  }

  /** Progress of a registration started in the dashboard (polled by the add-server flow). */
  async tokenStatus(id: string) {
    const token = await this.prisma.registrationToken.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      select: { id: true, serverType: true, serverName: true, expiresAt: true, usedAt: true, server: { select: { id: true, name: true, status: true, lastHeartbeatAt: true, pluginVersion: true, minecraftVersion: true } } },
    });
    if (!token) throw new NotFoundException();
    const status = token.usedAt ? 'REGISTERED' : token.expiresAt <= new Date() ? 'EXPIRED' : 'PENDING';
    return { id: token.id, serverType: token.serverType, serverName: token.serverName, expiresAt: token.expiresAt, usedAt: token.usedAt, status, server: token.server };
  }

  async revokeToken(id: string, actor: AuditActor, ip: string | null) {
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.registrationToken.updateMany({ where: { id, usedAt: null }, data: { expiresAt: new Date() } });
      await this.audit.record({ actor, action: 'servers.registration_token_revoked', targetType: 'registration_token', targetId: id, ipAddress: ip }, tx);
    });
  }

  /**
   * Exchanges a registration token for a long-lived credential. The token is
   * consumed atomically (conditional update), so it can never be used twice.
   */
  async register(input: { token: string; pluginVersion: string; platformVersion?: string; minecraftVersion?: string }, ip: string | null) {
    const tokenHash = sha256Hex(input.token);
    const secret = SECRET_PREFIX + randomToken(32);
    const keyId = KEY_PREFIX + randomToken(12);

    return this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const token = await tx.registrationToken.findUnique({ where: { tokenHash } });
      const now = new Date();
      const consumed = token
        ? await tx.registrationToken.updateMany({ where: { id: token.id, usedAt: null, expiresAt: { gt: now } }, data: { usedAt: now } })
        : { count: 0 };
      if (!token || consumed.count !== 1) {
        throw new UnauthorizedException({ code: 'INVALID_REGISTRATION_TOKEN', message: 'Registration token is invalid, expired or already used' });
      }
      const server = await tx.server.create({
        data: {
          name: token.serverName,
          type: token.serverType,
          status: ServerStatus.OFFLINE,
          pluginVersion: input.pluginVersion,
          platformVersion: input.platformVersion,
          minecraftVersion: input.minecraftVersion,
        },
      });
      await tx.registrationToken.update({ where: { id: token.id }, data: { serverId: server.id } });
      await tx.serverCredential.create({ data: { serverId: server.id, keyId, secretHash: sha256Hex(secret) } });
      await this.audit.record(
        { actor: { type: ActorType.SERVER, name: server.name }, action: 'servers.registered', targetType: 'server', targetId: server.id, metadata: { type: server.type, pluginVersion: input.pluginVersion }, ipAddress: ip },
        tx,
      );
      return { serverId: server.id, serverName: server.name, serverType: server.type, keyId, secret };
    });
  }
}
```
