`apps/backend/src/settings/plugin-settings.ts`:

```ts
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { isValidLocaleCode } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { DEFAULT_LOCALE, messagePlaceholders, parseMinecraftCatalog } from '@mnm/translations';
import { z } from 'zod';

/**
 * Settings managed centrally in the dashboard and pushed to connected plugins.
 * Every field is optional: `null` keeps the value from the server's own
 * config.properties. All of them apply live (no restart); options that only
 * the server owner should control (backend URL, AntiCheat allow-list, IP
 * collection, buffers) stay local on purpose.
 */
export const STATISTIC_CATEGORIES = ['movement', 'combat', 'blocks', 'general'] as const;

/** Tags that could make a message run commands or leak data when clicked. */
const UNSAFE_MINIMESSAGE = /<\s*\/?\s*(click|insert|insertion|nbt|data|selector|sel|score)\b/i;
export const MAX_PLUGIN_MESSAGE_LENGTH = 1000;

const localeKey = z.string().refine(isValidLocaleCode, 'Invalid locale code');

export const managedPluginSettingsSchema = z
  .object({
    language: localeKey.nullable().default(null),
    statisticsEnabled: z.boolean().nullable().default(null),
    statisticsCategories: z.array(z.enum(STATISTIC_CATEGORIES)).max(STATISTIC_CATEGORIES.length).nullable().default(null),
    statisticsIntervalSeconds: z.number().int().min(60).max(3600).nullable().default(null),
    inventorySync: z.boolean().nullable().default(null),
    enderChestSync: z.boolean().nullable().default(null),
    inventorySyncIntervalSeconds: z.number().int().min(30).max(3600).nullable().default(null),
    /** locale → message key → MiniMessage template overriding the bundled text. */
    messages: z.record(localeKey, z.record(z.string().max(128), z.string().max(MAX_PLUGIN_MESSAGE_LENGTH))).default({}),
  })
  .strict();

export type ManagedPluginSettings = z.infer<typeof managedPluginSettingsSchema>;
export interface StoredPluginSettings {
  revision: number;
  settings: ManagedPluginSettings;
  updatedAt: string | null;
}

export const EMPTY_PLUGIN_SETTINGS: ManagedPluginSettings = managedPluginSettingsSchema.parse({});

// ── Bundled plugin message catalogues ────────────────────────────────

let catalogs: Record<string, Record<string, string>> | null = null;

/** Bundled plugin messages (packages/translations/minecraft/*.yml), loaded once. */
export function pluginCatalogs(): Record<string, Record<string, string>> {
  if (catalogs) return catalogs;
  const dir = join(dirname(require.resolve('@mnm/translations/package.json')), 'minecraft');
  const loaded: Record<string, Record<string, string>> = {};
  for (const locale of ['en-US', 'de-DE']) {
    try {
      loaded[locale] = parseMinecraftCatalog(readFileSync(join(dir, `${locale}.yml`), 'utf8'));
    } catch {
      // A missing optional catalogue only means no bundled defaults for it.
    }
  }
  if (!loaded[DEFAULT_LOCALE]) throw new Error(`Bundled plugin messages (${DEFAULT_LOCALE}.yml) not found in ${dir}`);
  catalogs = loaded;
  return catalogs;
}

export interface MessageIssue {
  locale: string;
  key: string;
  problem: 'unknown-key' | 'unsafe-content' | 'unknown-placeholder' | 'empty';
}

/** Validates message overrides against the bundled en-US catalogue. */
export function validatePluginMessages(messages: ManagedPluginSettings['messages']): MessageIssue[] {
  const reference = pluginCatalogs()[DEFAULT_LOCALE];
  const issues: MessageIssue[] = [];
  for (const [locale, entries] of Object.entries(messages)) {
    for (const [key, text] of Object.entries(entries)) {
      const base = reference[key];
      if (base === undefined) {
        issues.push({ locale, key, problem: 'unknown-key' });
        continue;
      }
      if (!text.trim() && key !== 'prefix') issues.push({ locale, key, problem: 'empty' });
      if (UNSAFE_MINIMESSAGE.test(text)) issues.push({ locale, key, problem: 'unsafe-content' });
      const allowed = new Set(messagePlaceholders(base));
      if (messagePlaceholders(text).some((p) => !allowed.has(p))) issues.push({ locale, key, problem: 'unknown-placeholder' });
    }
  }
  return issues;
}

/** Drops empty locale maps so the stored document stays small. */
export function normalizePluginSettings(settings: ManagedPluginSettings): ManagedPluginSettings {
  const messages = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(settings.messages).filter(([, entries]) => Object.keys(entries).length > 0));
  const categories = settings.statisticsCategories ? [...new Set(settings.statisticsCategories)].sort() : null;
  return { ...settings, statisticsCategories: categories as ManagedPluginSettings['statisticsCategories'], messages };
}

// ── Moderation presets (ban reasons and durations) ───────────────────

export const PRESET_TYPES = ['BAN', 'TEMP_BAN', 'MUTE', 'TEMP_MUTE', 'KICK', 'WARNING', 'BLACKLIST'] as const;
const TEMPORARY = new Set(['TEMP_BAN', 'TEMP_MUTE']);

export const moderationPresetSchema = z
  .object({
    id: z.string().regex(/^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$/),
    name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64),
    type: z.enum(PRESET_TYPES),
    reason: z.string().trim().min(1).max(500),
    durationSeconds: z.number().int().min(60).max(10 * 365 * 86_400).nullable().default(null),
  })
  .strict()
  .refine((p) => TEMPORARY.has(p.type) === (p.durationSeconds !== null), { message: 'Temporary presets need a duration, others must not have one', path: ['durationSeconds'] });

export const moderationSettingsSchema = z
  .object({
    presets: z
      .array(moderationPresetSchema)
      .max(50)
      .refine((list) => new Set(list.map((p) => p.id)).size === list.length, 'Preset IDs must be unique')
      .default([]),
  })
  .strict();
export type ModerationSettings = z.infer<typeof moderationSettingsSchema>;

```

`apps/backend/src/settings/settings.controller.ts`:

```ts
import { BadRequestException, Body, ConflictException, Controller, Get, Patch, Put, Req } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import type { Request } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { type AuthenticatedUser, clientIp, CurrentUser, RequirePermissions } from '../common/auth-context';
import { ZodBody } from '../common/zod';
import { AuditService, userActor } from '../audit/audit.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { managedPluginSettingsSchema, moderationSettingsSchema, normalizePluginSettings, pluginCatalogs, validatePluginMessages } from './plugin-settings';
import { networkSettingsSchema, privacySettingsSchema, SETTING_KEYS, SettingsService } from './settings.service';

const updateNetworkSchema = networkSettingsSchema.partial().strict();
const updatePrivacySchema = privacySettingsSchema.strict();
const updatePluginSettingsSchema = z.object({ baseRevision: z.number().int().min(0), settings: managedPluginSettingsSchema }).strict();

@ApiTags('settings')
@Controller('settings')
export class SettingsController {
  constructor(
    private readonly settings: SettingsService,
    private readonly audit: AuditService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
  ) {}

  @Get('network')
  network() {
    return this.settings.getNetwork();
  }

  @Get('privacy')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.SETTINGS_MANAGE)
  privacy() {
    return this.settings.getPrivacy();
  }

  @Patch('privacy')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.SETTINGS_MANAGE)
  @ZodBody(updatePrivacySchema)
  async updatePrivacy(@CurrentUser() actor: AuthenticatedUser, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof updatePrivacySchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    const before = await this.settings.getPrivacy();
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await this.settings.set(SETTING_KEYS.PRIVACY, body, actor.id, tx);
      await this.audit.record({ actor: userActor(actor), action: 'settings.privacy_updated', targetType: 'setting', targetId: SETTING_KEYS.PRIVACY, metadata: { before, after: body }, ipAddress: clientIp(req) }, tx);
    });
    return body;
  }

  @Patch('network')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.SETTINGS_MANAGE)
  @ZodBody(updateNetworkSchema)
  async updateNetwork(@CurrentUser() actor: AuthenticatedUser, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof updateNetworkSchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    const current = await this.settings.getNetwork();
    const next = networkSettingsSchema.parse({ ...current, ...body });
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await this.settings.set(SETTING_KEYS.NETWORK, next, actor.id, tx);
      await this.audit.record({ actor: userActor(actor), action: 'settings.network_updated', targetType: 'setting', targetId: SETTING_KEYS.NETWORK, metadata: { before: current, after: next }, ipAddress: clientIp(req) }, tx);
    });
    return next;
  }

  /** Settings pushed to connected plugins (live, within one heartbeat). */
  @Get('plugins')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.SETTINGS_MANAGE)
  plugins() {
    return this.settings.getPluginSettings();
  }

  /** Bundled plugin messages per locale (defaults shown next to overrides). */
  @Get('plugins/messages')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.SETTINGS_MANAGE)
  pluginMessages() {
    return pluginCatalogs();
  }

  @Put('plugins')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.SETTINGS_MANAGE)
  @ZodBody(updatePluginSettingsSchema)
  async updatePlugins(@CurrentUser() actor: AuthenticatedUser, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof updatePluginSettingsSchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    const issues = validatePluginMessages(body.settings.messages);
    if (issues.length) throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'INVALID_MESSAGES', message: 'Some plugin messages are invalid', issues: issues.map((i) => ({ path: `${i.locale}.${i.key}`, message: i.problem })) });
    const settings = normalizePluginSettings(body.settings);
    return this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      // The row lock serialises concurrent saves; the revision check rejects lost updates.
      await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT \`key\` FROM system_settings WHERE \`key\` = ${SETTING_KEYS.PLUGINS} FOR UPDATE`;
      const current = await this.settings.getPluginSettings(tx);
      if (current.revision !== body.baseRevision) {
        throw new ConflictException({ code: 'STALE_SETTINGS', message: 'The settings were changed by someone else. Reload and try again.' });
      }
      const next = { revision: current.revision + 1, settings, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      await this.settings.set(SETTING_KEYS.PLUGINS, next, actor.id, tx);
      const { messages: beforeMessages, ...before } = current.settings;
      const { messages: afterMessages, ...after } = settings;
      await this.audit.record(
        {
          actor: userActor(actor),
          action: 'settings.plugins_updated',
          targetType: 'setting',
          targetId: SETTING_KEYS.PLUGINS,
          metadata: { revision: next.revision, before, after, messageOverrides: countMessages(afterMessages), previousMessageOverrides: countMessages(beforeMessages) },
          ipAddress: clientIp(req),
        },
        tx,
      );
      return next;
    });
  }

  /** Punishment presets (reasons and durations) offered when issuing punishments. */
  @Get('moderation')
  moderation() {
    return this.settings.getModeration();
  }

  @Put('moderation')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.SETTINGS_MANAGE)
  @ZodBody(moderationSettingsSchema)
  async updateModeration(@CurrentUser() actor: AuthenticatedUser, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof moderationSettingsSchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await this.settings.set(SETTING_KEYS.MODERATION, body, actor.id, tx);
      await this.audit.record({ actor: userActor(actor), action: 'settings.moderation_updated', targetType: 'setting', targetId: SETTING_KEYS.MODERATION, metadata: { presets: body.presets.length }, ipAddress: clientIp(req) }, tx);
    });
    return body;
  }
}

function countMessages(messages: Record<string, Record<string, string>>): number {
  return Object.values(messages).reduce((sum, entries) => sum + Object.keys(entries).length, 0);
}
```

`apps/backend/src/settings/settings.service.ts`:

```ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { z } from 'zod';
import type { Prisma } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { themeSchema, timezoneSchema } from '../common/validation';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { EMPTY_PLUGIN_SETTINGS, managedPluginSettingsSchema, type ModerationSettings, moderationSettingsSchema, type StoredPluginSettings } from './plugin-settings';

export const networkSettingsSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64),
  description: z.string().trim().max(500).default(''),
  minecraftDomain: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .max(253)
    .regex(/^$|^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+(:\d{1,5})?$/, 'Invalid domain')
    .default(''),
  dashboardUrl: z.union([z.literal(''), z.url({ protocol: /^https?$/ }).max(2048)]).default(''),
  defaultTimezone: timezoneSchema.default('UTC'),
  defaultTheme: themeSchema.default('dark'),
});

export type NetworkSettings = z.infer<typeof networkSettingsSchema>;

/** Data minimisation. IP addresses older than the retention period are removed (null = keep). */
export const privacySettingsSchema = z.object({
  ipRetentionDays: z.number().int().min(7).max(3650).nullable().default(180),
});
export type PrivacySettings = z.infer<typeof privacySettingsSchema>;

export const SETTING_KEYS = {
  NETWORK: 'network',
  SETUP_COMPLETED: 'setup.completed',
  SETUP_CODE_HASH: 'setup.codeHash',
  PLAYER_RECORD: 'stats.playerRecord',
  PRIVACY: 'privacy',
  PLUGINS: 'plugins.managed',
  MODERATION: 'moderation',
} as const;

const DEFAULT_NETWORK: NetworkSettings = networkSettingsSchema.parse({ name: 'Minecraft Network' });

@Injectable()
export class SettingsService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  async get<T>(key: string, tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient): Promise<T | null> {
    const row = await (tx ?? this.prisma).systemSetting.findUnique({ where: { key } });
    return (row?.value as T | undefined) ?? null;
  }

  async set(key: string, value: Prisma.InputJsonValue, userId: string | null, tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient): Promise<void> {
    const client = tx ?? this.prisma;
    await client.systemSetting.upsert({
      where: { key },
      create: { key, value, updatedByUserId: userId },
      update: { value, updatedByUserId: userId },
    });
    if (key === SETTING_KEYS.PLUGINS) this.revisionCache = null;
  }

  async getPrivacy(): Promise<PrivacySettings> {
    const parsed = privacySettingsSchema.safeParse((await this.get<unknown>(SETTING_KEYS.PRIVACY)) ?? {});
    return parsed.success ? parsed.data : privacySettingsSchema.parse({});
  }

  async getNetwork(): Promise<NetworkSettings> {
    const stored = await this.get<unknown>(SETTING_KEYS.NETWORK);
    const parsed = networkSettingsSchema.safeParse(stored ?? {});
    return parsed.success ? parsed.data : DEFAULT_NETWORK;
  }

  /** Centrally managed plugin settings with their revision (0 = never saved). */
  async getPluginSettings(tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient): Promise<StoredPluginSettings> {
    const stored = await this.get<{ revision?: unknown; settings?: unknown; updatedAt?: unknown }>(SETTING_KEYS.PLUGINS, tx);
    const parsed = managedPluginSettingsSchema.safeParse(stored?.settings ?? {});
    return {
      revision: typeof stored?.revision === 'number' ? stored.revision : 0,
      settings: parsed.success ? parsed.data : EMPTY_PLUGIN_SETTINGS,
      updatedAt: typeof stored?.updatedAt === 'string' ? stored.updatedAt : null,
    };
  }

  private revisionCache: { value: number; at: number } | null = null;

  /** Current plugin settings revision, cached briefly (asked on every heartbeat). */
  async pluginSettingsRevision(): Promise<number> {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (this.revisionCache && now - this.revisionCache.at < 5_000) return this.revisionCache.value;
    const rows = await this.prisma.$queryRaw<{ revision: bigint | number | null }[]>`
      SELECT CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(value, '$.revision') AS UNSIGNED) AS revision FROM system_settings WHERE \`key\` = ${SETTING_KEYS.PLUGINS}`;
    const value = Number(rows[0]?.revision ?? 0);
    this.revisionCache = { value, at: now };
    return value;
  }

  async getModeration(): Promise<ModerationSettings> {
    const parsed = moderationSettingsSchema.safeParse((await this.get<unknown>(SETTING_KEYS.MODERATION)) ?? {});
    return parsed.success ? parsed.data : { presets: [] };
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Body, Controller, Get, HttpCode, Post, Req, Res } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { Throttle } from '@nestjs/throttler';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { AuthService } from '../auth/auth.service';
import { setSessionCookies } from '../auth/cookies';
import { clientIp, Public } from '../common/auth-context';
import { ZodBody } from '../common/zod';
import { AppConfig } from '../config/app-config';
import { type InitializeInput, initializeSchema, SetupService } from './setup.service';

@ApiTags('setup')
@Public()
@Controller('setup')
export class SetupController {
  constructor(
    private readonly setup: SetupService,
    private readonly auth: AuthService,
    private readonly config: AppConfig,
  ) {}

  @Get('status')
  status() {
    return this.setup.status();
  }

  /** Creates the Owner and network settings, then signs the Owner in. Works exactly once. */
  @Post('initialize')
  @HttpCode(201)
  @Throttle({ default: { limit: 5, ttl: 60_000, blockDuration: 300_000 } })
  @ZodBody(initializeSchema)
  async initialize(@Body() body: InitializeInput, @Req() req: Request, @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response) {
    const { userId } = await this.setup.initialize(body, clientIp(req));
    const session = await this.auth.issueSession(userId, { ip: clientIp(req), userAgent: req.header('user-agent') ?? null });
    setSessionCookies(res, req, this.config, session);
    return { ok: true };
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/setup/setup.service.ts`:

```ts
import { ConflictException, ForbiddenException, Injectable, Logger, type OnApplicationBootstrap } from '@nestjs/common';
import { timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
import { DEFAULT_LOCALE, type SetupStatus } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { PasswordService } from '../auth/password.service';
import { randomCode, sha256Hex } from '../common/crypto';
import { emailSchema, localeSchema, passwordSchema, usernameSchema } from '../common/validation';
import { AppConfig } from '../config/app-config';
import { ActorType, Prisma } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { AuditService } from '../audit/audit.service';
import { HealthService } from '../health/health.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { OWNER_ROLE_KEY } from '../rbac/rbac.policy';
import { networkSettingsSchema, SETTING_KEYS, SettingsService } from '../settings/settings.service';

export const initializeSchema = z.object({
  setupCode: z.string().trim().min(1).max(128),
  owner: z.object({ username: usernameSchema, email: emailSchema, password: passwordSchema }),
  network: networkSettingsSchema.extend({ defaultLocale: localeSchema.default(DEFAULT_LOCALE) }),
});
export type InitializeInput = z.infer<typeof initializeSchema>;

/**
 * First-time installation. Ownership is protected by a setup code that is only
 * visible to whoever can read the backend logs (or set SETUP_TOKEN). After
 * completion the `setup.completed` row (primary key) makes re-initialisation
 * impossible, even under concurrent requests.
 */
@Injectable()
export class SetupService implements OnApplicationBootstrap {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(SetupService.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly settings: SettingsService,
    private readonly passwords: PasswordService,
    private readonly audit: AuditService,
    private readonly health: HealthService,
    private readonly config: AppConfig,
  ) {}

  async onApplicationBootstrap(): Promise<void> {
    if (await this.isInitialized()) return;
    const code = this.config.env.SETUP_TOKEN ?? randomCode();
    await this.settings.set(SETTING_KEYS.SETUP_CODE_HASH, sha256Hex(code), null);
    const source = this.config.env.SETUP_TOKEN ? 'SETUP_TOKEN environment variable' : 'generated for this start';
    this.logger.warn('──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────');
    this.logger.warn('Installation is not initialized. Open the dashboard to run the setup wizard.');
    if (this.config.env.SETUP_TOKEN) this.logger.warn(`Setup code: taken from the ${source}.`);
    else this.logger.warn(`Setup code (${source}): ${code}`);
    this.logger.warn('──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────');
  }

  async isInitialized(): Promise<boolean> {
    return (await this.prisma.systemSetting.count({ where: { key: SETTING_KEYS.SETUP_COMPLETED } })) > 0;
  }

  async status(): Promise<SetupStatus & { networkName: string | null }> {
    const [db, redis] = await Promise.all([this.health.database(), this.health.redisStatus()]);
    let initialized = false;
    let networkName: string | null = null;
    if (db.connected) {
      initialized = await this.isInitialized().catch(() => false);
      if (initialized) networkName = (await this.settings.getNetwork()).name;
    }
    return {
      initialized,
      version: this.config.version,
      networkName,
      database: {
        connected: db.connected,
        version: db.version,
        migrationsApplied: db.migrationsApplied,
        pendingMigrations: db.pendingMigrations,
      },
      redis: { connected: redis.connected },
    };
  }

  async initialize(input: InitializeInput, ip: string | null): Promise<{ userId: string }> {
    if (await this.isInitialized()) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'ALREADY_INITIALIZED', message: 'Setup has already been completed' });

    const storedHash = await this.settings.get<string>(SETTING_KEYS.SETUP_CODE_HASH);
    const providedHash = sha256Hex(input.setupCode.trim().toUpperCase());
    const providedRawHash = sha256Hex(input.setupCode.trim());
    if (!storedHash || !(hexEqual(storedHash, providedHash) || hexEqual(storedHash, providedRawHash))) {
      await this.audit.record({ actor: { type: ActorType.SYSTEM, name: 'setup' }, action: 'setup.invalid_code', ipAddress: ip });
      throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'INVALID_SETUP_CODE', message: 'The setup code is invalid' });
    }

    const ownerRole = await this.prisma.dashboardRole.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { key: OWNER_ROLE_KEY } });
    const language = await this.prisma.languageSetting.findUnique({ where: { locale: input.network.defaultLocale } });
    const defaultLocale = language ? input.network.defaultLocale : DEFAULT_LOCALE;
    const passwordHash = await this.passwords.hash(input.owner.password);
    const { defaultLocale: _ignored, ...network } = input.network;

    try {
      return await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        // Primary-key insert acts as a distributed lock: a concurrent second request fails here.
        await tx.systemSetting.create({ data: { key: SETTING_KEYS.SETUP_COMPLETED, value: { at: new Date().toISOString() } } });
        const owner = await tx.dashboardUser.create({
          data: {
            username: input.owner.username,
            email: input.owner.email,
            passwordHash,
            roleId: ownerRole.id,
            locale: defaultLocale,
            theme: network.defaultTheme,
            timezone: network.defaultTimezone,
          },
        });
        await this.settings.set(SETTING_KEYS.NETWORK, network, owner.id, tx);
        await tx.languageSetting.updateMany({ data: { isDefault: false } });
        await tx.languageSetting.update({ where: { locale: defaultLocale }, data: { isDefault: true, enabled: true } });
        await tx.systemSetting.delete({ where: { key: SETTING_KEYS.SETUP_CODE_HASH } });
        await this.audit.record(
          {
            actor: { type: ActorType.USER, userId: owner.id, name: owner.username },
            action: 'setup.initialized',
            targetType: 'dashboard_user',
            targetId: owner.id,
            metadata: { network: network.name, defaultLocale },
            ipAddress: ip,
          },
          tx,
        );
        return { userId: owner.id };
      });
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && err.code === 'P2002') {
        throw new ConflictException({ code: 'ALREADY_INITIALIZED', message: 'Setup has already been completed' });
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

function hexEqual(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  const ba = Buffer.from(a, 'hex');
  const bb = Buffer.from(b, 'hex');
  return ba.length === bb.length && timingSafeEqual(ba, bb);
}
```

`apps/backend/src/statistics/aggregation.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Statistic aggregation from hourly snapshots. Statistics are cumulative per
 * server ("scope"); a value lower than its predecessor means the counter was
 * reset (e.g. a new world), so only positive increments are summed.
 */
export interface Snapshot {
  scope: string;
  statKey: string;
  value: bigint;
  capturedAt: Date;
}

export const HOUR_MS = 3_600_000;

export function truncateToHour(date: Date): Date {
  return new Date(Math.floor(date.getTime() / HOUR_MS) * HOUR_MS);
}

/** Groups snapshots by scope+key, each list sorted by time. */
function seriesByScopeAndKey(snapshots: Snapshot[]): Map<string, Snapshot[]> {
  const map = new Map<string, Snapshot[]>();
  for (const s of snapshots) {
    const id = `${s.scope}\u0000${s.statKey}`;
    const list = map.get(id) ?? [];
    list.push(s);
    map.set(id, list);
  }
  for (const list of map.values()) list.sort((a, b) => a.capturedAt.getTime() - b.capturedAt.getTime());
  return map;
}

/** Increment contributed by `current` relative to `previous` (resets count from zero). */
function increment(previous: bigint | null, current: bigint): bigint {
  if (previous === null) return 0n;
  return current >= previous ? current - previous : current;
}

/**
 * Sum of increments per key inside [from, to]. `snapshots` must include, per
 * scope+key, the last snapshot before `from` (baseline) when one exists.
 * Without a baseline the first snapshot in range only serves as starting point.
 */
export function rangeTotals(snapshots: Snapshot[], from: Date, to: Date): Map<string, bigint> {
  const totals = new Map<string, bigint>();
  for (const list of seriesByScopeAndKey(snapshots).values()) {
    let previous: bigint | null = null;
    for (const s of list) {
      const t = s.capturedAt.getTime();
      if (t > to.getTime()) break;
      if (t >= from.getTime()) totals.set(s.statKey, (totals.get(s.statKey) ?? 0n) + increment(previous, s.value));
      previous = s.value;
    }
  }
  return totals;
}

/** Daily increments per key, bucketed by local calendar day in `timeZone`. */
export function dailySeries(snapshots: Snapshot[], keys: string[], days: string[], timeZone: string): Record<string, number[]> {
  const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' });
  const index = new Map(days.map((d, i) => [d, i]));
  const out: Record<string, number[]> = Object.fromEntries(keys.map((k) => [k, days.map(() => 0)]));
  for (const list of seriesByScopeAndKey(snapshots.filter((s) => keys.includes(s.statKey))).values()) {
    let previous: bigint | null = null;
    for (const s of list) {
      // Value at the end of hour H was reached during hour H → attribute to that hour's local day.
      const day = fmt.format(s.capturedAt);
      const i = index.get(day);
      const inc = increment(previous, s.value);
      if (i !== undefined) out[s.statKey][i] += Number(inc);
      previous = s.value;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** Sums current values per key across scopes. */
export function sumByKey(rows: { statKey: string; value: bigint }[]): Map<string, bigint> {
  const totals = new Map<string, bigint>();
  for (const r of rows) totals.set(r.statKey, (totals.get(r.statKey) ?? 0n) + r.value);
  return totals;
}
```

`apps/backend/src/statistics/statistics.controller.ts`:

```ts
import { BadRequestException, Body, Controller, ForbiddenException, Get, HttpCode, NotFoundException, Param, Post, Query, Req, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { Throttle } from '@nestjs/throttler';
import { LEADERBOARD_STATS, PERMISSIONS, STAT_KEY_PATTERN, STATS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { SkipCsrf } from '../auth/guards';
import { type AuthenticatedUser, CurrentUser, Public, RequirePermissions } from '../common/auth-context';
import { ZodBody, ZodQuery } from '../common/zod';
import { ServerType } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { type PluginRequest, PluginAuthGuard } from '../plugin-api/plugin-auth.guard';
import { uuidSchema } from '../plugin-api/plugin-events';
import { normalizeUuid } from '../players/players.controller';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { SettingsService } from '../settings/settings.service';
import { HISTORY_KEYS, StatisticsService } from './statistics.service';

const ingestSchema = z.object({
  capturedAt: z.number().int().positive(),
  players: z
    .array(
      z.object({
        uuid: uuidSchema,
        stats: z
          .record(z.string().regex(STAT_KEY_PATTERN), z.number().int().min(0).max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER))
          .refine((r) => Object.keys(r).length <= 5000, 'Too many statistics'),
      }),
    )
    .min(1)
    .max(50),
});

const RANGES = { '24h': 86_400_000, '7d': 7 * 86_400_000, '30d': 30 * 86_400_000 } as const;

const playerQuery = z.object({
  range: z.enum(['24h', '7d', '30d', 'all', 'custom']).default('all'),
  from: z.iso.datetime({ offset: true }).optional(),
  to: z.iso.datetime({ offset: true }).optional(),
});

const seriesQuery = z.object({
  keys: z.string().max(500).default([STATS.BLOCKS_MINED, STATS.MOB_KILLS, STATS.DEATHS, STATS.WALK].join(',')),
  days: z.coerce.number().int().min(7).max(90).default(30),
});

const leaderboardQuery = z.object({
  stat: z.string().refine((s) => (LEADERBOARD_STATS as readonly string[]).includes(s), 'Unsupported statistic'),
  limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(10),
});

/** Ingestion from Paper servers (signed plugin API). */
@ApiTags('plugin')
@Public()
@SkipCsrf()
@UseGuards(PluginAuthGuard)
@Throttle({ default: { limit: 600, ttl: 60_000 } })
@Controller('plugin/v1')
export class PluginStatisticsController {
  constructor(private readonly statistics: StatisticsService) {}

  @Post('statistics')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @ZodBody(ingestSchema)
  ingest(@Req() req: PluginRequest, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof ingestSchema>) {
    const server = req.pluginServer!;
    if (server.type !== ServerType.PAPER) throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'PAPER_ONLY', message: 'Statistics are reported by Paper servers' });
    return this.statistics.ingest(server.id, body.players, new Date(Math.min(body.capturedAt, Date.now())));
  }
}

@ApiTags('statistics')
@Controller()
export class StatisticsController {
  constructor(
    private readonly statistics: StatisticsService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly settings: SettingsService,
  ) {}

  /** Player statistics for 24h / 7d / 30d / all time / a custom range. */
  @Get('players/:uuid/statistics')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW_STATISTICS)
  @ZodQuery(playerQuery)
  async player(@Param('uuid') raw: string, @Query() q: z.infer<typeof playerQuery>) {
    const uuid = await this.requirePlayer(raw);
    const to = q.range === 'custom' && q.to ? new Date(q.to) : new Date();
    let from: Date | null = null;
    if (q.range === 'custom') {
      if (!q.from) throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'FROM_REQUIRED', message: 'A custom range needs "from"' });
      from = new Date(q.from);
      if (from >= to) throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'INVALID_RANGE', message: '"from" must be before "to"' });
    } else if (q.range !== 'all') {
      from = new Date(to.getTime() - RANGES[q.range]);
    }
    return this.statistics.forPlayer(uuid, { from, to });
  }

  @Get('players/:uuid/statistics/series')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW_STATISTICS)
  @ZodQuery(seriesQuery)
  async series(@Param('uuid') raw: string, @Query() q: z.infer<typeof seriesQuery>, @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const uuid = await this.requirePlayer(raw);
    const keys = q.keys.split(',').filter((k) => HISTORY_KEYS.includes(k)).slice(0, 8);
    if (!keys.length) throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'NO_KEYS', message: 'No supported statistic keys' });
    const timezone = user.timezone ?? (await this.settings.getNetwork()).defaultTimezone;
    return this.statistics.series(uuid, keys, q.days, timezone);
  }

  @Get('statistics/overview')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW_STATISTICS)
  overview() {
    return this.statistics.networkOverview();
  }

  @Get('statistics/leaderboard')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW_STATISTICS)
  @ZodQuery(leaderboardQuery)
  leaderboard(@Query() q: z.infer<typeof leaderboardQuery>) {
    return this.statistics.leaderboard(q.stat, q.limit);
  }

  private async requirePlayer(raw: string): Promise<string> {
    const uuid = normalizeUuid(raw);
    if (!uuid || !(await this.prisma.player.findUnique({ where: { uuid }, select: { uuid: true } }))) throw new NotFoundException();
    return uuid;
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/statistics/statistics.service.ts`:

```ts
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ORE_BLOCKS, STAT_DEFINITIONS, STAT_PREFIXES, STATS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { Prisma } from '../generated/prisma/client';
import { startOfDayInTimezone } from '../common/time';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { RealtimeService } from '../realtime/realtime.service';
import { dailySeries, rangeTotals, type Snapshot, sumByKey, truncateToHour } from './aggregation';

/** Keys kept in hourly history (ranges and charts). Per-block/entity values are current-only. */
export const HISTORY_KEYS: readonly string[] = STAT_DEFINITIONS.map((d) => d.key);
const HISTORY_SET = new Set(HISTORY_KEYS);
const UPSERT_CHUNK = 500;

export interface IngestPlayer {
  uuid: string;
  stats: Record<string, number>;
}

const toNumber = (v: bigint | undefined) => (v === undefined ? null : Number(v));

@Injectable()
export class StatisticsService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly realtime: RealtimeService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Stores absolute values reported by a server. Only changed values are
   * written; core statistics also update the hourly history.
   */
  async ingest(scope: string, players: IngestPlayer[], capturedAt: Date): Promise<{ players: number; changed: number }> {
    const known = new Set((await this.prisma.player.findMany({ where: { uuid: { in: players.map((p) => p.uuid) } }, select: { uuid: true } })).map((p) => p.uuid));
    const relevant = players.filter((p) => known.has(p.uuid));
    if (!relevant.length) return { players: 0, changed: 0 };

    const existing = await this.prisma.playerStatistic.findMany({
      where: { scope, playerUuid: { in: relevant.map((p) => p.uuid) } },
      select: { playerUuid: true, statKey: true, value: true },
    });
    const current = new Map(existing.map((r) => [`${r.playerUuid}\u0000${r.statKey}`, r.value]));

    const changed: { uuid: string; key: string; value: bigint }[] = [];
    for (const p of relevant) {
      for (const [key, raw] of Object.entries(p.stats)) {
        const value = BigInt(raw);
        if (current.get(`${p.uuid}\u0000${key}`) !== value) changed.push({ uuid: p.uuid, key, value });
      }
    }

    const hour = truncateToHour(capturedAt);
    for (let i = 0; i < changed.length; i += UPSERT_CHUNK) {
      const chunk = changed.slice(i, i + UPSERT_CHUNK);
      await this.prisma.$executeRaw`
        INSERT INTO player_statistics (player_uuid, scope, stat_key, value, updated_at)
        VALUES ${Prisma.join(chunk.map((c) => Prisma.sql`(${c.uuid}, ${scope}, ${c.key}, ${c.value}, ${capturedAt})`))}
        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value = VALUES(value), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)`;
      const history = chunk.filter((c) => HISTORY_SET.has(c.key));
      if (history.length) {
        await this.prisma.$executeRaw`
          INSERT INTO player_statistic_snapshots (player_uuid, scope, stat_key, value, captured_at)
          VALUES ${Prisma.join(history.map((c) => Prisma.sql`(${c.uuid}, ${scope}, ${c.key}, ${c.value}, ${hour})`))}
          ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value = VALUES(value)`;
      }
    }

    // Keep the profile's active/AFK time in sync (sum across servers).
    const touched = [...new Set(changed.filter((c) => c.key === STATS.ACTIVE_TIME || c.key === STATS.AFK_TIME).map((c) => c.uuid))];
    for (const uuid of touched) {
      const sums = await this.prisma.playerStatistic.groupBy({
        by: ['statKey'],
        where: { playerUuid: uuid, statKey: { in: [STATS.ACTIVE_TIME, STATS.AFK_TIME] } },
        _sum: { value: true },
      });
      const get = (k: string) => sums.find((s) => s.statKey === k)?._sum.value ?? null;
      await this.prisma.player.update({ where: { uuid }, data: { activePlaytimeSeconds: get(STATS.ACTIVE_TIME), afkSeconds: get(STATS.AFK_TIME) } });
    }
    for (const uuid of new Set(changed.map((c) => c.uuid))) this.realtime.publish({ type: 'player.updated', uuid });
    return { players: relevant.length, changed: changed.length };
  }

  /** Statistics for a player, all-time (current values) or for a range (from hourly history). */
  async forPlayer(uuid: string, range: { from: Date | null; to: Date }) {
    const [rows, firstSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.playerStatistic.findMany({ where: { playerUuid: uuid }, select: { statKey: true, value: true } }),
      this.prisma.playerStatisticSnapshot.findFirst({ where: { playerUuid: uuid }, orderBy: { capturedAt: 'asc' }, select: { capturedAt: true } }),
    ]);
    const allTime = sumByKey(rows);
    const top = (prefix: string, limit = 10) =>
      [...allTime.entries()]
        .filter(([k]) => k.startsWith(prefix))
        .sort((a, b) => (b[1] > a[1] ? 1 : b[1] < a[1] ? -1 : 0))
        .slice(0, limit)
        .map(([k, v]) => ({ id: k.slice(prefix.length), value: Number(v) }));
    const ores = ORE_BLOCKS.map((id) => ({ id, value: toNumber(allTime.get(`${STAT_PREFIXES.MINED}${id}`)) ?? 0 }))
      .filter((o) => o.value > 0)
      .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);

    let totals: Map<string, bigint> = allTime;
    if (range.from) {
      const snapshots = await this.loadSnapshots(uuid, range.from, range.to);
      totals = rangeTotals(snapshots, truncateToHour(range.from), range.to);
    }
    const coverageStart = firstSnapshot?.capturedAt ?? null;
    return {
      range: { from: range.from?.toISOString() ?? null, to: range.to.toISOString() },
      collected: rows.length > 0,
      coverageStart: coverageStart?.toISOString() ?? null,
      // A range starting before collection began cannot be complete; it is flagged, never extrapolated.
      partial: Boolean(range.from && (!coverageStart || coverageStart > range.from)),
      values: Object.fromEntries(HISTORY_KEYS.filter((k) => rows.some((r) => r.statKey === k)).map((k) => [k, Number(totals.get(k) ?? 0n)])),
      // Per-type breakdowns are all-time only.
      topMined: top(STAT_PREFIXES.MINED),
      topPlaced: top(STAT_PREFIXES.PLACED),
      topKilled: top(STAT_PREFIXES.KILLED),
      ores,
    };
  }

  /** Daily increments for the given keys over the last `days` local days. */
  async series(uuid: string, keys: string[], days: number, timezone: string) {
    const now = new Date();
    const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: timezone, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' });
    const dayKeys = [...new Set(Array.from({ length: days }, (_, i) => fmt.format(new Date(now.getTime() - (days - 1 - i) * 86_400_000))))];
    const from = startOfDayInTimezone(timezone, new Date(now.getTime() - (days - 1) * 86_400_000));
    const snapshots = await this.loadSnapshots(uuid, from, now, keys);
    return { timezone, days: dayKeys, series: dailySeries(snapshots, keys, dayKeys, timezone) };
  }

  /** Network leaderboard for one statistic (sum over servers). */
  async leaderboard(statKey: string, limit: number) {
    const groups = await this.prisma.playerStatistic.groupBy({
      by: ['playerUuid'],
      where: { statKey },
      _sum: { value: true },
      orderBy: { _sum: { value: 'desc' } },
      take: limit,
    });
    const players = await this.prisma.player.findMany({ where: { uuid: { in: groups.map((g) => g.playerUuid) } }, select: { uuid: true, username: true, online: true } });
    return groups.map((g, i) => ({ rank: i + 1, player: players.find((p) => p.uuid === g.playerUuid)!, value: Number(g._sum.value ?? 0n) }));
  }

  async networkOverview() {
    const [totals, trackedPlayers, first] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.playerStatistic.groupBy({ by: ['statKey'], where: { statKey: { in: [...HISTORY_KEYS] } }, _sum: { value: true } }),
      this.prisma.playerStatistic.findMany({ distinct: ['playerUuid'], select: { playerUuid: true } }).then((r) => r.length),
      this.prisma.playerStatisticSnapshot.findFirst({ orderBy: { capturedAt: 'asc' }, select: { capturedAt: true } }),
    ]);
    return {
      trackedPlayers,
      coverageStart: first?.capturedAt.toISOString() ?? null,
      totals: Object.fromEntries(totals.map((t) => [t.statKey, Number(t._sum.value ?? 0n)])),
    };
  }

  /** In-range snapshots plus, per scope+key, the last snapshot before `from` as baseline. */
  private async loadSnapshots(uuid: string, from: Date, to: Date, keys: readonly string[] = HISTORY_KEYS): Promise<Snapshot[]> {
    const [inRange, baselines] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.playerStatisticSnapshot.findMany({
        where: { playerUuid: uuid, statKey: { in: [...keys] }, capturedAt: { gte: truncateToHour(from), lte: to } },
        select: { scope: true, statKey: true, value: true, capturedAt: true },
      }),
      this.prisma.$queryRaw<Snapshot[]>`
        SELECT s.scope AS scope, s.stat_key AS statKey, s.value AS value, s.captured_at AS capturedAt
        FROM player_statistic_snapshots s
        JOIN (
          SELECT scope, stat_key, MAX(captured_at) AS captured_at
          FROM player_statistic_snapshots
          WHERE player_uuid = ${uuid} AND captured_at < ${truncateToHour(from)} AND stat_key IN (${Prisma.join([...keys])})
          GROUP BY scope, stat_key
        ) b ON b.scope = s.scope AND b.stat_key = s.stat_key AND b.captured_at = s.captured_at
        WHERE s.player_uuid = ${uuid}`,
    ]);
    return [...baselines.map((b) => ({ ...b, value: BigInt(b.value), capturedAt: new Date(b.capturedAt) })), ...inRange];
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/src/users/users.controller.ts`:

```ts
import { BadRequestException, Body, Controller, ForbiddenException, Get, NotFoundException, Param, Patch, Post, Query, Req } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ApiTags } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import type { Request } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { AuthService } from '../auth/auth.service';
import { PasswordService } from '../auth/password.service';
import { type AuthenticatedUser, clientIp, CurrentUser, RequirePermissions } from '../common/auth-context';
import { emailSchema, passwordSchema, usernameSchema } from '../common/validation';
import { paginationSchema, ZodBody, ZodQuery } from '../common/zod';
import { AuditService, userActor } from '../audit/audit.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { canManagePriority, OWNER_ROLE_KEY } from '../rbac/rbac.policy';

const listQuery = paginationSchema.extend({ search: z.string().trim().max(64).optional() });

const createUserSchema = z.object({
  username: usernameSchema,
  email: emailSchema,
  password: passwordSchema,
  roleId: z.string().min(1).max(32),
});

const updateUserSchema = z
  .object({
    email: emailSchema.optional(),
    roleId: z.string().min(1).max(32).optional(),
    disabled: z.boolean().optional(),
    password: passwordSchema.optional(),
  })
  .strict();

const userSelect = {
  id: true,
  username: true,
  email: true,
  disabled: true,
  locale: true,
  lastLoginAt: true,
  createdAt: true,
  twoFactorEnabled: true,
  role: { select: { id: true, key: true, name: true, priority: true } },
} as const;

@ApiTags('users')
@Controller('users')
export class UsersController {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly passwords: PasswordService,
    private readonly auth: AuthService,
    private readonly audit: AuditService,
  ) {}

  @Get()
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.USERS_VIEW)
  @ZodQuery(listQuery)
  async list(@Query() q: z.infer<typeof listQuery>) {
    const where = q.search ? { OR: [{ username: { contains: q.search } }, { email: { contains: q.search } }] } : {};
    const [total, items] = await this.prisma.$transaction([
      this.prisma.dashboardUser.count({ where }),
      this.prisma.dashboardUser.findMany({
        where,
        select: userSelect,
        orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
        skip: (q.page - 1) * q.pageSize,
        take: q.pageSize,
      }),
    ]);
    return { total, page: q.page, pageSize: q.pageSize, items };
  }

  @Post()
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.USERS_MANAGE)
  @ZodBody(createUserSchema)
  async create(@CurrentUser() actor: AuthenticatedUser, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof createUserSchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    await this.assertAssignableRole(actor, body.roleId);
    const passwordHash = await this.passwords.hash(body.password);
    return this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const user = await tx.dashboardUser.create({
        data: { username: body.username, email: body.email, passwordHash, roleId: body.roleId },
        select: userSelect,
      });
      await this.audit.record(
        { actor: userActor(actor), action: 'users.created', targetType: 'dashboard_user', targetId: user.id, metadata: { username: user.username, role: user.role.key }, ipAddress: clientIp(req) },
        tx,
      );
      return user;
    });
  }

  @Patch(':id')
  @RequirePermissions(PERMISSIONS.USERS_MANAGE)
  @ZodBody(updateUserSchema)
  async update(@CurrentUser() actor: AuthenticatedUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Body() body: z.infer<typeof updateUserSchema>, @Req() req: Request) {
    const target = await this.prisma.dashboardUser.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { role: true } });
    if (!target) throw new NotFoundException();
    const isSelf = target.id === actor.id;

    if (!isSelf && !canManagePriority(actor, target.role.priority)) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'PRIORITY_TOO_HIGH', message: 'You cannot manage this user' });
    }
    if (isSelf && (body.disabled !== undefined || body.roleId !== undefined)) {
      throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'SELF_MODIFICATION', message: 'You cannot change your own role or status' });
    }
    if (body.roleId && body.roleId !== target.roleId) await this.assertAssignableRole(actor, body.roleId);

    const losesOwner = target.role.key === OWNER_ROLE_KEY && ((body.roleId && body.roleId !== target.roleId) || body.disabled === true);
    if (losesOwner) {
      const owners = await this.prisma.dashboardUser.count({ where: { role: { key: OWNER_ROLE_KEY }, disabled: false } });
      if (owners <= 1) throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'LAST_OWNER', message: 'At least one active Owner is required' });
    }

    const passwordHash = body.password ? await this.passwords.hash(body.password) : undefined;
    const updated = await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const user = await tx.dashboardUser.update({
        where: { id },
        data: { email: body.email, roleId: body.roleId, disabled: body.disabled, passwordHash },
        select: userSelect,
      });
      const { password: _omit, ...changes } = body;
      await this.audit.record(
        {
          actor: userActor(actor),
          action: 'users.updated',
          targetType: 'dashboard_user',
          targetId: id,
          metadata: { ...changes, passwordReset: Boolean(body.password) },
          ipAddress: clientIp(req),
        },
        tx,
      );
      return user;
    });
    if (body.disabled || body.password || body.roleId) await this.auth.revokeAllSessions(id);
    return updated;
  }

  private async assertAssignableRole(actor: AuthenticatedUser, roleId: string): Promise<void> {
    const role = await this.prisma.dashboardRole.findUnique({ where: { id: roleId } });
    if (!role) throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'UNKNOWN_ROLE', message: 'Role does not exist' });
    if (!canManagePriority(actor, role.priority)) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'PRIORITY_TOO_HIGH', message: 'You cannot assign this role' });
    }
  }
}
```

`apps/backend/test/anticheat.spec.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { antiCheatSettingsSchema, decide, EXAMPLE_RULES, findRule } from '../src/anticheat/anticheat-rules';

const settings = antiCheatSettingsSchema.parse({
  rules: [
    { cheatType: 'Speed', action: 'TEMP_BAN', durationSeconds: 2_592_000, minViolationLevel: 10, cooldownSeconds: 300 },
    { cheatType: 'KillAura', action: 'BAN', durationSeconds: null },
    { cheatType: 'Timer', action: 'KICK', durationSeconds: null, enabled: false },
  ],
});
const ok = { inCooldown: false, rateLimited: false };

describe('AntiCheat settings', () => {
  it('defaults to logging only for automatic reports and a 30-day ban for explicit requests', () => {
    const defaults = antiCheatSettingsSchema.parse({});
    expect(defaults.defaultRule.action).toBe('NONE');
    expect(defaults.commandFallback).toMatchObject({ action: 'TEMP_BAN', durationSeconds: 30 * 86_400 });
    expect(defaults.rules).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('validates durations, duplicates and example rules', () => {
    expect(antiCheatSettingsSchema.safeParse({ rules: [{ cheatType: 'Fly', action: 'TEMP_BAN', durationSeconds: null }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(antiCheatSettingsSchema.safeParse({ rules: [{ cheatType: 'Fly', action: 'BAN', durationSeconds: 60 }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(antiCheatSettingsSchema.safeParse({ rules: [{ cheatType: 'Fly', action: 'KICK', durationSeconds: null }, { cheatType: 'fly', action: 'BAN', durationSeconds: null }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(antiCheatSettingsSchema.safeParse({ rules: EXAMPLE_RULES }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('matches cheat types case-insensitively and ignores disabled rules', () => {
    expect(findRule(settings, 'speed')?.cheatType).toBe('Speed');
    expect(findRule(settings, 'Timer')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('decide', () => {
  it('applies the matching rule above the threshold', () => {
    expect(decide(settings, { cheatType: 'Speed', violationLevel: 12, explicit: false }, ok).outcome).toBe('TEMP_BAN');
    expect(decide(settings, { cheatType: 'Speed', violationLevel: 5, explicit: false }, ok).outcome).toBe('SKIPPED_THRESHOLD');
    expect(decide(settings, { cheatType: 'Speed', violationLevel: 5, explicit: true }, ok).outcome).toBe('TEMP_BAN');
  });

  it('logs unknown automatic reports and uses the fallback for explicit ones', () => {
    expect(decide(settings, { cheatType: 'Reach', violationLevel: 99, explicit: false }, ok).outcome).toBe('LOGGED');
    const explicit = decide(settings, { cheatType: 'Reach', violationLevel: null, explicit: true }, ok);
    expect(explicit.outcome).toBe('TEMP_BAN');
    expect(explicit.matchedCheatType).toBeNull();
  });

  it('respects cooldowns, rate limits and the global switch', () => {
    expect(decide(settings, { cheatType: 'KillAura', violationLevel: 1, explicit: false }, { inCooldown: true, rateLimited: false }).outcome).toBe('SKIPPED_COOLDOWN');
    expect(decide(settings, { cheatType: 'KillAura', violationLevel: 1, explicit: false }, { inCooldown: false, rateLimited: true }).outcome).toBe('SKIPPED_RATE_LIMIT');
    expect(decide({ ...settings, enabled: false }, { cheatType: 'KillAura', violationLevel: 1, explicit: true }, ok).outcome).toBe('DISABLED');
  });
});
```

`apps/backend/test/e2e.spec.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * End-to-end test against real MySQL + Redis. Runs only when E2E_DATABASE_URL
 * and E2E_REDIS_URL are set (CI provides service containers). The database
 * must be empty and migrated (`prisma migrate deploy`).
 */
import type { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { sha256Hex } from '../src/common/crypto';
import { canonicalRequest, sign } from '../src/plugin-api/plugin-signature';

const enabled = Boolean(process.env.E2E_DATABASE_URL && process.env.E2E_REDIS_URL);
const SETUP_CODE = 'E2E-SETUP-CODE-0123456789';

describe.skipIf(!enabled)('backend e2e (MySQL + Redis)', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  let base: string;
  const jar = new Map<string, string>();

  async function call(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown, extraHeaders: Record<string, string> = {}) {
    const res = await fetch(`${base}${path}`, {
      method,
      headers: {
        'content-type': 'application/json',
        'x-mnm-csrf': '1',
        cookie: [...jar].map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`).join('; '),
        ...extraHeaders,
      },
      body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
    });
    for (const c of res.headers.getSetCookie()) {
      const [pair] = c.split(';');
      const [k, v] = pair.split('=');
      if (v) jar.set(k, v);
      else jar.delete(k);
    }
    const text = await res.text();
    return { status: res.status, body: text ? JSON.parse(text) : null };
  }

  beforeAll(async () => {
    Object.assign(process.env, {
      DATABASE_URL: process.env.E2E_DATABASE_URL,
      REDIS_URL: process.env.E2E_REDIS_URL,
      JWT_SECRET: 'e2e-secret-that-is-long-enough-for-validation', // gitleaks:allow (test-only fixture)
      SETUP_TOKEN: SETUP_CODE,
      COOKIE_SECURE: 'false',
      NODE_ENV: 'test',
    });
    const { AppModule } = await import('../src/app.module.js');
    app = await NestFactory.create(AppModule, { logger: ['error', 'warn'], rawBody: true });
    app.use(cookieParser());
    app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
    await app.listen(0, '127.0.0.1');
    base = (await app.getUrl()).replace('[::1]', '127.0.0.1');
  }, 60_000);

  afterAll(async () => {
    await app?.close();
  });

  it('reports readiness', async () => {
    const res = await call('GET', '/api/health/ready');
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
  });

  it('reports an uninitialized installation with migrations applied', async () => {
    const res = await call('GET', '/api/setup/status');
    expect(res.body.initialized).toBe(false);
    expect(res.body.database.connected).toBe(true);
    expect(res.body.database.pendingMigrations).toBe(false);
    expect(res.body.redis.connected).toBe(true);
  });

  const owner = { username: 'owner', email: 'owner@example.test', password: 'correct-horse-battery' };
  const network = { name: 'E2E Network', defaultLocale: 'en-US', defaultTimezone: 'Europe/Berlin', defaultTheme: 'dark' };

  it('rejects an invalid setup code', async () => {
    const res = await call('POST', '/api/setup/initialize', { setupCode: 'WRONG', owner, network });
    expect(res.status).toBe(403);
  });

  it('rejects mutating requests without the CSRF header', async () => {
    const res = await call('POST', '/api/setup/initialize', { setupCode: SETUP_CODE, owner, network }, { 'x-mnm-csrf': '' });
    expect(res.status).toBe(403);
    expect(res.body.code).toBe('CSRF_HEADER_MISSING');
  });

  it('initializes exactly once and signs the owner in', async () => {
    const res = await call('POST', '/api/setup/initialize', { setupCode: SETUP_CODE, owner, network });
    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(jar.has('mnm_access')).toBe(true);
    const again = await call('POST', '/api/setup/initialize', { setupCode: SETUP_CODE, owner, network });
    expect(again.status).toBe(409);
  });

  it('returns the current user with owner permissions', async () => {
    const res = await call('GET', '/api/auth/me');
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.roleKey).toBe('owner');
    expect(res.body.permissions).toContain('*');
    expect(res.body.locale).toBe('en-US');
  });

  it('serves the dashboard summary from real data', async () => {
    const res = await call('GET', '/api/dashboard/summary');
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.totalPlayers).toBe(0);
    expect(res.body.servers).toEqual([]);
    expect(res.body.recentActivity[0].action).toBe('setup.initialized');
  });

  it('issues a single-use registration token that a plugin can redeem once', async () => {
    const created = await call('POST', '/api/servers/registration-tokens', { type: 'VELOCITY', name: 'proxy-1' });
    expect(created.status).toBe(201);
    const token = created.body.token as string;
    expect(token.startsWith('mnm_reg_')).toBe(true);

    const register = await call('POST', '/api/plugin/v1/register', { token, pluginVersion: '0.1.0' }, { 'x-mnm-csrf': '' });
    expect(register.status).toBe(201);
    expect(register.body.secret).toMatch(/^mnm_sk_/);

    const reuse = await call('POST', '/api/plugin/v1/register', { token, pluginVersion: '0.1.0' }, { 'x-mnm-csrf': '' });
    expect(reuse.status).toBe(401);

    const servers = await call('GET', '/api/servers');
    expect(servers.body).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(servers.body[0].name).toBe('proxy-1');
    proxy = { keyId: register.body.keyId, secret: register.body.secret };

    const paperToken = await call('POST', '/api/servers/registration-tokens', { type: 'PAPER', name: 'lobby' });
    const paperReg = await call('POST', '/api/plugin/v1/register', { token: paperToken.body.token, pluginVersion: '0.2.0' }, { 'x-mnm-csrf': '' });
    expect(paperReg.status).toBe(201);
    paper = { keyId: paperReg.body.keyId, secret: paperReg.body.secret };
  });

  // ── Phase 2: signed plugin API ─────────────────────────────────

  let proxy: { keyId: string; secret: string };
  let paper: { keyId: string; secret: string };
  const steve = { uuid: '069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5', username: 'Steve' };
  const sessionKey = '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555';

  async function signed(creds: { keyId: string; secret: string }, method: string, path: string, body?: unknown, override: Record<string, string> = {}) {
    const raw = body === undefined ? '' : JSON.stringify(body);
    const timestamp = String(Date.now());
    const nonce = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    const signature = sign(sha256Hex(creds.secret), canonicalRequest(method, path, timestamp, nonce, raw));
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
      'content-type': 'application/json',
      'x-mnm-key-id': creds.keyId,
      'x-mnm-timestamp': timestamp,
      'x-mnm-nonce': nonce,
      'x-mnm-signature': signature,
      ...override,
    };
    const res = await fetch(`${base}${path}`, { method, headers, body: raw || undefined });
    const text = await res.text();
    return { status: res.status, body: text ? JSON.parse(text) : null, headers };
  }

  it('authenticates plugins by signature and rejects tampering and replays', async () => {
    const ping = await signed(proxy, 'GET', '/api/plugin/v1/ping');
    expect(ping.status).toBe(200);
    expect(ping.body.serverName).toBe('proxy-1');

    const forged = await signed(proxy, 'GET', '/api/plugin/v1/ping', undefined, { 'x-mnm-signature': '0'.repeat(64) });
    expect(forged.status).toBe(401);

    // Replaying the exact same signed request must fail.
    const replay = await fetch(`${base}/api/plugin/v1/ping`, { headers: ping.headers });
    expect(replay.status).toBe(401);
    expect((await replay.json()).code).toBe('PLUGIN_AUTH_REPLAYED');
  });

  it('records heartbeats with server metrics', async () => {
    const hb = await signed(paper, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/heartbeat', {
      pluginVersion: '0.2.0',
      minecraftVersion: '26.3',
      onlinePlayers: 0,
      maxPlayers: 100,
      tps: 19.97,
      mspt: 12.5,
      memoryUsedBytes: 1_073_741_824,
      memoryMaxBytes: 4_294_967_296,
    });
    expect(hb.status).toBe(200);
    expect(hb.body.heartbeatIntervalSeconds).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const servers = await call('GET', '/api/servers');
    const lobby = servers.body.find((s: { name: string }) => s.name === 'lobby');
    expect(lobby.status).toBe('ONLINE');
    expect(lobby.tps).toBeCloseTo(19.97);
    expect(lobby.memoryMaxBytes).toBe('4294967296');
  });

  it('only accepts session events from proxies', async () => {
    const res = await signed(paper, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/events', {
      events: [{ type: 'player.join', sessionKey, uuid: steve.uuid, username: steve.username, at: Date.now() }],
    });
    expect(res.status).toBe(403);
  });

  it('tracks join, server switch and leave idempotently', async () => {
    const joinedAt = Date.now() - 120_000;
    const batch = {
      events: [
        { type: 'player.join', sessionKey, uuid: steve.uuid, username: steve.username, at: joinedAt, ip: '203.0.113.7', virtualHost: 'play.example.test', protocol: 775, clientVersion: '26.3' },
        { type: 'player.switch', sessionKey, uuid: steve.uuid, server: 'lobby', at: joinedAt + 1000 },
        { type: 'player.brand', sessionKey, uuid: steve.uuid, brand: 'vanilla' },
      ],
    };
    const first = await signed(proxy, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/events', batch);
    expect(first.body).toEqual({ applied: 3, skipped: 0 });
    // Retried batch (e.g. after a timeout) must not duplicate anything.
    const retry = await signed(proxy, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/events', batch);
    expect(retry.body.skipped).toBe(3);

    const online = await call('GET', '/api/players?online=true');
    expect(online.body.total).toBe(1);
    expect(online.body.items[0].currentServer.name).toBe('lobby');
    expect(online.body.items[0].totalPlaytimeSeconds).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(119);

    const search = await call('GET', '/api/players?search=ste');
    expect(search.body.items[0].uuid).toBe(steve.uuid);
    const byUuid = await call('GET', `/api/players?search=${steve.uuid.replace(/-/g, '')}`);
    expect(byUuid.body.total).toBe(1);

    const profile = await call('GET', `/api/players/${steve.uuid}`);
    expect(profile.body.clientBrand).toBe('vanilla');
    expect(profile.body.sessions[0].servers[0].server.name).toBe('lobby');
    expect(profile.body.sessions[0].connection.ipAddress).toBe('203.0.113.7'); // owner has players.view.ip

    const summary = await call('GET', '/api/dashboard/summary');
    expect(summary.body.onlinePlayers).toBe(1);
    expect(summary.body.playerRecord.count).toBe(1);

    const leave = await signed(proxy, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/events', { events: [{ type: 'player.leave', sessionKey, uuid: steve.uuid, at: joinedAt + 60_000 }] });
    expect(leave.body.applied).toBe(1);
    const after = await call('GET', `/api/players/${steve.uuid}`);
    expect(after.body.online).toBe(false);
    expect(after.body.currentServer).toBeNull();
    expect(after.body.totalPlaytimeSeconds).toBe(60);
    expect(after.body.sessions[0].durationSeconds).toBe(60);
    expect(after.body.sessions[0].servers[0].leftAt).not.toBeNull();
  });

  // ── Phase 4: player profiles ───────────────────────────────────

  it('stores skins, serves activity and connection history with alt-account detection', async () => {
    const alt = { uuid: '9b8a7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-8c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d', username: 'SteveAlt' };
    const altSession = '33333333-4444-4555-8666-777777777777';
    const textures = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ textures: { SKIN: { url: 'http://textures.minecraft.net/texture/0123456789abcdef', metadata: { model: 'slim' } } } })).toString('base64');
    const at = Date.now() - 30 * 60_000;
    const res = await signed(proxy, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/events', {
      events: [
        { type: 'player.join', sessionKey: altSession, ...alt, at, ip: '203.0.113.7', textures },

    const connections = await call('GET', `/api/players/${alt.uuid}/connections`);
    expect(connections.body.total).toBe(1);
    expect(connections.body.items[0].ipAddress).toBe('203.0.113.7');
    expect(connections.body.ipSummary[0]).toMatchObject({ ipAddress: '203.0.113.7', connections: 1 });
    // Steve connected from the same address earlier.
    expect(connections.body.relatedAccounts.map((a: { username: string }) => a.username)).toContain('Steve');
    expect(connections.body.geoipEnabled).toBe(false);
  });

  it('anonymises IP addresses after the retention period', async () => {
    const privacy = await call('PATCH', '/api/settings/privacy', { ipRetentionDays: 7 });
    expect(privacy.status).toBe(200);
    const { MaintenanceService } = await import('../src/maintenance/maintenance.service.js');
    const result = await app.get(MaintenanceService).run(new Date(Date.now() + 8 * 86_400_000), true);
    expect(result.connections).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    const connections = await call('GET', '/api/players/069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5/connections');

  it('reconciles state from a proxy sync and closes sessions on shutdown', async () => {

    const alexSession = '22222222-3333-4444-8555-666666666666';

  // ── Phase 7: inventories ───────────────────────────────────────

  it('queues inventory edits for offline players, applies them with compare-and-set and rolls back', async () => {
    const steve = '069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5';
    const fp = (c: string) => c.repeat(64);
    const sword = { slot: 0, id: 'minecraft:diamond_sword', amount: 1, name: 'Excalibur', fp: fp('a'), data: 'U1dPUkQ=' };
    const dirt = { slot: 1, id: 'minecraft:dirt', amount: 64, fp: fp('b'), data: 'RElSVA==' };
    const ingest = await signed(paper, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/inventories', {
      capturedAt: Date.now(),
      players: [{ uuid: steve, inventory: { fp: fp('1'), items: [sword, dirt] }, enderChest: { fp: fp('2'), items: [] } }],
    });
    expect(ingest.body).toEqual({ changed: 2 });
    const again = await signed(paper, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/inventories', { capturedAt: Date.now(), players: [{ uuid: steve, inventory: { fp: fp('1'), items: [sword, dirt] } }] });
    expect(again.body).toEqual({ changed: 0 });

    const overview = await call('GET', `/api/players/${steve}/inventories`);
    expect(overview.body[0].serverName).toBe('lobby');
    const scope = overview.body[0].serverId as string;
    const view = await call('GET', `/api/players/${steve}/inventories/${scope}/inventory`);
    expect(view.body.revision).toBe(1);
    expect(view.body.items[0]).not.toHaveProperty('data');

    const base = `/api/players/${steve}/inventories/${scope}/inventory/revisions`;
    const move = { baseRevision: 1, reason: 'Support ticket #12', changes: [{ slot: 1, before: fp('b'), after: null }, { slot: 5, before: null, after: { id: 'minecraft:dirt', amount: 64, base: fp('b') } }] };
    expect((await call('POST', base, { ...move, baseRevision: 0 })).body.code).toBe('STALE_REVISION');
    expect((await call('POST', base, { ...move, changes: [{ slot: 2, before: null, after: { id: 'minecraft:dirt', amount: 1, base: fp('f') } }] })).body.code).toBe('UNKNOWN_BASE_ITEM');
    const created = await call('POST', base, move);
    expect(created.status).toBe(201);
    expect((await call('POST', base, move)).body.code).toBe('PENDING_EDIT');

    // Offline: nothing is delivered until the player is on that server.
    expect((await signed(paper, 'GET', '/api/plugin/v1/inventories/pending')).body.revisions).toEqual([]);
    const session = '44444444-5555-4666-8777-888888888888';
    await signed(proxy, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/events', {
      events: [
        { type: 'player.join', sessionKey: session, uuid: steve, username: 'Steve', at: Date.now() },
        { type: 'player.switch', sessionKey: session, uuid: steve, server: 'lobby', at: Date.now() },
      ],
    });
    const pending = await signed(paper, 'GET', '/api/plugin/v1/inventories/pending');
    expect(pending.body.revisions).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(pending.body.revisions[0].changes[1].after).toMatchObject({ id: 'minecraft:dirt', data: 'RElSVA==' });

    const movedDirt = { ...dirt, slot: 5, fp: fp('d') };
    const applied = await signed(paper, 'POST', `/api/plugin/v1/inventories/revisions/${created.body.id}/result`, {
      status: 'APPLIED',
      appliedFps: { '1': null, '5': fp('d') },
      snapshot: { fp: fp('3'), items: [sword, movedDirt] },
    });
    expect(applied.body.status).toBe('APPLIED');
    const afterApply = await call('GET', `/api/players/${steve}/inventories/${scope}/inventory`);
    expect(afterApply.body.revision).toBe(2);
    expect(afterApply.body.revisions[0]).toMatchObject({ status: 'APPLIED', reason: 'Support ticket #12' });

    // Rollback: the exact previous item comes back via the same compare-and-set path.
    const rollback = await call('POST', `/api/players/${steve}/inventories/revisions/${created.body.id}/rollback`, { reason: 'Undo' });
    expect(rollback.status).toBe(201);
    const pendingRollback = (await signed(paper, 'GET', '/api/plugin/v1/inventories/pending')).body.revisions[0];
    expect(pendingRollback.changes).toEqual(
      expect.arrayContaining([
        { slot: 1, before: null, after: expect.objectContaining({ id: 'minecraft:dirt', data: 'RElSVA==' }) },
        { slot: 5, before: fp('d'), after: null },
      ]),
    );
    const conflict = await signed(paper, 'POST', `/api/plugin/v1/inventories/revisions/${pendingRollback.id}/result`, { status: 'CONFLICT', message: 'Slot 5 changed' });
    expect(conflict.body.status).toBe('CONFLICT');
    const final = await call('GET', `/api/players/${steve}/inventories/${scope}/inventory`);
    expect(final.body.revisions[0]).toMatchObject({ status: 'CONFLICT', resultMessage: 'Slot 5 changed' });
    expect(final.body.revisions[1].status).toBe('APPLIED');

    const audit = await call('GET', '/api/audit-logs?action=inventory.');
    expect(audit.body.items.map((e: { action: string }) => e.action)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['inventory.edit_requested', 'inventory.revision_applied', 'inventory.rollback_requested', 'inventory.revision_conflict']));

    await signed(proxy, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/events', { events: [{ type: 'player.leave', sessionKey: session, uuid: steve, at: Date.now() }] });
  });

  // ── Phase 8: configuration and setup ───────────────────────────

    await call('POST', '/api/plugin/v1/register', { token: created.body.token, pluginVersion: '0.8.0' }, { 'x-mnm-csrf': '' });
    const done = await call('GET', `/api/servers/registration-tokens/${created.body.id}`);
    expect(done.body).toMatchObject({ status: 'REGISTERED', server: { name: 'survival', pluginVersion: '0.8.0' } });
    expect((await call('GET', '/api/servers/registration-tokens/unknown')).status).toBe(404);
  });

  it('pushes managed plugin settings with revisions and validated messages', async () => {
    const initial = await call('GET', '/api/settings/plugins');

    const unsafe = await call('PUT', '/api/settings/plugins', { baseRevision: 0, settings: { messages: { 'en-US': { 'command.kick.success': '<click:run_command:/op x>{player}' } } } });
    expect(unsafe.status).toBe(400);
    expect(unsafe.body.issues[0]).toEqual({ path: 'en-US.command.kick.success', message: 'unsafe-content' });

    const saved = await call('PUT', '/api/settings/plugins', { baseRevision: 0, settings });

    const audit = await call('GET', '/api/audit-logs?action=settings.plugins_updated');

  });

  it('stores punishment presets', async () => {
```
