```ts
  it('adds languages and imports validated dashboard catalogues', async () => {
    expect((await call('POST', '/api/i18n/languages', { locale: 'fr-FR', name: 'French' })).status).toBe(201);
    expect((await call('POST', '/api/i18n/languages', { locale: 'fr-FR', name: 'French' })).status).toBe(409);
    // Disabled languages are not served publicly.
    expect((await call('GET', '/api/i18n/messages/fr-FR')).status).toBe(404);

    const bad = await call('PUT', '/api/i18n/catalogs/fr-FR', { messages: { common: { save: '<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>' }, nope: { key: 'x' } } });
    expect(bad.status).toBe(400);
    expect(bad.body.code).toBe('INVALID_CATALOG');

    const imported = await call('PUT', '/api/i18n/catalogs/fr-FR', { messages: { meta: { nativeName: 'Français' }, common: { save: 'Enregistrer' } } });
    expect(imported.status).toBe(200);
    expect(imported.body.missingKeys).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    await call('PATCH', '/api/i18n/languages/fr-FR', { enabled: true });

    const served = await call('GET', '/api/i18n/messages/fr-FR');
    expect(served.body).toMatchObject({ locale: 'fr-FR', messages: { common: { save: 'Enregistrer' }, meta: { locale: 'fr-FR' } } });
    expect(served.body.revision).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const languages = await call('GET', '/api/i18n/languages');
    expect(languages.body.find((l: { locale: string }) => l.locale === 'fr-FR')).toMatchObject({ nativeName: 'Français', customized: true, bundled: false });

    // Overrides for a bundled language merge over the shipped catalogue.
    await call('PUT', '/api/i18n/catalogs/de-DE', { messages: { common: { save: 'Sichern' } } });
    const exported = await call('GET', '/api/i18n/catalogs/de-DE');
    expect(exported.body.common.save).toBe('Sichern');
    expect(exported.body.common.cancel).toBeTruthy();
    expect((await call('DELETE', '/api/i18n/catalogs/de-DE')).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await call('DELETE', '/api/i18n/languages/de-DE')).body.code).toBe('BUNDLED_LANGUAGE');

    expect((await call('DELETE', '/api/i18n/languages/fr-FR')).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await call('GET', '/api/i18n/messages/fr-FR')).status).toBe(404);
  });

  it('rotates and revokes server credentials', async () => {
    const servers = await call('GET', '/api/servers');
    const proxyId = servers.body.find((s: { name: string }) => s.name === 'proxy-1').id;
    const rotated = await call('POST', `/api/servers/${proxyId}/credentials/rotate`);
    expect(rotated.status).toBe(201);
    expect((await signed(proxy, 'GET', '/api/plugin/v1/ping')).status).toBe(401);
    const next = { keyId: rotated.body.keyId, secret: rotated.body.secret };
    expect((await signed(next, 'GET', '/api/plugin/v1/ping')).status).toBe(200);

    const disabled = await call('PATCH', `/api/servers/${proxyId}`, { enabled: false });
    expect(disabled.body.status).toBe('DISABLED');
    expect((await signed(next, 'GET', '/api/plugin/v1/ping')).status).toBe(403);
  });

  // ── Phase 3: punishments ───────────────────────────────────────

  it('bans via plugin command idempotently, feeds the change to plugins and prevents duplicates', async () => {
    const snapshot = await signed(paper, 'GET', '/api/plugin/v1/punishments/active');
    expect(snapshot.status).toBe(200);
    expect(snapshot.body.punishments).toEqual([]);
    const cursor = snapshot.body.cursor as string;

    const ban = { type: 'TEMP_BAN', target: 'steve', reason: 'Griefing spawn', durationSeconds: 86_400, issuer: { uuid: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', name: 'ModAnna' }, idempotencyKey: 'cmd-0001' };
    const first = await signed(paper, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/punishments', ban);
    expect(first.status).toBe(201);
    expect(first.body.target.username).toBe('Steve');
    expect(first.body.status).toBe('ACTIVE');
    expect(first.body.issuer.name).toBe('ModAnna');

    const retry = await signed(paper, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/punishments', ban);
    expect(retry.body.id).toBe(first.body.id);

    const duplicate = await signed(paper, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/punishments', { ...ban, type: 'BAN', durationSeconds: undefined, idempotencyKey: 'cmd-0002' });
    expect(duplicate.status).toBe(409);
    expect(duplicate.body.code).toBe('ALREADY_BANNED');

    const feed = await signed(paper, 'GET', `/api/plugin/v1/punishments/changes?after=${cursor}`);
    expect(feed.body.changes).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(feed.body.changes[0].kind).toBe('CREATED');
    expect(feed.body.changes[0].punishment).toMatchObject({ type: 'TEMP_BAN', targetName: 'Steve', reason: 'Griefing spawn' });
    expect((await signed(paper, 'GET', `/api/plugin/v1/punishments/changes?after=${feed.body.cursor}`)).body.changes).toEqual([]);

    const lookup = await signed(paper, 'GET', '/api/plugin/v1/players/lookup?target=Steve');
    expect(lookup.body.active.ban.id).toBe(first.body.id);
    expect(lookup.body.active.mute).toBeNull();
  });

  it('rejects invalid durations, kicks of offline players and unknown targets', async () => {
    const base = { issuer: { name: 'console' }, reason: 'x' };
    expect((await signed(paper, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/punishments', { ...base, type: 'TEMP_MUTE', target: 'Steve', idempotencyKey: 'cmd-0003' })).status).toBe(400);
    const kick = await signed(paper, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/punishments', { ...base, type: 'KICK', target: 'Steve', idempotencyKey: 'cmd-0004' });
    expect(kick.status).toBe(409);
    expect(kick.body.code).toBe('PLAYER_OFFLINE');
    const unknown = await signed(paper, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/punishments', { ...base, type: 'WARNING', target: 'Nobody', idempotencyKey: 'cmd-0005' });
    expect(unknown.status).toBe(404);
  });

  it('manages punishments and notes from the dashboard with an audit trail', async () => {
    const mute = await call('POST', '/api/punishments', { type: 'MUTE', target: 'ec561538-f3fd-461d-aff5-086b22154bce', reason: 'Spam' });
    expect(mute.status).toBe(201);
    expect(mute.body.issuer).toMatchObject({ type: 'USER', name: 'owner' });

    const active = await call('GET', '/api/punishments?status=active');
    expect(active.body.total).toBe(2);
    const steveHistory = await call('GET', '/api/players/069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5/punishments');
    expect(steveHistory.body.active.ban.reason).toBe('Griefing spawn');

    const unban = await call('POST', `/api/punishments/${steveHistory.body.active.ban.id}/revoke`, { reason: 'Appeal accepted' });
    expect(unban.status).toBe(200);
    expect(unban.body.status).toBe('REVOKED');
    expect(unban.body.revokedBy).toBe('owner');
    expect((await call('POST', `/api/punishments/${steveHistory.body.active.ban.id}/revoke`, {})).status).toBe(409);

    // Revocation is visible to plugins via the feed.
    const snapshot = await signed(paper, 'GET', '/api/plugin/v1/punishments/active');
    expect(snapshot.body.punishments.map((p: { type: string }) => p.type)).toEqual(['MUTE']);

    const unmute = await signed(paper, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/punishments/revoke', { kind: 'MUTE', target: 'Alex', revoker: { name: 'console' } });
    expect(unmute.status).toBe(200);
    expect(unmute.body.revokedBy).toBe('console@lobby');

    const note = await call('POST', '/api/players/069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5/notes', { content: 'Promised to rebuild the spawn.' });
    expect(note.status).toBe(201);
    expect((await call('GET', '/api/players/069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5/notes')).body).toHaveLength(1);

    const audit = await call('GET', '/api/audit-logs?action=punishments.');
    expect(audit.body.items.map((e: { action: string }) => e.action)).toEqual(
      expect.arrayContaining(['punishments.temp_ban', 'punishments.mute', 'punishments.revoked']),
    );
  });

  // ── Phase 5: statistics ────────────────────────────────────────

  it('ingests statistics from Paper and serves totals, ranges, series and leaderboards', async () => {
    const steve = '069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5';
    const hour = 3_600_000;
    const first = await signed(paper, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/statistics', {
      capturedAt: Date.now() - 3 * hour,
      players: [{ uuid: steve, stats: { 'mnm:blocks_mined': 100, 'mined:minecraft:diamond_ore': 4, 'mnm:active_time': 3000, 'mnm:afk_time': 600, 'custom:minecraft:deaths': 2 } }],
    });
    expect(first.body).toEqual({ players: 1, changed: 5 });
    const unchanged = await signed(paper, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/statistics', {
      capturedAt: Date.now() - 3 * hour,
      players: [{ uuid: steve, stats: { 'mnm:blocks_mined': 100 } }, { uuid: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000ff', stats: { 'mnm:blocks_mined': 1 } }],
    });
    expect(unchanged.body).toEqual({ players: 1, changed: 0 });
    await signed(paper, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/statistics', {
      capturedAt: Date.now() - hour,
      players: [{ uuid: steve, stats: { 'mnm:blocks_mined': 160, 'mined:minecraft:diamond_ore': 6, 'mnm:active_time': 4200, 'mnm:afk_time': 600, 'custom:minecraft:deaths': 3 } }],
    });

    const invalidKey = await signed(paper, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/statistics', { capturedAt: Date.now(), players: [{ uuid: steve, stats: { 'drop table': 1 } }] });
    expect(invalidKey.status).toBe(400);
    const fromProxy = await signed(proxy, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/statistics', { capturedAt: Date.now(), players: [{ uuid: steve, stats: { 'mnm:blocks_mined': 1 } }] });
    expect([401, 403]).toContain(fromProxy.status); // proxy is rotated/disabled or not a Paper server

    const all = await call('GET', `/api/players/${steve}/statistics?range=all`);
    expect(all.body.collected).toBe(true);
    expect(all.body.values['mnm:blocks_mined']).toBe(160);
    expect(all.body.ores).toEqual([{ id: 'minecraft:diamond_ore', value: 6 }]);
    expect(all.body.topMined[0]).toEqual({ id: 'minecraft:diamond_ore', value: 6 });

    const day = await call('GET', `/api/players/${steve}/statistics?range=24h`);
    expect(day.body.values['mnm:blocks_mined']).toBe(60); // first snapshot has no known start
    expect(day.body.partial).toBe(true);

    const series = await call('GET', `/api/players/${steve}/statistics/series?keys=mnm:blocks_mined&days=7`);
    expect(series.body.series['mnm:blocks_mined'].reduce((a: number, b: number) => a + b, 0)).toBe(60);

    const profile = await call('GET', `/api/players/${steve}`);
    expect(profile.body.activePlaytimeSeconds).toBe(4200);
    expect(profile.body.afkSeconds).toBe(600);

    const board = await call('GET', '/api/statistics/leaderboard?stat=mnm:blocks_mined');
    expect(board.body[0]).toMatchObject({ rank: 1, value: 160, player: { username: 'Steve' } });
    expect((await call('GET', '/api/statistics/leaderboard?stat=mined:minecraft:stone')).status).toBe(400);
    const overview = await call('GET', '/api/statistics/overview');
    expect(overview.body.trackedPlayers).toBe(1);
  });

  // ── Phase 6: AntiCheat ─────────────────────────────────────────

  it('applies AntiCheat rules with thresholds, cooldowns, idempotency and evidence', async () => {
    const alex = 'ec561538-f3fd-461d-aff5-086b22154bce';
    const defaults = await call('GET', '/api/anticheat/settings');
    expect(defaults.body.settings.defaultRule.action).toBe('NONE');
    expect(defaults.body.examples).toHaveLength(3);

    const put = await call('PUT', '/api/anticheat/settings', {
      ...defaults.body.settings,
      rules: [{ cheatType: 'Speed', action: 'TEMP_BAN', durationSeconds: 2_592_000, minViolationLevel: 10, cooldownSeconds: 300, enabled: true }],
    });
    expect(put.status).toBe(200);

    const report = (body: Record<string, unknown>) => signed(paper, 'POST', '/api/plugin/v1/anticheat/reports', { provider: 'Grim', target: 'Alex', ...body });

    expect((await report({ cheatType: 'Speed', violationLevel: 4, eventKey: 'ac-event-0001' })).body.outcome).toBe('SKIPPED_THRESHOLD');
    expect((await report({ cheatType: 'Reach', violationLevel: 50, eventKey: 'ac-event-0002' })).body.outcome).toBe('LOGGED');

    const ban = await report({ cheatType: 'speed', violationLevel: 15, evidence: 'moved 12.3 b/s', metadata: { ping: 42 }, eventKey: 'ac-event-0003' });
    expect(ban.body.outcome).toBe('TEMP_BAN');
    expect(ban.body.punishmentId).toBeTruthy();
    const retry = await report({ cheatType: 'speed', violationLevel: 15, eventKey: 'ac-event-0003' });
    expect(retry.body).toEqual(ban.body);

    expect((await report({ cheatType: 'Speed', violationLevel: 20, eventKey: 'ac-event-0004' })).body.outcome).toBe('SKIPPED_COOLDOWN');
    // Explicit request without a rule → fallback ban, but Alex is already banned.
    expect((await report({ cheatType: 'Fly', explicit: true, eventKey: 'ac-event-0005' })).body.outcome).toBe('SKIPPED_DUPLICATE');

    const punishments = await call('GET', `/api/players/${alex}/punishments`);
    expect(punishments.body.active.ban).toMatchObject({ source: 'ANTICHEAT', issuer: { type: 'SERVER', name: 'AntiCheat (Grim)' } });

    const events = await call('GET', `/api/players/${alex}/anticheat`);
    expect(events.body.total).toBe(5);
    const summary = await call('GET', '/api/anticheat/summary');
    expect(summary.body).toMatchObject({ events: 5, punished: 1, providers: ['Grim'] });
    expect((await call('GET', '/api/anticheat/events?punished=true')).body.total).toBe(1);

    // Unban Alex again so later tests are unaffected.
    await call('POST', `/api/punishments/${ban.body.punishmentId}/revoke`, { reason: 'test cleanup' });
  });

  it('enforces RBAC for lower roles', async () => {
    const roles = await call('GET', '/api/roles');
    const viewer = roles.body.find((r: { key: string }) => r.key === 'viewer');
    const created = await call('POST', '/api/users', { username: 'viewer1', email: 'viewer@example.test', password: 'viewer-password-123', roleId: viewer.id });
    expect(created.status).toBe(201);

    await call('POST', '/api/auth/logout');
    jar.clear();
    const login = await call('POST', '/api/auth/login', { identifier: 'viewer1', password: 'viewer-password-123' });
    expect(login.status).toBe(200);

    expect((await call('GET', '/api/audit-logs')).status).toBe(403);
    expect((await call('GET', '/api/users')).status).toBe(403);
    expect((await call('GET', '/api/servers')).status).toBe(200);
    // Viewers may not see or issue punishments (server-side check, not just hidden UI).
    expect((await call('GET', '/api/punishments')).status).toBe(403);
    expect((await call('POST', '/api/punishments', { type: 'WARNING', target: 'Steve', reason: 'x' })).status).toBe(403);
    expect((await call('GET', '/api/anticheat/events')).status).toBe(403);
  });

  it('switches the language preference per user', async () => {
    const res = await call('PATCH', '/api/auth/me', { locale: 'de-DE' });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect((await call('GET', '/api/auth/me')).body.locale).toBe('de-DE');
    expect((await call('PATCH', '/api/auth/me', { locale: 'xx-XX' })).status).toBe(400);
  });

  it('rotates refresh tokens and rejects reuse', async () => {
    const before = jar.get('mnm_refresh');
    const res = await fetch(`${base}/api/auth/refresh`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'x-mnm-csrf': '1', cookie: `mnm_refresh=${before}` } });
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const reuse = await fetch(`${base}/api/auth/refresh`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'x-mnm-csrf': '1', cookie: `mnm_refresh=${before}` } });
    expect(reuse.status).toBe(401);
  });
});
```

`apps/backend/test/guards.spec.ts`:

```ts
import { ForbiddenException, UnauthorizedException, type ExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { PermissionsGuard, SessionGuard } from '../src/auth/guards';
import type { AuthService } from '../src/auth/auth.service';
import type { AuthenticatedUser } from '../src/common/auth-context';

const user: AuthenticatedUser = {
  id: 'u1',
  username: 'alice',
  email: 'alice@example.test',
  roleId: 'r1',
  roleKey: 'moderator',
  rolePriority: 500,
  permissions: ['players.view'],
  sessionId: 's1',
  locale: null,
  theme: null,
  timezone: null,
};

function context(req: Record<string, unknown>, meta: Record<string, unknown> = {}): { ctx: ExecutionContext; reflector: Reflector } {
  const handler = () => undefined;
  const reflector = {
    getAllAndOverride: (key: string) => meta[key],
    getAllAndMerge: (key: string) => meta[key] ?? [],
  } as unknown as Reflector;
  const request = { method: 'GET', cookies: {}, header: (name: string) => (req.headers as Record<string, string> | undefined)?.[name], ...req };
  const ctx = {
    getType: () => 'http',
    getHandler: () => handler,
    getClass: () => Object,
    switchToHttp: () => ({ getRequest: () => request }),
  } as unknown as ExecutionContext;
  return { ctx, reflector };
}

const auth = { authenticate: async (token: string) => (token === 'good' ? user : null) } as unknown as AuthService;

describe('SessionGuard', () => {
  it('rejects unauthenticated requests to protected routes', async () => {
    const { ctx, reflector } = context({});
    await expect(new SessionGuard(reflector, auth).canActivate(ctx)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(UnauthorizedException);
  });

  it('accepts a valid session cookie', async () => {
    const { ctx, reflector } = context({ cookies: { mnm_access: 'good' } });
    await expect(new SessionGuard(reflector, auth).canActivate(ctx)).resolves.toBe(true);
  });

  it('rejects an invalid token', async () => {
    const { ctx, reflector } = context({ headers: { authorization: 'Bearer bad' } });
    await expect(new SessionGuard(reflector, auth).canActivate(ctx)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(UnauthorizedException);
  });

  it('requires the CSRF header on mutating requests', async () => {
    const { ctx, reflector } = context({ method: 'POST', cookies: { mnm_access: 'good' } });
    await expect(new SessionGuard(reflector, auth).canActivate(ctx)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ForbiddenException);
    const ok = context({ method: 'POST', cookies: { mnm_access: 'good' }, headers: { 'x-mnm-csrf': '1' } });
    await expect(new SessionGuard(ok.reflector, auth).canActivate(ok.ctx)).resolves.toBe(true);
  });

  it('lets public routes through and skips CSRF for plugin routes', async () => {
    const { ctx, reflector } = context({ method: 'POST' }, { 'mnm:isPublic': true, 'mnm:skipCsrf': true });
    await expect(new SessionGuard(reflector, auth).canActivate(ctx)).resolves.toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('PermissionsGuard', () => {
  it('allows when every required permission is granted', () => {
    const { ctx, reflector } = context({ user }, { 'mnm:permissions': ['players.view'] });
    expect(new PermissionsGuard(reflector).canActivate(ctx)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('denies missing permissions server-side', () => {
    const { ctx, reflector } = context({ user }, { 'mnm:permissions': ['punishments.ban'] });
    expect(() => new PermissionsGuard(reflector).canActivate(ctx)).toThrow(ForbiddenException);
  });
});
```

`apps/backend/test/inventory.spec.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { editSchema, inverseChanges, InventoryEditError, publicItems, resolveEdit, type Snapshot } from '../src/inventory/inventory-model';

const fp = (c: string) => c.repeat(64);
const snapshot: Snapshot = {
  fp: fp('0'),
  items: [
    { slot: 0, id: 'minecraft:diamond_sword', amount: 1, name: 'Excalibur', enchantments: { 'minecraft:sharpness': 5 }, fp: fp('a'), data: 'U1dPUkQ=' },
    { slot: 1, id: 'minecraft:dirt', amount: 64, fp: fp('b'), data: 'RElSVA==' },
  ],
};
const enderChestItem = { slot: 0, id: 'minecraft:emerald', amount: 5, fp: fp('c'), data: 'RU1FUkFMRA==' };
const pool = [...snapshot.items, enderChestItem];

describe('resolveEdit', () => {
  it('resolves a move into two compare-and-set changes with server-side data', () => {
    const changes = resolveEdit('INVENTORY', snapshot, pool, {
      baseRevision: 1,
      changes: [
        { slot: 1, before: fp('b'), after: null },
        { slot: 5, before: null, after: { id: 'minecraft:dirt', amount: 64, base: fp('b') } },
      ],
    });
    expect(changes[0]).toMatchObject({ slot: 1, before: fp('b'), after: null, beforeItem: { id: 'minecraft:dirt' } });
    expect(changes[1].after).toMatchObject({ id: 'minecraft:dirt', amount: 64, data: 'RElSVA==' });
  });

  it('allows moving items from the ender chest', () => {
    const [change] = resolveEdit('INVENTORY', snapshot, pool, { baseRevision: 1, changes: [{ slot: 9, before: null, after: { id: 'minecraft:emerald', amount: 5, base: fp('c') } }] });
    expect(change.after?.data).toBe('RU1FUkFMRA==');
  });

  it('rejects stale slots, unknown or mismatched base items and invalid slots', () => {
    const run = (changes: Parameters<typeof resolveEdit>[3]['changes'], kind: 'INVENTORY' | 'ENDER_CHEST' = 'INVENTORY') => {
      try {
        resolveEdit(kind, snapshot, pool, { baseRevision: 1, changes });
        return 'ok';
      } catch (err) {
        return (err as InventoryEditError).code;
      }
    };
    expect(run([{ slot: 0, before: null, after: null }])).toBe('STALE_SLOT');
    expect(run([{ slot: 2, before: null, after: { id: 'minecraft:dirt', amount: 1, base: fp('f') } }])).toBe('UNKNOWN_BASE_ITEM');
    expect(run([{ slot: 2, before: null, after: { id: 'minecraft:stone', amount: 1, base: fp('b') } }])).toBe('BASE_TYPE_MISMATCH');
    expect(run([{ slot: 30, before: null, after: null }], 'ENDER_CHEST')).toBe('INVALID_SLOT');
  });

  it('never accepts raw item data from clients', () => {
    const parsed = editSchema.parse({ baseRevision: 1, changes: [{ slot: 3, before: null, after: { id: 'minecraft:stone', amount: 1, data: 'EVIL' } }] });
    expect(parsed.changes[0].after).not.toHaveProperty('data');
    expect(editSchema.safeParse({ baseRevision: 1, changes: [{ slot: 3, before: null, after: null }, { slot: 3, before: null, after: null }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(editSchema.safeParse({ baseRevision: 1, changes: [{ slot: 3, before: null, after: { id: 'minecraft:stone', amount: 1, enchantments: { 'minecraft:sharpness': 999 } } }] }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('inverseChanges', () => {
  it('restores the exact previous items and requires applied fingerprints', () => {
    const applied = resolveEdit('INVENTORY', snapshot, pool, { baseRevision: 1, changes: [{ slot: 0, before: fp('a'), after: { id: 'minecraft:diamond_sword', amount: 1, name: null, base: fp('a') } }] });
    expect(() => inverseChanges(applied)).toThrow(InventoryEditError);
    const inverse = inverseChanges(applied.map((c) => ({ ...c, afterFp: fp('d') })));
    expect(inverse[0]).toMatchObject({ slot: 0, before: fp('d'), after: { id: 'minecraft:diamond_sword', data: 'U1dPUkQ=' } });
  });
});

describe('publicItems', () => {
  it('strips serialized data before sending snapshots to browsers', () => {
    expect(publicItems(snapshot).every((i) => !('data' in i))).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { messagePlaceholders, parseMinecraftCatalog } from '@mnm/translations';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { managedPluginSettingsSchema, moderationSettingsSchema, normalizePluginSettings, pluginCatalogs, validatePluginMessages } from '../src/settings/plugin-settings';

describe('plugin message catalogues', () => {
  it('parses the flat YAML subset including escapes', () => {
    const parsed = parseMinecraftCatalog('# comment\nprefix: "<gray>[N]</gray> "\na.b-c: "Line\\nwith \\"quotes\\""\n\nbroken line\n');
    expect(parsed).toEqual({ prefix: '<gray>[N]</gray> ', 'a.b-c': 'Line\nwith "quotes"' });
  });

  it('loads the bundled catalogues with identical keys', () => {
    const catalogs = pluginCatalogs();
    expect(Object.keys(catalogs['en-US']).length).toBeGreaterThan(20);
    expect(Object.keys(catalogs['de-DE']).sort()).toEqual(Object.keys(catalogs['en-US']).sort());
  });

  it('extracts placeholders', () => {
    expect(messagePlaceholders('{player} was banned for {duration}. ID: {id} {player}')).toEqual(['player', 'duration', 'id']);
  });
});

describe('managed plugin settings', () => {
  it('defaults every field to "use the local value"', () => {
    const parsed = managedPluginSettingsSchema.parse({});
    expect(parsed).toMatchObject({ language: null, statisticsEnabled: null, inventorySync: null, messages: {} });
  });

  it('rejects out-of-range intervals and unknown fields', () => {
    expect(managedPluginSettingsSchema.safeParse({ statisticsIntervalSeconds: 10 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(managedPluginSettingsSchema.safeParse({ backendUrl: 'http://evil' }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it('validates message overrides', () => {
    const ok = validatePluginMessages({ 'fr-FR': { 'command.ban.success': '<green>{player} a été banni. ID : {id}' } });
    expect(ok).toEqual([]);
    const issues = validatePluginMessages({
      'en-US': {
        'does.not.exist': 'x',
        'command.ban.success': '<click:run_command:/op {player}>Click</click>',
        'command.kick.success': '{player} {secret}',
        'command.warn.success': '  ',
      },
    });
    expect(issues.map((i) => [i.key, i.problem])).toEqual([
      ['does.not.exist', 'unknown-key'],
      ['command.ban.success', 'unsafe-content'],
      ['command.kick.success', 'unknown-placeholder'],
      ['command.warn.success', 'empty'],
    ]);
  });

  it('normalises categories and drops empty locales', () => {
    const settings = managedPluginSettingsSchema.parse({ statisticsCategories: ['general', 'combat', 'combat'], messages: { 'de-DE': {} } });
    expect(normalizePluginSettings(settings)).toMatchObject({ statisticsCategories: ['combat', 'general'], messages: {} });
  });
});

describe('moderation presets', () => {
  const preset = { id: 'hacking', name: 'Hacking', type: 'TEMP_BAN', reason: 'Unfair advantage', durationSeconds: 30 * 86_400 };

  it('accepts valid presets', () => {
    expect(moderationSettingsSchema.safeParse({ presets: [preset, { ...preset, id: 'spam', type: 'MUTE', durationSeconds: null }] }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('requires durations exactly for temporary types and unique IDs', () => {
    expect(moderationSettingsSchema.safeParse({ presets: [{ ...preset, durationSeconds: null }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(moderationSettingsSchema.safeParse({ presets: [{ ...preset, type: 'BAN' }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(moderationSettingsSchema.safeParse({ presets: [preset, preset] }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

`apps/backend/test/plugin.spec.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { sha256Hex } from '../src/common/crypto';
import { canonicalRequest, checkSignature, MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_MS, sign } from '../src/plugin-api/plugin-signature';
import { eventBatchSchema, heartbeatSchema } from '../src/plugin-api/plugin-events';
import { normalizeUuid } from '../src/players/players.controller';

// Shared test vector – the same values are asserted in RequestSignerTest.java.
const VECTOR = {
  secret: 'mnm_sk_test-vector-secret',
  method: 'POST',
  path: '/api/plugin/v1/heartbeat',
  timestamp: '1795400000000',
  nonce: 'nonce-0123456789abcdef',
  body: '{"onlinePlayers":3}',
  signingKeyHex: '2d82f41db33f1785036be6980f75ca56279ad6c7a3a2de9dad2374e2d1ea85ca', // gitleaks:allow (test vector)
  signature: 'abbe9d82b6527986e5434b4df02b8ff6d6ce279d6cffebd9a722221ac561bb03',
};

describe('plugin request signatures', () => {
  it('derives the signing key as SHA-256 of the secret (= stored credential hash)', () => {
    expect(sha256Hex(VECTOR.secret)).toBe(VECTOR.signingKeyHex);
  });

  it('matches the shared test vector', () => {
    const canonical = canonicalRequest(VECTOR.method, VECTOR.path, VECTOR.timestamp, VECTOR.nonce, VECTOR.body);
    expect(sign(VECTOR.signingKeyHex, canonical)).toBe(VECTOR.signature);
  });

  const base = {
    signingKeyHex: VECTOR.signingKeyHex,
    method: VECTOR.method,
    path: VECTOR.path,
    timestamp: VECTOR.timestamp,
    nonce: VECTOR.nonce,
    signature: VECTOR.signature,
    body: VECTOR.body,
    now: Number(VECTOR.timestamp) + 1000,
  };

  it('accepts a valid signature', () => {
    expect(checkSignature(base)).toEqual({ ok: true });
  });

  it('rejects tampered bodies, paths and methods', () => {
    expect(checkSignature({ ...base, body: '{"onlinePlayers":4}' })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'BAD_SIGNATURE' });
    expect(checkSignature({ ...base, path: '/api/plugin/v1/shutdown' })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'BAD_SIGNATURE' });
    expect(checkSignature({ ...base, method: 'PUT' })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'BAD_SIGNATURE' });
  });

  it('rejects stale or future timestamps', () => {
    expect(checkSignature({ ...base, now: Number(VECTOR.timestamp) + MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_MS + 1 })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'CLOCK_SKEW' });
    expect(checkSignature({ ...base, now: Number(VECTOR.timestamp) - MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_MS - 1 })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'CLOCK_SKEW' });
  });

  it('rejects missing or malformed headers', () => {
    expect(checkSignature({ ...base, signature: undefined })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'MISSING_HEADERS' });
    expect(checkSignature({ ...base, nonce: 'short' })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'BAD_NONCE' });
    expect(checkSignature({ ...base, timestamp: 'yesterday' })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'BAD_TIMESTAMP' });
    expect(checkSignature({ ...base, signature: 'zz' })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'BAD_SIGNATURE' });
  });
});

describe('plugin payload validation', () => {
  it('normalises UUIDs and clamps future event times', () => {
    const future = Date.now() + 3_600_000;
    const parsed = eventBatchSchema.parse({
      events: [{ type: 'player.leave', sessionKey: 'AAAAAAAA-BBBB-CCCC-DDDD-EEEEEEEEEEEE', uuid: '069A79F4-44E9-4726-A5BE-FCA90E38AAF5', at: future }],
    });
    const event = parsed.events[0];
    expect(event.uuid).toBe('069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5');
    expect(event.type === 'player.leave' && event.at.getTime()).toBeLessThanOrEqual(Date.now());
  });

  it('rejects unknown event types and invalid IPs', () => {
    expect(eventBatchSchema.safeParse({ events: [{ type: 'player.fly', uuid: 'x' }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(
      eventBatchSchema.safeParse({
        events: [{ type: 'player.join', sessionKey: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', uuid: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', username: 'Steve', at: 1, ip: 'not-an-ip' }],
      }).success,
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it('validates heartbeat metrics', () => {
    expect(heartbeatSchema.safeParse({ pluginVersion: '0.2.0', onlinePlayers: 5, tps: 19.98, cpuLoad: 0.2 }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(heartbeatSchema.safeParse({ pluginVersion: '0.2.0', onlinePlayers: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(heartbeatSchema.safeParse({ pluginVersion: '0.2.0', onlinePlayers: 1, cpuLoad: 3 }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('normalizeUuid', () => {
  it('accepts dashed and undashed UUIDs', () => {
    expect(normalizeUuid('069a79f444e94726a5befca90e38aaf5')).toBe('069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5');
    expect(normalizeUuid('069A79F4-44E9-4726-A5BE-FCA90E38AAF5')).toBe('069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5');
    expect(normalizeUuid('Notch')).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

`apps/backend/test/profiles.spec.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { buildActivity } from '../src/players/activity';
import { isPublicIp } from '../src/players/geoip.service';
import { isPremiumUuid, isSkinPng, normalizeTextureUrl, parseTexturesProperty } from '../src/players/skins';

const b64 = (o: unknown) => Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(o)).toString('base64');

describe('skin textures', () => {
  it('accepts only Mojang texture URLs (SSRF protection)', () => {
    expect(normalizeTextureUrl('http://textures.minecraft.net/texture/abcdef0123456789')).toBe('https://textures.minecraft.net/texture/abcdef0123456789');
    expect(normalizeTextureUrl('https://evil.example/texture/abcdef0123456789')).toBeNull();
    expect(normalizeTextureUrl('https://textures.minecraft.net.evil.example/texture/abcdef0123456789')).toBeNull();
    expect(normalizeTextureUrl('https://textures.minecraft.net/texture/../admin')).toBeNull();
    expect(normalizeTextureUrl('http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('parses the textures property including the arm model', () => {
    const slim = b64({ textures: { SKIN: { url: 'http://textures.minecraft.net/texture/0123456789abcdef', metadata: { model: 'slim' } } } });
    expect(parseTexturesProperty(slim)).toEqual({ url: 'https://textures.minecraft.net/texture/0123456789abcdef', model: 'slim' });
    const classic = b64({ textures: { SKIN: { url: 'http://textures.minecraft.net/texture/0123456789abcdef' } } });
    expect(parseTexturesProperty(classic)?.model).toBe('classic');
    expect(parseTexturesProperty('not base64 json')).toBeNull();
    expect(parseTexturesProperty(b64({ textures: { SKIN: { url: 'http://localhost/x' } } }))).toBeNull();
  });

  it('identifies premium UUIDs and valid skin PNGs', () => {
    expect(isPremiumUuid('069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5')).toBe(true);
    expect(isPremiumUuid('5c80c4a6-9c49-3d2d-8f8a-1d3e8b0a1d2c')).toBe(false);
    const png = Buffer.alloc(24);
    png.writeUInt32BE(0x89504e47, 0);
    png.writeUInt32BE(0x0d0a1a0a, 4);
    png.writeUInt32BE(64, 16);
    png.writeUInt32BE(64, 20);
    expect(isSkinPng(png)).toBe(true);
    png.writeUInt32BE(128, 16);
    expect(isSkinPng(png)).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('isPublicIp', () => {
  it('skips private and special ranges', () => {
    expect(isPublicIp('203.0.113.7')).toBe(true);
    expect(isPublicIp('2001:db8::1')).toBe(true);
    for (const ip of ['10.0.0.1', '172.16.5.4', '192.168.1.1', '127.0.0.1', '100.64.0.1', '169.254.1.1', '::1', 'fd00::1', 'not-an-ip']) {
      expect(isPublicIp(ip)).toBe(false);
    }
  });
});

describe('buildActivity', () => {
  const now = new Date('2026-11-26T12:00:00Z'); // Thursday

  it('splits sessions across local days and weekday/hour buckets', () => {
    const report = buildActivity(
      [
        // 23:30–00:30 Berlin (UTC+1) spans two local days
        { startedAt: new Date('2026-11-24T22:30:00Z'), endedAt: new Date('2026-11-24T23:30:00Z') },
        // open session: 11:00 UTC until now → 1 h
        { startedAt: new Date('2026-11-26T11:00:00Z'), endedAt: null },
      ],
      { timezone: 'Europe/Berlin', days: 7, now },
    );
    expect(report.daily).toHaveLength(7);
    expect(report.daily.at(-1)).toEqual({ date: '2026-11-26', seconds: 3600 });
    expect(report.daily.find((d) => d.date === '2026-11-24')?.seconds).toBe(1800);
    expect(report.daily.find((d) => d.date === '2026-11-25')?.seconds).toBe(1800);
    expect(report.totalSeconds).toBe(7200);
    expect(report.sessions).toBe(2);
    // Tuesday 23:00 local and Wednesday 00:00 local
    expect(report.heatmap[1][23]).toBe(1800);
    expect(report.heatmap[2][0]).toBe(1800);
    expect(report.heatmap[3][12]).toBe(3600); // Thursday 12:00 local
  });

  it('ignores time outside the range', () => {
    const report = buildActivity([{ startedAt: new Date('2026-10-01T10:00:00Z'), endedAt: new Date('2026-10-01T11:00:00Z') }], { timezone: 'UTC', days: 7, now });
    expect(report.totalSeconds).toBe(0);
    expect(report.sessions).toBe(0);
    expect(report.averageSessionSeconds).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

`apps/backend/test/punishments.spec.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { computeExpiry, effectiveStatus, ISSUE_PERMISSION, isRevocable, REVOKE_PERMISSION } from '../src/punishments/punishment-rules';

const now = new Date('2026-11-25T12:00:00Z');

describe('computeExpiry', () => {
  it('requires a duration for temporary punishments', () => {
    expect(computeExpiry('TEMP_BAN', undefined, now)).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: expect.stringContaining('required') });
    expect(computeExpiry('TEMP_MUTE', 3600, now)).toEqual({ ok: true, expiresAt: new Date('2026-11-25T13:00:00Z') });
  });

  it('rejects durations for permanent types and out-of-range values', () => {
    expect(computeExpiry('BAN', 3600, now).ok).toBe(false);
    expect(computeExpiry('KICK', 60, now).ok).toBe(false);
    expect(computeExpiry('TEMP_BAN', 10, now).ok).toBe(false);
    expect(computeExpiry('TEMP_BAN', 11 * 365 * 86_400, now).ok).toBe(false);
    expect(computeExpiry('BAN', undefined, now)).toEqual({ ok: true, expiresAt: null });
  });
});

describe('effectiveStatus', () => {
  it('treats active punishments past their expiry as expired', () => {
    const t = now.getTime();
    expect(effectiveStatus({ status: 'ACTIVE', expiresAt: new Date(t - 1) }, t)).toBe('EXPIRED');
    expect(effectiveStatus({ status: 'ACTIVE', expiresAt: new Date(t + 1) }, t)).toBe('ACTIVE');
    expect(effectiveStatus({ status: 'ACTIVE', expiresAt: null }, t)).toBe('ACTIVE');
    expect(effectiveStatus({ status: 'REVOKED', expiresAt: null }, t)).toBe('REVOKED');
  });

  it('never considers kicks revocable', () => {
    expect(isRevocable({ type: 'KICK', status: 'ACTIVE', expiresAt: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(isRevocable({ type: 'BAN', status: 'ACTIVE', expiresAt: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(isRevocable({ type: 'BAN', status: 'REVOKED', expiresAt: null })).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('permission mapping', () => {
  it('maps each type to issue and revoke permissions', () => {
    expect(ISSUE_PERMISSION.TEMP_BAN).toBe('punishments.ban');
    expect(ISSUE_PERMISSION.BLACKLIST).toBe('punishments.blacklist');
    expect(REVOKE_PERMISSION.BAN).toBe('punishments.unban');
    expect(REVOKE_PERMISSION.TEMP_MUTE).toBe('punishments.unmute');
  });
});
```

`apps/backend/test/statistics.spec.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { dailySeries, rangeTotals, type Snapshot, sumByKey, truncateToHour } from '../src/statistics/aggregation';

const snap = (scope: string, statKey: string, value: number, iso: string): Snapshot => ({ scope, statKey, value: BigInt(value), capturedAt: new Date(iso) });
const K = 'mnm:blocks_mined';

describe('rangeTotals', () => {
  it('sums increments after the baseline, across servers', () => {
    const totals = rangeTotals(
      [
        snap('lobby', K, 100, '2026-11-20T10:00:00Z'), // baseline before range
        snap('lobby', K, 150, '2026-11-25T10:00:00Z'),
        snap('lobby', K, 180, '2026-11-26T10:00:00Z'),
        snap('survival', K, 10, '2026-11-25T12:00:00Z'), // first ever value on this server: no known start
        snap('survival', K, 40, '2026-11-26T12:00:00Z'),
      ],
      new Date('2026-11-24T00:00:00Z'),
      new Date('2026-11-27T00:00:00Z'),
    );
    expect(totals.get(K)).toBe(80n + 30n);
  });

  it('treats a decrease as a counter reset instead of a negative delta', () => {
    const totals = rangeTotals(
      [snap('lobby', K, 500, '2026-11-24T01:00:00Z'), snap('lobby', K, 20, '2026-11-25T01:00:00Z'), snap('lobby', K, 50, '2026-11-26T01:00:00Z')],
      new Date('2026-11-24T00:00:00Z'),
      new Date('2026-11-27T00:00:00Z'),
    );
    expect(totals.get(K)).toBe(20n + 30n);
  });

  it('ignores snapshots after the range end', () => {
    const totals = rangeTotals([snap('lobby', K, 1, '2026-11-24T01:00:00Z'), snap('lobby', K, 9, '2026-11-28T01:00:00Z')], new Date('2026-11-24T00:00:00Z'), new Date('2026-11-27T00:00:00Z'));
    expect(totals.get(K)).toBe(0n);
  });
});

describe('dailySeries', () => {
  it('attributes increments to the local day of the snapshot hour', () => {
    const series = dailySeries(
      [snap('lobby', K, 10, '2026-11-24T22:00:00Z'), snap('lobby', K, 25, '2026-11-24T23:00:00Z'), snap('lobby', K, 30, '2026-11-25T10:00:00Z')],
      [K],
      ['2026-11-24', '2026-11-25'],
      'Europe/Berlin',
    );
    // 23:00 UTC is already Nov 25 in Berlin.
    expect(series[K]).toEqual([0, 15 + 5]);
  });
});

describe('helpers', () => {
  it('truncates to the hour and sums values per key', () => {
    expect(truncateToHour(new Date('2026-11-25T10:59:59.999Z')).toISOString()).toBe('2026-11-25T10:00:00.000Z');
    expect(sumByKey([{ statKey: K, value: 2n }, { statKey: K, value: 3n }, { statKey: 'x', value: 1n }]).get(K)).toBe(5n);
  });
});
```

`apps/backend/test/unit.spec.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { DEFAULT_ROLES, hasPermission, PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { getMessages, mergeWithFallback, validateCatalog } from '@mnm/translations';
import { randomCode, safeEqual, sha256Hex } from '../src/common/crypto';
import { startOfDayInTimezone } from '../src/common/time';
import { isValidTimezone } from '../src/common/validation';
import { parseEnv } from '../src/config/env';
import { canManagePriority, ungrantablePermissions } from '../src/rbac/rbac.policy';
import { effectiveStatus } from '../src/servers/servers.service';

describe('hasPermission', () => {
  it('matches exact, global and namespace wildcards', () => {
    expect(hasPermission(['players.view'], 'players.view')).toBe(true);
    expect(hasPermission(['players.view'], 'players.view.ip')).toBe(false);
    expect(hasPermission(['*'], 'audit.view')).toBe(true);
    expect(hasPermission(['players.*'], 'players.view.ip')).toBe(true);
    expect(hasPermission(['players.*'], 'punishments.ban')).toBe(false);
    expect(hasPermission([], 'players.view')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('gives the default viewer role no moderation rights', () => {
    const viewer = DEFAULT_ROLES.find((r) => r.key === 'viewer')!;
    expect(hasPermission(viewer.permissions, PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_BAN)).toBe(false);
    expect(hasPermission(viewer.permissions, PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW_IP)).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('RBAC policy', () => {
  const admin = { roleKey: 'administrator', rolePriority: 900, permissions: ['users.manage', 'players.view'] };
  const owner = { roleKey: 'owner', rolePriority: 1000, permissions: ['*'] };

  it('only allows managing strictly lower priorities (owner exempt)', () => {
    expect(canManagePriority(admin, 500)).toBe(true);
    expect(canManagePriority(admin, 900)).toBe(false);
    expect(canManagePriority(admin, 1000)).toBe(false);
    expect(canManagePriority(owner, 1000)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('prevents granting permissions the actor does not hold', () => {
    expect(ungrantablePermissions(admin, ['players.view'])).toEqual([]);
    expect(ungrantablePermissions(admin, ['players.view', 'audit.view'])).toEqual(['audit.view']);
    expect(ungrantablePermissions(admin, ['*'])).toEqual(['*']);
    expect(ungrantablePermissions(owner, ['audit.view', '*'])).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('crypto helpers', () => {
  it('generates grouped setup codes without ambiguous characters', () => {
    const code = randomCode();
    expect(code).toMatch(/^[A-HJ-NP-Z2-9]{4}(-[A-HJ-NP-Z2-9]{4}){3}$/);
  });

  it('compares secrets in constant time', () => {
    expect(safeEqual('abc', 'abc')).toBe(true);
    expect(safeEqual('abc', 'abd')).toBe(false);
    expect(sha256Hex('a')).toHaveLength(64);
  });
});

describe('startOfDayInTimezone', () => {
  it('returns UTC midnight for UTC', () => {
    expect(startOfDayInTimezone('UTC', new Date('2026-11-23T17:00:00Z')).toISOString()).toBe('2026-11-23T00:00:00.000Z');
  });

  it('accounts for the zone offset (winter, CET = UTC+1)', () => {
    expect(startOfDayInTimezone('Europe/Berlin', new Date('2026-11-23T17:00:00Z')).toISOString()).toBe('2026-11-22T23:00:00.000Z');
  });

  it('accounts for the zone offset (summer, CEST = UTC+2)', () => {
    expect(startOfDayInTimezone('Europe/Berlin', new Date('2026-07-01T12:00:00Z')).toISOString()).toBe('2026-06-30T22:00:00.000Z');
  });

  it('uses the local date, not the UTC date', () => {
    // 2026-11-23 23:30 in New York is already 2026-11-24 in UTC.
    expect(startOfDayInTimezone('America/New_York', new Date('2026-11-24T04:30:00Z')).toISOString()).toBe('2026-11-23T05:00:00.000Z');
  });
});

describe('validation', () => {
  it('validates IANA time zones', () => {
    expect(isValidTimezone('Europe/Berlin')).toBe(true);
    expect(isValidTimezone('Mars/Olympus')).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('environment parsing', () => {
  const base = { DATABASE_URL: 'mysql://u:p@db:3306/mnm', REDIS_URL: 'redis://redis:6379', JWT_SECRET: 'x'.repeat(48) };

  it('applies secure defaults', () => {
    const env = parseEnv(base);
    expect(env.PORT).toBe(4000);
    expect(env.COOKIE_SECURE).toBe('auto');
    expect(env.SETUP_TOKEN).toBeUndefined();
    expect(env.REGISTRATION_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES).toBe(30);
  });

  it('rejects weak secrets and wrong URLs', () => {
    expect(() => parseEnv({ ...base, JWT_SECRET: 'short' })).toThrow(/JWT_SECRET/);
    expect(() => parseEnv({ ...base, DATABASE_URL: 'postgres://x' })).toThrow(/DATABASE_URL/);
    expect(() => parseEnv({ ...base, SETUP_TOKEN: 'too-short' })).toThrow(/SETUP_TOKEN/);
  });
});

describe('server status', () => {
  const now = Date.parse('2026-11-23T12:00:00Z');
  it('treats stale heartbeats as offline', () => {
    expect(effectiveStatus({ status: 'ONLINE', enabled: true, lastHeartbeatAt: new Date(now - 10_000) }, now)).toBe('ONLINE');
    expect(effectiveStatus({ status: 'ONLINE', enabled: true, lastHeartbeatAt: new Date(now - 120_000) }, now)).toBe('OFFLINE');
    expect(effectiveStatus({ status: 'ONLINE', enabled: false, lastHeartbeatAt: new Date(now) }, now)).toBe('DISABLED');
  });
});

describe('translations', () => {
  it('rejects markup and script injection in catalogues', () => {
    const issues = validateCatalog({ a: { b: '<script>alert(1)</script>', c: 'ok {name}', d: 'javascript:void(0)', e: 'broken {' } });
    expect(issues.map((i) => `${i.key}:${i.problem}`).sort()).toEqual(['a.b:unsafe-content', 'a.d:unsafe-content', 'a.e:unbalanced-braces']);
  });

  it('falls back to English for missing keys', () => {
    const merged = mergeWithFallback({ a: 'A', n: { b: 'B', c: 'C' } }, { n: { b: 'Bde' } });
    expect(merged).toEqual({ a: 'A', n: { b: 'Bde', c: 'C' } });
    expect((getMessages('xx-XX').common as Record<string, string>).save).toBe('Save');
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { useFormatter, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { AntiCheatEvents } from '@/components/anticheat-events';
import { AntiCheatRules } from '@/components/anticheat-rules';
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/app-shell';
import { useLiveRefresh } from '@/components/realtime-provider';
import { Badge, Card, CardContent, Select, Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/primitives';
import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch';
import { api } from '@/lib/api';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

interface Summary {
  since: string;
  events: number;
  punished: number;
  topCheatTypes: { cheatType: string; count: number }[];
  providers: string[];
}

export default function AntiCheatPage() {
  const t = useTranslations('anticheat');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'events' | 'rules'>('events');
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<Summary | null>(null);
  const [provider, setProvider] = useState('');
  const [punishedOnly, setPunishedOnly] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setSummary(await api<Summary>('/anticheat/summary').catch(() => null));
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);
  useLiveRefresh(['anticheat.event'], load);

  const query = new URLSearchParams({ ...(provider ? { provider } : {}), ...(punishedOnly ? { punished: 'true' } : {}) }).toString();

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title={t('title')} subtitle={t('subtitle')} />

      {!summary ? (
        <Skeleton className="mb-6 h-24" />
      ) : (
        <div className="mb-6 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
          <Card className="p-4">
            <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('eventsToday')}</div>
            <div className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold tabular-nums">{format.number(summary.events)}</div>
          </Card>
          <Card className="p-4">
            <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('punishedToday')}</div>
            <div className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold tabular-nums">{format.number(summary.punished)}</div>
          </Card>
          <Card className="p-4">
            <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('topTypes')}</div>
            <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              {summary.topCheatTypes.length === 0 ? (
                <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">–</span>
              ) : (
                summary.topCheatTypes.map((c) => (
                  <Badge key={c.cheatType} variant="outline">
                    {c.cheatType} · {c.count}
                  </Badge>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}

      <nav className="mb-4 flex gap-1 border-b">
        {(['events', 'rules'] as const).map((key) => (
          <button
            key={key}
            type="button"
            aria-current={tab === key ? 'page' : undefined}
            onClick={() => setTab(key)}
            className={cn('-mb-px border-b-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground', tab === key ? 'border-primary font-medium text-foreground' : 'border-transparent')}
          >
            {t(`tabs.${key}`)}
          </button>
        ))}
      </nav>

      {tab === 'events' ? (
        <>
          <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
            <Select aria-label={t('provider')} className="w-52" value={provider} onChange={(e) => setProvider(e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">{t('allProviders')}</option>
              {summary?.providers.map((p) => (
                <option key={p} value={p}>
                  {p}
                </option>
              ))}
            </Select>
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <Switch checked={punishedOnly} onCheckedChange={setPunishedOnly} aria-label={t('onlyPunished')} />
              {t('onlyPunished')}
            </label>
          </div>
          <Card>
            <CardContent className="px-0 py-0">
              <AntiCheatEvents endpoint="/anticheat/events" query={query} showPlayer />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </>
      ) : (
        <AntiCheatRules />
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/app/(app)/audit/page.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useFormatter, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/app-shell';
import { Alert, Badge, Button, Card, Input, Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/primitives';
import { TBody, TD, TH, THead, TR, Table } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { api, type AuditEntry, errorKey, type Page } from '@/lib/api';

const PAGE_SIZE = 25;

export default function AuditPage() {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useFormatter();
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [action, setAction] = useState('');
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('');
  const [data, setData] = useState<Page<AuditEntry> | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page), pageSize: String(PAGE_SIZE) });
    if (filter) params.set('action', filter);
    try {
      setData(await api<Page<AuditEntry>>(`/audit-logs?${params}`));
      setError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`));
    }
  }, [page, filter, t]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setTimeout(() => {
      setPage(1);
      setFilter(action.trim());
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [action]);

  const pages = data ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(data.total / PAGE_SIZE)) : 1;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={t('audit.title')}
        subtitle={t('audit.subtitle')}
        actions={<Input className="w-72" placeholder={t('audit.filterAction')} aria-label={t('audit.filterAction')} value={action} onChange={(e) => setAction(e.target.value)} />}
      />
      {error && <Alert variant="destructive">{error}</Alert>}
      <Card>
        {!data ? (
          <div className="grid gap-2 p-5">
            {Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => (
              <Skeleton key={i} className="h-9" />
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : data.items.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="p-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('audit.empty')}</p>
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <THead>
              <TR>
                <TH>{t('audit.timestamp')}</TH>
                <TH>{t('audit.actor')}</TH>
                <TH>{t('audit.action')}</TH>
                <TH>{t('audit.target')}</TH>
              </TR>
            </THead>
            <TBody>
              {data.items.map((e) => (
                <TR key={e.id}>
                  <TD className="whitespace-nowrap text-muted-foreground">
                    <time dateTime={e.createdAt}>{format.dateTime(new Date(e.createdAt), { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'medium' })}</time>
                  </TD>
                  <TD>
                    <span className="font-medium">{e.actorType === 'SYSTEM' ? t('audit.system') : e.actorName}</span>{' '}
                    <Badge variant="muted">{e.actorType}</Badge>
                  </TD>
                  <TD className="font-mono text-xs">{e.action}</TD>
                  <TD className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{e.targetType ? `${e.targetType}:${e.targetId ?? ''}` : '–'}</TD>
                </TR>
              ))}
            </TBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </Card>
      {data && pages > 1 && (
        <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-end gap-3 text-sm">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={page <= 1} onClick={() => setPage(page - 1)}>
            {t('common.previous')}
          </Button>
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t('common.page', { page, pages })}</span>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={page >= pages} onClick={() => setPage(page + 1)}>
            {t('common.next')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { Gavel, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/app-shell';
import { PunishDialog, useIssuableTypes } from '@/components/punishment-dialogs';
import { PunishmentTable } from '@/components/punishment-table';
import { useLiveRefresh } from '@/components/realtime-provider';
import { Alert, Button, Card, Input, Select, Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/primitives';
import { api, errorKey, type Page, type Punishment, type PunishmentType } from '@/lib/api';

const PAGE_SIZE = 25;
const TYPES: PunishmentType[] = ['BAN', 'TEMP_BAN', 'BLACKLIST', 'MUTE', 'TEMP_MUTE', 'KICK', 'WARNING'];

export default function ModerationPage() {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const issuable = useIssuableTypes();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [type, setType] = useState<PunishmentType | ''>('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'active' | 'expired' | 'revoked' | ''>('active');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [data, setData] = useState<Page<Punishment> | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page), pageSize: String(PAGE_SIZE) });
    if (search) params.set('search', search);
    if (type) params.set('type', type);
    if (status) params.set('status', status);
    try {
      setData(await api<Page<Punishment>>(`/punishments?${params}`));
      setError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`));
    }
  }, [page, search, type, status, t]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setTimeout(() => {
      setPage(1);
      setSearch(query.trim());
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [query]);
  useLiveRefresh(['punishment.changed'], load);

  const pages = data ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(data.total / PAGE_SIZE)) : 1;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={t('moderation.title')}
        subtitle={t('moderation.subtitle')}
        actions={
          issuable.length > 0 && (
            <PunishDialog
              onIssued={load}
              trigger={
                <Button>
                  <Gavel aria-hidden /> {t('moderation.newPunishment')}
                </Button>
              }
            />
          )
        }
      />
      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <label className="relative min-w-64 flex-1">
          <span className="sr-only">{t('moderation.search')}</span>
          <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
          <Input className="pl-9" placeholder={t('moderation.search')} value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} maxLength={64} />
        </label>
        <Select aria-label={t('moderation.type')} className="w-48" value={type} onChange={(e) => { setPage(1); setType(e.target.value as PunishmentType | ''); }}>
          <option value="">{t('moderation.allTypes')}</option>
          {TYPES.map((ty) => (
            <option key={ty} value={ty}>
              {t(`moderation.types.${ty}`)}
            </option>
          ))}
        </Select>
        <Select aria-label={t('moderation.status')} className="w-44" value={status} onChange={(e) => { setPage(1); setStatus(e.target.value as typeof status); }}>
          <option value="">{t('moderation.allStatuses')}</option>
          <option value="active">{t('moderation.filter.active')}</option>
          <option value="expired">{t('moderation.filter.expired')}</option>
          <option value="revoked">{t('moderation.filter.revoked')}</option>
        </Select>
      </div>
      {error && <Alert variant="destructive" className="mb-4">{error}</Alert>}
      <Card>
        {!data ? (
          <div className="grid gap-2 p-5">
            {Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => (
              <Skeleton key={i} className="h-12" />
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : data.items.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="p-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('moderation.empty')}</p>
        ) : (
          <PunishmentTable items={data.items} showTarget onChange={load} />
        )}
      </Card>
      {data && pages > 1 && (
        <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-end gap-3 text-sm">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={page <= 1} onClick={() => setPage(page - 1)}>
            {t('common.previous')}
          </Button>
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t('common.page', { page, pages })}</span>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={page >= pages} onClick={() => setPage(page + 1)}>
            {t('common.next')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { Ban, Gamepad2, LogIn, MicOff, ShieldAlert, Trophy, UserPlus, Users } from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useFormatter, useNow, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/app-shell';
import { useLiveRefresh } from '@/components/realtime-provider';
import { ServerCard } from '@/components/server-card';
import { Alert, Button, buttonVariants, Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/primitives';
import { api, type DashboardSummary, errorKey } from '@/lib/api';

function Stat({ label, value, icon: Icon, hint }: { label: string; value: string; icon: typeof Users; hint?: string }) {
  return (
    <Card className="p-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        {label}
        <Icon className="size-4" aria-hidden />
      </div>
      <div className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold tabular-nums">{value}</div>
      {hint && <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{hint}</div>}
    </Card>
  );
}

export default function DashboardPage() {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 30_000 });
  const [data, setData] = useState<DashboardSummary | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setData(await api<DashboardSummary>('/dashboard/summary'));
      setError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`));
    }
  }, [t]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);
  // Server-Sent Events push changes; a slow poll covers counters without events (e.g. punishments).
  useLiveRefresh(['server.updated', 'server.removed', 'player.online', 'player.offline', 'punishment.changed', 'anticheat.event'], load, 60_000);

  const n = (v: number) => format.number(v);

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title={t('dashboard.title')} subtitle={t('dashboard.subtitle')} />
      {error && (
        <Alert variant="destructive" className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          {error}
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => void load()}>
            {t('common.retry')}
          </Button>
        </Alert>
      )}

      {!data ? (
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          {Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => (
            <Skeleton key={i} className="h-28" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
            <Stat label={t('dashboard.onlinePlayers')} value={n(data.onlinePlayers)} icon={Gamepad2} />
            <Stat label={t('dashboard.totalPlayers')} value={n(data.totalPlayers)} icon={Users} />
            <Stat label={t('dashboard.newPlayersToday')} value={n(data.newPlayersToday)} icon={UserPlus} />
            <Stat label={t('dashboard.connectionsToday')} value={n(data.connectionsToday)} icon={LogIn} />
            <Stat
              label={t('dashboard.playerRecord')}
              value={data.playerRecord ? n(data.playerRecord.count) : '–'}
              hint={data.playerRecord ? format.dateTime(new Date(data.playerRecord.at), { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }) : t('dashboard.notRecorded')}
              icon={Trophy}
            />
            <Stat label={t('dashboard.activeBans')} value={n(data.activeBans)} icon={Ban} />
            <Stat label={t('dashboard.activeMutes')} value={n(data.activeMutes)} icon={MicOff} />
            <Stat label={t('dashboard.anticheatToday')} value={n(data.anticheatToday)} icon={ShieldAlert} />
          </div>

          <div className="mt-6 grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-3">
            {data.servers && (
              <Card className="xl:col-span-2">
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle>{t('dashboard.servers')}</CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  {data.servers.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-dashed p-8 text-center">
                      <p className="font-medium">{t('dashboard.serversEmpty')}</p>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('dashboard.serversEmptyHint')}</p>
                      <Link href="/settings" className={buttonVariants({ variant: 'outline', className: 'mt-4' })}>
                        {t('nav.settings')}
                      </Link>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                      {data.servers.map((s) => (
                        <ServerCard key={s.id} server={s} href={`/servers/${s.id}`} />
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}
            {data.recentActivity && (
              <Card>
                <CardHeader>
                  <CardTitle>{t('dashboard.recentActivity')}</CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent>
                  {data.recentActivity.length === 0 ? (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('dashboard.recentActivityEmpty')}</p>
                  ) : (
                    <ul className="grid gap-3">
                      {data.recentActivity.map((a) => (
                        <li key={a.id} className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 text-sm">
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="truncate font-mono text-xs">{a.action}</div>
                            <div className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{a.actorName}</div>
                          </div>
                          <time className="shrink-0 text-xs text-muted-foreground" dateTime={a.createdAt}>
                            {format.relativeTime(new Date(a.createdAt), now)}
                          </time>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  )}
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { ArrowLeft, Check, Copy } from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useParams, usePathname, useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { useFormatter, useLocale, useNow, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { type ReactNode, Suspense, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { AntiCheatEvents } from '@/components/anticheat-events';
import { useAuth } from '@/components/auth-provider';
import { InventoryEditor } from '@/components/inventory-editor';
import { PlayerActivity } from '@/components/player-activity';
import { PlayerConnections } from '@/components/player-connections';
import { PlayerModeration, PlayerNotes } from '@/components/player-moderation';
import { PlayerStatistics } from '@/components/player-statistics';
import { PlayerHead, SkinViewer } from '@/components/player-skin';
import { useLiveRefresh } from '@/components/realtime-provider';
import { Alert, Badge, Button, Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, Skeleton, StatusDot } from '@/components/ui/primitives';
import { TBody, TD, TH, THead, TR, Table } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { api, ApiError, errorKey, type PlayerProfile } from '@/lib/api';
import { useDuration } from '@/lib/format';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const GAMEMODES = ['SURVIVAL', 'CREATIVE', 'ADVENTURE', 'SPECTATOR'] as const;
type Gamemode = (typeof GAMEMODES)[number];

const TABS = ['overview', 'statistics', 'inventory', 'enderChest', 'moderation', 'connections', 'activity', 'notes'] as const;
type Tab = (typeof TABS)[number];

function Fact({ label, children }: { label: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border px-4 py-3">
      <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="mt-1 font-medium">{children}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

function ProfileContent() {
  const { uuid } = useParams<{ uuid: string }>();
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useFormatter();
  const locale = useLocale();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 30_000 });
  const duration = useDuration();
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const { can } = useAuth();
  const [player, setPlayer] = useState<PlayerProfile | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const visible = TABS.filter((tab) => (tab === 'moderation' ? can(PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_HISTORY) : tab === 'notes' ? can(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_NOTES) : tab === 'statistics' ? can(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW_STATISTICS) : tab === 'inventory' || tab === 'enderChest' ? can(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW_INVENTORY) : true));
  const requested = params.get('tab') as Tab | null;
  const tab: Tab = requested && visible.includes(requested) ? requested : 'overview';

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setPlayer(await api<PlayerProfile>(`/players/${encodeURIComponent(uuid)}`));
      setError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 404 ? t('profile.notFound') : t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`));
    }
  }, [uuid, t]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);
  useLiveRefresh(['player.online', 'player.offline', 'player.updated'], load, 60_000);

  const date = (iso: string) => format.dateTime(new Date(iso), { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' });
  const notCollected = <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t('profile.notCollected')}</span>;

  return (
    <>
      <Link href="/players" className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">
        <ArrowLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden /> {t('profile.backToList')}
      </Link>
      {error && <Alert variant="destructive">{error}</Alert>}
      {!player && !error && <Skeleton className="h-64" />}

      {player && (
        <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-6 [&>*]:min-w-0">
          <Card className="overflow-hidden">
            <div className="bg-blocks flex flex-wrap items-center gap-6 px-6 py-2">
              <SkinViewer uuid={player.uuid} model={player.skinModel} className="mx-auto sm:mx-0" />
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 py-4">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                  <PlayerHead uuid={player.uuid} username={player.username} size={40} />
                  <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{player.username}</h1>
                  <Badge variant={player.online ? 'default' : 'muted'}>
                    <StatusDot state={player.online ? 'up' : 'down'} /> {player.online ? t('common.online') : t('common.offline')}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {player.uuid}
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="icon"
                    className="size-7"
                    title={t('profile.copyUuid')}
                    onClick={() => {
                      void navigator.clipboard.writeText(player.uuid);
                      setCopied(true);
                      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500);
                    }}
                  >
                    {copied ? <Check aria-hidden /> : <Copy aria-hidden />}
                    <span className="sr-only">{t('profile.copyUuid')}</span>
                  </Button>
                </div>
                <dl className="mt-5 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                  <Fact label={t('profile.currentServer')}>{player.online ? (player.currentServer?.name ?? t('common.unknown')) : '–'}</Fact>
                  <Fact label={t('players.lastSeen')}>{player.online ? t('common.online') : format.relativeTime(new Date(player.lastSeenAt), now)}</Fact>
                  <Fact label={t('players.playtime')}>{duration(player.totalPlaytimeSeconds)}</Fact>
                  <Fact label={t('players.connections')}>{format.number(player.connectionCount)}</Fact>
                </dl>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Card>

          <nav aria-label={player.username} className="-mb-2 flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b [scrollbar-width:none]">
            {visible.map((key) => (
              <button
                key={key}
                type="button"
                aria-current={tab === key ? 'page' : undefined}
                onClick={() => router.replace(`${pathname}${key === 'overview' ? '' : `?tab=${key}`}`, { scroll: false })}
                className={cn(
                  '-mb-px shrink-0 border-b-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground',
                  tab === key ? 'border-primary font-medium text-foreground' : 'border-transparent',
                )}
              >
                {t(`profileTabs.${key}`)}
              </button>
            ))}
          </nav>

          {tab === 'overview' && (
            <>
              <Card>
                <CardContent className="pt-5">
                  <dl className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
                    <Fact label={t('players.firstSeen')}>{date(player.firstSeenAt)}</Fact>
                    <Fact label={t('profile.activePlaytime')}>{player.activePlaytimeSeconds === null ? notCollected : duration(player.activePlaytimeSeconds)}</Fact>
                    <Fact label={t('profile.afkTime')}>{player.afkSeconds === null ? notCollected : duration(player.afkSeconds)}</Fact>
                    <Fact label={t('profile.gamemode')}>
                      {player.gamemode && GAMEMODES.includes(player.gamemode as Gamemode) ? t(`profile.gamemodes.${player.gamemode as Gamemode}`) : (player.gamemode ?? notCollected)}
                    </Fact>
                    <Fact label={t('profile.clientVersion')}>{player.clientVersion ?? notCollected}</Fact>
                    <Fact label={t('profile.clientBrand')}>{player.clientBrand ?? notCollected}</Fact>
                  </dl>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>

              <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3 [&>*]:min-w-0">
                <Card>
                  <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle>{t('profile.nameHistory')}</CardTitle>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent>
                    <ol className="grid gap-2">
                      {player.names.map((n) => (
                        <li key={n.username} className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md border px-3 py-2 text-sm">
                          <span className="font-medium">{n.username}</span>
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{format.dateTime(new Date(n.firstSeenAt), { dateStyle: 'medium' })}</span>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ol>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>

                <Card className="lg:col-span-2">
                  <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle>{t('profile.recentSessions')}</CardTitle>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent className="px-0">
                    <Table>
                      <THead>
                        <TR>
                          <TH>{t('profile.started')}</TH>
                          <TH>{t('profile.duration')}</TH>
                          <TH>{t('profile.servers')}</TH>
                        </TR>
                      </THead>
                      <TBody>
                        {player.sessions.map((s) => (
                          <TR key={s.id}>
                            <TD className="whitespace-nowrap">{date(s.startedAt)}</TD>
                            <TD className="whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums">{s.endedAt ? duration(s.durationSeconds ?? 0) : <Badge>{t('profile.ongoing')}</Badge>}</TD>
                            <TD className="text-muted-foreground">{s.servers.map((v) => v.server.name).join(' → ') || '–'}</TD>
                          </TR>
                        ))}
                      </TBody>
                    </Table>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {tab === 'moderation' && <PlayerModeration uuid={player.uuid} username={player.username} />}
          {tab === 'moderation' && can(PERMISSIONS.ANTICHEAT_VIEW) && (
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle>{t('anticheat.title')}</CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="px-0">
                <AntiCheatEvents endpoint={`/players/${player.uuid}/anticheat`} showPlayer={false} />
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}
          {tab === 'connections' && <PlayerConnections uuid={player.uuid} locale={locale} />}
          {tab === 'activity' && <PlayerActivity uuid={player.uuid} />}
          {tab === 'statistics' && <PlayerStatistics uuid={player.uuid} />}
          {tab === 'inventory' && <InventoryEditor key="inventory" uuid={player.uuid} kind="inventory" />}
          {tab === 'enderChest' && <InventoryEditor key="ender-chest" uuid={player.uuid} kind="ender-chest" />}
          {tab === 'notes' && <PlayerNotes uuid={player.uuid} />}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

export default function PlayerProfilePage() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<Skeleton className="h-64" />}>
      <ProfileContent />
    </Suspense>
```
