```tsx
'use client';

import { PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { ArrowLeft, Check, Copy, KeyRound, Power, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useFormatter, useLocale, useNow, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { type FormEvent, type ReactNode, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '@/components/auth-provider';
import { ConfirmDialog } from '@/components/confirm-dialog';
import { useLiveRefresh } from '@/components/realtime-provider';
import { useToast } from '@/components/toaster';
import { Alert, Badge, Button, Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, Field, Input, Skeleton, StatusDot } from '@/components/ui/primitives';
import { TBody, TD, TH, THead, TR, Table } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { api, errorKey, type RotatedCredentials, type ServerDetail } from '@/lib/api';
import { formatBytes } from '@/lib/utils';

function Fact({ label, children }: { label: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border px-4 py-3">
      <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="mt-1 font-medium">{children}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function ServerDetailPage() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useFormatter();
  const locale = useLocale();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 15_000 });
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { can } = useAuth();
  const canManage = can(PERMISSIONS.SERVERS_MANAGE);
  const [server, setServer] = useState<ServerDetail | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [rotated, setRotated] = useState<RotatedCredentials | null>(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const detail = await api<ServerDetail>(`/servers/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
      setServer(detail);
      setName((current) => current || detail.name);
      setError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`));
    }
  }, [id, t]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);
  useLiveRefresh(['server.updated', 'player.online', 'player.offline'], load, 30_000);

  async function run(action: () => Promise<unknown>, success?: string) {
    try {
      await action();
      if (success) toast(success);
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`), 'error');
    }
  }

  async function rename(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    await run(() => api(`/servers/${id}`, { method: 'PATCH', body: { name } }), t('settings.saved'));
  }

  if (error) return <Alert variant="destructive">{error}</Alert>;
  if (!server) return <Skeleton className="h-72" />;

  const credentialsFile = rotated
    ? `key-id=${rotated.keyId}\nsecret=${rotated.secret}\nserver-id=${rotated.serverId}\nserver-name=${rotated.serverName}\n`
    : '';
  const state = server.status === 'ONLINE' ? 'up' : server.status === 'PENDING' ? 'pending' : 'down';

  return (
    <>
      <Link href="/servers" className="mb-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">
        <ArrowLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden /> {t('servers.title')}
      </Link>

      <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{server.name}</h1>
        <Badge variant={server.type === 'VELOCITY' ? 'info' : 'default'}>{server.type === 'VELOCITY' ? 'Velocity' : 'Paper'}</Badge>
        <Badge variant={state === 'up' ? 'default' : state === 'pending' ? 'warning' : 'muted'}>
          <StatusDot state={state} /> {t(`servers.status.${server.status}`)}
        </Badge>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6">
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="pt-5">
            <dl className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
              <Fact label={t('servers.heartbeat')}>{server.lastHeartbeatAt ? format.relativeTime(new Date(server.lastHeartbeatAt), now) : t('common.never')}</Fact>
              <Fact label={server.type === 'VELOCITY' ? t('servers.openSessions') : t('servers.connectedPlayers')}>
                {format.number(server.type === 'VELOCITY' ? server.openProxySessions : server.connectedPlayers)}
              </Fact>
              <Fact label="TPS">{server.tps === null ? '–' : format.number(server.tps, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</Fact>
              <Fact label="MSPT">{server.mspt === null ? '–' : format.number(server.mspt, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</Fact>
              <Fact label="RAM">
                {server.memoryUsedBytes && server.memoryMaxBytes ? `${formatBytes(server.memoryUsedBytes, locale)} / ${formatBytes(server.memoryMaxBytes, locale)}` : '–'}
              </Fact>
              <Fact label="CPU">{server.cpuLoad === null ? '–' : format.number(server.cpuLoad, { style: 'percent', maximumFractionDigits: 0 })}</Fact>
              <Fact label={t('servers.version')}>{server.minecraftVersion ?? '–'}</Fact>
              <Fact label={t('servers.plugin')}>{server.pluginVersion ?? '–'}</Fact>
            </dl>
            {server.platformVersion && <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t('servers.platform')}: {server.platformVersion}</p>}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {canManage && (
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>{t('common.actions')}</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>{server.type === 'PAPER' ? t('servers.nameHint') : t('servers.disabledHint')}</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="grid gap-5">
              <form onSubmit={rename} className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3">
                <div className="min-w-64 flex-1">
                  <Field label={t('servers.name')} htmlFor="srv-name">
                    <Input id="srv-name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} pattern="[A-Za-z0-9_.\-]+" minLength={2} maxLength={64} required />
                  </Field>
                </div>
                <Button type="submit" variant="outline" disabled={name === server.name}>
                  {t('servers.rename')}
                </Button>
              </form>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => void run(() => api(`/servers/${id}`, { method: 'PATCH', body: { enabled: !server.enabled } }), t('settings.saved'))}>
                  <Power aria-hidden /> {server.enabled ? t('servers.disable') : t('servers.enable')}
                </Button>
                <ConfirmDialog
                  trigger={
                    <Button variant="outline">
                      <KeyRound aria-hidden /> {t('servers.rotate')}
                    </Button>
                  }
                  title={t('servers.rotate')}
                  description={t('servers.rotateConfirm')}
                  confirmLabel={t('servers.rotate')}
                  onConfirm={() => run(async () => setRotated(await api<RotatedCredentials>(`/servers/${id}/credentials/rotate`, { method: 'POST' })))}
                />
                <ConfirmDialog
                  trigger={<Button variant="outline">{t('servers.revoke')}</Button>}
                  title={t('servers.revoke')}
                  description={t('servers.revokeConfirm')}
                  confirmLabel={t('servers.revoke')}
                  destructive
                  onConfirm={() => run(() => api(`/servers/${id}/credentials/revoke`, { method: 'POST' }), t('settings.saved'))}
                />
                <ConfirmDialog
                  trigger={
                    <Button variant="destructive">
                      <Trash2 aria-hidden /> {t('servers.remove')}
                    </Button>
                  }
                  title={t('servers.remove')}
                  description={t('servers.removeConfirm', { server: server.name })}
                  confirmLabel={t('common.delete')}
                  destructive
                  onConfirm={async () => {
                    try {
                      await api(`/servers/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
                      toast(t('servers.removed', { server: server.name }));
                      router.replace('/servers');
                    } catch (err) {
                      toast(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`), 'error');
                    }
                  }}
                />
              </div>

              {rotated && (
                <Alert variant="success" className="grid gap-2">
                  <span>{t('servers.rotated', { server: rotated.serverName })}</span>
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                    <pre className="flex-1 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border bg-background p-3 font-mono text-xs text-foreground">{credentialsFile}</pre>
                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => {
                        void navigator.clipboard.writeText(credentialsFile);
                        setCopied(true);
                        setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
                      }}
                    >
                      {copied ? <Check aria-hidden /> : <Copy aria-hidden />}
                      {copied ? t('common.copied') : t('common.copy')}
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </Alert>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{t('servers.credentials')}</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="px-0">
            <Table>
              <THead>
                <TR>
                  <TH>{t('servers.keyId')}</TH>
                  <TH>{t('common.status')}</TH>
                  <TH>{t('servers.created')}</TH>
                  <TH>{t('servers.lastUsed')}</TH>
                </TR>
              </THead>
              <TBody>
                {server.credentials.map((c) => (
                  <TR key={c.id}>
                    <TD className="font-mono text-xs">{c.keyId}</TD>
                    <TD>{c.revokedAt ? <Badge variant="muted">{t('servers.revoked')}</Badge> : <Badge>{t('servers.active')}</Badge>}</TD>
                    <TD className="text-muted-foreground">{format.dateTime(new Date(c.createdAt), { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' })}</TD>
                    <TD className="text-muted-foreground">{c.lastUsedAt ? format.relativeTime(new Date(c.lastUsedAt), now) : t('common.never')}</TD>
                  </TR>
                ))}
              </TBody>
            </Table>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/app-shell';
import { useLiveRefresh } from '@/components/realtime-provider';
import { ServerCard } from '@/components/server-card';
import { Alert, buttonVariants, Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/primitives';
import { api, errorKey, type ServerInfo } from '@/lib/api';

export default function ServersPage() {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const [servers, setServers] = useState<ServerInfo[] | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setServers(await api<ServerInfo[]>('/servers'));
      setError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`));
    }
  }, [t]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);
  useLiveRefresh(['server.updated', 'server.removed', 'player.online', 'player.offline'], load);

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title={t('servers.title')} subtitle={t('servers.subtitle')} />
      {error && <Alert variant="destructive">{error}</Alert>}
      {!servers && !error && (
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
          <Skeleton className="h-40" />
          <Skeleton className="h-40" />
        </div>
      )}
      {servers && servers.length === 0 && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-dashed p-10 text-center">
          <p className="font-medium">{t('dashboard.serversEmpty')}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('dashboard.serversEmptyHint')}</p>
          <Link href="/settings" className={buttonVariants({ variant: 'outline', className: 'mt-4' })}>
            {t('nav.settings')}
          </Link>
        </div>
      )}
      {servers && servers.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
          {servers.map((s) => (
            <ServerCard key={s.id} server={s} href={`/servers/${s.id}`} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/app/(app)/settings/page.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { usePathname, useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { type FormEvent, Suspense, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/app-shell';
import { useAuth } from '@/components/auth-provider';
import { LanguagesManager } from '@/components/languages-manager';
import { MinecraftIntegration } from '@/components/minecraft-integration';
import { ModerationPresets } from '@/components/moderation-presets';
import { PluginSettingsEditor } from '@/components/plugin-settings-editor';
import { LanguageSwitcher, ThemeToggle } from '@/components/preference-controls';
import { useToast } from '@/components/toaster';
import { Button, Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, Field, Input, Label, Select, Skeleton, Textarea } from '@/components/ui/primitives';
import { api, errorKey } from '@/lib/api';
import { browserTimeZone, storeTimeZone } from '@/lib/preferences';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const SECTIONS = [
  { key: 'general', permission: null },
  { key: 'minecraft', permission: PERMISSIONS.SERVERS_MANAGE },
  { key: 'plugins', permission: PERMISSIONS.SETTINGS_MANAGE },
  { key: 'moderation', permission: PERMISSIONS.SETTINGS_MANAGE },
  { key: 'languages', permission: PERMISSIONS.TRANSLATIONS_MANAGE },
  { key: 'privacy', permission: PERMISSIONS.SETTINGS_MANAGE },
] as const;
type Section = (typeof SECTIONS)[number]['key'];

export default function SettingsPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<Skeleton className="h-64" />}>
      <Settings />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

function Settings() {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const { can } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const visible = SECTIONS.filter((s) => s.permission === null || can(s.permission)).map((s) => s.key);
  const requested = params.get('section') as Section | null;
  const section: Section = requested && visible.includes(requested) ? requested : 'general';

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title={t('settings.title')} subtitle={t('settings.subtitle')} />
      <nav aria-label={t('settings.title')} className="mb-6 flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b [scrollbar-width:none]">
        {visible.map((key) => (
          <button
            key={key}
            type="button"
            aria-current={section === key ? 'page' : undefined}
            onClick={() => router.replace(`${pathname}${key === 'general' ? '' : `?section=${key}`}`, { scroll: false })}
            className={cn(
              '-mb-px shrink-0 border-b-2 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground',
              section === key ? 'border-primary font-medium text-foreground' : 'border-transparent',
            )}
          >
            {t(`settings.sections.${key}`)}
          </button>
        ))}
      </nav>
      <div className="grid gap-6">
        {section === 'general' && (
          <>
            <PreferencesCard />
            {can(PERMISSIONS.SETTINGS_MANAGE) && <NetworkCard />}
          </>
        )}
        {section === 'minecraft' && <MinecraftIntegration />}
        {section === 'plugins' && <PluginSettingsEditor />}
        {section === 'moderation' && <ModerationPresets />}
        {section === 'languages' && <LanguagesManager />}
        {section === 'privacy' && <PrivacyCard />}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

function PreferencesCard() {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const toast = useToast();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [timezone, setTimezone] = useState(user.timezone ?? browserTimeZone());
  const zones = useMemo(() => (typeof Intl.supportedValuesOf === 'function' ? Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone') : ['UTC']), []);

  async function saveTimezone(next: string) {
    setTimezone(next);
    try {
      await api('/auth/me', { method: 'PATCH', body: { timezone: next } });
      if (storeTimeZone(next)) router.refresh();
      toast(t('settings.saved'));
    } catch (err) {
      toast(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`), 'error');
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t('settings.preferences')}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t('settings.preferencesDescription')}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <div className="grid gap-1.5">
          <Label>{t('settings.language')}</Label>
          <LanguageSwitcher persist className="w-full [&_select]:w-full" />
        </div>
        <div className="grid gap-1.5">
          <Label>{t('settings.theme')}</Label>
          <ThemeToggle persist />
        </div>
        <Field label={t('settings.timezone')} htmlFor="pref-tz">
          <Select id="pref-tz" value={timezone} onChange={(e) => void saveTimezone(e.target.value)}>
            {zones.map((z) => (
              <option key={z} value={z}>
                {z}
              </option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </Field>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

interface NetworkSettings {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  minecraftDomain: string;
  dashboardUrl: string;
  defaultTimezone: string;
  defaultTheme: 'dark' | 'light' | 'system';
}

function NetworkCard() {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [form, setForm] = useState<NetworkSettings | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    api<NetworkSettings>('/settings/network').then(setForm).catch(() => undefined);
  }, []);

  async function save(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      setForm(await api<NetworkSettings>('/settings/network', { method: 'PATCH', body: form }));
      toast(t('settings.saved'));
    } catch (err) {
      toast(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`), 'error');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  if (!form) return null;
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t('settings.network')}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t('settings.networkDescription')}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <form onSubmit={save} className="grid gap-4">
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <Field label={t('setup.network.name')} htmlFor="n-name">
              <Input id="n-name" value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })} maxLength={64} required />
            </Field>
            <Field label={t('setup.network.domain')} htmlFor="n-domain">
              <Input id="n-domain" value={form.minecraftDomain} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, minecraftDomain: e.target.value })} />
            </Field>
          </div>
          <Field label={t('setup.network.description')} htmlFor="n-desc">
            <Textarea id="n-desc" value={form.description} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })} maxLength={500} />
          </Field>
          <Field label={t('setup.network.dashboardUrl')} htmlFor="n-url">
            <Input id="n-url" type="url" value={form.dashboardUrl} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, dashboardUrl: e.target.value })} />
          </Field>
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <Button type="submit" disabled={busy}>
              {busy ? t('common.saving') : t('common.save')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

const RETENTION_OPTIONS = [30, 90, 180, 365, 730] as const;

function PrivacyCard() {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [days, setDays] = useState<number | null | undefined>(undefined);

  useEffect(() => {
    api<{ ipRetentionDays: number | null }>('/settings/privacy').then((p) => setDays(p.ipRetentionDays)).catch(() => undefined);
  }, []);

  async function save(next: number | null) {
    setDays(next);
    try {
      await api('/settings/privacy', { method: 'PATCH', body: { ipRetentionDays: next } });
      toast(t('settings.saved'));
    } catch (err) {
      toast(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`), 'error');
    }
  }

  if (days === undefined) return null;
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t('privacy.title')}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t('privacy.description')}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <Field label={t('privacy.ipRetention')} hint={t('privacy.ipRetentionHint')} htmlFor="ip-retention">
          <Select id="ip-retention" className="max-w-xs" value={days === null ? 'forever' : String(days)} onChange={(e) => void save(e.target.value === 'forever' ? null : Number(e.target.value))}>
            {[...new Set([...RETENTION_OPTIONS, ...(days === null ? [] : [days])])].sort((a, b) => a - b).map((d) => (
              <option key={d} value={d}>
                {t('privacy.days', { count: d })}
              </option>
            ))}
            <option value="forever">{t('privacy.keepForever')}</option>
          </Select>
        </Field>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { LEADERBOARD_STATS, STATS, type StatKey } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useFormatter, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/app-shell';
import { PlayerHead } from '@/components/player-skin';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, Select, Skeleton, StatusDot } from '@/components/ui/primitives';
import { TBody, TD, TH, THead, TR, Table } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { api } from '@/lib/api';
import { STAT_NAME, useStatFormatter } from '@/lib/stats';

interface Overview {
  trackedPlayers: number;
  coverageStart: string | null;
  totals: Partial<Record<StatKey, number>>;
}

interface LeaderboardEntry {
  rank: number;
  player: { uuid: string; username: string; online: boolean };
  value: number;
}

const HEADLINE: StatKey[] = [STATS.ACTIVE_TIME, STATS.BLOCKS_MINED, STATS.BLOCKS_PLACED, STATS.MOB_KILLS, STATS.PLAYER_KILLS, STATS.DEATHS, STATS.WALK, STATS.CHAT_MESSAGES];

export default function StatisticsPage() {
  const t = useTranslations('stats');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const formatStat = useStatFormatter();
  const [overview, setOverview] = useState<Overview | null>(null);
  const [stat, setStat] = useState<StatKey>(STATS.ACTIVE_TIME);
  const [board, setBoard] = useState<LeaderboardEntry[] | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    void api<Overview>('/statistics/overview').then(setOverview).catch(() => undefined);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    setBoard(null);
    void api<LeaderboardEntry[]>(`/statistics/leaderboard?stat=${encodeURIComponent(stat)}&limit=25`).then(setBoard).catch(() => setBoard([]));
  }, [stat]);

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title={t('title')} subtitle={t('subtitle')} />
      {!overview ? (
        <Skeleton className="h-40" />
      ) : overview.trackedPlayers === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed p-10 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('networkNoData')}</div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-6 [&>*]:min-w-0">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>{t('networkTotals')}</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                {t('trackedPlayers')}: {format.number(overview.trackedPlayers)}
                {overview.coverageStart && ` · ${t('collectedSince', { date: format.dateTime(new Date(overview.coverageStart), { dateStyle: 'medium' }) })}`}
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <dl className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                {HEADLINE.map((k) => (
                  <div key={k} className="rounded-lg border px-4 py-3">
                    <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t(`labels.${STAT_NAME[k]}`)}</dt>
                    <dd className="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums">{overview.totals[k] === undefined ? t('notCollected') : formatStat(k, overview.totals[k]!)}</dd>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </dl>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card>
            <CardHeader className="flex-row flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <CardTitle>{t('leaderboard')}</CardTitle>
              <Select aria-label={t('leaderboard')} className="w-60" value={stat} onChange={(e) => setStat(e.target.value as StatKey)}>
                {LEADERBOARD_STATS.map((k) => (
                  <option key={k} value={k}>
                    {t(`labels.${STAT_NAME[k]}`)}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="px-0">
              {!board ? (
                <Skeleton className="mx-5 h-40" />
              ) : board.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="px-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('emptyList')}</p>
              ) : (
                <Table>
                  <THead>
                    <TR>
                      <TH className="w-16">{t('rank')}</TH>
                      <TH>{t('player')}</TH>
                      <TH className="text-right">{t('value')}</TH>
                    </TR>
                  </THead>
                  <TBody>
                    {board.map((e) => (
                      <TR key={e.player.uuid}>
                        <TD className="font-semibold tabular-nums">#{e.rank}</TD>
                        <TD>
                          <Link href={`/players/${e.player.uuid}?tab=statistics`} className="flex items-center gap-3 hover:underline">
                            <PlayerHead uuid={e.player.uuid} username={e.player.username} size={28} />
                            <span className="font-medium">{e.player.username}</span>
                            <StatusDot state={e.player.online ? 'up' : 'down'} />
                          </Link>
                        </TD>
                        <TD className="text-right tabular-nums">{formatStat(stat, e.value)}</TD>
                      </TR>
                    ))}
                  </TBody>
                </Table>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/app/(app)/users/page.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { ALL_PERMISSIONS, PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { useFormatter, useNow, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { type FormEvent, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/app-shell';
import { useAuth } from '@/components/auth-provider';
import { useToast } from '@/components/toaster';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTrigger } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Alert, Badge, Button, Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, Field, Input, Select, Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/primitives';
import { TBody, TD, TH, THead, TR, Table } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { api, errorKey, type Page } from '@/lib/api';
import { useRoleName } from '@/lib/use-role-name';

interface UserRow {
  id: string;
  username: string;
  email: string;
  disabled: boolean;
  lastLoginAt: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  role: { id: string; key: string; name: string; priority: number };
}

interface Role {
  id: string;
  key: string;
  name: string;
  priority: number;
  isSystem: boolean;
  userCount: number;
  permissions: string[];
}

export default function UsersPage() {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 30_000 });
  const toast = useToast();
  const { user: me, can } = useAuth();
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<UserRow[] | null>(null);
  const [roles, setRoles] = useState<Role[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ username: '', email: '', password: '', roleId: '' });
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const canManage = can(PERMISSIONS.USERS_MANAGE);
  const roleName = useRoleName();

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const [u, r] = await Promise.all([api<Page<UserRow>>('/users?pageSize=100'), api<Role[]>('/roles')]);
      setUsers(u.items);
      setRoles(r);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`));
    }
  }, [t]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  // Roles the current user may assign (strictly lower priority, Owner may assign all).
  const assignable = roles.filter((r) => me.roleKey === 'owner' || r.priority < me.rolePriority);

  async function createUser(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFormError(null);
    try {
      await api('/users', { method: 'POST', body: form });
      toast(t('users.created', { username: form.username }));
      setOpen(false);
      setForm({ username: '', email: '', password: '', roleId: '' });
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`));
    }
  }

  async function update(u: UserRow, body: Record<string, unknown>) {
    try {
      await api(`/users/${u.id}`, { method: 'PATCH', body });
      toast(t('users.updated', { username: u.username }));
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`), 'error');
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={t('users.title')}
        subtitle={users ? `${t('users.subtitle')} ${t('users.count', { count: users.length })}` : t('users.subtitle')}
        actions={
          canManage && (
            <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
              <DialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button>
                  <Plus aria-hidden /> {t('users.create')}
                </Button>
              </DialogTrigger>
              <DialogContent title={t('users.create')} closeLabel={t('common.close')}>
                <form onSubmit={createUser} className="grid gap-4">
                  {formError && <Alert variant="destructive">{formError}</Alert>}
                  <Field label={t('users.username')} htmlFor="nu-username">
                    <Input id="nu-username" value={form.username} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, username: e.target.value })} minLength={3} maxLength={32} required />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label={t('users.email')} htmlFor="nu-email">
                    <Input id="nu-email" type="email" value={form.email} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, email: e.target.value })} required />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label={t('users.password')} hint={t('users.passwordHint')} htmlFor="nu-password">
                    <Input id="nu-password" type="password" autoComplete="new-password" value={form.password} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, password: e.target.value })} minLength={12} required />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label={t('users.role')} htmlFor="nu-role">
                    <Select id="nu-role" value={form.roleId} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, roleId: e.target.value })} required>
                      <option value="" disabled>
                        –
                      </option>
                      {assignable.map((r) => (
                        <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                          {roleName(r)}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </Select>
                  </Field>
                  <div className="flex justify-end">
                    <Button type="submit" disabled={!form.roleId || form.password.length < 12}>
                      {t('common.create')}
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </form>
              </DialogContent>
            </Dialog>
          )
        }
      />
      {error && <Alert variant="destructive">{error}</Alert>}

      <Card>
        {!users ? (
          <div className="grid gap-2 p-5">
            <Skeleton className="h-10" />
            <Skeleton className="h-10" />
          </div>
        ) : users.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="p-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('users.empty')}</p>
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <THead>
              <TR>
                <TH>{t('users.username')}</TH>
                <TH>{t('users.email')}</TH>
                <TH>{t('users.role')}</TH>
                <TH>{t('common.status')}</TH>
                <TH>{t('users.lastLogin')}</TH>
                {canManage && <TH className="text-right">{t('common.actions')}</TH>}
              </TR>
            </THead>
            <TBody>
              {users.map((u) => {
                const manageable = canManage && u.id !== me.id && (me.roleKey === 'owner' || u.role.priority < me.rolePriority);
                return (
                  <TR key={u.id}>
                    <TD className="font-medium">{u.username}</TD>
                    <TD className="text-muted-foreground">{u.email}</TD>
                    <TD>
                      {manageable ? (
                        <Select aria-label={t('users.role')} className="h-8 w-40" value={u.role.id} onChange={(e) => void update(u, { roleId: e.target.value })}>
                          {assignable.map((r) => (
                            <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                              {roleName(r)}
                            </option>
                          ))}
                        </Select>
                      ) : (
                        <Badge variant="outline">{roleName(u.role)}</Badge>
                      )}
                    </TD>
                    <TD>{u.disabled ? <Badge variant="danger">{t('users.disabled')}</Badge> : <Badge>{t('users.active')}</Badge>}</TD>
                    <TD className="text-muted-foreground">{u.lastLoginAt ? format.relativeTime(new Date(u.lastLoginAt), now) : t('common.never')}</TD>
                    {canManage && (
                      <TD className="text-right">
                        {manageable && (
                          <Button size="sm" variant={u.disabled ? 'outline' : 'ghost'} onClick={() => void update(u, { disabled: !u.disabled })}>
                            {u.disabled ? t('users.enable') : t('users.disable')}
                          </Button>
                        )}
                      </TD>
                    )}
                  </TR>
                );
              })}
            </TBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </Card>

      <RolesPanel roles={roles} onSaved={load} />
    </>
  );
}

function RolesPanel({ roles, onSaved }: { roles: Role[]; onSaved: () => Promise<void> }) {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { user: me, can } = useAuth();
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const role = roles.find((r) => r.id === selected) ?? roles[0];
  const roleName = useRoleName();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (role) setDraft(new Set(role.permissions));
  }, [role]);

  if (!role) return null;
  const editable = can(PERMISSIONS.ROLES_MANAGE) && role.key !== 'owner' && (me.roleKey === 'owner' || role.priority < me.rolePriority);

  async function save() {
    try {
      await api(`/roles/${role.id}`, { method: 'PATCH', body: { permissions: [...draft] } });
      toast(t('roles.saved', { role: roleName(role) }));
      await onSaved();
    } catch (err) {
      toast(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`), 'error');
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card className="mt-6">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t('roles.title')}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t('roles.subtitle')}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-[220px_1fr]">
        <ul className="grid content-start gap-1">
          {roles.map((r) => (
            <li key={r.id}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelected(r.id)}
                className={`flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm hover:bg-accent ${r.id === role.id ? 'bg-accent font-medium' : ''}`}
              >
                <span>{roleName(r)}</span>
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t('roles.users', { count: r.userCount })}</span>
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        <div>
          {role.key === 'owner' ? (
            <Alert>{t('roles.ownerLocked')}</Alert>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {ALL_PERMISSIONS.map((p) => (
                  <label key={p} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md border px-3 py-2 font-mono text-xs">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      className="accent-[var(--primary)]"
                      checked={draft.has(p)}
                      disabled={!editable}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const next = new Set(draft);
                        if (e.target.checked) next.add(p);
                        else next.delete(p);
                        setDraft(next);
                      }}
                    />
                    {p}
                  </label>
                ))}
              </div>
              {editable && (
                <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end">
                  <Button onClick={() => void save()}>{t('common.save')}</Button>
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```ts
import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server';

/**
 * Same-origin proxy from the dashboard to the backend API. Keeps session
 * cookies first-party (SameSite=Strict) and lets the backend URL be configured
 * at runtime via BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL (no rebuild needed).
 */
const BACKEND = (process.env.BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4000').replace(/\/$/, '');

const FORWARD_REQUEST_HEADERS = [
  'accept',
  'accept-language',
  'content-type',
  'cookie',
  'user-agent',
  'x-mnm-csrf',
  'authorization',
  // Plugin request signatures (see apps/backend/src/plugin-api/plugin-signature.ts)
  'x-mnm-key-id',
  'x-mnm-timestamp',
  'x-mnm-nonce',
  'x-mnm-signature',
];
const DROP_RESPONSE_HEADERS = new Set(['content-encoding', 'content-length', 'transfer-encoding', 'connection', 'set-cookie']);

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

async function proxy(req: NextRequest, ctx: { params: Promise<{ path: string[] }> }): Promise<Response> {
  const { path } = await ctx.params;
  const target = `${BACKEND}/api/${path.map(encodeURIComponent).join('/')}${req.nextUrl.search}`;

  const headers = new Headers();
  for (const name of FORWARD_REQUEST_HEADERS) {
    const value = req.headers.get(name);
    if (value) headers.set(name, value);
  }
  // Only the right-most hop is meaningful: it was added by Next.js (socket
  // address) or by the reverse proxy in front of the dashboard. Anything to the
  // left is client-controlled. See docs/installation/https.md.
  const forwardedFor = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for');
  if (forwardedFor) headers.set('x-forwarded-for', forwardedFor.split(',').pop()!.trim());
  const proto = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-proto') ?? req.nextUrl.protocol.replace(':', '');
  headers.set('x-forwarded-proto', proto);
  headers.set('x-forwarded-host', req.headers.get('host') ?? '');

  let upstream: Response;
  try {
    upstream = await fetch(target, {
      method: req.method,
      headers,
      body: ['GET', 'HEAD'].includes(req.method) ? undefined : await req.arrayBuffer(),
      redirect: 'manual',
      cache: 'no-store',
    });
  } catch {
    return Response.json({ statusCode: 502, code: 'BACKEND_UNREACHABLE', message: 'Backend unreachable' }, { status: 502 });
  }

  const responseHeaders = new Headers();
  upstream.headers.forEach((value, key) => {
    if (!DROP_RESPONSE_HEADERS.has(key)) responseHeaders.set(key, value);
  });
  for (const cookie of upstream.headers.getSetCookie()) responseHeaders.append('set-cookie', cookie);

  return new Response(upstream.body, { status: upstream.status, headers: responseHeaders });
}

export { proxy as GET, proxy as POST, proxy as PATCH, proxy as PUT, proxy as DELETE };

```

```tsx
import type { Metadata, Viewport } from 'next';
import { NextIntlClientProvider } from 'next-intl';
import { getLocale, getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Providers } from '@/components/providers';
import './globals.css';

export async function generateMetadata(): Promise<Metadata> {
  const t = await getTranslations('common');
  return { title: { default: t('appName'), template: `%s · ${t('appName')}` }, robots: { index: false, follow: false } };
}

export const viewport: Viewport = {
  themeColor: [
    { media: '(prefers-color-scheme: dark)', color: '#141a17' },
    { media: '(prefers-color-scheme: light)', color: '#f7faf7' },
  ],
};

export default async function RootLayout({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const locale = await getLocale();
  return (
    <html lang={locale} className="dark" suppressHydrationWarning>
      <body className="min-h-dvh">
        <NextIntlClientProvider>
          <Providers>{children}</Providers>
        </NextIntlClientProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/app/login/page.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { type FormEvent, Suspense, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Logo } from '@/components/logo';
import { LanguageSwitcher, ThemeToggle } from '@/components/preference-controls';
import { Alert, Button, Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, Field, Input } from '@/components/ui/primitives';
import { api, ApiError, errorKey, type SetupStatus } from '@/lib/api';

function LoginForm() {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const [identifier, setIdentifier] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [networkName, setNetworkName] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    api<SetupStatus>('/setup/status')
      .then((s) => {
        if (!s.initialized) router.replace('/setup');
        else setNetworkName(s.networkName);
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
  }, [router]);

  async function submit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api('/auth/login', { method: 'POST', body: { identifier, password } });
      const next = params.get('next');
      // Only allow same-site relative redirects.
      router.replace(next && next.startsWith('/') && !next.startsWith('//') ? next : '/');
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 401) setError(t('auth.invalidCredentials'));
      else if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 429) setError(t('auth.rateLimited'));
      else setError(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`));
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <CardHeader className="items-center text-center">
        <Logo className="mb-2 size-12" />
        <CardTitle className="text-xl">{networkName ?? t('common.appName')}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t('auth.subtitle')}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="grid gap-4" noValidate>
          {error && <Alert variant="destructive">{error}</Alert>}
          <Field label={t('auth.identifier')} htmlFor="identifier">
            <Input id="identifier" autoComplete="username" value={identifier} onChange={(e) => setIdentifier(e.target.value)} required autoFocus />
          </Field>
          <Field label={t('auth.password')} htmlFor="password">
            <Input id="password" type="password" autoComplete="current-password" value={password} onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)} required />
          </Field>
          <Button type="submit" disabled={busy || !identifier || !password} className="w-full">
            {busy ? t('auth.submitting') : t('auth.submit')}
          </Button>
        </form>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export default function LoginPage() {
  return (
    <div className="bg-blocks flex min-h-dvh flex-col">
      <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 p-4">
        <LanguageSwitcher persist={false} />
        <ThemeToggle persist={false} />
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center p-4">
        <Suspense>
          <LoginForm />
        </Suspense>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/app/setup/page.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { Check, Copy, Database, KeyRound, Network, PartyPopper, Server, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useFormatter, useNow, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { type FormEvent, type ReactNode, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Logo } from '@/components/logo';
import { LanguageSwitcher, ThemeToggle } from '@/components/preference-controls';
import { Alert, Badge, Button, Card, CardContent, Field, Input, Select, Skeleton, StatusDot, Textarea } from '@/components/ui/primitives';
import { api, ApiError, errorKey, type Language, type RegistrationTokenResult, type SetupStatus } from '@/lib/api';
import { browserTimeZone, storeLocale } from '@/lib/preferences';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const STEPS = ['welcome', 'database', 'owner', 'network', 'velocity', 'finish'] as const;
type Step = (typeof STEPS)[number];
const ICONS: Record<Step, typeof Database> = { welcome: Sparkles, database: Database, owner: KeyRound, network: Network, velocity: Server, finish: PartyPopper };

function StatusRow({ label, up, detail }: { label: string; up: boolean; detail?: ReactNode }) {
  const t = useTranslations('common');
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border px-4 py-3">
      <span className="flex items-center gap-3 text-sm font-medium">
        <StatusDot state={up ? 'up' : 'down'} />
        {label}
      </span>
      <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{detail ?? (up ? t('up') : t('down'))}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function SetupPage() {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 30_000 });
  const router = useRouter();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<SetupStatus | null>(null);
  const [statusError, setStatusError] = useState(false);
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>('welcome');
  const [languages, setLanguages] = useState<Language[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const completed = useRef(false);

  const [owner, setOwner] = useState({ setupCode: '', username: '', email: '', password: '', confirm: '' });
  const [network, setNetwork] = useState({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    minecraftDomain: '',
    dashboardUrl: '',
    defaultLocale: 'en-US',
    defaultTimezone: 'UTC',
    defaultTheme: 'dark' as 'dark' | 'light' | 'system',
  });
  const [proxyName, setProxyName] = useState('proxy');
  const [token, setToken] = useState<RegistrationTokenResult | null>(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const timeZones = useMemo(() => (typeof Intl.supportedValuesOf === 'function' ? Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone') : ['UTC']), []);

  const loadStatus = useCallback(async () => {
    setStatusError(false);
    try {
      const s = await api<SetupStatus>('/setup/status');
      setStatus(s);
      if (s.initialized && !completed.current) router.replace('/login');
    } catch {
      setStatusError(true);
    }
  }, [router]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadStatus();
    api<Language[]>('/i18n/languages').then(setLanguages).catch(() => undefined);
    setNetwork((n) => ({ ...n, defaultTimezone: browserTimeZone(), dashboardUrl: window.location.origin }));
  }, [loadStatus]);

  const index = STEPS.indexOf(step);
  const dbReady = !!status?.database.connected && status.database.pendingMigrations === false;
  const servicesUp = !!status?.database.connected && !!status?.redis.connected;

  const passwordError = owner.password && owner.password.length < 12 ? t('setup.owner.passwordTooShort') : null;
  const confirmError = owner.confirm && owner.password !== owner.confirm ? t('setup.owner.passwordMismatch') : null;
  const ownerValid = owner.setupCode.trim() && owner.username.length >= 3 && owner.email.includes('@') && owner.password.length >= 12 && owner.password === owner.confirm;

  async function initialize(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api('/setup/initialize', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          setupCode: owner.setupCode,
          owner: { username: owner.username, email: owner.email, password: owner.password },
          network,
        },
      });
      completed.current = true;
      storeLocale(network.defaultLocale);
      setStep('velocity');
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof ApiError && err.code === 'INVALID_SETUP_CODE') {
        setError(t('setup.invalidSetupCode'));
        setStep('owner');
      } else if (err instanceof ApiError && err.code === 'ALREADY_INITIALIZED') setError(t('setup.alreadyInitialized'));
      else setError(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function generateToken() {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      setToken(await api<RegistrationTokenResult>('/servers/registration-tokens', { method: 'POST', body: { type: 'VELOCITY', name: proxyName } }));
    } catch (err) {
      setError(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function copyToken() {
    if (!token) return;
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(token.token);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  }

  return (
    <div className="bg-blocks flex min-h-dvh flex-col">
      <header className="flex items-center gap-3 p-4">
        <Logo />
        <span className="font-semibold">{t('setup.title')}</span>
        <div className="ml-auto flex gap-2">
          <LanguageSwitcher persist={false} />
          <ThemeToggle persist={false} />
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="mx-auto grid w-full max-w-4xl flex-1 gap-6 p-4 md:grid-cols-[200px_1fr]">
        <ol className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto md:flex-col" aria-label={t('setup.title')}>
          {STEPS.map((s, i) => {
            const Icon = ICONS[s];
            return (
              <li
                key={s}
                aria-current={s === step ? 'step' : undefined}
                className={cn(
                  'flex shrink-0 items-center gap-3 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm',
                  s === step ? 'bg-accent font-medium text-accent-foreground' : i < index ? 'text-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground',
                )}
              >
                {i < index ? <Check className="size-4 text-primary" aria-hidden /> : <Icon className="size-4" aria-hidden />}
                {t(`setup.steps.${s}`)}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>

        <Card>
          <CardContent className="grid gap-5 p-6">
            <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">{t('setup.stepOf', { current: index + 1, total: STEPS.length })}</p>
            {error && <Alert variant="destructive">{error}</Alert>}

            {step === 'welcome' && (
              <>
                <div>
                  <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold">{t('setup.welcome.heading', { appName: t('common.appName') })}</h1>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('setup.welcome.description')}</p>
                </div>
                {status ? (
                  <div className="grid gap-2">
                    <StatusRow label={t('setup.welcome.backend')} up detail={t('common.version', { version: status.version })} />
                    <StatusRow label={t('setup.welcome.database')} up={status.database.connected} />
                    <StatusRow label={t('setup.welcome.redis')} up={status.redis.connected} />
                  </div>
                ) : statusError ? (
                  <Alert variant="destructive">{t('errors.network')}</Alert>
                ) : (
                  <div className="grid gap-2">
                    <Skeleton className="h-12" />
                    <Skeleton className="h-12" />
                    <Skeleton className="h-12" />
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => void loadStatus()}>
                    {t('common.retry')}
                  </Button>
                  <Button onClick={() => setStep('database')} disabled={!servicesUp}>
                    {t('common.next')}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {step === 'database' && status && (
              <>
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">{t('setup.database.heading')}</h2>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('setup.database.description')}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="grid gap-2">
                  <StatusRow label={t('setup.database.connectivity')} up={status.database.connected} />
                  <StatusRow label={t('setup.database.version')} up={!!status.database.version} detail={status.database.version ?? t('common.unknown')} />
                  <StatusRow label={t('setup.database.migrations')} up={dbReady} detail={String(status.database.migrationsApplied ?? '–')} />
                </div>
                {dbReady ? <Alert variant="success">{t('setup.database.upToDate')}</Alert> : <Alert variant="destructive">{t('setup.database.notReady')}</Alert>}
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setStep('welcome')}>
                    {t('common.back')}
                  </Button>
                  <Button onClick={() => setStep('owner')} disabled={!dbReady}>
                    {t('common.next')}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {step === 'owner' && (
              <form
                className="grid gap-4"
                onSubmit={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  setError(null);
                  if (ownerValid) setStep('network');
                }}
              >
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">{t('setup.owner.heading')}</h2>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('setup.owner.description')}</p>
                </div>
                <Field label={t('setup.owner.setupCode')} hint={t('setup.owner.setupCodeHint')} htmlFor="setupCode">
                  <Input id="setupCode" className="font-mono uppercase" autoComplete="off" value={owner.setupCode} onChange={(e) => setOwner({ ...owner, setupCode: e.target.value })} required />
                </Field>
                <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <Field label={t('setup.owner.username')} htmlFor="username">
                    <Input id="username" autoComplete="username" value={owner.username} onChange={(e) => setOwner({ ...owner, username: e.target.value })} minLength={3} maxLength={32} required />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label={t('setup.owner.email')} htmlFor="email">
                    <Input id="email" type="email" autoComplete="email" value={owner.email} onChange={(e) => setOwner({ ...owner, email: e.target.value })} required />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label={t('setup.owner.password')} htmlFor="password" error={passwordError}>
                    <Input id="password" type="password" autoComplete="new-password" value={owner.password} onChange={(e) => setOwner({ ...owner, password: e.target.value })} aria-invalid={!!passwordError} minLength={12} required />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label={t('setup.owner.confirmPassword')} htmlFor="confirm" error={confirmError}>
                    <Input id="confirm" type="password" autoComplete="new-password" value={owner.confirm} onChange={(e) => setOwner({ ...owner, confirm: e.target.value })} aria-invalid={!!confirmError} required />
                  </Field>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setStep('database')}>
                    {t('common.back')}
                  </Button>
                  <Button type="submit" disabled={!ownerValid}>
                    {t('common.next')}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </form>
            )}

            {step === 'network' && (
              <form className="grid gap-4" onSubmit={initialize}>
                <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">{t('setup.network.heading')}</h2>
                <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <Field label={t('setup.network.name')} htmlFor="netName">
                    <Input id="netName" value={network.name} onChange={(e) => setNetwork({ ...network, name: e.target.value })} maxLength={64} required />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label={t('setup.network.domain')} htmlFor="domain">
                    <Input id="domain" placeholder="play.example.net" value={network.minecraftDomain} onChange={(e) => setNetwork({ ...network, minecraftDomain: e.target.value })} />
                  </Field>
                </div>
                <Field label={t('setup.network.description')} htmlFor="desc">
                  <Textarea id="desc" value={network.description} onChange={(e) => setNetwork({ ...network, description: e.target.value })} maxLength={500} />
                </Field>
                <Field label={t('setup.network.dashboardUrl')} htmlFor="dashUrl">
                  <Input id="dashUrl" type="url" value={network.dashboardUrl} onChange={(e) => setNetwork({ ...network, dashboardUrl: e.target.value })} />
                </Field>
                <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
                  <Field label={t('setup.network.defaultLanguage')} htmlFor="lang">
                    <Select id="lang" value={network.defaultLocale} onChange={(e) => setNetwork({ ...network, defaultLocale: e.target.value })}>
                      {(languages.length ? languages : [{ locale: 'en-US', nativeName: 'English (US)' }]).map((l) => (
                        <option key={l.locale} value={l.locale}>
                          {l.nativeName}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </Select>
                  </Field>
                  <Field label={t('setup.network.defaultTimezone')} htmlFor="tz">
                    <Select id="tz" value={network.defaultTimezone} onChange={(e) => setNetwork({ ...network, defaultTimezone: e.target.value })}>
                      {timeZones.map((z) => (
                        <option key={z} value={z}>
                          {z}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </Select>
                  </Field>
                  <Field label={t('setup.network.defaultTheme')} htmlFor="theme">
                    <Select id="theme" value={network.defaultTheme} onChange={(e) => setNetwork({ ...network, defaultTheme: e.target.value as typeof network.defaultTheme })}>
                      <option value="dark">{t('theme.dark')}</option>
                      <option value="light">{t('theme.light')}</option>
                      <option value="system">{t('theme.system')}</option>
                    </Select>
                  </Field>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setStep('owner')} disabled={busy}>
                    {t('common.back')}
                  </Button>
                  <Button type="submit" disabled={busy || !network.name.trim()}>
                    {busy ? t('common.saving') : t('setup.network.submit')}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </form>
            )}

            {step === 'velocity' && (
              <>
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">{t('setup.velocity.heading')}</h2>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('setup.velocity.description')}</p>
                </div>
                {!token ? (
                  <Field label={t('setup.velocity.proxyName')} htmlFor="proxyName">
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <Input id="proxyName" value={proxyName} onChange={(e) => setProxyName(e.target.value)} maxLength={64} />
                      <Button onClick={() => void generateToken()} disabled={busy || proxyName.trim().length < 2}>
                        {t('setup.velocity.generate')}
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </Field>
                ) : (
                  <div className="grid gap-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">{t('setup.velocity.token')}</span>
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <code className="flex-1 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border bg-muted px-3 py-2 font-mono text-sm">{token.token}</code>
                      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => void copyToken()}>
                        {copied ? <Check aria-hidden /> : <Copy aria-hidden />}
                        {copied ? t('common.copied') : t('common.copy')}
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t('setup.velocity.expires', { time: format.relativeTime(new Date(token.expiresAt), now) })}</p>
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                  {!token && (
                    <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setStep('finish')}>
                      {t('setup.velocity.skip')}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  {token && <Button onClick={() => setStep('finish')}>{t('common.next')}</Button>}
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {step === 'finish' && (
              <>
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">{t('setup.finish.heading')}</h2>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('setup.finish.description')}</p>
                </div>
                <dl className="grid gap-2 text-sm">
                  {[
                    [t('setup.finish.summaryNetwork'), network.name],
                    [t('setup.finish.summaryOwner'), `${owner.username} (${owner.email})`],
                    [t('setup.finish.summaryLanguage'), languages.find((l) => l.locale === network.defaultLocale)?.nativeName ?? network.defaultLocale],
                  ].map(([k, v]) => (
                    <div key={k} className="flex justify-between rounded-lg border px-4 py-3">
                      <dt className="text-muted-foreground">{k}</dt>
                      <dd className="font-medium">{v}</dd>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  <div className="flex justify-between rounded-lg border px-4 py-3">
                    <dt className="text-muted-foreground">{t('setup.finish.summaryVelocity')}</dt>
                    <dd>{token ? <Badge>{t('setup.finish.generated')}</Badge> : <Badge variant="muted">{t('setup.finish.skipped')}</Badge>}</dd>
                  </div>
                </dl>
                <div className="flex justify-end">
                  <Button
                    onClick={() => {
                      router.replace('/');
                      router.refresh();
                    }}
                  >
                    {t('setup.finish.openDashboard')}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/components/anticheat-events.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useFormatter, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api, type Page } from '@/lib/api';
import { useLiveRefresh } from './realtime-provider';
import { Badge, Button, Skeleton } from './ui/primitives';
import { TBody, TD, TH, THead, TR, Table } from './ui/table';

export interface AntiCheatEvent {
  id: string;
  player: { uuid: string; username: string; online: boolean };
  server: { id: string; name: string } | null;
  provider: string;
  cheatType: string;
  violationLevel: number | null;
  outcome: string;
  explicit: boolean;
  reason: string | null;
  punishmentId: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
}

const OUTCOMES = ['WARNING', 'KICK', 'TEMP_BAN', 'BAN', 'LOGGED', 'DISABLED', 'SKIPPED_THRESHOLD', 'SKIPPED_COOLDOWN', 'SKIPPED_RATE_LIMIT', 'SKIPPED_DUPLICATE', 'SKIPPED_OFFLINE'] as const;
type Outcome = (typeof OUTCOMES)[number];

function outcomeVariant(outcome: string) {
  if (outcome === 'BAN' || outcome === 'TEMP_BAN') return 'danger' as const;
  if (outcome === 'KICK' || outcome === 'WARNING') return 'warning' as const;
  return 'muted' as const;
}

/** Paginated AntiCheat events. `query` adds filters (e.g. "provider=Grim&punished=true"). */
export function AntiCheatEvents({ endpoint, query = '', showPlayer }: { endpoint: string; query?: string; showPlayer: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations('anticheat');
  const tc = useTranslations('common');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [data, setData] = useState<Page<AntiCheatEvent> | null>(null);
  const PAGE_SIZE = 25;

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setData(await api<Page<AntiCheatEvent>>(`${endpoint}?page=${page}&pageSize=${PAGE_SIZE}${query ? `&${query}` : ''}`).catch(() => null));
  }, [endpoint, page, query]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);
  useEffect(() => setPage(1), [query]);
  useLiveRefresh(['anticheat.event'], load);

  if (!data) return <Skeleton className="m-5 h-32" />;
  if (data.items.length === 0) return <p className="p-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('empty')}</p>;
  const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(data.total / PAGE_SIZE));

  return (
    <>
      <Table>
        <THead>
          <TR>
            <TH>{t('time')}</TH>
            {showPlayer && <TH>{t('player')}</TH>}
            <TH>{t('provider')}</TH>
            <TH>{t('cheatType')}</TH>
            <TH className="text-right">{t('violationLevel')}</TH>
            <TH>{t('outcome')}</TH>
          </TR>
        </THead>
        <TBody>
          {data.items.map((e) => (
            <TR key={e.id}>
              <TD className="whitespace-nowrap text-muted-foreground">{format.dateTime(new Date(e.createdAt), { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'medium' })}</TD>
              {showPlayer && (
                <TD>
                  <Link href={`/players/${e.player.uuid}?tab=moderation`} className="font-medium hover:underline">
                    {e.player.username}
                  </Link>
                </TD>
              )}
              <TD className="whitespace-nowrap">
                {e.provider}
                {e.server && <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{e.server.name}</span>}
              </TD>
              <TD className="min-w-40">
                <span className="font-medium">{e.cheatType}</span>
                {e.reason && <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{e.reason}</span>}
              </TD>
              <TD className="text-right tabular-nums">{e.violationLevel === null ? '–' : format.number(e.violationLevel, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })}</TD>
              <TD className="whitespace-nowrap">
                <Badge variant={outcomeVariant(e.outcome)}>{OUTCOMES.includes(e.outcome as Outcome) ? t(`outcomes.${e.outcome as Outcome}`) : e.outcome}</Badge>
                {e.explicit && <span className="ml-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t('explicit')}</span>}
              </TD>
            </TR>
          ))}
        </TBody>
      </Table>
      {pages > 1 && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 p-4 text-sm">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={page <= 1} onClick={() => setPage(page - 1)}>
            {tc('previous')}
          </Button>
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">{tc('page', { page, pages })}</span>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={page >= pages} onClick={() => setPage(page + 1)}>
            {tc('next')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```
