`apps/dashboard/src/components/anticheat-rules.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api, ApiError, errorKey } from '@/lib/api';
import { useAuth } from './auth-provider';
import { useToast } from './toaster';
import { Alert, Button, Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, Field, Input, Select, Skeleton } from './ui/primitives';
import { Switch } from './ui/switch';
import { TBody, TD, TH, THead, TR, Table } from './ui/table';

const ACTIONS = ['NONE', 'WARNING', 'KICK', 'TEMP_BAN', 'BAN'] as const;
type Action = (typeof ACTIONS)[number];

interface Rule {
  action: Action;
  durationSeconds: number | null;
  minViolationLevel: number;
  cooldownSeconds: number;
}
interface CheatRule extends Rule {
  cheatType: string;
  enabled: boolean;
}
interface Settings {
  enabled: boolean;
  collectEvidence: boolean;
  defaultRule: Rule;
  commandFallback: Rule;
  rules: CheatRule[];
  maxPunishmentsPerMinute: number;
}

const DAY = 86_400;

/** Keeps duration consistent with the action (required for TEMP_BAN, absent otherwise). */
function withAction<T extends Rule>(rule: T, action: Action): T {
  return { ...rule, action, durationSeconds: action === 'TEMP_BAN' ? (rule.durationSeconds ?? 7 * DAY) : null };
}

function RuleFields({ rule, onChange, disabled, id }: { rule: Rule; onChange: (r: Rule) => void; disabled: boolean; id: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('anticheat');
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
      <Field label={t('action')} htmlFor={`${id}-action`}>
        <Select id={`${id}-action`} value={rule.action} disabled={disabled} onChange={(e) => onChange(withAction(rule, e.target.value as Action))}>
          {ACTIONS.map((a) => (
            <option key={a} value={a}>
              {t(`actions.${a}`)}
            </option>
          ))}
        </Select>
      </Field>
      <Field label={t('durationDays')} htmlFor={`${id}-duration`}>
        <Input
          id={`${id}-duration`}
          type="number"
          min={1}
          max={3650}
          disabled={disabled || rule.action !== 'TEMP_BAN'}
          value={rule.durationSeconds === null ? '' : Math.round(rule.durationSeconds / DAY)}
          onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...rule, durationSeconds: Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value)) * DAY })}
        />
      </Field>
      <Field label={t('minVl')} htmlFor={`${id}-vl`}>
        <Input id={`${id}-vl`} type="number" min={0} step="any" disabled={disabled} value={rule.minViolationLevel} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...rule, minViolationLevel: Math.max(0, Number(e.target.value)) })} />
      </Field>
      <Field label={t('cooldown')} htmlFor={`${id}-cd`}>
        <Input id={`${id}-cd`} type="number" min={0} disabled={disabled} value={rule.cooldownSeconds} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...rule, cooldownSeconds: Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(e.target.value))) })} />
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}

export function AntiCheatRules() {
  const t = useTranslations('anticheat');
  const tc = useTranslations('common');
  const te = useTranslations('errors');
  const toast = useToast();
  const { can } = useAuth();
  const canManage = can(PERMISSIONS.ANTICHEAT_MANAGE);
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<Settings | null>(null);
  const [examples, setExamples] = useState<CheatRule[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    void api<{ settings: Settings; examples: CheatRule[] }>('/anticheat/settings').then((r) => {
      setSettings(r.settings);
      setExamples(r.examples);
    });
  }, []);

  if (!settings) return <Skeleton className="h-64" />;
  const update = (patch: Partial<Settings>) => setSettings({ ...settings, ...patch });
  const updateRule = (i: number, rule: CheatRule) => update({ rules: settings.rules.map((r, j) => (j === i ? rule : r)) });

  async function save() {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      setSettings(await api<Settings>('/anticheat/settings', { method: 'PUT', body: settings }));
      toast(t('saved'));
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof ApiError && err.issues?.length ? err.issues.map((i) => `${i.path}: ${i.message}`).join(' · ') : te(errorKey(err)));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const existing = new Set(settings.rules.map((r) => r.cheatType.toLowerCase()));

  return (
    <div className="grid min-w-0 gap-6 [&>*]:min-w-0">
      {!canManage && <Alert>{t('readOnly')}</Alert>}
      {error && <Alert variant="destructive">{error}</Alert>}

      <Card>
        <CardContent className="grid gap-4 pt-5">
          <label className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
            <span>
              <span className="block font-medium">{t('enabled')}</span>
              <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('enabledHint')}</span>
            </span>
            <Switch checked={settings.enabled} disabled={!canManage} onCheckedChange={(v) => update({ enabled: v })} />
          </label>
          <label className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
            <span>
              <span className="block font-medium">{t('collectEvidence')}</span>
              <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('collectEvidenceHint')}</span>
            </span>
            <Switch checked={settings.collectEvidence} disabled={!canManage} onCheckedChange={(v) => update({ collectEvidence: v })} />
          </label>
          <Field label={t('maxPerMinute')} htmlFor="ac-max">
            <Input id="ac-max" className="max-w-32" type="number" min={1} max={1000} disabled={!canManage} value={settings.maxPunishmentsPerMinute} onChange={(e) => update({ maxPunishmentsPerMinute: Math.min(1000, Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value))) })} />
          </Field>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2 [&>*]:min-w-0">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="text-base">{t('defaultRule')}</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>{t('defaultRuleHint')}</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <RuleFields id="ac-default" rule={settings.defaultRule} disabled={!canManage} onChange={(r) => update({ defaultRule: r })} />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="text-base">{t('commandFallback')}</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>{t('commandFallbackHint')}</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <RuleFields id="ac-fallback" rule={settings.commandFallback} disabled={!canManage} onChange={(r) => update({ commandFallback: r })} />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="flex-row flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <CardTitle>{t('rules')}</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>{t('rulesHint')}</CardDescription>
            {canManage && <CardDescription className="mt-1 text-xs">{t('examplesHint')}</CardDescription>}
          </div>
          {canManage && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => update({ rules: [...settings.rules, ...examples.filter((e) => !existing.has(e.cheatType.toLowerCase()))] })}
              >
                {t('loadExamples')}
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => update({ rules: [...settings.rules, { cheatType: '', action: 'KICK', durationSeconds: null, minViolationLevel: 0, cooldownSeconds: 300, enabled: true }] })}
              >
                <Plus aria-hidden /> {t('addRule')}
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="px-0">
          {settings.rules.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="px-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('noRules')}</p>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <THead>
                <TR>
                  <TH>{t('cheatType')}</TH>
                  <TH>{t('action')}</TH>
                  <TH>{t('durationDays')}</TH>
                  <TH>{t('minVl')}</TH>
                  <TH>{t('cooldown')}</TH>
                  <TH>{t('ruleEnabled')}</TH>
                  <TH>
                    <span className="sr-only">{tc('actions')}</span>
                  </TH>
                </TR>
              </THead>
              <TBody>
                {settings.rules.map((rule, i) => (
                  <TR key={i}>
                    <TD className="min-w-36">
                      <Input aria-label={t('cheatType')} value={rule.cheatType} maxLength={64} disabled={!canManage} onChange={(e) => updateRule(i, { ...rule, cheatType: e.target.value })} />
                    </TD>
                    <TD className="min-w-44">
                      <Select aria-label={t('action')} value={rule.action} disabled={!canManage} onChange={(e) => updateRule(i, withAction(rule, e.target.value as Action))}>
                        {ACTIONS.map((a) => (
                          <option key={a} value={a}>
                            {t(`actions.${a}`)}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                    </TD>
                    <TD className="w-28">
                      <Input
                        aria-label={t('durationDays')}
                        type="number"
                        min={1}
                        disabled={!canManage || rule.action !== 'TEMP_BAN'}
                        value={rule.durationSeconds === null ? '' : Math.round(rule.durationSeconds / DAY)}
                        onChange={(e) => updateRule(i, { ...rule, durationSeconds: Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value)) * DAY })}
                      />
                    </TD>
                    <TD className="min-w-24">
                      <Input aria-label={t('minVl')} type="number" min={0} step="any" disabled={!canManage} value={rule.minViolationLevel} onChange={(e) => updateRule(i, { ...rule, minViolationLevel: Math.max(0, Number(e.target.value)) })} />
                    </TD>
                    <TD className="w-28">
                      <Input aria-label={t('cooldown')} type="number" min={0} disabled={!canManage} value={rule.cooldownSeconds} onChange={(e) => updateRule(i, { ...rule, cooldownSeconds: Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(e.target.value))) })} />
                    </TD>
                    <TD>
                      <Switch aria-label={t('ruleEnabled')} checked={rule.enabled} disabled={!canManage} onCheckedChange={(v) => updateRule(i, { ...rule, enabled: v })} />
                    </TD>
                    <TD>
                      {canManage && (
                        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" title={tc('delete')} onClick={() => update({ rules: settings.rules.filter((_, j) => j !== i) })}>
                          <Trash2 aria-hidden />
                          <span className="sr-only">{tc('delete')}</span>
                        </Button>
                      )}
                    </TD>
                  </TR>
                ))}
              </TBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {canManage && (
        <div className="flex justify-end">
          <Button onClick={() => void save()} disabled={busy || settings.rules.some((r) => !r.cheatType.trim())}>
            {busy ? tc('saving') : tc('save')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { BarChart3, Gavel, LayoutDashboard, LogOut, Menu, ScrollText, Server, Settings, ShieldAlert, UserCog, Users, Wifi } from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';

import { LanguageSwitcher, ThemeToggle } from './preference-controls';
import { Button } from './ui/primitives';

type NavKey = 'dashboard' | 'players' | 'onlinePlayers' | 'statistics' | 'moderation' | 'anticheat' | 'servers' | 'auditLogs' | 'users' | 'settings';

const NAV: { key: NavKey; href: string; icon: typeof Users; permission?: string }[] = [
  { key: 'dashboard', href: '/', icon: LayoutDashboard },
  { key: 'players', href: '/players', icon: Users, permission: PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_VIEW },

  { key: 'anticheat', href: '/anticheat', icon: ShieldAlert, permission: PERMISSIONS.ANTICHEAT_VIEW },

  { key: 'auditLogs', href: '/audit', icon: ScrollText, permission: PERMISSIONS.AUDIT_VIEW },

  { key: 'settings', href: '/settings', icon: Settings },
];

export function AppShell({ children, version }: { children: ReactNode; version: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations();

  const { user, can, signOut } = useAuth();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const roleName = useRoleName();

  const isActive = (href: string) => (href === '/' ? pathname === '/' : pathname === href || (pathname.startsWith(`${href}/`) && href !== '/players'));

  const nav = (
    <nav className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 p-3" aria-label={t('common.appName')}>
      {NAV.filter((item) => !item.permission || can(item.permission)).map(({ key, href, icon: Icon }) => (
        <Link
          key={key}
          href={href}
          onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
          aria-current={isActive(href) ? 'page' : undefined}
          className={cn(
            'flex items-center gap-3 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground',
            isActive(href) && 'bg-accent font-medium text-accent-foreground',
          )}
        >
          <Icon className="size-4" aria-hidden />
          {t(`nav.${key}`)}
        </Link>
      ))}
    </nav>
  );

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-dvh">
      <aside className={cn('fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-40 flex w-64 flex-col border-r bg-sidebar transition-transform lg:static lg:translate-x-0', open ? 'translate-x-0' : '-translate-x-full')}>
        <div className="flex h-16 items-center gap-3 border-b px-5">
          <Logo />
          <div className="leading-tight">
            <div className="font-semibold">{t('common.appName')}</div>
            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t('common.version', { version })}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto">{nav}</div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-t p-4">
          <div className="flex size-9 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-primary/15 font-semibold text-primary" aria-hidden>
            {user.username.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 leading-tight">
            <div className="truncate text-sm font-medium">{user.username}</div>
            <div className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{roleName({ key: user.roleKey, name: user.roleKey })}</div>
          </div>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={() => void signOut()} title={t('common.signOut')}>
            <LogOut aria-hidden />
            <span className="sr-only">{t('common.signOut')}</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </aside>
      {open && <button type="button" aria-label={t('common.close')} className="fixed inset-0 z-30 bg-black/50 lg:hidden" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} />}

      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
        <header className="sticky top-0 z-20 flex h-16 items-center gap-3 border-b bg-background/80 px-4 backdrop-blur lg:px-8">
          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="lg:hidden" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
            <Menu aria-hidden />
            <span className="sr-only">{t('nav.toggleSidebar')}</span>
          </Button>
          <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2">
            <LanguageSwitcher persist />
            <ThemeToggle persist />
          </div>
        </header>
        <main className="flex-1 px-4 py-6 lg:px-8">{children}</main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function PageHeader({ title, subtitle, actions }: { title: string; subtitle?: string; actions?: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{title}</h1>
        {subtitle && <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{subtitle}</p>}
      </div>
      {actions}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/components/auth-provider.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { hasPermission } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { usePathname, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTheme } from 'next-themes';
import { createContext, type ReactNode, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api, ApiError, type Me } from '@/lib/api';
import { browserTimeZone, storeLocale, storeTimeZone } from '@/lib/preferences';

interface AuthContextValue {
  user: Me;
  can: (permission: string) => boolean;
  reload: () => Promise<void>;
  signOut: () => Promise<void>;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextValue | null>(null);

export function useAuth(): AuthContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useAuth must be used inside <AuthProvider>');
  return ctx;
}

/** Loads the signed-in user, applies their saved preferences, and guards the app routes. */
export function AuthProvider({ children, fallback }: { children: ReactNode; fallback: ReactNode }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const { setTheme } = useTheme();
  const [user, setUser] = useState<Me | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const me = await api<Me>('/auth/me');
      setUser(me);
      const localeChanged = me.locale ? storeLocale(me.locale) : false;
      const tzChanged = storeTimeZone(me.timezone ?? browserTimeZone());
      if (me.theme) setTheme(me.theme);
      if (localeChanged || tzChanged) router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 401) {
        const status = await api<{ initialized: boolean }>('/setup/status').catch(() => null);
        router.replace(status && !status.initialized ? '/setup' : `/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(pathname)}`);
      } else {
        throw err;
      }
    }
  }, [pathname, router, setTheme]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
    // Only on mount: navigation inside the app keeps the session.
  }, []);

  const signOut = useCallback(async () => {
    await api('/auth/logout', { method: 'POST' }).catch(() => undefined);
    router.replace('/login');
  }, [router]);

  if (!user) return <>{fallback}</>;

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, can: (p) => hasPermission(user.permissions, p), reload: load, signOut }}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/components/confirm-dialog.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { type ReactNode, useState } from 'react';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTrigger } from './ui/dialog';
import { Button } from './ui/primitives';

/** Confirmation step for destructive or disruptive actions. */
export function ConfirmDialog({
  trigger,
  title,
  description,
  confirmLabel,
  destructive = false,
  onConfirm,
}: {
  trigger: ReactNode;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  confirmLabel: string;
  destructive?: boolean;
  onConfirm: () => Promise<void> | void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('common');
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>{trigger}</DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent title={title} description={description} closeLabel={t('close')}>
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} disabled={busy}>
            {t('cancel')}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={destructive ? 'destructive' : 'default'}
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={async () => {
              setBusy(true);
              try {
                await onConfirm();
                setOpen(false);
              } finally {
                setBusy(false);
              }
            }}
          >
            {confirmLabel}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/components/inventory-editor.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { Plus, RefreshCw, RotateCcw, Trash2, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useFormatter, useNow, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { type DragEvent, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { api, ApiError, errorKey } from '@/lib/api';
import { diff, type Draft, type DraftItem, effective, initials, type InventoryItem, ITEM_ID, move, normalizeId } from '@/lib/inventory';
import { prettyId } from '@/lib/stats';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { useAuth } from './auth-provider';
import { ConfirmDialog } from './confirm-dialog';
import { useLiveRefresh } from './realtime-provider';
import { useToast } from './toaster';
import { Alert, Badge, Button, Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, Field, Input, Select, Skeleton, Textarea } from './ui/primitives';

type Kind = 'inventory' | 'ender-chest';
interface ServerOverview {
  serverId: string;
  serverName: string;
  online: boolean;
  kinds: { kind: 'INVENTORY' | 'ENDER_CHEST'; revision: number; capturedAt: string }[];
}
interface RevisionSummary {
  id: string;
  status: 'PENDING' | 'APPLIED' | 'CONFLICT' | 'REJECTED' | 'ROLLED_BACK' | 'CANCELLED' | 'SNAPSHOT';
  reason: string | null;
  resultMessage: string | null;
  rollbackOfId: string | null;
  actor: { id: string; username: string } | null;
  createdAt: string;
  appliedAt: string | null;
  changes: { slot: number; before: { id: string; amount: number } | null; after: { id: string; amount: number } | null }[];
}
interface View {
  revision: number;
  capturedAt: string;
  items: InventoryItem[];
  pending: string | null;
  revisions: RevisionSummary[];
}

const STATUS_VARIANT: Record<RevisionSummary['status'], 'default' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'muted' | 'info'> = {
  PENDING: 'info',
  APPLIED: 'default',
  CONFLICT: 'warning',
  REJECTED: 'danger',
  ROLLED_BACK: 'muted',
  CANCELLED: 'muted',
  SNAPSHOT: 'muted',
};

function hueOf(id: string) {
  let h = 0;
  for (const c of id) h = (h * 31 + c.charCodeAt(0)) % 360;
  return h;
}

/** One Minecraft-style slot. Item textures are not bundled; items show a labelled tile. */
function Slot({ slot, item, selected, changed, editable, onSelect, onDrop, label }: {
  slot: number;
  item: DraftItem | null;
  selected: boolean;
  changed: boolean;
  editable: boolean;
  onSelect: (slot: number) => void;
  onDrop: (from: number, to: number) => void;
  label?: string;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('inventory');
  const enchanted = item && Object.keys(item.enchantments).length > 0;
  const damaged = item?.maxDamage && item.damage ? 1 - item.damage / item.maxDamage : null;
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      draggable={editable && !!item}
      onDragStart={(e: DragEvent) => e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', String(slot))}
      onDragOver={(e: DragEvent) => editable && e.preventDefault()}
      onDrop={(e: DragEvent) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const from = Number(e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain'));
        if (!Number.isNaN(from)) onDrop(from, slot);
      }}
      onClick={() => onSelect(slot)}
      title={item ? `${prettyId(item.id)}${item.name ? ` – ${item.name}` : ''} ×${item.amount}` : label ?? t('empty')}
      aria-label={item ? `${t('slot', { slot })}: ${item.amount} × ${prettyId(item.id)}` : `${t('slot', { slot })}: ${label ?? t('empty')}`}
      aria-pressed={selected}
      className={cn(
        'relative size-12 shrink-0 border-2 bg-[#8b8b8b] [border-color:#373737_#ffffff_#ffffff_#373737] transition-[outline] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-primary dark:bg-[#5a5a5a] dark:[border-color:#2a2a2a_#8f8f8f_#8f8f8f_#2a2a2a]',
        selected && 'outline-2 outline-offset-1 outline-primary',
        changed && 'ring-2 ring-gold',
      )}
    >
      {item ? (
        <>
          <span
            className={cn('absolute inset-1 flex items-center justify-center rounded-sm text-[11px] font-bold text-white [text-shadow:1px_1px_0_#000]', enchanted && 'shadow-[0_0_8px_2px_#b06cff] ring-1 ring-[#c99bff]')}
            style={{ background: `oklch(0.5 0.12 ${hueOf(item.id)})` }}
          >
            {initials(item.id)}
          </span>
          {item.amount > 1 && <span className="absolute bottom-0 right-0.5 text-xs font-bold text-white [text-shadow:1px_1px_0_#000]">{item.amount}</span>}
          {damaged !== null && (
            <span className="absolute inset-x-1 bottom-0.5 h-0.5 bg-black">
              <span className="block h-full" style={{ width: `${damaged * 100}%`, background: `hsl(${damaged * 120} 90% 45%)` }} />
            </span>
          )}
        </>
      ) : (
        label && <span className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-[8px] uppercase text-black/40 dark:text-white/30">{label}</span>
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

/** Inventory or Ender Chest of one player on one server, with editing, history and rollback. */
export function InventoryEditor({ uuid, kind }: { uuid: string; kind: Kind }) {
  const t = useTranslations('inventory');
  const tc = useTranslations('common');
  const te = useTranslations('errors');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 30_000 });
  const toast = useToast();
  const { can } = useAuth();
  const canEdit = can(PERMISSIONS.PLAYERS_EDIT_INVENTORY);
  const [servers, setServers] = useState<ServerOverview[] | null>(null);
  const [scope, setScope] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [view, setView] = useState<View | null>(null);
  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Draft>(new Map());
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const size = kind === 'inventory' ? 41 : 27;

  const loadServers = useCallback(async () => {
    const list = await api<ServerOverview[]>(`/players/${uuid}/inventories`).catch(() => []);
    setServers(list);
    setScope((current) => current ?? list.find((s) => s.online)?.serverId ?? list[0]?.serverId ?? null);
  }, [uuid]);

  const loadView = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!scope) return;
    try {
      setView(await api<View>(`/players/${uuid}/inventories/${scope}/${kind}`));
      setMissing(false);
    } catch (err) {
      setView(null);
      setMissing(err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 404);
    }
  }, [uuid, scope, kind]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadServers();
  }, [loadServers]);
  useEffect(() => {
    setDraft(new Map());
    setSelected(null);
    void loadView();
  }, [loadView]);
  // Live updates only refresh the view when nothing is being edited.
  useLiveRefresh(['inventory.changed'], () => {
    void loadServers();
    if (draft.size === 0) void loadView();
  }, 120_000);

  const items = useMemo(() => new Map((view?.items ?? []).map((i) => [i.slot, i])), [view]);
  const changes = useMemo(() => (view ? diff(items, draft, view.items) : []), [items, draft, view]);
  const changedSlots = new Set(changes.map((c) => c.slot));
  const server = servers?.find((s) => s.serverId === scope);
  const editable = canEdit && !!view && !view.pending;
  const current = selected === null ? null : effective(items, draft, selected);

  function update(slot: number, item: DraftItem | null) {
    setDraft(new Map(draft).set(slot, item));
  }

  async function save() {
    if (!view || !scope) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await api(`/players/${uuid}/inventories/${scope}/${kind}/revisions`, { method: 'POST', body: { baseRevision: view.revision, reason: reason.trim() || undefined, changes } });
      toast(t('saved'));
      setDraft(new Map());
      setReason('');
      await loadView();
    } catch (err) {
      const code = err instanceof ApiError ? err.code : '';
      if (code === 'STALE_REVISION' || code === 'STALE_SLOT') {
        setDraft(new Map());
        await loadView();
      }
      toast(code === 'STALE_REVISION' || code === 'PENDING_EDIT' || code === 'STALE_SLOT' ? t(`errors.${code}`) : te(errorKey(err)), 'error');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function refresh() {
    try {
      await api(`/players/${uuid}/inventories/${scope}/refresh`, { method: 'POST' });
      toast(t('refreshRequested'));
    } catch (err) {
      toast(err instanceof ApiError && err.code === 'PLAYER_NOT_ON_SERVER' ? t('errors.PLAYER_NOT_ON_SERVER') : te(errorKey(err)), 'error');
    }
  }

  async function revisionAction(path: string, success?: string) {
    try {
      await api(path, { method: 'POST', body: {} });
      if (success) toast(success);
      await loadView();
    } catch (err) {
      toast(err instanceof ApiError && err.code === 'PENDING_EDIT' ? t('errors.PENDING_EDIT') : te(errorKey(err)), 'error');
    }
  }

  if (!servers) return <Skeleton className="h-72" />;
  if (servers.length === 0) return <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed p-10 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('noServers')}</div>;

  const slotProps = (slot: number, label?: string) => ({
    slot,
    label,
    item: effective(items, draft, slot),
    selected: selected === slot,
    changed: changedSlots.has(slot),
    editable,
    onSelect: setSelected,
    onDrop: (from: number, to: number) => editable && setDraft(move(items, draft, from, to)),
  });

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6 [&>*]:min-w-0">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <Select aria-label={t('server')} className="w-56" value={scope ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setScope(e.target.value)}>
          {servers.map((s) => (
            <option key={s.serverId} value={s.serverId}>
              {s.serverName}
              {s.online ? ` · ${tc('online')}` : ''}
            </option>
          ))}
        </Select>
        {view && (
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {t('capturedAt', { time: format.relativeTime(new Date(view.capturedAt), now) })} · {t('revision', { revision: view.revision })}
          </span>
        )}
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="ml-auto" disabled={!server?.online} title={t('refreshHint')} onClick={() => void refresh()}>
          <RefreshCw aria-hidden /> {t('refresh')}
        </Button>
      </div>

      {missing && <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed p-10 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('noSnapshot')}</div>}

      {view && (
        <>
          {!canEdit && <Alert>{t('readOnly')}</Alert>}
          {canEdit && <Alert>{server?.online ? t('onlineNotice') : t('offlineNotice')}</Alert>}
          {view.pending && (
            <Alert className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              {t('pending')}
              {canEdit && (
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => void revisionAction(`/players/${uuid}/inventories/revisions/${view.pending}/cancel`)}>
                  <X aria-hidden /> {t('cancelPending')}
                </Button>
              )}
            </Alert>
          )}

          <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[auto_1fr] [&>*]:min-w-0">
            <Card className="w-fit max-w-full overflow-x-auto bg-[#c6c6c6] p-4 dark:bg-[#3b3b3b]">
              {kind === 'inventory' ? (
                <div className="grid gap-3">
                  <div className="flex gap-4">
                    <div className="grid gap-0.5">
                      <span className="text-[10px] uppercase text-black/60 dark:text-white/50">{t('armor')}</span>
                      {[39, 38, 37, 36].map((s, i) => (
                        <Slot key={s} {...slotProps(s, ['helmet', 'chest', 'legs', 'boots'][i])} />
                      ))}
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid content-end gap-0.5">
                      <span className="text-[10px] uppercase text-black/60 dark:text-white/50">{t('offhand')}</span>
                      <Slot {...slotProps(40, 'offhand')} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase text-black/60 dark:text-white/50">{t('main')}</span>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-9 gap-0.5">
                    {Array.from({ length: 27 }, (_, i) => (
                      <Slot key={i + 9} {...slotProps(i + 9)} />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase text-black/60 dark:text-white/50">{t('hotbar')}</span>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-9 gap-0.5">
                    {Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => (
                      <Slot key={i} {...slotProps(i)} />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="grid gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase text-black/60 dark:text-white/50">{t('enderChest')}</span>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-9 gap-0.5">
                    {Array.from({ length: 27 }, (_, i) => (
                      <Slot key={i} {...slotProps(i)} />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </Card>

            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="text-base">{selected === null ? t('selectHint') : t('slot', { slot: selected })}</CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                {selected !== null && (
                  <ItemPanel
                    key={`${selected}-${draft.size}`}
                    item={current}
                    editable={editable}
                    onChange={(item) => update(selected, item)}
                  />
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>

          {editable && (
            <Card>
              <CardContent className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3 pt-5">
                <span className="text-sm font-medium">{t('changes', { count: changes.length })}</span>
                <div className="min-w-64 flex-1">
                  <Input aria-label={t('reason')} placeholder={t('reason')} value={reason} maxLength={500} onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} />
                </div>
                <ConfirmDialog
                  trigger={
                    <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
                      <Trash2 aria-hidden /> {t('clearAll')}
                    </Button>
                  }
                  title={t('clearAll')}
                  description={t('changes', { count: [...items.keys()].length })}
                  confirmLabel={t('clearAll')}
                  destructive
                  onConfirm={() => setDraft(new Map(Array.from({ length: size }, (_, i) => [i, null] as [number, null])))}
                />
                <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={!changes.length} onClick={() => setDraft(new Map())}>
                  {t('reset')}
                </Button>
                <Button size="sm" disabled={busy || !changes.length} onClick={() => void save()}>
                  {busy ? tc('saving') : t('save')}
                </Button>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}

          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>{t('history')}</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              {view.revisions.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('noHistory')}</p>
              ) : (
                <ul className="grid gap-2">
                  {view.revisions.map((r) => (
                    <li key={r.id} className="rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                        <Badge variant={STATUS_VARIANT[r.status]}>{t(`status.${r.status}`)}</Badge>
                        {r.rollbackOfId && <Badge variant="outline">{t('rolledBackOf')}</Badge>}
                        <span className="font-medium">{r.actor?.username ?? tc('unknown')}</span>
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{format.dateTime(new Date(r.createdAt), { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' })}</span>
                        {canEdit && r.status === 'APPLIED' && !view.pending && (
                          <span className="ml-auto">
                            <ConfirmDialog
                              trigger={
                                <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
                                  <RotateCcw aria-hidden /> {t('rollback')}
                                </Button>
                              }
                              title={t('rollback')}
                              description={t('rollbackConfirm')}
                              confirmLabel={t('rollback')}
                              onConfirm={() => revisionAction(`/players/${uuid}/inventories/revisions/${r.id}/rollback`, t('saved'))}
                            />
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      {r.reason && <p className="mt-1 text-muted-foreground">{r.reason}</p>}
                      {(r.status === 'CONFLICT' || r.status === 'REJECTED') && (
                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gold">
                          {r.resultMessage} {r.status === 'CONFLICT' && `· ${t('conflictHint')}`}
                        </p>
                      )}
                      <ul className="mt-2 grid gap-0.5 font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {r.changes.map((c) => (
                          <li key={c.slot}>
                            #{c.slot}: {c.before ? `${c.before.amount}× ${prettyId(c.before.id)}` : '∅'} → {c.after ? `${c.after.amount}× ${prettyId(c.after.id)}` : '∅'}
                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Inspect / edit one slot. */
function ItemPanel({ item, editable, onChange }: { item: DraftItem | null; editable: boolean; onChange: (item: DraftItem | null) => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations('inventory');
  const [id, setId] = useState(item?.id ?? '');
  const [newEnchant, setNewEnchant] = useState({ id: '', level: 1 });

  if (!item) {
    return editable ? (
      <div className="grid gap-3">
        <Field label={t('itemId')} htmlFor="new-item" error={id && !ITEM_ID.test(normalizeId(id)) ? t('invalidId') : null}>
          <Input id="new-item" placeholder="minecraft:diamond" value={id} onChange={(e) => setId(e.target.value)} maxLength={128} />
        </Field>
        <Button size="sm" className="w-fit" disabled={!id || !ITEM_ID.test(normalizeId(id))} onClick={() => onChange({ id: normalizeId(id), amount: 1, name: null, lore: [], enchantments: {} })}>
          <Plus aria-hidden /> {t('addItem')}
        </Button>
      </div>
    ) : (
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('empty')}</p>
    );
  }

  const set = (patch: Partial<DraftItem>) => onChange({ ...item, ...patch });
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div>
          <div className="font-medium">{prettyId(item.id)}</div>
          <div className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">{item.id}</div>
        </div>
        {editable && (
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => onChange(null)}>
            <Trash2 aria-hidden /> {t('removeItem')}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
      {item.maxDamage ? (
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {t('durability')}: {item.maxDamage - (item.damage ?? 0)} / {item.maxDamage}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Field label={t('amount')} htmlFor="item-amount">
          <Input id="item-amount" type="number" min={1} max={99} disabled={!editable} value={item.amount} onChange={(e) => set({ amount: Math.min(99, Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value) || 1)) })} />
        </Field>
        <Field label={t('name')} htmlFor="item-name">
          <Input id="item-name" maxLength={100} disabled={!editable} value={item.name ?? ''} onChange={(e) => set({ name: e.target.value || null })} />
        </Field>
      </div>
      <Field label={t('lore')} htmlFor="item-lore">
        <Textarea id="item-lore" disabled={!editable} value={item.lore.join('\n')} onChange={(e) => set({ lore: e.target.value.split('\n').slice(0, 20).map((l) => l.slice(0, 200)) })} />
      </Field>
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <span className="text-sm font-medium">{t('enchantments')}</span>
        {Object.entries(item.enchantments).map(([key, level]) => (
          <div key={key} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <span className="flex-1">{prettyId(key)}</span>
            <Input aria-label={`${prettyId(key)} ${t('level')}`} className="w-20" type="number" min={1} max={255} disabled={!editable} value={level} onChange={(e) => set({ enchantments: { ...item.enchantments, [key]: Math.min(255, Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value) || 1)) } })} />
            {editable && (
              <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="size-8" onClick={() => set({ enchantments: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(item.enchantments).filter(([k]) => k !== key)) })}>
                <X aria-hidden />
                <span className="sr-only">{t('removeItem')}</span>
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
        {editable && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2">
            <Input aria-label={t('enchantmentId')} placeholder="minecraft:sharpness" className="min-w-40 flex-1" value={newEnchant.id} onChange={(e) => setNewEnchant({ ...newEnchant, id: e.target.value })} />
            <Input aria-label={t('level')} className="w-20" type="number" min={1} max={255} value={newEnchant.level} onChange={(e) => setNewEnchant({ ...newEnchant, level: Math.min(255, Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value) || 1)) })} />
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              disabled={!ITEM_ID.test(normalizeId(newEnchant.id || 'x'))}
              onClick={() => {
                set({ enchantments: { ...item.enchantments, [normalizeId(newEnchant.id)]: newEnchant.level } });
                setNewEnchant({ id: '', level: 1 });
              }}
            >
              <Plus aria-hidden /> {t('addEnchantment')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/components/languages-manager.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { Download, Plus, RotateCcw, Trash2, Upload } from 'lucide-react';
import { useFormatter, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { type FormEvent, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { ConfirmDialog } from '@/components/confirm-dialog';
import { useToast } from '@/components/toaster';
import { Alert, Badge, Button, Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, Field, Input } from '@/components/ui/primitives';
import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch';
import { api, ApiError, errorKey, type Language } from '@/lib/api';
import { downloadFile } from '@/lib/zip';

const LOCALE_PATTERN = /^[a-z]{2,3}-[A-Z]{2}$/;
const MAX_IMPORT_BYTES = 90_000;

/**
 * Settings → Languages: enable languages, choose the default, add languages
 * and import/export dashboard catalogues. Imports are validated by the
 * backend (no markup, known keys); missing keys fall back to English.
 */
export function LanguagesManager() {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useFormatter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [languages, setLanguages] = useState<Language[]>([]);
  const [locale, setLocale] = useState('');
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [importErrors, setImportErrors] = useState<{ locale: string; issues: string[] } | null>(null);
  const fileInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const importTarget = useRef<string>('');

  const load = useCallback(() => api<Language[]>('/i18n/languages').then(setLanguages).catch(() => undefined), []);
  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  async function run(action: () => Promise<unknown>, success = t('settings.saved')) {
    try {
      await action();
      toast(success);
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof ApiError && err.code === 'LANGUAGE_EXISTS') toast(t('languages.exists'), 'error');
      else toast(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`), 'error');
    }
  }

  async function create(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    await run(() => api('/i18n/languages', { method: 'POST', body: { locale, name: name.trim() } }), t('languages.created'));
    setLocale('');
    setName('');
  }

  async function exportCatalog(code: string) {
    try {
      const catalog = await api<unknown>(`/i18n/catalogs/${code}`);
      downloadFile(`${code}.json`, `${JSON.stringify(catalog, null, 2)}\n`, 'application/json');
    } catch (err) {
      toast(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`), 'error');
    }
  }

  function chooseFile(code: string) {
    importTarget.current = code;
    setImportErrors(null);
    fileInput.current?.click();
  }

  async function importFile(file: File | undefined) {
    const code = importTarget.current;
    if (!file || !code) return;
    if (file.size > MAX_IMPORT_BYTES) {
      toast(t('languages.tooLarge'), 'error');
      return;
    }
    let messages: unknown;
    try {
      messages = JSON.parse(await file.text());
    } catch {
      toast(t('languages.invalidJson'), 'error');
      return;
    }
    try {
      const result = await api<{ missingKeys: number }>(`/i18n/catalogs/${code}`, { method: 'PUT', body: { messages } });
      toast(t('languages.imported', { count: result.missingKeys }));
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof ApiError && err.code === 'INVALID_CATALOG') {
        setImportErrors({ locale: code, issues: (err.issues ?? []).map((i) => `${i.path}: ${t(`languages.problems.${i.message as 'unsafe-content'}`)}`) });
      } else toast(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`), 'error');
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t('settings.languages')}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t('languages.description')}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="grid gap-4">
        <input
          ref={fileInput}
          type="file"
          accept="application/json,.json"
          className="hidden"
          onChange={(e) => {
            void importFile(e.target.files?.[0]);
            e.target.value = '';
          }}
        />
        {importErrors && (
          <Alert variant="destructive" className="grid gap-1">
            <span className="font-medium">{t('languages.importFailed', { locale: importErrors.locale })}</span>
            <ul className="list-inside list-disc text-xs">
              {importErrors.issues.slice(0, 10).map((issue) => (
                <li key={issue} className="break-all">
                  {issue}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </Alert>
        )}
        <ul className="grid gap-2">
          {languages.map((l) => (
            <li key={l.locale} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3">
              <div className="min-w-40 flex-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-medium">
                  {l.nativeName}
                  {!l.bundled && <Badge variant="info">{t('languages.added')}</Badge>}
                  {l.customized && <Badge>{t('languages.customized')}</Badge>}
                </div>
                <div className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {l.locale}
                  {l.customUpdatedAt && <span className="ml-2 font-sans">{t('languages.importedAt', { time: format.dateTime(new Date(l.customUpdatedAt), { dateStyle: 'medium' }) })}</span>}
                </div>
              </div>
              {typeof l.missingKeys === 'number' && <Badge variant={l.missingKeys === 0 ? 'default' : 'warning'}>{t('settings.missingKeys', { count: l.missingKeys })}</Badge>}
              {l.isDefault ? (
                <Badge variant="info">{t('settings.default')}</Badge>
              ) : (
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => void run(() => api(`/i18n/languages/${l.locale}`, { method: 'PATCH', body: { isDefault: true } }))}>
                  {t('settings.setDefault')}
                </Button>
              )}
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                <Switch
                  checked={l.enabled}
                  disabled={l.isDefault}
                  onCheckedChange={(v) => void run(() => api(`/i18n/languages/${l.locale}`, { method: 'PATCH', body: { enabled: v } }))}
                  aria-label={t('settings.enabled')}
                />
                {t('settings.enabled')}
              </label>
              <div className="flex gap-1">
                <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" title={t('languages.export')} onClick={() => void exportCatalog(l.locale)}>
                  <Download aria-hidden />
                  <span className="sr-only">{t('languages.export')}</span>
                </Button>
                <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" title={t('languages.import')} onClick={() => chooseFile(l.locale)}>
                  <Upload aria-hidden />
                  <span className="sr-only">{t('languages.import')}</span>
                </Button>
                {l.customized && l.bundled && (
                  <ConfirmDialog
                    trigger={
                      <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" title={t('languages.reset')}>
                        <RotateCcw aria-hidden />
                        <span className="sr-only">{t('languages.reset')}</span>
                      </Button>
                    }
                    title={t('languages.resetTitle', { language: l.nativeName })}
                    description={t('languages.resetDescription')}
                    confirmLabel={t('languages.reset')}
                    onConfirm={() => run(() => api(`/i18n/catalogs/${l.locale}`, { method: 'DELETE' }))}
                  />
                )}
                {!l.bundled && !l.isDefault && (
                  <ConfirmDialog
                    trigger={
                      <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" title={t('common.delete')}>
                        <Trash2 aria-hidden />
                        <span className="sr-only">{t('common.delete')}</span>
                      </Button>
                    }
                    title={t('languages.deleteTitle', { language: l.nativeName })}
                    description={t('languages.deleteDescription')}
                    confirmLabel={t('common.delete')}
                    destructive
                    onConfirm={() => run(() => api(`/i18n/languages/${l.locale}`, { method: 'DELETE' }))}
                  />
                )}
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>

        <form onSubmit={create} className="grid gap-3 rounded-lg border border-dashed p-4 sm:grid-cols-[160px_1fr_auto] sm:items-end">
          <Field label={t('languages.code')} htmlFor="lang-code">
            <Input id="lang-code" placeholder="fr-FR" title={t('languages.codeHint')} value={locale} onChange={(e) => setLocale(e.target.value.trim())} maxLength={16} />
          </Field>
          <Field label={t('languages.name')} htmlFor="lang-name">
            <Input id="lang-name" placeholder="Français" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} maxLength={64} />
          </Field>
          <Button type="submit" disabled={!LOCALE_PATTERN.test(locale) || !name.trim()}>
            <Plus aria-hidden />
            {t('languages.add')}
          </Button>
        </form>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t('languages.workflow')}</p>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/components/logo.tsx`:

```tsx
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

// 8x8 pixel grass block: top rows grass, the rest dirt. Purely decorative.
const PIXELS = [
  'GGGGGGGG',
  'GgGGgGGG',
  'GGdGGGgG',
  'dDdddDdd',
  'ddDddddD',
  'dddDdDdd',
  'dDdddddd',
  'ddddDddD',
];
const COLORS: Record<string, string> = { G: '#5dbb46', g: '#4a9e36', d: '#8b5a2b', D: '#6e4521' };

export function Logo({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 8 8" className={cn('pixelated size-8 shrink-0 rounded-sm', className)} aria-hidden shapeRendering="crispEdges">
      {PIXELS.flatMap((row, y) => [...row].map((c, x) => <rect key={`${x}-${y}`} x={x} y={y} width="1" height="1" fill={COLORS[c]} />))}
    </svg>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/components/minecraft-integration.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { Check, CheckCircle2, Copy, Download, FileArchive, Loader2, Server, ShieldAlert, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useFormatter, useNow, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { type ReactNode, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useToast } from '@/components/toaster';
import { Alert, Badge, Button, buttonVariants, Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, Field, Input, Select } from '@/components/ui/primitives';
import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch';
import { api, errorKey, type Language, type RegistrationStatus, type RegistrationTokenResult, type SetupStatus } from '@/lib/api';
import {
  configPath,
  defaultOptions,
  generateConfig,
  installGuide,
  isInsecureUrl,
  type PluginConfigOptions,
  type PluginKind,
  RANGES,
  STATISTIC_CATEGORIES,
  validateOptions,
} from '@/lib/plugin-config';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { createZip, downloadFile } from '@/lib/zip';

const NAME_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{2,64}$/;

/**
 * Settings → Minecraft integration: add a server step by step (type and name,
 * plugin options, registration token, install, confirmation) and generate
 * configurations for existing servers without a token.
 */
export function MinecraftIntegration() {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [version, setVersion] = useState('');
  const [languages, setLanguages] = useState<Language[]>([]);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [options, setOptions] = useState<PluginConfigOptions>(() => defaultOptions('PAPER', ''));
  const [token, setToken] = useState<RegistrationTokenResult | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [pendingKey, setPendingKey] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    api<SetupStatus>('/setup/status').then((s) => setVersion(s.version)).catch(() => undefined);
    api<Language[]>('/i18n/languages').then(setLanguages).catch(() => undefined);
    api<{ dashboardUrl: string }>('/settings/network')
      .then((n) => setOptions((o) => ({ ...o, backendUrl: o.backendUrl || n.dashboardUrl || window.location.origin })))
      .catch(() => setOptions((o) => ({ ...o, backendUrl: o.backendUrl || window.location.origin })));
  }, []);

  const set = <K extends keyof PluginConfigOptions>(key: K, value: PluginConfigOptions[K]) => setOptions((o) => ({ ...o, [key]: value }));
  const problems = validateOptions(options);
  const nameValid = NAME_PATTERN.test(name.trim());
  const effective = useMemo(() => ({ ...options, registrationToken: token?.token ?? '' }), [options, token]);
  const config = useMemo(() => generateConfig(effective), [effective]);

  function switchKind(kind: PluginKind) {
    if (token) return;
    setOptions((o) => ({ ...defaultOptions(kind, o.backendUrl), language: o.language, debug: o.debug, managedSettings: o.managedSettings }));
  }

  async function createToken() {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      setToken(await api<RegistrationTokenResult>('/servers/registration-tokens', { method: 'POST', body: { type: options.kind, name: name.trim() } }));
      setPendingKey((k) => k + 1);
    } catch (err) {
      toast(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`), 'error');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  function reset() {
    setToken(null);
    setName('');
    setPendingKey((k) => k + 1);
  }

  const fileBase = (name.trim() || options.kind.toLowerCase()).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]/g, '_');

  function downloadZip() {
    const folder = configPath(options.kind).replace(/\/config\.properties$/, '');
    const zip = createZip([
      { name: `${folder}/config.properties`, content: config },
      { name: 'INSTALL.md', content: installGuide(effective, name.trim() || options.kind, version || 'x.y.z', token?.expiresAt ?? null) },
    ]);
    downloadFile(`networkmanager-${fileBase}.zip`, zip, 'application/zip');
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{t('integration.title')}</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>{t('integration.description')}</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="grid gap-6">
          <Steps current={token ? 3 : nameValid ? 2 : 1} />

          <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
            <div className="grid content-start gap-5">
              <Section title={t('integration.server')}>
                <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[220px_1fr]">
                  <Field label={t('settings.serverType')} htmlFor="int-kind">
                    <Select id="int-kind" value={options.kind} disabled={Boolean(token)} onChange={(e) => switchKind(e.target.value as PluginKind)}>
                      <option value="VELOCITY">{t('integration.velocity')}</option>
                      <option value="PAPER">{t('integration.paper')}</option>
                    </Select>
                  </Field>
                  <Field label={options.kind === 'VELOCITY' ? t('integration.proxyName') : t('settings.serverName')} hint={t('integration.nameHint')} htmlFor="int-name">
                    <Input id="int-name" placeholder={options.kind === 'VELOCITY' ? 'proxy-1' : 'lobby-1'} value={name} disabled={Boolean(token)} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} maxLength={64} />
                  </Field>
                </div>
              </Section>

              <Section title={t('integration.connection')}>
                <Field
                  label={t('integration.backendUrl')}
                  hint={t('integration.backendUrlHint')}
                  error={problems.includes('backendUrl') ? t('integration.problems.backendUrl') : problems.includes('backendUrlPath') ? t('integration.problems.backendUrlPath') : null}
                  htmlFor="int-url"
                >
                  <Input id="int-url" value={options.backendUrl} onChange={(e) => set('backendUrl', e.target.value)} />
                </Field>
                <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <Field label={t('integration.connectionMode')} htmlFor="int-mode">
                    <Select
                      id="int-mode"
                      value={options.backendUrl.startsWith('https://') ? 'https' : 'http'}
                      onChange={(e) => set('backendUrl', options.backendUrl.replace(/^https?:\/\//, `${e.target.value}://`))}
                    >
                      <option value="https">{t('integration.modeHttps')}</option>
                      <option value="http">{t('integration.modeHttp')}</option>
                    </Select>
                  </Field>
                  <Field label={t('integration.language')} hint={t('integration.languageHint')} htmlFor="int-lang">
                    <Select id="int-lang" value={options.language} onChange={(e) => set('language', e.target.value)}>
                      {(languages.length ? languages : [{ locale: 'en-US', nativeName: 'English (US)' }]).map((l) => (
                        <option key={l.locale} value={l.locale}>
                          {l.nativeName}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </Select>
                  </Field>
                </div>
                {isInsecureUrl(options.backendUrl) && (
                  <Alert variant="destructive" className="flex gap-2">
                    <ShieldAlert aria-hidden className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" />
                    {t('integration.insecure')}
                  </Alert>
                )}
                <NumberField id="int-hb" label={t('integration.heartbeat')} value={options.heartbeatIntervalSeconds} range={RANGES.heartbeatIntervalSeconds} onChange={(v) => set('heartbeatIntervalSeconds', v)} />
              </Section>

              <Section title={t('integration.moderation')}>
                <Toggle label={t('integration.punishments')} hint={t('integration.punishmentsHint')} checked={options.punishmentsEnabled} onChange={(v) => set('punishmentsEnabled', v)} />
                {options.kind === 'VELOCITY' && (
                  <Toggle label={t('integration.commands')} hint={t('integration.commandsHint')} checked={options.moderationCommands} disabled={!options.punishmentsEnabled} onChange={(v) => set('moderationCommands', v)} />
                )}
              </Section>

              {options.kind === 'VELOCITY' ? (
                <Section title={t('integration.proxy')}>
                  <NumberField id="int-sync" label={t('integration.syncInterval')} hint={t('integration.syncIntervalHint')} value={options.syncIntervalSeconds} range={RANGES.syncIntervalSeconds} onChange={(v) => set('syncIntervalSeconds', v)} />
                  <Toggle label={t('integration.collectIps')} hint={t('integration.collectIpsHint')} checked={options.collectIpAddresses} onChange={(v) => set('collectIpAddresses', v)} />
                </Section>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Section title={t('integration.statistics')}>
                    <Toggle label={t('integration.statisticsEnabled')} checked={options.statisticsEnabled} onChange={(v) => set('statisticsEnabled', v)} />
                    <fieldset className="grid gap-2" disabled={!options.statisticsEnabled}>
                      <legend className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium">{t('integration.categories')}</legend>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-5 gap-y-2">
                        {STATISTIC_CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
                          <label key={c} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                            <input
                              type="checkbox"
                              className="size-4 accent-primary"
                              checked={options.statisticsCategories.includes(c)}
                              onChange={(e) => set('statisticsCategories', e.target.checked ? [...options.statisticsCategories, c] : options.statisticsCategories.filter((x) => x !== c))}
                            />
                            {t(`integration.category.${c}`)}
                          </label>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </fieldset>
                    <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                      <NumberField id="int-stat" label={t('integration.statisticsInterval')} value={options.statisticsIntervalSeconds} range={RANGES.statisticsIntervalSeconds} onChange={(v) => set('statisticsIntervalSeconds', v)} />
                      <NumberField id="int-afk" label={t('integration.afkTimeout')} value={options.afkTimeoutSeconds} range={RANGES.afkTimeoutSeconds} onChange={(v) => set('afkTimeoutSeconds', v)} />
                    </div>
                  </Section>
                  <Section title={t('integration.inventories')}>
                    <Toggle label={t('integration.inventorySync')} checked={options.inventorySync} onChange={(v) => set('inventorySync', v)} />
                    <Toggle label={t('integration.enderChestSync')} checked={options.enderChestSync} onChange={(v) => set('enderChestSync', v)} />
                    <NumberField id="int-inv" label={t('integration.inventoryInterval')} value={options.inventorySyncIntervalSeconds} range={RANGES.inventorySyncIntervalSeconds} onChange={(v) => set('inventorySyncIntervalSeconds', v)} />
                  </Section>
                  <Section title={t('integration.anticheat')}>
                    <Field label={t('integration.integrations')} hint={t('integration.integrationsHint')} error={problems.includes('integrations') ? t('integration.problems.integrations') : null} htmlFor="int-ac">
                      <Input id="int-ac" placeholder="Grim, Vulcan" value={options.anticheatIntegrations} onChange={(e) => set('anticheatIntegrations', e.target.value)} />
                    </Field>
                    <NumberField id="int-acr" label={t('integration.maxReports')} value={options.anticheatMaxReportsPerMinute} range={RANGES.anticheatMaxReportsPerMinute} onChange={(v) => set('anticheatMaxReportsPerMinute', v)} />
                  </Section>
                </>
              )}

              <Section title={t('integration.advanced')}>
                <Toggle label={t('integration.managed')} hint={t('integration.managedHint')} checked={options.managedSettings} onChange={(v) => set('managedSettings', v)} />
                <Toggle label={t('integration.debug')} checked={options.debug} onChange={(v) => set('debug', v)} />
              </Section>
            </div>

            <div className="grid content-start gap-4 xl:sticky xl:top-20">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="text-sm font-medium">
                  {t('integration.preview')} <code className="ml-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{configPath(options.kind)}</code>
                </div>
                <CopyButton text={config} disabled={problems.length > 0} />
              </div>
              <pre className="max-h-[480px] overflow-auto rounded-lg border bg-muted/40 p-4 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed" aria-label={t('integration.preview')}>
                {config}
              </pre>
              {problems.includes('range') && <Alert variant="destructive">{t('integration.problems.range')}</Alert>}

              {!token ? (
                <Alert className="grid gap-3">
                  <span>{t('integration.tokenExplanation')}</span>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <Button onClick={() => void createToken()} disabled={busy || !nameValid || problems.length > 0}>
                      {busy ? <Loader2 aria-hidden className="animate-spin" /> : <Server aria-hidden />}
                      {t('integration.createToken')}
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => downloadFile('config.properties', config, 'text/plain')} disabled={problems.length > 0}>
                      <Download aria-hidden />
                      {t('integration.downloadWithoutToken')}
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                  {!nameValid && name.length > 0 && <span className="text-xs text-destructive">{t('integration.problems.name')}</span>}
                </Alert>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <Button onClick={downloadZip}>
                      <FileArchive aria-hidden />
                      {t('integration.downloadZip')}
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => downloadFile('config.properties', config, 'text/plain')}>
                      <Download aria-hidden />
                      {t('integration.downloadConfig')}
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                  <RegistrationProgress token={token} onReset={reset} />
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <PendingTokens refreshKey={pendingKey} />
    </div>
  );
}

function Steps({ current }: { current: number }) {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const steps = [t('integration.steps.server'), t('integration.steps.options'), t('integration.steps.install')];
  return (
    <ol className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-sm">
      {steps.map((label, i) => (
        <li
          key={label}
          aria-current={i + 1 === current ? 'step' : undefined}
          className={cn('flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-3 py-1', i + 1 === current ? 'border-primary bg-primary/10 font-medium' : i + 1 < current ? 'text-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground')}
        >
          <span className={cn('grid size-5 place-items-center rounded-full text-xs', i + 1 < current ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'bg-muted')}>{i + 1 < current ? <Check aria-hidden className="size-3" /> : i + 1}</span>
          {label}
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}

function RegistrationProgress({ token, onReset }: { token: RegistrationTokenResult; onReset: () => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 15_000 });
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<RegistrationStatus | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let stopped = false;
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
    const poll = async () => {
      try {
        const next = await api<RegistrationStatus>(`/servers/registration-tokens/${token.id}`);
        if (stopped) return;
        setStatus(next);
        // Keep polling until the server sent its first heartbeat (or the token expired).
        if (next.status === 'EXPIRED' || next.server?.lastHeartbeatAt) return;
      } catch {
        // retry below
      }
      if (!stopped) timer = setTimeout(() => void poll(), 3_000);
    };
    void poll();
    return () => {
      stopped = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [token.id]);

  const registered = status?.status === 'REGISTERED';
  const connected = Boolean(status?.server?.lastHeartbeatAt);
  const expired = status?.status === 'EXPIRED';

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 rounded-lg border p-4" aria-live="polite">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="font-medium">{t('integration.progress.title', { name: token.serverName })}</div>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onReset}>
          {t('integration.addAnother')}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <ProgressItem done>{t('integration.progress.token', { time: format.relativeTime(new Date(token.expiresAt), now) })}</ProgressItem>
      <ProgressItem done={registered} waiting={!registered && !expired}>
        {t('integration.progress.install', { path: configPath(token.serverType) })}
      </ProgressItem>
      <ProgressItem done={registered} waiting={!registered && !expired}>
        {registered ? t('integration.progress.registered', { version: status?.server?.pluginVersion ?? '?' }) : t('integration.progress.waitingRegistration')}
      </ProgressItem>
      <ProgressItem done={connected} waiting={registered && !connected}>
        {connected ? t('integration.progress.connected') : t('integration.progress.waitingHeartbeat')}
      </ProgressItem>
      {expired && <Alert variant="destructive">{t('integration.progress.expired')}</Alert>}
      {registered && status?.server && (
        <Link href={`/servers/${status.server.id}`} className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: 'outline', size: 'sm' }), 'justify-self-start')}>
          {t('integration.openServer')}
        </Link>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ProgressItem({ done, waiting, children }: { done: boolean; waiting?: boolean; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className={cn('flex items-start gap-2 text-sm', !done && !waiting && 'text-muted-foreground')}>
      {done ? (
        <CheckCircle2 aria-hidden className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-500" />
      ) : waiting ? (
        <Loader2 aria-hidden className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      ) : (
        <span aria-hidden className="mt-1 ml-1 size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/40" />
      )}
      <span>{children}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

interface PendingToken {
  id: string;
  serverType: 'VELOCITY' | 'PAPER';
  serverName: string;
  expiresAt: string;
}

function PendingTokens({ refreshKey }: { refreshKey: number }) {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 30_000 });
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<PendingToken[]>([]);

  const load = useCallback(() => api<PendingToken[]>('/servers/registration-tokens').then(setPending).catch(() => undefined), []);
  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load, refreshKey]);

  async function revoke(id: string) {
    await api(`/servers/registration-tokens/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' }).catch(() => undefined);
    await load();
  }

  if (pending.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t('integration.pendingTitle')}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t('integration.pendingDescription')}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <ul className="grid gap-2">
          {pending.map((p) => (
            <li key={p.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border px-4 py-2 text-sm">
              <Badge variant={p.serverType === 'VELOCITY' ? 'info' : 'default'}>{p.serverType === 'VELOCITY' ? 'Velocity' : 'Paper'}</Badge>
              <span className="flex-1 font-medium">{p.serverName}</span>
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t('setup.velocity.expires', { time: format.relativeTime(new Date(p.expiresAt), now) })}</span>
              <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={() => void revoke(p.id)} title={t('integration.revokeToken')}>
                <Trash2 aria-hidden />
                <span className="sr-only">{t('integration.revokeToken')}</span>
              </Button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

function Section({ title, children }: { title: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <fieldset className="grid gap-3 rounded-lg border p-4">
      <legend className="px-1 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">{title}</legend>
      {children}
    </fieldset>
  );
}

export function Toggle({ label, hint, checked, disabled, onChange }: { label: string; hint?: string; checked: boolean; disabled?: boolean; onChange: (value: boolean) => void }) {
  return (
    <label className={cn('flex items-start justify-between gap-4 text-sm', disabled && 'opacity-50')}>
      <span className="grid gap-0.5">
        <span className="font-medium">{label}</span>
        {hint && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{hint}</span>}
      </span>
      <Switch checked={checked} disabled={disabled} onCheckedChange={onChange} aria-label={label} />
    </label>
  );
}

function NumberField({ id, label, hint, value, range, onChange }: { id: string; label: string; hint?: string; value: number; range: readonly [number, number]; onChange: (value: number) => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations();
  return (
    <Field label={label} hint={hint ?? t('integration.range', { min: range[0], max: range[1] })} htmlFor={id}>
      <Input id={id} type="number" min={range[0]} max={range[1]} value={Number.isFinite(value) ? value : ''} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.valueAsNumber)} />
    </Field>
  );
}

function CopyButton({ text, disabled }: { text: string; disabled?: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Button
      variant="outline"
      size="sm"
      disabled={disabled}
      onClick={() => {
        void navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        setCopied(true);
        setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
      }}
    >
      {copied ? <Check aria-hidden /> : <Copy aria-hidden />}
      {copied ? t('common.copied') : t('common.copy')}
    </Button>
  );
}
```
