`apps/dashboard/src/components/moderation-presets.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { splitDuration, TEMPORARY_TYPES, UNIT_SECONDS, type Unit } from '@/components/punishment-dialogs';
import { useToast } from '@/components/toaster';
import { Alert, Button, Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, Field, Input, Select, Textarea } from '@/components/ui/primitives';
import { api, errorKey, type ModerationPreset, type PunishmentType } from '@/lib/api';

const TYPES: PunishmentType[] = ['WARNING', 'KICK', 'TEMP_MUTE', 'MUTE', 'TEMP_BAN', 'BAN', 'BLACKLIST'];
const EXAMPLES: Omit<ModerationPreset, 'id'>[] = [
  { name: 'Spam', type: 'TEMP_MUTE', reason: 'Spamming in chat', durationSeconds: 3600 },
  { name: 'Insults', type: 'TEMP_MUTE', reason: 'Insulting other players', durationSeconds: 86_400 },
  { name: 'Griefing', type: 'TEMP_BAN', reason: 'Griefing', durationSeconds: 7 * 86_400 },
  { name: 'Cheating', type: 'TEMP_BAN', reason: 'Use of unfair modifications', durationSeconds: 30 * 86_400 },
];

const slug = (name: string, taken: Set<string>) => {
  const base = name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '').slice(0, 32) || 'preset';
  let id = base;
  for (let i = 2; taken.has(id); i++) id = `${base}-${i}`;
  return id;
};

/** Settings → Moderation: punishment templates (reason, type, duration) offered in the punishment dialog. */
export function ModerationPresets() {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [presets, setPresets] = useState<ModerationPreset[] | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    api<{ presets: ModerationPreset[] }>('/settings/moderation')
      .then((m) => {
        setPresets(m.presets);
        setSaved(JSON.stringify(m.presets));
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
  }, []);

  if (!presets) return null;
  const update = (index: number, patch: Partial<ModerationPreset>) => setPresets(presets.map((p, i) => (i === index ? { ...p, ...patch } : p)));
  const invalid = presets.some((p) => !p.name.trim() || !p.reason.trim() || (TEMPORARY_TYPES.includes(p.type) && !(p.durationSeconds && p.durationSeconds >= 60)));

  function add(example?: Omit<ModerationPreset, 'id'>) {
    if (!presets) return;
    const base = example ?? { name: '', type: 'WARNING' as const, reason: '', durationSeconds: null };
    setPresets([...presets, { ...base, id: slug(base.name || `preset-${presets.length + 1}`, new Set(presets.map((p) => p.id))) }]);
  }

  async function save() {
    if (!presets) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const body = { presets: presets.map((p) => ({ ...p, name: p.name.trim(), reason: p.reason.trim() })) };
      const result = await api<{ presets: ModerationPreset[] }>('/settings/moderation', { method: 'PUT', body });
      setPresets(result.presets);
      setSaved(JSON.stringify(result.presets));
      toast(t('settings.saved'));
    } catch (err) {
      toast(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`), 'error');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t('presets.title')}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t('presets.description')}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="grid gap-4">
        {presets.length === 0 && (
          <Alert className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            {t('presets.empty')}
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setPresets(EXAMPLES.map((e) => ({ ...e, id: slug(e.name, new Set()) })))}>
              {t('presets.insertExamples')}
            </Button>
          </Alert>
        )}
        <ul className="grid gap-3">
          {presets.map((p, i) => {
            const temporary = TEMPORARY_TYPES.includes(p.type);
            const split = splitDuration(p.durationSeconds ?? 86_400);
            return (
              <li key={p.id} className="grid gap-3 rounded-lg border p-4">
                <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_180px_220px_auto] sm:items-end">
                  <Field label={t('presets.name')} htmlFor={`pr-name-${i}`}>
                    <Input id={`pr-name-${i}`} value={p.name} maxLength={64} onChange={(e) => update(i, { name: e.target.value })} />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label={t('moderation.type')} htmlFor={`pr-type-${i}`}>
                    <Select
                      id={`pr-type-${i}`}
                      value={p.type}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const type = e.target.value as PunishmentType;
                        update(i, { type, durationSeconds: TEMPORARY_TYPES.includes(type) ? (p.durationSeconds ?? 86_400) : null });
                      }}
                    >
                      {TYPES.map((ty) => (
                        <option key={ty} value={ty}>
                          {t(`moderation.types.${ty}`)}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </Select>
                  </Field>
                  {temporary ? (
                    <Field label={t('moderation.duration')} htmlFor={`pr-amount-${i}`}>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        <Input id={`pr-amount-${i}`} type="number" min={1} max={5000} value={split.amount} onChange={(e) => update(i, { durationSeconds: Math.max(1, e.target.valueAsNumber || 1) * UNIT_SECONDS[split.unit] })} />
                        <Select aria-label={t('moderation.unit')} value={split.unit} onChange={(e) => update(i, { durationSeconds: split.amount * UNIT_SECONDS[e.target.value as Unit] })}>
                          {(Object.keys(UNIT_SECONDS) as Unit[]).map((u) => (
                            <option key={u} value={u}>
                              {t(`moderation.units.${u}`)}
                            </option>
                          ))}
                        </Select>
                      </div>
                    </Field>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="hidden sm:block" />
                  )}
                  <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={() => setPresets(presets.filter((_, j) => j !== i))} title={t('common.delete')}>
                    <Trash2 aria-hidden />
                    <span className="sr-only">{t('common.delete')}</span>
                  </Button>
                </div>
                <Field label={t('moderation.reason')} htmlFor={`pr-reason-${i}`}>
                  <Textarea id={`pr-reason-${i}`} rows={2} value={p.reason} maxLength={500} onChange={(e) => update(i, { reason: e.target.value })} />
                </Field>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => add()} disabled={presets.length >= 50}>
            <Plus aria-hidden />
            {t('presets.add')}
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={() => void save()} disabled={busy || invalid || JSON.stringify(presets) === saved}>
            {busy ? t('common.saving') : t('common.save')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useFormatter, useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Bar, BarChart, CartesianGrid, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, XAxis, YAxis } from 'recharts';
import { api } from '@/lib/api';
import { useDuration } from '@/lib/format';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, Skeleton } from './ui/primitives';

interface ActivityReport {
  timezone: string;
  daily: { date: string; seconds: number }[];
  heatmap: number[][];
  totalSeconds: number;
  sessions: number;
  averageSessionSeconds: number | null;
}

const RANGES = [7, 30, 90] as const;

/** Locale-correct short weekday names, Monday first (2024-01-01 was a Monday). */
function useWeekdays() {
  const locale = useLocale();
  return useMemo(() => Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { weekday: 'short', timeZone: 'UTC' }).format(new Date(Date.UTC(2024, 0, 1 + i)))), [locale]);
}

export function PlayerActivity({ uuid }: { uuid: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useFormatter();
  const duration = useDuration();
  const weekdays = useWeekdays();
  const [days, setDays] = useState<(typeof RANGES)[number]>(30);
  const [data, setData] = useState<ActivityReport | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setData(null);
    void api<ActivityReport>(`/players/${uuid}/activity?days=${days}`).then(setData).catch(() => undefined);
  }, [uuid, days]);

  const chart = useMemo(
    () => (data?.daily ?? []).map((d) => ({ label: format.dateTime(new Date(`${d.date}T12:00:00Z`), { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' }), hours: Math.round((d.seconds / 3600) * 10) / 10, seconds: d.seconds })),
    [data, format],
  );
  const maxCell = Math.max(1, ...(data?.heatmap.flat() ?? [0]));

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div role="radiogroup" className="inline-flex rounded-md border p-0.5">
          {RANGES.map((r) => (
            <button
              key={r}
              type="button"
              role="radio"
              aria-checked={days === r}
              onClick={() => setDays(r)}
              className={cn('rounded px-3 py-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground', days === r && 'bg-accent text-accent-foreground')}
            >
              {t('activity.range', { days: r })}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        {data && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t('activity.timezone', { timezone: data.timezone })}</p>}
      </div>

      {!data ? (
        <Skeleton className="h-72" />
      ) : (
        <>
          <dl className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
            {[
              [t('activity.total'), duration(data.totalSeconds)],
              [t('activity.sessions'), format.number(data.sessions)],
              [t('activity.average'), data.averageSessionSeconds === null ? '–' : duration(data.averageSessionSeconds)],
            ].map(([label, value]) => (
              <div key={label} className="rounded-lg border px-4 py-3">
                <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{label}</dt>
                <dd className="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums">{value}</dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>

          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>{t('activity.dailyPlaytime')}</CardTitle>
              {data.sessions === 0 && <CardDescription>{t('activity.noData')}</CardDescription>}
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="h-64">
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                <BarChart data={chart} margin={{ top: 4, right: 8, left: -16, bottom: 0 }}>
                  <CartesianGrid vertical={false} stroke="var(--border)" />
                  <XAxis dataKey="label" tick={{ fill: 'var(--muted-foreground)', fontSize: 11 }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} interval="preserveStartEnd" minTickGap={16} />
                  <YAxis tick={{ fill: 'var(--muted-foreground)', fontSize: 11 }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} allowDecimals={false} />
                  <Tooltip
                    cursor={{ fill: 'var(--accent)' }}
                    contentStyle={{ background: 'var(--card)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 8, color: 'var(--foreground)' }}
                    formatter={(_value, _name, item) => [duration((item.payload as { seconds: number }).seconds), t('players.playtime')]}
                  />
                  <Bar dataKey="hours" fill="var(--primary)" radius={[3, 3, 0, 0]} maxBarSize={28} />
                </BarChart>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>{t('activity.heatmap')}</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="border-separate border-spacing-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th />
                    {Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, h) => (
                      <th key={h} className="w-5 font-normal">
                        {h % 3 === 0 ? h : ''}
                      </th>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {data.heatmap.map((row, d) => (
                    <tr key={d}>
                      <th scope="row" className="pr-2 text-right font-normal">
                        {weekdays[d]}
                      </th>
                      {row.map((seconds, h) => (
                        <td
                          key={h}
                          title={`${weekdays[d]} ${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:00 · ${duration(seconds)}`}
                          className="size-5 rounded-sm"
                          style={{ background: seconds ? `color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) ${Math.round(15 + (seconds / maxCell) * 85)}%, transparent)` : 'var(--muted)' }}
                        />
                      ))}
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/components/player-connections.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useFormatter, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api, type Page } from '@/lib/api';
import { useDuration } from '@/lib/format';
import { PlayerHead } from './player-skin';
import { Alert, Button, Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, Skeleton, StatusDot } from './ui/primitives';
import { TBody, TD, TH, THead, TR, Table } from './ui/table';

interface Location {
  countryCode: string | null;
  region: string | null;
  city: string | null;
  isp: string | null;
  asn: number | null;
}

interface ConnectionsResponse extends Page<{
  id: string;
  connectedAt: string;
  endedAt: string | null;
  durationSeconds: number | null;
  proxy: string | null;
  clientProtocol: number | null;
  clientBrand: string | null;
  ipAddress?: string | null;
  virtualHost?: string | null;
  location?: Location;
}> {
  canViewIp: boolean;
  canViewLocation: boolean;
  geoipEnabled: boolean;
  ipSummary?: { ipAddress: string; connections: number; firstSeenAt: string; lastSeenAt: string; location?: Location }[];
  relatedAccounts?: { uuid: string; username: string; online: boolean; connections: number; lastSeenAt: string }[];
}

const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

/** Localized country name from an ISO code, e.g. "DE" → "Germany" / "Deutschland". */
function countryNameFor(code: string | null, locale: string): string | null {
  if (!code) return null;
  try {
    return new Intl.DisplayNames([locale], { type: 'region' }).of(code) ?? code;
  } catch {
    return code;
  }
}

function describe(loc: Location | undefined, countryName: (code: string | null) => string | null): string {
  if (!loc) return '–';
  return [loc.city, loc.region, countryName(loc.countryCode)].filter(Boolean).join(', ') || '–';
}

export function PlayerConnections({ uuid, locale }: { uuid: string; locale: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useFormatter();
  const duration = useDuration();
  const countryName = (code: string | null) => countryNameFor(code, locale);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [data, setData] = useState<ConnectionsResponse | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    void api<ConnectionsResponse>(`/players/${uuid}/connections?page=${page}&pageSize=${PAGE_SIZE}`).then(setData).catch(() => undefined);
  }, [uuid, page]);

  if (!data) return <Skeleton className="h-64" />;
  const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(data.total / PAGE_SIZE));
  const date = (iso: string) => format.dateTime(new Date(iso), { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' });

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6 [&>*]:min-w-0">
      {!data.canViewIp && <Alert>{t('connections.ipPermission')}</Alert>}
      {data.canViewIp && !data.canViewLocation && <Alert>{t('connections.locationPermission')}</Alert>}
      {data.canViewLocation && !data.geoipEnabled && <Alert>{t('connections.geoipDisabled')}</Alert>}

      {data.ipSummary && (
        <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2 [&>*]:min-w-0">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>{t('connections.ipAddresses')}</CardTitle>
              {data.canViewLocation && <CardDescription>{t('connections.approximate')}</CardDescription>}
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="px-0">
              <Table>
                <THead>
                  <TR>
                    <TH>IP</TH>
                    {data.canViewLocation && <TH>{t('connections.location')}</TH>}
                    <TH className="text-right">{t('players.connections')}</TH>
                    <TH>{t('players.lastSeen')}</TH>
                  </TR>
                </THead>
                <TBody>
                  {data.ipSummary.map((ip) => (
                    <TR key={ip.ipAddress}>
                      <TD className="font-mono text-xs">{ip.ipAddress}</TD>
                      {data.canViewLocation && (
                        <TD className="min-w-40 text-xs">
                          {describe(ip.location, countryName)}
                          {ip.location?.isp && <span className="block text-muted-foreground">{ip.location.isp}</span>}
                        </TD>
                      )}
                      <TD className="text-right tabular-nums">{ip.connections}</TD>
                      <TD className="whitespace-nowrap text-muted-foreground">{date(ip.lastSeenAt)}</TD>
                    </TR>
                  ))}
                </TBody>
              </Table>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>{t('connections.relatedAccounts')}</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>{t('connections.relatedHint')}</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              {!data.relatedAccounts?.length ? (
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('connections.noRelated')}</p>
              ) : (
                <ul className="grid gap-2">
                  {data.relatedAccounts.map((a) => (
                    <li key={a.uuid}>
                      <Link href={`/players/${a.uuid}`} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-md border px-3 py-2 hover:bg-accent">
                        <PlayerHead uuid={a.uuid} username={a.username} size={28} />
                        <span className="flex-1 font-medium">{a.username}</span>
                        <StatusDot state={a.online ? 'up' : 'down'} />
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t('connections.count', { count: a.connections })}</span>
                      </Link>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>{t('connections.history')}</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="px-0">
          <Table>
            <THead>
              <TR>
                <TH>{t('connections.connected')}</TH>
                <TH>{t('profile.duration')}</TH>
                <TH>{t('profile.proxy')}</TH>
                <TH>{t('connections.client')}</TH>
                {data.canViewIp && <TH>IP</TH>}
                {data.canViewIp && <TH>{t('connections.joinedVia')}</TH>}
                {data.canViewLocation && <TH>{t('connections.location')}</TH>}
              </TR>
            </THead>
            <TBody>
              {data.items.map((c) => (
                <TR key={c.id}>
                  <TD className="whitespace-nowrap">{date(c.connectedAt)}</TD>
                  <TD className="whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums">{c.endedAt ? duration(c.durationSeconds ?? 0) : t('profile.ongoing')}</TD>
                  <TD>{c.proxy ?? '–'}</TD>
                  <TD className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs">
                    {c.clientBrand ?? '–'}
                    {c.clientProtocol !== null && <span className="block text-muted-foreground">protocol {c.clientProtocol}</span>}
                  </TD>
                  {data.canViewIp && <TD className="font-mono text-xs">{c.ipAddress ?? <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t('connections.anonymised')}</span>}</TD>}
                  {data.canViewIp && <TD className="text-xs">{c.virtualHost ?? '–'}</TD>}
                  {data.canViewLocation && <TD className="min-w-40 text-xs">{describe(c.location, countryName)}</TD>}
                </TR>
              ))}
            </TBody>
          </Table>
          {pages > 1 && (
            <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-end gap-3 px-5 text-sm">
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={page <= 1} onClick={() => setPage(page - 1)}>
                {t('common.previous')}
              </Button>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t('common.page', { page, pages })}</span>
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={page >= pages} onClick={() => setPage(page + 1)}>
                {t('common.next')}
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
const PAGE_SIZE = 25;
type Sort = 'lastSeen' | 'firstSeen' | 'username' | 'playtime';

/** Player search and listing. `onlineOnly` turns it into the live "Online Players" view. */
export function PlayerList({ onlineOnly }: { onlineOnly: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 30_000 });
  const duration = useDuration();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<Sort>(onlineOnly ? 'username' : 'lastSeen');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [data, setData] = useState<Page<PlayerListItem> | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page), pageSize: String(PAGE_SIZE), sort });
    if (search) params.set('search', search);
    if (onlineOnly) params.set('online', 'true');
    try {
      setData(await api<Page<PlayerListItem>>(`/players?${params}`));
      setError(null);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`));
    }
  }, [page, sort, search, onlineOnly, t]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setTimeout(() => {
      setPage(1);
      setSearch(query.trim());
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [query]);

  const live = useLiveRefresh(['player.online', 'player.offline', 'player.updated'], load, onlineOnly ? 30_000 : 120_000);
  const pages = data ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(data.total / PAGE_SIZE)) : 1;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={onlineOnly ? t('players.onlineTitle') : t('players.title')}
        subtitle={onlineOnly ? t('players.onlineSubtitle') : t('players.subtitle')}
        actions={
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {data && <Badge variant="muted">{t('players.count', { count: data.total })}</Badge>}
            {live && (
              <Badge>
                <Radio className="size-3" aria-hidden /> {t('players.live')}
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>
        }
      />

      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <label className="relative min-w-64 flex-1">
          <span className="sr-only">{t('players.search')}</span>
          <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
          <Input className="pl-9" placeholder={t('players.search')} value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} maxLength={36} />
        </label>
        <Select aria-label={t('players.sort')} className="w-48" value={sort} onChange={(e) => setSort(e.target.value as Sort)}>
          <option value="lastSeen">{t('players.sortLastSeen')}</option>
          <option value="firstSeen">{t('players.sortFirstSeen')}</option>
          <option value="username">{t('players.sortUsername')}</option>
          <option value="playtime">{t('players.sortPlaytime')}</option>
        </Select>
      </div>

      {error && <Alert variant="destructive" className="mb-4">{error}</Alert>}

      <Card>
        {!data ? (
          <div className="grid gap-2 p-5">
            {Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => (

        ) : data.items.length === 0 ? (

                      <PlayerHead uuid={p.uuid} username={p.username} />

                      </span>
                    </Link>
                  </TD>
                  <TD>
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap">
                      <StatusDot state={p.online ? 'up' : 'down'} />
                      {p.online ? (p.currentServer?.name ?? t('common.online')) : t('common.offline')}
                    </span>
                  </TD>
                  <TD className="text-muted-foreground">{p.online ? t('common.online') : format.relativeTime(new Date(p.lastSeenAt), now)}</TD>
                  <TD className="hidden text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">{format.dateTime(new Date(p.firstSeenAt), { dateStyle: 'medium' })}</TD>
                  <TD className="text-right tabular-nums">{duration(p.totalPlaytimeSeconds)}</TD>
                </TR>
              ))}

      {data && pages > 1 && (
```

```tsx
import { PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { Gavel, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useFormatter, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { type FormEvent, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api, errorKey, type PlayerNote, type PlayerPunishments } from '@/lib/api';

/** Internal staff notes. Authors can delete their own notes. */
export function PlayerNotes({ uuid }: { uuid: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useFormatter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { user, can } = useAuth();
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<PlayerNote[] | null>(null);
  const [content, setContent] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setNotes(await api<PlayerNote[]>(`/players/${uuid}/notes`).catch(() => []));
  }, [uuid]);
  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  async function add(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await api(`/players/${uuid}/notes`, { method: 'POST', body: { content: content.trim() } });
      setContent('');
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`), 'error');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function remove(id: string) {
    try {
      await api(`/players/${uuid}/notes/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      toast(t('notes.deleted'));
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`), 'error');
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t('notes.title')}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t('notes.description')}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="grid gap-4">
        <form onSubmit={add} className="grid gap-2">
          <Textarea aria-label={t('notes.add')} placeholder={t('notes.placeholder')} value={content} onChange={(e) => setContent(e.target.value)} maxLength={4000} />
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <Button type="submit" size="sm" disabled={busy || !content.trim()}>
              {t('notes.add')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
        {!notes ? (
          <Skeleton className="h-12" />
        ) : notes.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('notes.empty')}</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid gap-2">
            {notes.map((n) => (
              <li key={n.id} className="rounded-lg border px-4 py-3">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm">{n.content}</p>
                  {(n.author?.id === user.id || can(PERMISSIONS.DASHBOARD_MANAGE)) && (
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="size-7 shrink-0" title={t('common.delete')} onClick={() => void remove(n.id)}>
                      <Trash2 aria-hidden />
                      <span className="sr-only">{t('common.delete')}</span>
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {n.author?.username ?? t('common.unknown')} · {format.dateTime(new Date(n.createdAt), { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' })}
                </p>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/components/player-skin.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { PlayerAvatar } from './player-avatar';

/** Skins are served by the backend (cached, Mojang texture host only); no third-party request from the browser. */
export const skinUrl = (uuid: string) => `/api/players/${uuid}/skin`;

/**
 * Player head rendered from the skin texture: face (8×8 at 8,8) plus the hat
 * overlay (8×8 at 40,8), pixel-perfect. Falls back to a lettered avatar.
 */
export function PlayerHead({ uuid, username, size = 32, className }: { uuid: string; username: string; size?: number; className?: string }) {
  const canvas = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setFailed(false);
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => {
      const ctx = canvas.current?.getContext('2d');
      if (!ctx) return;
      ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 8, 8);
      ctx.drawImage(img, 8, 8, 8, 8, 0, 0, 8, 8);
      ctx.drawImage(img, 40, 8, 8, 8, 0, 0, 8, 8);
    };
    img.onerror = () => setFailed(true);
    img.src = skinUrl(uuid);
    return () => {
      img.onload = null;
      img.onerror = null;
    };
  }, [uuid]);

  if (failed) return <PlayerAvatar uuid={uuid} username={username} className={className} />;
  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvas}
      width={8}
      height={8}
      aria-hidden
      className={cn('pixelated shrink-0 rounded-md bg-muted', className)}
      style={{ width: size, height: size }}
    />
  );
}

/** Interactive 3D skin preview (skinview3d, loaded on demand). Drag to rotate. */
export function SkinViewer({ uuid, model, className }: { uuid: string; model: string | null; className?: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('skin');
  const canvas = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const [state, setState] = useState<'loading' | 'ready' | 'unavailable'>('loading');

  useEffect(() => {
    let disposed = false;
    let viewer: { dispose(): void } | null = null;
    void (async () => {
      const probe = await fetch(skinUrl(uuid), { method: 'GET', credentials: 'same-origin' }).catch(() => null);
      if (!probe?.ok || disposed || !canvas.current) {
        if (!disposed) setState('unavailable');
        return;
      }
      // Decode the image before handing it over, so the object URL can be revoked safely.
      const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(await probe.blob());
      const image = new Image();
      const decoded = await new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
        image.onload = () => resolve(true);
        image.onerror = () => resolve(false);
        image.src = blobUrl;
      });
      URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
      if (!decoded) {
        if (!disposed) setState('unavailable');
        return;
      }
      const { SkinViewer: Viewer, WalkingAnimation } = await import('skinview3d');
      if (disposed || !canvas.current) return;
      const instance = new Viewer({
        canvas: canvas.current,
        width: 220,
        height: 300,
        skin: image,
        model: model === 'slim' ? 'slim' : 'default',
        zoom: 0.85,
      });
      instance.autoRotate = true;
      instance.autoRotateSpeed = 0.6;
      const walk = new WalkingAnimation();
      walk.speed = 0.5;
      instance.animation = walk;
      instance.controls.enableZoom = false;
      viewer = instance;
      setState('ready');
    })();
    return () => {
      disposed = true;
      viewer?.dispose();
    };
  }, [uuid, model]);

  return (
    <div className={cn('relative flex h-[300px] w-[220px] items-center justify-center', className)}>
      <canvas ref={canvas} className={cn('cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing', state !== 'ready' && 'invisible')} aria-label={t('preview')} title={t('dragHint')} />
      {state === 'loading' && <div className="absolute inset-8 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-muted" />}
      {state === 'unavailable' && <p className="absolute text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t('unavailable')}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
function TopList({ title, items, empty }: { title: string; items: { id: string; value: number }[]; empty: string }) {

        <CardTitle className="text-base">{title}</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {items.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{empty}</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid gap-2">
            {items.map((i) => (
              <li key={i.id} className="grid gap-1 text-sm">
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="truncate">{prettyId(i.id)}</span>
                  <span className="tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{format.number(i.value)}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted">
                  <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-primary" style={{ width: `${(i.value / max) * 100}%` }} />
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function PlayerStatistics({ uuid }: { uuid: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('stats');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const formatStat = useStatFormatter();
  const [range, setRange] = useState<Range>('all');
  const [custom, setCustom] = useState({ from: '', to: '' });
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('range=all');
  const [data, setData] = useState<PlayerStats | null>(null);
  const [chartKey, setChartKey] = useState<StatKey>(STATS.BLOCKS_MINED);
  const [series, setSeries] = useState<Series | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setData(null);
    void api<PlayerStats>(`/players/${uuid}/statistics?${query}`).then(setData).catch(() => undefined);
  }, [uuid, query]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void api<Series>(`/players/${uuid}/statistics/series?keys=${encodeURIComponent(CHART_KEYS.join(','))}&days=30`).then(setSeries).catch(() => undefined);
  }, [uuid]);

  function selectRange(next: Range) {
    setRange(next);
    if (next !== 'custom') setQuery(`range=${next}`);
  }

  function applyCustom(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!custom.from) return;
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ range: 'custom', from: new Date(custom.from).toISOString() });
    if (custom.to) params.set('to', new Date(`${custom.to}T23:59:59`).toISOString());
    setQuery(params.toString());
  }

  const chart = useMemo(() => {
    if (!series) return [];
    const values = series.series[chartKey] ?? [];
    return series.days.map((d, i) => ({ label: format.dateTime(new Date(`${d}T12:00:00Z`), { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' }), value: values[i] ?? 0 }));
  }, [series, chartKey, format]);

  const v = data?.values ?? {};
  // K/D: PvP kills per death (only when deaths were recorded).
  const deaths = v[STATS.DEATHS];
  const kd = deaths ? (v[STATS.PLAYER_KILLS] ?? 0) / deaths : null;

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6 [&>*]:min-w-0">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <div role="radiogroup" className="inline-flex rounded-md border p-0.5">
          {(Object.keys(RANGE_LABEL) as Range[]).map((r) => (
            <button key={r} type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={range === r} onClick={() => selectRange(r)} className={cn('rounded px-3 py-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground', range === r && 'bg-accent text-accent-foreground')}>
              {t(`ranges.${RANGE_LABEL[r]}`)}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        {range === 'custom' && (
          <form onSubmit={applyCustom} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Input type="date" aria-label={t('from')} className="w-40" value={custom.from} onChange={(e) => setCustom({ ...custom, from: e.target.value })} required />
            <Input type="date" aria-label={t('to')} className="w-40" value={custom.to} onChange={(e) => setCustom({ ...custom, to: e.target.value })} />
            <Button type="submit" size="sm" variant="outline">
              {t('apply')}
            </Button>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>

      {!data ? (
        <Skeleton className="h-64" />
      ) : !data.collected ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed p-10 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('noData')}</div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {data.partial && data.coverageStart && <Alert>{t('partial', { date: format.dateTime(new Date(data.coverageStart), { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }) })}</Alert>}

          <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 [&>*]:min-w-0">
            {CATEGORIES.map((category) => {
              const keys = STATS_BY_CATEGORY[category].filter((k) => v[k] !== undefined);
              return (
                <Card key={category}>
                  <CardHeader>
                    <CardTitle className="text-base">{t(`categories.${category}`)}</CardTitle>
                  </CardHeader>
                  <CardContent>
                    {keys.length === 0 ? (
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('emptyList')}</p>
                    ) : (
                      <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-3 text-sm">
                        {keys.map((k) => (
                          <div key={k}>
                            <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t(`labels.${STAT_NAME[k]}`)}</dt>
                            <dd className="font-medium tabular-nums">{formatStat(k, v[k] ?? 0)}</dd>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                        {category === 'combat' && kd !== null && (
                          <div>
                            <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t('kd')}</dt>
                            <dd className="font-medium tabular-nums">{format.number(kd, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</dd>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </dl>
                    )}
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <Card>
            <CardHeader className="flex-row flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div>
                <CardTitle>{t('daily')}</CardTitle>
                {series && <CardDescription>{series.timezone}</CardDescription>}
              </div>
              <Select aria-label={t('daily')} className="w-56" value={chartKey} onChange={(e) => setChartKey(e.target.value as StatKey)}>
                {CHART_KEYS.map((k) => (
                  <option key={k} value={k}>
                    {t(`labels.${STAT_NAME[k]}`)}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="h-60">
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                <BarChart data={chart} margin={{ top: 4, right: 8, left: -8, bottom: 0 }}>
                  <CartesianGrid vertical={false} stroke="var(--border)" />
                  <XAxis dataKey="label" tick={{ fill: 'var(--muted-foreground)', fontSize: 11 }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} minTickGap={16} />
                  <YAxis tick={{ fill: 'var(--muted-foreground)', fontSize: 11 }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} allowDecimals={false} tickFormatter={(n: number) => format.number(n, { notation: 'compact' })} />
                  <Tooltip
                    cursor={{ fill: 'var(--accent)' }}
                    contentStyle={{ background: 'var(--card)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 8, color: 'var(--foreground)' }}
                    formatter={(value) => [formatStat(chartKey, Number(value)), t(`labels.${STAT_NAME[chartKey]}`)]}
                  />
                  <Bar dataKey="value" fill="var(--primary)" radius={[3, 3, 0, 0]} maxBarSize={28} />
                </BarChart>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <div>
            <p className="mb-3 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">{t('allTimeOnly')}</p>
            <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4 [&>*]:min-w-0">
              <TopList title={t('ores')} items={data.ores} empty={t('emptyList')} />
              <TopList title={t('topMined')} items={data.topMined} empty={t('emptyList')} />
              <TopList title={t('topPlaced')} items={data.topPlaced} empty={t('emptyList')} />
              <TopList title={t('topKilled')} items={data.topKilled} empty={t('emptyList')} />
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/components/plugin-settings-editor.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { RotateCcw, Search, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { useFormatter, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useToast } from '@/components/toaster';
import { Alert, Badge, Button, Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, Field, Input, Select, Textarea } from '@/components/ui/primitives';
import { api, ApiError, errorKey, type Language, type ManagedPluginSettings, type StoredPluginSettings } from '@/lib/api';
import { RANGES, STATISTIC_CATEGORIES } from '@/lib/plugin-config';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

type Tri = 'inherit' | 'on' | 'off';
const toTri = (v: boolean | null): Tri => (v === null ? 'inherit' : v ? 'on' : 'off');
const fromTri = (v: Tri): boolean | null => (v === 'inherit' ? null : v === 'on');

/**
 * Settings → Plugin settings: values pushed to every connected plugin with
 * managed-settings=true. They apply live within one heartbeat; "Server
 * setting" keeps each server's own config.properties value.
 */
export function PluginSettingsEditor() {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useFormatter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [stored, setStored] = useState<StoredPluginSettings | null>(null);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<ManagedPluginSettings | null>(null);
  const [defaults, setDefaults] = useState<Record<string, Record<string, string>>>({});
  const [languages, setLanguages] = useState<Language[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [stale, setStale] = useState(false);
  const [issues, setIssues] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const [settings, messages, langs] = await Promise.all([
      api<StoredPluginSettings>('/settings/plugins'),
      api<Record<string, Record<string, string>>>('/settings/plugins/messages'),
      api<Language[]>('/i18n/languages').catch(() => [] as Language[]),
    ]);
    setStored(settings);
    setDraft(settings.settings);
    setDefaults(messages);
    setLanguages(langs);
    setStale(false);
    setIssues({});
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load().catch(() => undefined);
  }, [load]);

  if (!stored || !draft) return null;
  const set = <K extends keyof ManagedPluginSettings>(key: K, value: ManagedPluginSettings[K]) => setDraft({ ...draft, [key]: value });
  const dirty = JSON.stringify(draft) !== JSON.stringify(stored.settings);

  async function save() {
    if (!stored || !draft) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const next = await api<StoredPluginSettings>('/settings/plugins', { method: 'PUT', body: { baseRevision: stored.revision, settings: draft } });
      setStored(next);
      setDraft(next.settings);
      setIssues({});
      toast(t('pluginSettings.saved'));
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof ApiError && err.code === 'STALE_SETTINGS') setStale(true);
      else if (err instanceof ApiError && err.code === 'INVALID_MESSAGES') {
        setIssues(Object.fromEntries((err.issues ?? []).map((i) => [i.path, i.message])));
        toast(t('pluginSettings.invalidMessages'), 'error');
      } else toast(t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`), 'error');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="grid gap-1.5">
              <CardTitle>{t('pluginSettings.title')}</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>{t('pluginSettings.description')}</CardDescription>
            </div>
            <Badge variant="info" className="gap-1">
              <Zap aria-hidden className="size-3" />
              {t('pluginSettings.live')}
            </Badge>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="grid gap-5">
          {stale && (
            <Alert variant="destructive" className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              {t('pluginSettings.stale')}
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => void load()}>
                {t('pluginSettings.reload')}
              </Button>
            </Alert>
          )}
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <Field label={t('pluginSettings.language')} hint={t('pluginSettings.languageHint')} htmlFor="ps-lang">
              <Select id="ps-lang" value={draft.language ?? ''} onChange={(e) => set('language', e.target.value || null)}>
                <option value="">{t('pluginSettings.inherit')}</option>
                {languages.map((l) => (
                  <option key={l.locale} value={l.locale}>
                    {l.nativeName} ({l.locale})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </Field>
          </div>

          <fieldset className="grid gap-4 rounded-lg border p-4">
            <legend className="px-1 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">{t('integration.statistics')}</legend>
            <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <TriField id="ps-stats" label={t('integration.statisticsEnabled')} value={draft.statisticsEnabled} onChange={(v) => set('statisticsEnabled', v)} />
              <IntervalField id="ps-stat-int" label={t('integration.statisticsInterval')} value={draft.statisticsIntervalSeconds} range={RANGES.statisticsIntervalSeconds} fallback={300} onChange={(v) => set('statisticsIntervalSeconds', v)} />
            </div>
            <div className="grid gap-2">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium">
                <input type="checkbox" className="size-4 accent-primary" checked={draft.statisticsCategories !== null} onChange={(e) => set('statisticsCategories', e.target.checked ? [...STATISTIC_CATEGORIES] : null)} />
                {t('pluginSettings.manageCategories')}
              </label>
              {draft.statisticsCategories !== null && (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-5 gap-y-2 pl-6">
                  {STATISTIC_CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
                    <label key={c} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        className="size-4 accent-primary"
                        checked={draft.statisticsCategories?.includes(c) ?? false}
                        onChange={(e) => set('statisticsCategories', e.target.checked ? [...(draft.statisticsCategories ?? []), c] : (draft.statisticsCategories ?? []).filter((x) => x !== c))}
                      />
                      {t(`integration.category.${c}`)}
                    </label>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </fieldset>

          <fieldset className="grid gap-4 rounded-lg border p-4">
            <legend className="px-1 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">{t('integration.inventories')}</legend>
            <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
              <TriField id="ps-inv" label={t('integration.inventorySync')} value={draft.inventorySync} onChange={(v) => set('inventorySync', v)} />
              <TriField id="ps-ec" label={t('integration.enderChestSync')} value={draft.enderChestSync} onChange={(v) => set('enderChestSync', v)} />
              <IntervalField id="ps-inv-int" label={t('integration.inventoryInterval')} value={draft.inventorySyncIntervalSeconds} range={RANGES.inventorySyncIntervalSeconds} fallback={300} onChange={(v) => set('inventorySyncIntervalSeconds', v)} />
            </div>
          </fieldset>

          <Alert>{t('pluginSettings.localOnly')}</Alert>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <MessageEditor
        messages={draft.messages}
        defaults={defaults}
        languages={languages}
        preferredLocale={draft.language}
        issues={issues}
        onChange={(messages) => set('messages', messages)}
      />

      <div className="sticky bottom-4 z-10 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-3 rounded-lg border bg-background/95 p-3 shadow-sm backdrop-blur">
        <span className="mr-auto text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {stored.updatedAt ? t('pluginSettings.revision', { revision: stored.revision, time: format.dateTime(new Date(stored.updatedAt), { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }) }) : t('pluginSettings.neverSaved')}
        </span>
        <Button variant="ghost" disabled={!dirty || busy} onClick={() => setDraft(stored.settings)}>
          {t('pluginSettings.discard')}
        </Button>
        <Button disabled={!dirty || busy || stale} onClick={() => void save()}>
          {busy ? t('common.saving') : t('pluginSettings.saveAndPush')}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function TriField({ id, label, value, onChange }: { id: string; label: string; value: boolean | null; onChange: (v: boolean | null) => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations();
  return (
    <Field label={label} htmlFor={id}>
      <Select id={id} value={toTri(value)} onChange={(e) => onChange(fromTri(e.target.value as Tri))}>
        <option value="inherit">{t('pluginSettings.inherit')}</option>
        <option value="on">{t('pluginSettings.on')}</option>
        <option value="off">{t('pluginSettings.off')}</option>
      </Select>
    </Field>
  );
}

function IntervalField({ id, label, value, range, fallback, onChange }: { id: string; label: string; value: number | null; range: readonly [number, number]; fallback: number; onChange: (v: number | null) => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const invalid = value !== null && (!Number.isInteger(value) || value < range[0] || value > range[1]);
  return (
    <Field label={label} hint={t('integration.range', { min: range[0], max: range[1] })} error={invalid ? t('integration.problems.range') : null} htmlFor={id}>
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <Select aria-label={label} className="w-40 shrink-0" value={value === null ? 'inherit' : 'set'} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value === 'inherit' ? null : fallback)}>
          <option value="inherit">{t('pluginSettings.inherit')}</option>
          <option value="set">{t('pluginSettings.custom')}</option>
        </Select>
        {value !== null && <Input id={id} type="number" min={range[0]} max={range[1]} value={Number.isFinite(value) ? value : ''} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.valueAsNumber)} />}
      </div>
    </Field>
  );
}

function MessageEditor({
  messages,
  defaults,
  languages,
  preferredLocale,
  issues,
  onChange,
}: {
  messages: Record<string, Record<string, string>>;
  defaults: Record<string, Record<string, string>>;
  languages: Language[];
  preferredLocale: string | null;
  issues: Record<string, string>;
  onChange: (messages: Record<string, Record<string, string>>) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const locales = useMemo(
    () => [...new Set(['en-US', ...Object.keys(defaults), ...languages.map((l) => l.locale), ...Object.keys(messages)])].sort(),
    [defaults, languages, messages],
  );
  const [locale, setLocale] = useState(preferredLocale ?? 'en-US');
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [onlyChanged, setOnlyChanged] = useState(false);
  const reference = defaults['en-US'] ?? {};
  const base = { ...reference, ...(defaults[locale] ?? {}) };
  const overrides = messages[locale] ?? {};
  const keys = Object.keys(reference)
    .sort()
    .filter((k) => (!onlyChanged || k in overrides) && (!query || k.includes(query.toLowerCase()) || (overrides[k] ?? base[k]).toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())));

  function update(key: string, value: string | null) {
    const next = { ...overrides };
    if (value === null || value === base[key]) delete next[key];
    else next[key] = value;
    onChange({ ...messages, [locale]: next });
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t('pluginSettings.messagesTitle')}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t('pluginSettings.messagesDescription')}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="grid gap-4">
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[200px_1fr_auto] sm:items-end">
          <Field label={t('pluginSettings.messageLanguage')} htmlFor="pm-locale">
            <Select id="pm-locale" value={locale} onChange={(e) => setLocale(e.target.value)}>
              {locales.map((l) => (
                <option key={l} value={l}>
                  {languages.find((x) => x.locale === l)?.nativeName ?? l} {messages[l] && Object.keys(messages[l]).length ? `(${Object.keys(messages[l]).length})` : ''}
                </option>
              ))}
            </Select>
          </Field>
          <div className="relative">
            <Search aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 left-3 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input aria-label={t('pluginSettings.search')} placeholder={t('pluginSettings.search')} className="pl-9" value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} />
          </div>
          <label className="flex h-9 items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <input type="checkbox" className="size-4 accent-primary" checked={onlyChanged} onChange={(e) => setOnlyChanged(e.target.checked)} />
            {t('pluginSettings.onlyChanged')}
          </label>
        </div>
        {!defaults[locale] && <Alert>{t('pluginSettings.noBundled', { locale })}</Alert>}
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t('pluginSettings.formatHint')}</p>
        <ul className="grid gap-3">
          {keys.map((key) => {
            const changed = key in overrides;
            const problem = issues[`${locale}.${key}`];
            return (
              <li key={key} className={cn('grid gap-1.5 rounded-lg border p-3', changed && 'border-primary/50 bg-primary/5', problem && 'border-destructive')}>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <code className="text-xs font-medium">{key}</code>
                  {changed && <Badge variant="info">{t('pluginSettings.overridden')}</Badge>}
                  {changed && (
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="ml-auto h-7" onClick={() => update(key, null)}>
                      <RotateCcw aria-hidden />
                      {t('pluginSettings.resetMessage')}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
                <Textarea
                  aria-label={key}
                  rows={Math.min(5, Math.max(1, (overrides[key] ?? base[key] ?? '').split('\n').length))}
                  className="font-mono text-xs"
                  value={overrides[key] ?? base[key] ?? ''}
                  onChange={(e) => update(key, e.target.value)}
                  maxLength={1000}
                />
                {problem && <span className="text-xs text-destructive">{t(`pluginSettings.problems.${problem as 'unsafe-content'}`)}</span>}
              </li>
            );
          })}
          {keys.length === 0 && <li className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t('pluginSettings.noMatches')}</li>}
        </ul>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/components/preference-controls.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { Languages, Monitor, Moon, Sun } from 'lucide-react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useTheme } from 'next-themes';
import { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from 'react';
import { api, type Language } from '@/lib/api';
import { storeLocale } from '@/lib/preferences';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

/**
 * Language selector. Switching is immediate: the locale cookie is updated and
 * the server components re-render with the new catalogue (no reload/restart).
 * When signed in the preference is also saved to the account.
 */
export function LanguageSwitcher({ persist, className }: { persist: boolean; className?: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('language');
  const locale = useLocale();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [languages, setLanguages] = useState<Language[]>([]);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  useEffect(() => {
    api<Language[]>('/i18n/languages')
      .then((list) => setLanguages(list.filter((l) => l.enabled)))
      .catch(() => setLanguages([]));
  }, []);

  async function change(next: string) {
    if (persist) await api('/auth/me', { method: 'PATCH', body: { locale: next } }).catch(() => undefined);
    storeLocale(next);
    startTransition(() => router.refresh());
  }

  const options = languages.length ? languages : [{ locale, nativeName: locale }];

  return (
    <label className={cn('relative inline-flex items-center', className)}>
      <span className="sr-only">{t('label')}</span>
      <Languages className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 size-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
      <select
        value={locale}
        disabled={pending}
        onChange={(e) => void change(e.target.value)}
        className="h-9 rounded-md border border-input bg-background pl-8 pr-3 text-sm focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
      >
        {options.map((l) => (
          <option key={l.locale} value={l.locale}>
            {l.nativeName}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>
    </label>
  );
}

const THEMES = [
  { value: 'dark', icon: Moon },
  { value: 'light', icon: Sun },
  { value: 'system', icon: Monitor },
] as const;

export function ThemeToggle({ persist }: { persist: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations('theme');
  const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme();
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => setMounted(true), []);

  function change(next: (typeof THEMES)[number]['value']) {
    setTheme(next);
    if (persist) void api('/auth/me', { method: 'PATCH', body: { theme: next } }).catch(() => undefined);
  }

  return (
    <div role="radiogroup" aria-label={t('label')} className="inline-flex h-9 w-fit items-center rounded-md border border-input p-0.5">
      {THEMES.map(({ value, icon: Icon }) => (
        <button
          key={value}
          type="button"
          role="radio"
          aria-checked={mounted && theme === value}
          title={t(value)}
          onClick={() => change(value)}
          className={cn(
            'inline-flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground',
            mounted && theme === value && 'bg-accent text-accent-foreground',
          )}
        >
          <Icon className="size-4" aria-hidden />
          <span className="sr-only">{t(value)}</span>
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/components/punishment-dialogs.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { PERMISSIONS } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { type FormEvent, type ReactNode, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api, ApiError, errorKey, type ModerationPreset, type Punishment, type PunishmentType } from '@/lib/api';
import { useAuth } from './auth-provider';
import { useToast } from './toaster';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTrigger } from './ui/dialog';
import { Alert, Button, Field, Input, Select, Textarea } from './ui/primitives';

const TYPE_PERMISSION: Record<PunishmentType, string> = {
  BAN: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_BAN,
  TEMP_BAN: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_BAN,
  MUTE: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_MUTE,
  TEMP_MUTE: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_MUTE,
  KICK: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_KICK,
  WARNING: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_WARN,
  BLACKLIST: PERMISSIONS.PUNISHMENTS_BLACKLIST,
};
const TYPES: PunishmentType[] = ['WARNING', 'KICK', 'TEMP_MUTE', 'MUTE', 'TEMP_BAN', 'BAN', 'BLACKLIST'];
const TEMPORARY: PunishmentType[] = ['TEMP_BAN', 'TEMP_MUTE'];
const PRESETS = [3600, 86_400, 3 * 86_400, 7 * 86_400, 30 * 86_400];
const UNIT_SECONDS = { minutes: 60, hours: 3600, days: 86_400, weeks: 604_800 } as const;
type Unit = keyof typeof UNIT_SECONDS;

/** Largest unit that represents the duration exactly (e.g. 1209600 → 2 weeks). */
export function splitDuration(seconds: number): { amount: number; unit: Unit } {
  for (const unit of ['weeks', 'days', 'hours', 'minutes'] as const) {
    if (seconds % UNIT_SECONDS[unit] === 0) return { amount: seconds / UNIT_SECONDS[unit], unit };
  }
  return { amount: Math.max(1, Math.round(seconds / 60)), unit: 'minutes' };
}
export { UNIT_SECONDS, TEMPORARY as TEMPORARY_TYPES, type Unit };

/** Types the current user may issue (cosmetic; the backend enforces the same rules). */
export function useIssuableTypes(): PunishmentType[] {
  const { can } = useAuth();
  return TYPES.filter((type) => can(TYPE_PERMISSION[type]));
}

/** Maps punishment-specific backend errors to messages. */
function useErrorMessage() {
  const t = useTranslations();
  return (err: unknown) => {
    if (err instanceof ApiError) {
      if (err.code === 'ALREADY_BANNED') return t('moderation.alreadyBanned');
      if (err.code === 'ALREADY_MUTED') return t('moderation.alreadyMuted');
      if (err.code === 'PLAYER_OFFLINE') return t('moderation.playerOffline');
      if (err.code === 'PLAYER_NOT_FOUND') return t('moderation.playerNotFound');
    }
    return t(`errors.${errorKey(err)}`);
  };
}

export function PunishDialog({ trigger, target, targetName, onIssued }: { trigger: ReactNode; target?: string; targetName?: string; onIssued?: () => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useErrorMessage();
  const toast = useToast();
  const types = useIssuableTypes();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [player, setPlayer] = useState(target ?? '');
  const [type, setType] = useState<PunishmentType>(types[0] ?? 'WARNING');
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [preset, setPreset] = useState<number | 'custom'>(86_400);
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState(1);
  const [unit, setUnit] = useState<Unit>('days');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [presets, setPresets] = useState<ModerationPreset[]>([]);
  const [presetId, setPresetId] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    api<{ presets: ModerationPreset[] }>('/settings/moderation')
      .then((m) => setPresets(m.presets))
      .catch(() => setPresets([]));
  }, [open]);

  if (types.length === 0) return null;
  const usablePresets = presets.filter((p) => types.includes(p.type));

  function applyPreset(id: string) {
    setPresetId(id);
    const p = usablePresets.find((x) => x.id === id);
    if (!p) return;
    setType(p.type);
    setReason(p.reason);
    if (p.durationSeconds) {
      if (PRESETS.includes(p.durationSeconds)) setPreset(p.durationSeconds);
      else {
        const split = splitDuration(p.durationSeconds);
        setPreset('custom');
        setAmount(split.amount);
        setUnit(split.unit);
      }
    }
  }
  const temporary = TEMPORARY.includes(type);
  const durationSeconds = preset === 'custom' ? amount * UNIT_SECONDS[unit] : preset;

  async function submit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const created = await api<Punishment>('/punishments', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: { type, target: player.trim(), reason: reason.trim(), ...(temporary ? { durationSeconds } : {}) },
      });
      toast(t('moderation.issued', { type: t(`moderation.types.${type}`), player: created.target.username }));
      setOpen(false);
      setReason('');
      setPresetId('');
      onIssued?.();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(format(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(o) => { setOpen(o); setError(null); }}>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>{trigger}</DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent title={targetName ? t('moderation.punishTitle', { player: targetName }) : t('moderation.newPunishment')} closeLabel={t('common.close')}>
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="grid gap-4">
          {error && <Alert variant="destructive">{error}</Alert>}
          {!target && (
            <Field label={t('moderation.punishTarget')} htmlFor="pun-target">
              <Input id="pun-target" value={player} onChange={(e) => setPlayer(e.target.value)} maxLength={36} required autoFocus />
            </Field>
          )}
          {usablePresets.length > 0 && (
            <Field label={t('presets.template')} htmlFor="pun-preset">
              <Select id="pun-preset" value={presetId} onChange={(e) => applyPreset(e.target.value)}>
                <option value="">{t('presets.none')}</option>
                {usablePresets.map((p) => (
                  <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                    {p.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </Field>
          )}
          <Field label={t('moderation.type')} htmlFor="pun-type" hint={type === 'BLACKLIST' ? t('moderation.blacklistHint') : undefined}>
            <Select id="pun-type" value={type} onChange={(e) => setType(e.target.value as PunishmentType)}>
              {types.map((ty) => (
                <option key={ty} value={ty}>
                  {t(`moderation.types.${ty}`)}
                </option>
              ))}
            </Select>
          </Field>
          {temporary && (
            <Field label={t('moderation.duration')} htmlFor="pun-duration">
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                <Select id="pun-duration" value={String(preset)} onChange={(e) => setPreset(e.target.value === 'custom' ? 'custom' : Number(e.target.value))}>
                  {PRESETS.map((s) => (
                    <option key={s} value={s}>
                      {s >= 86_400 ? t('moderation.presetDays', { count: s / 86_400 }) : t('moderation.presetHours', { count: s / 3600 })}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                  <option value="custom">{t('moderation.custom')}</option>
                </Select>
                {preset === 'custom' && (
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    <Input aria-label={t('moderation.amount')} type="number" min={1} max={5000} value={amount} onChange={(e) => setAmount(Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value)))} />
                    <Select aria-label={t('moderation.unit')} value={unit} onChange={(e) => setUnit(e.target.value as Unit)}>
                      {(Object.keys(UNIT_SECONDS) as Unit[]).map((u) => (
                        <option key={u} value={u}>
                          {t(`moderation.units.${u}`)}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </Select>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </Field>
          )}
          <Field label={t('moderation.reason')} htmlFor="pun-reason">
            <Textarea id="pun-reason" value={reason} onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} maxLength={500} required />
          </Field>
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} disabled={busy}>
              {t('common.cancel')}
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" variant={['BAN', 'TEMP_BAN', 'BLACKLIST'].includes(type) ? 'destructive' : 'default'} disabled={busy || !reason.trim() || !player.trim()}>
              {t('moderation.punish')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

export function RevokeDialog({ punishment, onRevoked }: { punishment: Punishment; onRevoked?: () => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useErrorMessage();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function revoke() {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await api(`/punishments/${punishment.id}/revoke`, { method: 'POST', body: { reason: reason.trim() || undefined } });
      toast(t('moderation.revoked'));
      setOpen(false);
      onRevoked?.();
    } catch (err) {
      toast(format(err), 'error');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        <Button size="sm" variant="outline">
          {t('moderation.revoke')}
        </Button>
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent title={t('moderation.revokeTitle')} description={t('moderation.revokeDescription')} closeLabel={t('common.close')}>
        <Field label={t('moderation.revokeReason')} htmlFor="rev-reason">
          <Input id="rev-reason" value={reason} onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} maxLength={500} />
        </Field>
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} disabled={busy}>
            {t('common.cancel')}
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={() => void revoke()} disabled={busy}>
            {t('moderation.revoke')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/components/realtime-provider.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { createContext, type ReactNode, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export type RealtimeEventType = 'server.updated' | 'server.removed' | 'player.online' | 'player.offline' | 'player.updated' | 'punishment.changed' | 'anticheat.event' | 'inventory.changed';
export interface RealtimeEvent {
  type: RealtimeEventType;
  serverId?: string;
  uuid?: string;
}

type Listener = (event: RealtimeEvent) => void;

interface RealtimeContextValue {
  connected: boolean;
  subscribe: (listener: Listener) => () => void;
}

const RealtimeContext = createContext<RealtimeContextValue>({ connected: false, subscribe: () => () => undefined });

const EVENT_TYPES: RealtimeEventType[] = ['server.updated', 'server.removed', 'player.online', 'player.offline', 'player.updated', 'punishment.changed', 'anticheat.event', 'inventory.changed'];

/**
 * Single Server-Sent Events connection per tab (GET /api/events). The browser
 * reconnects automatically; if the stream is closed because the access token
 * expired, the session is refreshed before reconnecting.
 */
export function RealtimeProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const listeners = useRef(new Set<Listener>());
  const [connected, setConnected] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let source: EventSource | null = null;
    let retryTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    let stopped = false;

    const connect = () => {
      source = new EventSource('/api/events');
      source.addEventListener('ready', () => setConnected(true));
      for (const type of EVENT_TYPES) {
        source.addEventListener(type, (message) => {
          try {
            const event = JSON.parse((message as MessageEvent<string>).data) as RealtimeEvent;
            listeners.current.forEach((listener) => listener(event));
          } catch {
            // ignore malformed payloads
          }
        });
      }
      source.onerror = () => {
        setConnected(false);
        if (source?.readyState === EventSource.CLOSED && !stopped) {
          // The server rejected the stream (e.g. expired access token): refresh, then retry.
          source.close();
          void fetch('/api/auth/refresh', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'x-mnm-csrf': '1' } }).finally(() => {
            if (!stopped) retryTimer = setTimeout(connect, 5000);
          });
        }
      };
    };

    connect();
    return () => {
      stopped = true;
      if (retryTimer) clearTimeout(retryTimer);
      source?.close();
    };
  }, []);

  const subscribe = (listener: Listener) => {
    listeners.current.add(listener);
    return () => listeners.current.delete(listener);
  };

  return <RealtimeContext.Provider value={{ connected, subscribe }}>{children}</RealtimeContext.Provider>;
}

/**
 * Calls `onChange` (debounced) whenever one of the given event types arrives.
 * Also falls back to polling every `fallbackMs` in case the stream is down.
 */
export function useLiveRefresh(types: RealtimeEventType[], onChange: () => void, fallbackMs = 60_000): boolean {
  const { connected, subscribe } = useContext(RealtimeContext);
  const callback = useRef(onChange);
  callback.current = onChange;
  const key = types.join(',');

  useEffect(() => {
    const wanted = new Set(key.split(','));
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    const unsubscribe = subscribe((event) => {
      if (!wanted.has(event.type)) return;
      if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
      timer = setTimeout(() => callback.current(), 400);
    });
    const poll = setInterval(() => callback.current(), fallbackMs);
    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
      clearInterval(poll);
      if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [key, subscribe, fallbackMs]);

  return connected;
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useFormatter, useNow, useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import type { ServerInfo } from '@/lib/api';
import { formatBytes } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Badge, Card, StatusDot } from './ui/primitives';

export function ServerCard({ server, href }: { server: ServerInfo; href?: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations();
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 30_000 });
  const locale = useLocale();
  const state = server.status === 'ONLINE' ? 'up' : server.status === 'PENDING' ? 'pending' : 'down';
  const memory =
    server.memoryUsedBytes && server.memoryMaxBytes ? `${formatBytes(server.memoryUsedBytes, locale)} / ${formatBytes(server.memoryMaxBytes, locale)}` : null;

  // Only render metrics that were actually reported; never show placeholders as data.
  const metrics: [string, string][] = [];
  if (server.tps !== null) metrics.push(['TPS', format.number(server.tps, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })]);
  if (server.mspt !== null) metrics.push(['MSPT', format.number(server.mspt, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })]);
  if (memory) metrics.push(['RAM', memory]);
  if (server.cpuLoad !== null) metrics.push(['CPU', format.number(server.cpuLoad, { style: 'percent', maximumFractionDigits: 0 })]);

  return (
    <Card className="p-4">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <StatusDot state={state} />
            {href ? (
              <Link href={href} className="truncate font-medium hover:underline">
                {server.name}
              </Link>
            ) : (
              <span className="truncate font-medium">{server.name}</span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {[server.minecraftVersion, server.pluginVersion && t('dashboard.pluginVersion', { version: server.pluginVersion })].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || t('common.unknown')}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1">
          <Badge variant={server.type === 'VELOCITY' ? 'info' : 'default'}>{server.type === 'VELOCITY' ? 'Velocity' : 'Paper'}</Badge>
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t(`servers.status.${server.status}`)}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 text-sm">{server.onlinePlayers !== null ? t('dashboard.serverPlayers', { count: server.onlinePlayers }) : t('dashboard.notRecorded')}</div>
      {metrics.length > 0 && (
        <dl className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
          {metrics.map(([k, v]) => (
            <div key={k} className="rounded-md bg-muted px-2 py-1.5">
              <dt className="text-muted-foreground">{k}</dt>
              <dd className="font-medium">{v}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      )}
      <div className="mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        {t('dashboard.lastHeartbeat', { time: server.lastHeartbeatAt ? format.relativeTime(new Date(server.lastHeartbeatAt), now) : t('common.never') })}
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/components/toaster.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { createContext, type ReactNode, useCallback, useContext, useState } from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

type ToastKind = 'success' | 'error';
interface Toast {
  id: number;
  kind: ToastKind;
  message: string;
}

const ToastContext = createContext<(message: string, kind?: ToastKind) => void>(() => undefined);

export function useToast() {
  return useContext(ToastContext);
}

export function Toaster({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<Toast[]>([]);
  const push = useCallback((message: string, kind: ToastKind = 'success') => {
    const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
    setToasts((t) => [...t, { id, kind, message }]);
    setTimeout(() => setToasts((t) => t.filter((x) => x.id !== id)), 4000);
  }, []);

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={push}>
      {children}
      <div aria-live="polite" className="pointer-events-none fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-[60] flex w-80 flex-col gap-2">
        {toasts.map((t) => (
          <div
            key={t.id}
            className={cn(
              'pointer-events-auto rounded-lg border bg-card px-4 py-3 text-sm shadow-lg',
```
