```tsx
            )}
          >
            {t.message}

        ))}
      </div>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
```

`apps/dashboard/src/i18n/config.ts`:

```ts
import { BUNDLED_LOCALES, isValidLocaleCode } from '@mnm/shared-types';

export const LOCALE_COOKIE = 'NEXT_LOCALE';
export const TIMEZONE_COOKIE = 'mnm_tz';

/** BCP 47 code (ll-RR). Besides the bundled locales, administrators can add languages at runtime. */
export type AppLocale = string;

/** Locales whose catalogue ships with the dashboard. */
export function isSupportedLocale(value: string | undefined | null): value is AppLocale {
  return !!value && (BUNDLED_LOCALES as readonly string[]).includes(value);
}

/** Syntactically valid locale code (bundled or possibly added at runtime). */
export function isLocaleCode(value: string | undefined | null): value is AppLocale {
  return !!value && isValidLocaleCode(value);
}

export function isValidTimeZone(value: string | undefined | null): value is string {
  if (!value) return false;
  try {
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: value });
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/i18n/request.ts`:

```ts
import { getMessages, mergeWithFallback, type MessageTree } from '@mnm/translations';
import { DEFAULT_LOCALE } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { getRequestConfig } from 'next-intl/server';
import { isLocaleCode, isSupportedLocale, isValidTimeZone, LOCALE_COOKIE, TIMEZONE_COOKIE } from './config';

const BACKEND = (process.env.BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4000').replace(/\/$/, '');
const CACHE_MS = 30_000;
const cache = new Map<string, { at: number; messages: MessageTree | null }>();

/**
 * Messages imported in the dashboard (Settings → Languages) for an enabled
 * language, cached briefly per server process. `null` = language not
 * available. A backend outage keeps serving the last known value.
 */
async function importedMessages(locale: string): Promise<MessageTree | null> {
  const cached = cache.get(locale);
  if (cached && Date.now() - cached.at < CACHE_MS) return cached.messages;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${BACKEND}/api/i18n/messages/${encodeURIComponent(locale)}`, { cache: 'no-store', signal: AbortSignal.timeout(2_000) });
    const messages = res.ok ? ((await res.json()) as { messages: MessageTree }).messages : res.status === 404 ? null : (cached?.messages ?? null);
    cache.set(locale, { at: Date.now(), messages });
    return messages;
  } catch {
    return cached?.messages ?? null;
  }
}

/**
 * Resolves the locale per request: the explicit preference cookie (set from the
 * user's saved preference or the language switcher), otherwise en-US. The
 * browser language is deliberately not used: English is the system default.
 * Messages are merged over English, so missing keys always fall back.
 */
export default getRequestConfig(async () => {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const fromCookie = cookieStore.get(LOCALE_COOKIE)?.value;
  const tz = cookieStore.get(TIMEZONE_COOKIE)?.value;

  // Bundled languages always work; added ones only while enabled (imported messages exist).
  let locale: string = isLocaleCode(fromCookie) ? fromCookie : DEFAULT_LOCALE;
  let imported = await importedMessages(locale);
  if (!isSupportedLocale(locale) && !imported) {
    locale = DEFAULT_LOCALE;
    imported = await importedMessages(locale);
  }
  const messages = mergeWithFallback(getMessages(locale), imported ?? undefined);

  return {
    locale,
    messages: messages as Record<string, unknown>,
    timeZone: isValidTimeZone(tz) ? tz : 'UTC',
    onError(error) {
      if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') console.error(error.message);
    },
    getMessageFallback({ namespace, key }) {
      return [namespace, key].filter(Boolean).join('.');
    },
  };
});
```

`apps/dashboard/src/lib/api.ts`:

```ts
/** Thin client for the backend API, reached through the same-origin /api proxy. */

export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    readonly code: string,
    message: string,
    readonly issues?: { path: string; message: string }[],
  ) {
    super(message);
  }
}

let refreshing: Promise<boolean> | null = null;

/** Single-flight refresh so parallel 401s trigger only one token rotation. */
async function refreshSession(): Promise<boolean> {
  refreshing ??= fetch('/api/auth/refresh', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'x-mnm-csrf': '1' }, credentials: 'same-origin' })
    .then((r) => r.ok)
    .catch(() => false)
    .finally(() => {
      setTimeout(() => (refreshing = null), 0);
    });
  return refreshing;
}

export async function api<T>(path: string, init: { method?: string; body?: unknown } = {}, retry = true): Promise<T> {
  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(`/api${path}`, {
      method: init.method ?? 'GET',
      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-mnm-csrf': '1' },
      body: init.body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(init.body),
      credentials: 'same-origin',
      cache: 'no-store',
    });
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError(0, 'NETWORK_ERROR', 'Network error');
  }

  if (res.status === 401 && retry && !path.startsWith('/auth/login') && !path.startsWith('/auth/refresh')) {
    if (await refreshSession()) return api<T>(path, init, false);
  }

  const text = await res.text();
  const data = text ? safeJson(text) : null;
  if (!res.ok) {
    const body = (data ?? {}) as { code?: string; message?: string; issues?: { path: string; message: string }[] };
    throw new ApiError(res.status, body.code ?? 'ERROR', body.message ?? res.statusText, body.issues);
  }
  return data as T;
}

function safeJson(text: string): unknown {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Maps an error to a translation key in the `errors` namespace. */
export function errorKey(err: unknown): 'generic' | 'network' | 'forbidden' | 'notFound' | 'validation' | 'conflict' {
  if (!(err instanceof ApiError)) return 'generic';
  if (err.status === 0 || err.status === 502) return 'network';
  if (err.status === 403) return 'forbidden';
  if (err.status === 404) return 'notFound';
  if (err.status === 400) return 'validation';
  if (err.status === 409) return 'conflict';
  return 'generic';
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/lib/format.ts`:

```ts
import { useLocale } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback } from 'react';

/** Compact, locale-aware duration such as "3 h 12 min" / "3 Std. 12 Min.". */
export function formatDuration(totalSeconds: number, locale: string): string {
  const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(totalSeconds));
  const days = Math.floor(seconds / 86_400);
  const hours = Math.floor((seconds % 86_400) / 3600);
  const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
  const unit = (value: number, u: 'day' | 'hour' | 'minute' | 'second') =>
    new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: 'unit', unit: u, unitDisplay: 'short' }).format(value);

  if (days > 0) return `${unit(days, 'day')} ${unit(hours, 'hour')}`;
  if (hours > 0) return `${unit(hours, 'hour')} ${unit(minutes, 'minute')}`;
  if (minutes > 0) return unit(minutes, 'minute');
  return unit(seconds, 'second');
}

export function useDuration() {
  const locale = useLocale();
  return useCallback((seconds: number) => formatDuration(seconds, locale), [locale]);
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { diff, type Draft, initials, type InventoryItem, move, normalizeId, toDraft } from './inventory';

const fp = (c: string) => c.repeat(64);
const sword: InventoryItem = { slot: 0, id: 'minecraft:diamond_sword', amount: 1, name: 'Excalibur', enchantments: { 'minecraft:sharpness': 5 }, fp: fp('a') };
const dirt: InventoryItem = { slot: 1, id: 'minecraft:dirt', amount: 64, fp: fp('b') };
const items = new Map([sword, dirt].map((i) => [i.slot, i]));
const pool = [sword, dirt];

describe('inventory draft', () => {
  it('produces no changes for an untouched draft', () => {
    const draft: Draft = new Map([[0, toDraft(sword)]]);
    expect(diff(items, draft, pool)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('turns a move into two compare-and-set changes based on the original item', () => {
    const changes = diff(items, move(items, new Map(), 1, 5), pool);
    expect(changes).toEqual([
      { slot: 1, before: fp('b'), after: null },
      { slot: 5, before: null, after: { id: 'minecraft:dirt', amount: 64, base: fp('b') } },
    ]);
  });

  it('swaps occupied slots', () => {
    const changes = diff(items, move(items, new Map(), 0, 1), pool);
    expect(changes.map((c) => [c.slot, c.before, c.after?.base])).toEqual([
      [0, fp('a'), fp('b')],
      [1, fp('b'), fp('a')],
    ]);
  });

  it('only sends fields that differ from the base item', () => {
    const edited: Draft = new Map([[0, { ...toDraft(sword), amount: 1, name: 'Renamed' }]]);
    expect(diff(items, edited, pool)).toEqual([{ slot: 0, before: fp('a'), after: { id: 'minecraft:diamond_sword', amount: 1, base: fp('a'), name: 'Renamed' } }]);
    const unenchanted: Draft = new Map([[0, { ...toDraft(sword), enchantments: {} }]]);
    expect(diff(items, unenchanted, pool)[0].after).toEqual({ id: 'minecraft:diamond_sword', amount: 1, base: fp('a'), enchantments: {} });
  });

  it('ignores trailing empty lore lines left while typing', () => {
    const draft: Draft = new Map([[1, { ...toDraft(dirt), lore: ['Line', ''] }]]);
    expect(diff(items, draft, pool)[0].after?.lore).toEqual(['Line']);
    expect(diff(items, new Map([[1, { ...toDraft(dirt), lore: [''] }]]), pool)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('creates new items without a base', () => {
    const draft: Draft = new Map([[9, { id: 'minecraft:golden_apple', amount: 3, name: null, lore: [], enchantments: {} }]]);
    expect(diff(items, draft, pool)).toEqual([{ slot: 9, before: null, after: { id: 'minecraft:golden_apple', amount: 3 } }]);
  });

  it('clears slots', () => {
    expect(diff(items, new Map([[0, null], [1, null], [2, null]]), pool)).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it('normalises IDs and builds tile labels', () => {
    expect(normalizeId(' Diamond_Sword ')).toBe('minecraft:diamond_sword');
    expect(initials('minecraft:diamond_sword')).toBe('DS');
    expect(initials('minecraft:dirt')).toBe('DI');
  });
});
```

`apps/dashboard/src/lib/inventory.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Inventory editor model. The draft maps slots to desired items; `diff`
 * turns it into the backend's compare-and-set changes. Items that started
 * from an existing item keep a `base` fingerprint, and only fields that differ
 * from that item are sent, so untouched components (e.g. formatted names)
 * are preserved exactly.
 */
export interface InventoryItem {
  slot: number;
  id: string;
  amount: number;
  name?: string | null;
  lore?: string[];
  enchantments?: Record<string, number>;
  damage?: number;
  maxDamage?: number;
  fp: string;
}

export interface DraftItem {
  id: string;
  amount: number;
  name: string | null;
  lore: string[];
  enchantments: Record<string, number>;
  /** Fingerprint of the existing item this one is based on. */
  base?: string;
  damage?: number;
  maxDamage?: number;
}

/** slot → desired item; a slot missing from the map is unchanged, `null` means empty. */
export type Draft = Map<number, DraftItem | null>;

export interface Change {
  slot: number;
  before: string | null;
  after: { id: string; amount: number; base?: string; name?: string | null; lore?: string[]; enchantments?: Record<string, number> } | null;
}

export const ITEM_ID = /^[a-z0-9_.-]+:[a-z0-9_./-]+$/;

export function normalizeId(value: string): string {
  const v = value.trim().toLowerCase();
  return v.includes(':') ? v : `minecraft:${v}`;
}

export function toDraft(item: InventoryItem): DraftItem {
  return {
    id: item.id,
    amount: item.amount,
    name: item.name ?? null,
    lore: item.lore ?? [],
    enchantments: item.enchantments ?? {},
    base: item.fp,
    damage: item.damage,
    maxDamage: item.maxDamage,
  };
}

/** Current effective content of a slot (draft overrides snapshot). */
export function effective(items: Map<number, InventoryItem>, draft: Draft, slot: number): DraftItem | null {
  if (draft.has(slot)) return draft.get(slot) ?? null;
  const item = items.get(slot);
  return item ? toDraft(item) : null;
}

/** Moves (or swaps) the contents of two slots in the draft. */
export function move(items: Map<number, InventoryItem>, draft: Draft, from: number, to: number): Draft {
  if (from === to) return draft;
  const next = new Map(draft);
  const a = effective(items, draft, from);
  const b = effective(items, draft, to);
  next.set(to, a);
  next.set(from, b);
  return next;
}

/** Drops trailing empty lines (the editor keeps them while typing). */
export const cleanLore = (lore: string[]) => {
  const out = [...lore];
  while (out.length && !out[out.length - 1].trim()) out.pop();
  return out;
};

const sameLore = (a: string[], b: string[]) => a.length === b.length && a.every((l, i) => l === b[i]);
const sameEnchants = (a: Record<string, number>, b: Record<string, number>) =>
  Object.keys(a).length === Object.keys(b).length && Object.entries(a).every(([k, v]) => b[k] === v);

/** Compare-and-set changes for every slot whose content differs from the snapshot. */
export function diff(items: Map<number, InventoryItem>, draft: Draft, pool: InventoryItem[]): Change[] {
  const changes: Change[] = [];
  for (const [slot, desired] of draft) {
    const original = items.get(slot) ?? null;
    const before = original?.fp ?? null;
    if (!desired) {
      if (original) changes.push({ slot, before, after: null });
      continue;
    }
    const base = desired.base ? pool.find((i) => i.fp === desired.base) : undefined;
    const baseDraft = base ? toDraft(base) : undefined;
    const lore = cleanLore(desired.lore);
    const fieldsChanged = {
      name: !baseDraft || desired.name !== baseDraft.name,
      lore: !baseDraft || !sameLore(lore, baseDraft.lore),
      enchantments: !baseDraft || !sameEnchants(desired.enchantments, baseDraft.enchantments),
    };
    const unchanged = original && base && base.fp === original.fp && desired.amount === original.amount && !fieldsChanged.name && !fieldsChanged.lore && !fieldsChanged.enchantments;
    if (unchanged) continue;

    const after: NonNullable<Change['after']> = { id: desired.id, amount: desired.amount };
    if (base) after.base = base.fp;
    if (fieldsChanged.name && (base || desired.name)) after.name = desired.name || null;
    if (fieldsChanged.lore && (base || lore.length)) after.lore = lore;
    if (fieldsChanged.enchantments && (base || Object.keys(desired.enchantments).length)) after.enchantments = desired.enchantments;
    changes.push({ slot, before, after });
  }
  return changes.sort((a, b) => a.slot - b.slot);
}

/** Short label for item tiles: "diamond_sword" → "DS". */
export function initials(id: string): string {
  const words = id.replace(/^[^:]+:/, '').split('_').filter(Boolean);
  return (words.length > 1 ? words.slice(0, 2).map((w) => w[0]) : [words[0]?.slice(0, 2) ?? '?']).join('').toUpperCase();
}
```

```ts
const parse = (text: string) =>
  Object.fromEntries(
    text
      .split('\n')
      .filter((l) => l && !l.startsWith('#'))
      .map((l) => [l.slice(0, l.indexOf('=')), l.slice(l.indexOf('=') + 1)]),

  });
```

`apps/dashboard/src/lib/plugin-config.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Generates the plugins' config.properties (same keys, ranges and defaults as
 * apps/plugin-common/src/main/resources/config.properties) and installation
 * instructions. Runs in the browser: registration tokens never leave the page
 * except as a downloaded file.
 */
export type PluginKind = 'VELOCITY' | 'PAPER';

export const STATISTIC_CATEGORIES = ['movement', 'combat', 'blocks', 'general'] as const;
export type StatisticCategory = (typeof STATISTIC_CATEGORIES)[number];

export interface PluginConfigOptions {
  kind: PluginKind;
  backendUrl: string;
  registrationToken: string;
  language: string;
  debug: boolean;
  managedSettings: boolean;
  heartbeatIntervalSeconds: number;
  maxQueuedEvents: number;
  punishmentsEnabled: boolean;
  // Velocity
  collectIpAddresses: boolean;
  syncIntervalSeconds: number;
  moderationCommands: boolean;
  // Paper
  statisticsEnabled: boolean;
  statisticsIntervalSeconds: number;
  statisticsCategories: StatisticCategory[];
  afkTimeoutSeconds: number;
  inventorySync: boolean;
  enderChestSync: boolean;
  inventorySyncIntervalSeconds: number;
  anticheatIntegrations: string;
  anticheatMaxReportsPerMinute: number;
}

/** Allowed ranges; values outside are clamped by the plugin, so the form enforces them. */
export const RANGES = {
  heartbeatIntervalSeconds: [5, 300],
  syncIntervalSeconds: [15, 3600],
  maxQueuedEvents: [1_000, 1_000_000],
  statisticsIntervalSeconds: [60, 3600],
  afkTimeoutSeconds: [30, 3600],
  inventorySyncIntervalSeconds: [30, 3600],
  anticheatMaxReportsPerMinute: [1, 10_000],
} as const satisfies Record<string, readonly [number, number]>;

export function defaultOptions(kind: PluginKind, backendUrl: string): PluginConfigOptions {
  return {
    kind,
    backendUrl,
    registrationToken: '',
    language: 'en-US',
    debug: false,
    managedSettings: true,
    heartbeatIntervalSeconds: 15,
    maxQueuedEvents: 50_000,
    punishmentsEnabled: true,
    collectIpAddresses: true,
    syncIntervalSeconds: 60,
    moderationCommands: true,
    statisticsEnabled: true,
    statisticsIntervalSeconds: 300,
    statisticsCategories: [...STATISTIC_CATEGORIES],
    afkTimeoutSeconds: 300,
    inventorySync: true,
    enderChestSync: true,
    inventorySyncIntervalSeconds: 300,
    anticheatIntegrations: '',
    anticheatMaxReportsPerMinute: 120,
  };
}

export type ConfigProblem = 'backendUrl' | 'backendUrlPath' | 'integrations' | 'range';

/** Problems that would make the plugin refuse to start or behave unexpectedly. */
export function validateOptions(o: PluginConfigOptions): ConfigProblem[] {
  const problems: ConfigProblem[] = [];
  let url: URL | null = null;
  try {
    url = new URL(o.backendUrl);
  } catch {
    // reported below
  }
  if (!url || !['http:', 'https:'].includes(url.protocol)) problems.push('backendUrl');
  else if (url.pathname.replace(/\/$/, '') !== '' || url.search || url.hash) problems.push('backendUrlPath');
  if (o.anticheatIntegrations.split(',').some((n) => n.trim() && !/^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}$/.test(n.trim()))) problems.push('integrations');
  for (const [key, [min, max]] of Object.entries(RANGES)) {
    const value = o[key as keyof typeof RANGES];
    if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value < min || value > max) {
      problems.push('range');
      break;
    }
  }
  return problems;
}

/** Plain HTTP to anything but a private address sends credentials-derived signatures in clear text. */
export function isInsecureUrl(backendUrl: string): boolean {
  try {
    const url = new URL(backendUrl);
    if (url.protocol !== 'http:') return false;
    const host = url.hostname;
    return !(host === 'localhost' || /^127\./.test(host) || /^10\./.test(host) || /^192\.168\./.test(host) || /^172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\./.test(host) || host.endsWith('.local') || host.endsWith('.internal') || !host.includes('.'));
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

const normalizeUrl = (value: string) => value.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
const names = (value: string) =>
  [...new Set(value.split(',').map((n) => n.trim()).filter(Boolean))].join(',');
/** Properties values must not contain line breaks (they would start a new key). */
const single = (value: string) => value.replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').trim();

export function generateConfig(o: PluginConfigOptions, generatedAt = new Date()): string {
  const paper = o.kind === 'PAPER';
  const lines: string[] = [
    '# ------------------------------------------------------------------',
    `# Network Manager plugin configuration (${paper ? 'Paper' : 'Velocity'})`,
    `# Generated by the dashboard on ${generatedAt.toISOString()}`,
    '# ------------------------------------------------------------------',
    '',
    '# Address of the Network Manager dashboard (the API is served under /api).',
    `backend-url=${single(normalizeUrl(o.backendUrl))}`,
    '',
    '# Single-use registration token. It is exchanged for credentials (credentials.properties)',
    '# on the first start and can be removed afterwards.',
    `registration-token=${single(o.registrationToken)}`,
    '',
    '# Language of plugin messages. Can be overridden in the dashboard (managed-settings).',
    `language=${single(o.language)}`,
    '',
    '# How often the server reports its status (5-300 seconds).',
    `heartbeat-interval-seconds=${o.heartbeatIntervalSeconds}`,
    '',
    '# Events kept in memory while the backend is unreachable.',
    `max-queued-events=${o.maxQueuedEvents}`,
    '',
    '# --- Moderation ------------------------------------------------------',
    `punishments-enabled=${o.punishmentsEnabled}`,
  ];
  if (!paper) {
    lines.push(
      `moderation-commands=${o.moderationCommands}`,
      '',
      '# --- Proxy ------------------------------------------------------------',
      '# Store player IP addresses with connection records (personal data).',
      `collect-ip-addresses=${o.collectIpAddresses}`,
      '# Full list of connected players sent periodically (15-3600 seconds).',
      `sync-interval-seconds=${o.syncIntervalSeconds}`,
    );
  } else {
    lines.push(
      '',
      '# --- Statistics ------------------------------------------------------',
      `statistics-enabled=${o.statisticsEnabled}`,
      `statistics-interval-seconds=${o.statisticsIntervalSeconds}`,
      `statistics-categories=${STATISTIC_CATEGORIES.filter((c) => o.statisticsCategories.includes(c)).join(',')}`,
      `afk-timeout-seconds=${o.afkTimeoutSeconds}`,
      '',
      '# --- AntiCheat integration -------------------------------------------',
      '# Plugins allowed to report violations (comma-separated plugin names). Empty = none.',
      `anticheat-integrations=${names(o.anticheatIntegrations)}`,
      `anticheat-max-reports-per-minute=${o.anticheatMaxReportsPerMinute}`,
      '',
      '# --- Inventories -----------------------------------------------------',
      `inventory-sync=${o.inventorySync}`,
      `enderchest-sync=${o.enderChestSync}`,
      `inventory-sync-interval-seconds=${o.inventorySyncIntervalSeconds}`,
    );
  }
  lines.push(
    '',
    '# --- Central management ------------------------------------------------',
    '# Let the dashboard override language, messages, statistics and inventory options live.',
    `managed-settings=${o.managedSettings}`,
    '',
    `debug=${o.debug}`,
    '',
  );
  return lines.join('\n');
}

/** Plugin data folder on the server (relative to the server directory). */
export function configPath(kind: PluginKind): string {
  return kind === 'VELOCITY' ? 'plugins/networkmanager/config.properties' : 'plugins/NetworkManager/config.properties';
}

export function jarName(kind: PluginKind, version: string): string {
  return `NetworkManager-${kind === 'VELOCITY' ? 'Velocity' : 'Paper'}-${version}.jar`;
}

/** Installation instructions shipped in the ZIP package (English, like all generated files). */
export function installGuide(o: PluginConfigOptions, serverName: string, version: string, expiresAt: string | null): string {
  const platform = o.kind === 'VELOCITY' ? 'Velocity proxy' : 'Paper server';
  const steps = [
    `# Network Manager – ${platform} "${serverName}"`,
    '',
    '## Installation',
    '',
    `1. Stop the ${platform}.`,
    `2. Copy \`${jarName(o.kind, version)}\` into the \`plugins/\` folder (build it with \`./gradlew build\` or download it from your release).`,
    `3. Copy \`config.properties\` from this package to \`${configPath(o.kind)}\`.`,
    `4. Start the ${platform}. The plugin registers itself and stores its credentials in \`credentials.properties\`.`,
    '5. Check the connection with `/networkmanager` in the console or in the dashboard under Servers.',
    '',
  ];
  if (o.registrationToken) {
    steps.push(
      '## Registration token',
      '',
      `The included token is single-use${expiresAt ? ` and expires at ${expiresAt}` : ''}. If it expired, create a new one in the dashboard (Settings → Minecraft integration).`,
      'Treat this package like a password until the server has registered.',
      '',
    );
  }
  steps.push(
    '## Notes',
    '',
    '- `managed-settings=true` lets the dashboard change language, messages, statistics and inventory options without a restart.',
    '- All other options in `config.properties` require a restart of the server.',
    '- Do not delete `credentials.properties` or `punishments-cache.json`.',
    '',
  );
  return steps.join('\n');
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/lib/preferences.ts`:

```ts
import { LOCALE_COOKIE, TIMEZONE_COOKIE } from '@/i18n/config';

const ONE_YEAR = 60 * 60 * 24 * 365;

function writeCookie(name: string, value: string): void {
  const secure = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? '; secure' : '';
  document.cookie = `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}; path=/; max-age=${ONE_YEAR}; samesite=lax${secure}`;
}

function readCookie(name: string): string | null {
  const match = document.cookie.split('; ').find((c) => c.startsWith(`${name}=`));
  return match ? decodeURIComponent(match.slice(name.length + 1)) : null;
}

/** Stores the UI locale for server rendering. Returns true when it changed. */
export function storeLocale(locale: string): boolean {
  if (readCookie(LOCALE_COOKIE) === locale) return false;
  writeCookie(LOCALE_COOKIE, locale);
  return true;
}

/** Stores the display time zone used for formatting timestamps. Returns true when it changed. */
export function storeTimeZone(timeZone: string): boolean {
  if (readCookie(TIMEZONE_COOKIE) === timeZone) return false;
  writeCookie(TIMEZONE_COOKIE, timeZone);
  return true;
}

export function browserTimeZone(): string {
  return Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone || 'UTC';
}
```

```ts
import { STAT_DEFINITIONS, STATS, type StatCategory, type StatKey, type StatUnit } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { useFormatter, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback } from 'react';
import { useDuration } from './format';

export type StatName = keyof typeof STATS;

/** Reverse lookup: "custom:minecraft:jump" → "JUMPS" (translation key). */
export const STAT_NAME: Record<StatKey, StatName> = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(STATS).map(([name, key]) => [key, name])) as Record<StatKey, StatName>;

export const STATS_BY_CATEGORY: Record<StatCategory, StatKey[]> = {
  movement: STAT_DEFINITIONS.filter((d) => d.category === 'movement').map((d) => d.key),
  combat: STAT_DEFINITIONS.filter((d) => d.category === 'combat').map((d) => d.key),
  blocks: STAT_DEFINITIONS.filter((d) => d.category === 'blocks').map((d) => d.key),
  general: STAT_DEFINITIONS.filter((d) => d.category === 'general').map((d) => d.key),
};

const UNIT: Record<string, StatUnit> = Object.fromEntries(STAT_DEFINITIONS.map((d) => [d.key, d.unit]));

/** "minecraft:deepslate_diamond_ore" → "Deepslate Diamond Ore" (game ids are not translated). */
export function prettyId(id: string): string {
  return id
    .replace(/^minecraft:/, '')
    .split('_')
    .map((w) => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1))
    .join(' ');
}

/** Formats a raw statistic value according to its unit (cm → km, damage → hearts, ticks/seconds → duration). */
export function useStatFormatter() {
  const t = useTranslations('stats');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const duration = useDuration();
  return useCallback(
    (key: StatKey, value: number) => {
      switch (UNIT[key]) {
        case 'cm':
          return t('km', { value: format.number(value / 100_000, { maximumFractionDigits: value < 100_000 ? 2 : 1 }) });
        case 'damage':
          // Minecraft records damage in tenths of a health point; one heart is two health points.
          return t('hearts', { value: format.number(value / 20, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }) });
        case 'ticks':
          return duration(value / 20);
        case 'seconds':
          return duration(value);
        default:
          return format.number(value);
      }
    },
    [t, format, duration],
  );
}
```

```ts
import { SYSTEM_ROLES, type SystemRole } from '@mnm/shared-types';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';

/** Localized name for system roles; custom roles keep their stored name. */
export function useRoleName() {
  const t = useTranslations('roles.names');
  return (role: { key: string; name: string }) =>
    (SYSTEM_ROLES as readonly string[]).includes(role.key) ? t(role.key as SystemRole) : role.name;
}
```

```ts
import { type ClassValue, clsx } from 'clsx';
import { twMerge } from 'tailwind-merge';

export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]): string {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs));
}

export function formatBytes(value: string | number | null | undefined, locale: string): string | null {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
  const bytes = Number(value);
  const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
  let i = 0;
  let n = bytes;
  while (n >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) {
    n /= 1024;
    i++;
  }
  return `${new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(n)} ${units[i]}`;
}
```

`apps/dashboard/src/lib/zip.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Minimal ZIP writer (stored entries, no compression) for small generated
 * text files such as plugin configurations. Avoids a dependency for a few KB.
 */
export interface ZipEntry {
  name: string;
  content: string | Uint8Array;
}

let table: Uint32Array | null = null;

export function crc32(data: Uint8Array): number {
  if (!table) {
    table = new Uint32Array(256);
    for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
      let c = n;
      for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = c & 1 ? 0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1) : c >>> 1;
      table[n] = c >>> 0;
    }
  }
  let crc = 0xffffffff;
  for (const byte of data) crc = table[(crc ^ byte) & 0xff] ^ (crc >>> 8);
  return (crc ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0;
}

/** MS-DOS date/time as used by ZIP headers. */
function dosDateTime(date: Date): { time: number; date: number } {
  return {
    time: (date.getHours() << 11) | (date.getMinutes() << 5) | Math.floor(date.getSeconds() / 2),
    date: ((date.getFullYear() - 1980) << 9) | ((date.getMonth() + 1) << 5) | date.getDate(),
  };
}

export function createZip(entries: ZipEntry[], now = new Date()): Uint8Array {
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const { time, date } = dosDateTime(now);
  const locals: Uint8Array[] = [];
  const centrals: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let offset = 0;

  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (!entry.name || entry.name.startsWith('/') || entry.name.split('/').includes('..')) throw new Error(`Invalid ZIP entry name: ${entry.name}`);
    const name = encoder.encode(entry.name);
    const data = typeof entry.content === 'string' ? encoder.encode(entry.content) : entry.content;
    const crc = crc32(data);

    const local = new Uint8Array(30 + name.length + data.length);
    const lv = new DataView(local.buffer);
    lv.setUint32(0, 0x04034b50, true);
    lv.setUint16(4, 20, true); // version needed
    lv.setUint16(6, 0x0800, true); // UTF-8 names
    lv.setUint16(8, 0, true); // stored
    lv.setUint16(10, time, true);
    lv.setUint16(12, date, true);
    lv.setUint32(14, crc, true);
    lv.setUint32(18, data.length, true);
    lv.setUint32(22, data.length, true);
    lv.setUint16(26, name.length, true);
    local.set(name, 30);
    local.set(data, 30 + name.length);

    const central = new Uint8Array(46 + name.length);
    const cv = new DataView(central.buffer);
    cv.setUint32(0, 0x02014b50, true);
    cv.setUint16(4, 20, true);
    cv.setUint16(6, 20, true);
    cv.setUint16(8, 0x0800, true);
    cv.setUint16(10, 0, true);
    cv.setUint16(12, time, true);
    cv.setUint16(14, date, true);
    cv.setUint32(16, crc, true);
    cv.setUint32(20, data.length, true);
    cv.setUint32(24, data.length, true);
    cv.setUint16(28, name.length, true);
    cv.setUint32(42, offset, true);
    central.set(name, 46);

    locals.push(local);
    centrals.push(central);
    offset += local.length;
  }

  const centralSize = centrals.reduce((sum, c) => sum + c.length, 0);
  const end = new Uint8Array(22);
  const ev = new DataView(end.buffer);
  ev.setUint32(0, 0x06054b50, true);
  ev.setUint16(8, entries.length, true);
  ev.setUint16(10, entries.length, true);
  ev.setUint32(12, centralSize, true);
  ev.setUint32(16, offset, true);

  const out = new Uint8Array(offset + centralSize + end.length);
  let position = 0;
  for (const part of [...locals, ...centrals, end]) {
    out.set(part, position);
    position += part.length;
  }
  return out;
}

/** Offers bytes or text as a file download without putting anything in a URL query. */
export function downloadFile(name: string, content: Uint8Array | string, type: string): void {
  const blob = new Blob([typeof content === 'string' ? content : new Uint8Array(content)], { type });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = name;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 10_000);
}
```

`apps/paper-plugin/src/main/java/dev/mnm/paper/ChatMuteListener.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.paper;

import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.PunishmentCache;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.PunishmentTexts;
import io.papermc.paper.event.player.AsyncChatEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.EventHandler;
import org.bukkit.event.EventPriority;
import org.bukkit.event.Listener;

/**
 * Enforces network mutes on the backend server. Chat is blocked here rather
 * than on the proxy because Velocity cannot cancel signed chat messages.
 * Reads only the thread-safe local cache, so it is safe on async chat threads.
 */
final class ChatMuteListener implements Listener {
    private final PunishmentCache cache;
    private final PunishmentTexts texts;

    ChatMuteListener(PunishmentCache cache, PunishmentTexts texts) {
        this.cache = cache;
        this.texts = texts;
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onChat(AsyncChatEvent event) {
        cache.findMute(event.getPlayer().getUniqueId(), System.currentTimeMillis()).ifPresent(mute -> {
            event.setCancelled(true);
            event.getPlayer().sendMessage(texts.muteNotice(mute));
        });
    }
}
```

`apps/paper-plugin/src/main/java/dev/mnm/paper/IntervalTask.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.paper;

import java.util.function.IntSupplier;

/**
 * Runs {@code task} every {@code interval} seconds while being scheduled once
 * per second. The interval is re-read on every call, so changes made in the
 * dashboard take effect without rescheduling or a restart.
 */
final class IntervalTask implements Runnable {
    private final IntSupplier intervalSeconds;
    private final Runnable task;
    private int elapsed;

    IntervalTask(IntSupplier intervalSeconds, Runnable task) {
        this.intervalSeconds = intervalSeconds;
        this.task = task;
    }

    @Override
    public void run() {
        if (++elapsed < intervalSeconds.getAsInt()) return;
        elapsed = 0;
        task.run();
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.mnm.paper;

import dev.mnm.plugin.BackendConnector;
import dev.mnm.plugin.ManagedSettings;
import dev.mnm.plugin.Messages;
import dev.mnm.plugin.PluginConfig;
import dev.mnm.plugin.StatusLines;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.PunishmentCache;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.PunishmentFeed;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.PunishmentTexts;
import dev.mnm.paper.anticheat.AntiCheatBanCommand;
import dev.mnm.paper.anticheat.AntiCheatBridge;
import dev.mnm.paper.api.AntiCheatApi;
import dev.mnm.paper.inventory.InventorySync;
import dev.mnm.paper.stats.ActivityTracker;
import dev.mnm.paper.stats.StatisticsCollector;
import io.papermc.paper.command.brigadier.BasicCommand;
import io.papermc.paper.command.brigadier.CommandSourceStack;
import io.papermc.paper.plugin.lifecycle.event.types.LifecycleEvents;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.plugin.ServicePriority;
import org.bukkit.plugin.java.JavaPlugin;

/** Paper backend-server plugin: server heartbeats (TPS, MSPT, memory) and per-player game state. */
public final class NetworkManagerPaper extends JavaPlugin {
    static final String ADMIN_PERMISSION = "networkmanager.admin";

    private BackendConnector connector;

    @Override
    public void onEnable() {
        PluginConfig config;
        Messages messages;
        try {
            config = PluginConfig.loadOrCreate(getDataFolder().toPath(), getClassLoader());
            messages = Messages.load(getClassLoader(), config.language());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            getSLF4JLogger().error("Network Manager is disabled: {}", e.getMessage());
            getServer().getPluginManager().disablePlugin(this);
            return;
        }

        ManagedSettings managed = new ManagedSettings(config, getDataFolder().toPath(), getSLF4JLogger());
        managed.bind(messages);
        connector = new BackendConnector(getDataFolder().toPath(), config, new PaperPlatform(this), getPluginMeta().getVersion(), getSLF4JLogger());
        connector.useManagedSettings(managed);
        BackendConnector statusSource = connector;
        getLifecycleManager().registerEventHandler(LifecycleEvents.COMMANDS, event -> event.registrar().register(
                "networkmanager",
                "Shows the Network Manager connection status",
                List.of("nm"),
                new BasicCommand() {
                    @Override
                    public void execute(CommandSourceStack source, String[] args) {
                        StatusLines.render(messages, statusSource.status(), "PAPER").forEach(source.getSender()::sendMessage);
                    }

                    @Override
                    public boolean canUse(CommandSender sender) {
                        return sender.hasPermission(ADMIN_PERMISSION);
                    }

                    @Override
                    public String permission() {
                        return ADMIN_PERMISSION;
                    }
                }));
        // Mutes are enforced here (chat); bans and kicks are handled by the proxy.
        PunishmentTexts texts = new PunishmentTexts(messages);
        if (config.punishmentsEnabled()) {
            PunishmentCache cache = new PunishmentCache();
            PunishmentFeed feed = new PunishmentFeed(connector.client(), cache, getDataFolder().toPath(), punishment -> {}, getSLF4JLogger());
            connector.every3Seconds(feed::poll);
            getServer().getPluginManager().registerEvents(new ChatMuteListener(cache, texts), this);
        } else {
            getSLF4JLogger().warn("punishments-enabled=false: network mutes are NOT enforced on this server.");
        }

        // AntiCheat: Java API (allow-listed integrations) and /anticheatban.
        AntiCheatBridge anticheat = new AntiCheatBridge(this, connector.client(), config.anticheatIntegrations(), config.anticheatMaxReportsPerMinute(), texts, getSLF4JLogger());
        getServer().getServicesManager().register(AntiCheatApi.class, anticheat, this, ServicePriority.Normal);
        getLifecycleManager().registerEventHandler(LifecycleEvents.COMMANDS, event -> event.registrar().register(
                "anticheatban", "Requests an AntiCheat punishment according to the network rules", List.of(), new AntiCheatBanCommand(anticheat, messages)));

        // Inventories and statistics follow the managed settings live: the
        // components are always registered and check the effective values,
        // and intervals are re-read on every timer check.
        InventorySync inventories = new InventorySync(this, connector.client(), managed::inventorySync, managed::enderChestSync, getSLF4JLogger());
        getServer().getPluginManager().registerEvents(inventories, this);
        connector.every3Seconds(inventories::poll);
        getServer().getScheduler().runTaskTimer(this, new IntervalTask(managed::inventorySyncIntervalSeconds, inventories::snapshotAll), 20L, 20L);

        ActivityTracker activity = new ActivityTracker(this, config.afkTimeoutSeconds());
        StatisticsCollector statistics = new StatisticsCollector(connector.client(), activity, managed::statisticsCategories, managed::statisticsEnabled, getSLF4JLogger());
        getServer().getPluginManager().registerEvents(activity, this);
        getServer().getPluginManager().registerEvents(statistics, this);
        getServer().getScheduler().runTaskTimer(this, () -> {
            if (managed.statisticsEnabled()) activity.tick();
        }, 20L, 20L);
        getServer().getScheduler().runTaskTimer(this, statistics::tick, 1L, 1L);
        getServer().getScheduler().runTaskTimer(this, new IntervalTask(managed::statisticsIntervalSeconds, statistics::startRound), 20L, 20L);

        connector.start();
    }

    @Override
    public void onDisable() {
        if (connector != null) connector.stop(Duration.ofSeconds(5));
    }
}
```

`apps/paper-plugin/src/main/java/dev/mnm/paper/PaperPlatform.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.paper;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import dev.mnm.plugin.BackendConnector;
import dev.mnm.plugin.ProcessMetrics;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;

final class PaperPlatform implements BackendConnector.Platform {
    private final Plugin plugin;

    PaperPlatform(Plugin plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public String type() {
        return "PAPER";
    }

    @Override
    public String platformVersion() {
        return Bukkit.getName() + " " + Bukkit.getVersion();
    }

    @Override
    public String minecraftVersion() {
        return Bukkit.getMinecraftVersion();
    }

    /**
     * Player and tick data must be read on the server thread; the snapshot is
     * taken there and the HTTP call continues asynchronously.
     */
    @Override
    public CompletableFuture<JsonObject> heartbeat() {
        CompletableFuture<JsonObject> future = new CompletableFuture<>();
        if (!plugin.isEnabled()) {
            future.completeExceptionally(new IllegalStateException("plugin disabled"));
            return future;
        }
        try {
            Bukkit.getScheduler().runTask(plugin, () -> {
                try {
                    future.complete(snapshot());
                } catch (RuntimeException e) {
                    future.completeExceptionally(e);
                }
            });
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            future.completeExceptionally(e);
        }
        return future;
    }

    private static JsonObject snapshot() {
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.addProperty("onlinePlayers", Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers().size());
        body.addProperty("maxPlayers", Bukkit.getMaxPlayers());
        double tps = Bukkit.getTPS()[0];
        body.addProperty("tps", Math.round(Math.min(tps, 1000) * 100) / 100.0);
        body.addProperty("mspt", Math.round(Bukkit.getAverageTickTime() * 100) / 100.0);
        JsonArray players = new JsonArray();
        for (Player player : Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers()) {
            JsonObject p = new JsonObject();
            p.addProperty("uuid", player.getUniqueId().toString());
            p.addProperty("gamemode", player.getGameMode().name());
            players.add(p);
        }
        body.add("players", players);
        ProcessMetrics.addTo(body);
        return body;
    }
}
```

`apps/paper-plugin/src/main/java/dev/mnm/paper/anticheat/AntiCheatBanCommand.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.paper.anticheat;

import dev.mnm.plugin.Messages;
import io.papermc.paper.command.brigadier.BasicCommand;
import io.papermc.paper.command.brigadier.CommandSourceStack;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

/**
 * {@code /anticheatban <player> <cheatType> <reason>} – explicit punishment
 * request, typically dispatched as console by AntiCheat plugins. The network's
 * rule for the cheat type (or the configured fallback) determines the
 * punishment. Requires {@code networkmanager.anticheat.command} (default: false,
 * console always has it), so regular players can never use it.
 */
public final class AntiCheatBanCommand implements BasicCommand {
    public static final String PERMISSION = "networkmanager.anticheat.command";

    private final AntiCheatBridge bridge;
    private final Messages messages;

    public AntiCheatBanCommand(AntiCheatBridge bridge, Messages messages) {
        this.bridge = bridge;
        this.messages = messages;
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSourceStack source, String[] args) {
        CommandSender sender = source.getSender();
        if (args.length < 3) {
            sender.sendMessage(messages.prefixed("error.usage", Map.of("usage", "/anticheatban <player> <cheatType> <reason>")));
            return;
        }
        String target = args[0];
        String cheatType = args[1];
        String reason = String.join(" ", Arrays.copyOfRange(args, 2, args.length));
        String provider = sender instanceof Player p ? "Command " + p.getName() : "Console";
        bridge.command(provider, target, cheatType, reason).whenComplete((result, error) -> {
            if (error != null) sender.sendMessage(messages.prefixed("error.backend-unavailable", Map.of()));
            else sender.sendMessage(messages.prefixed("anticheat.result", Map.of("player", target, "cheat", cheatType, "outcome", result.outcome().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))));
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Collection<String> suggest(CommandSourceStack source, String[] args) {
        if (args.length > 1) return java.util.List.of();
        String prefix = args.length == 0 ? "" : args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers().stream().map(Player::getName).filter(n -> n.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith(prefix)).toList();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canUse(CommandSender sender) {
        return sender.hasPermission(PERMISSION);
    }

    @Override
    public String permission() {
        return PERMISSION;
    }
}
```

`apps/paper-plugin/src/main/java/dev/mnm/paper/anticheat/AntiCheatBridge.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.paper.anticheat;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import dev.mnm.paper.api.AntiCheatApi;
import dev.mnm.paper.api.AntiCheatReport;
import dev.mnm.paper.api.ReportResult;
import dev.mnm.plugin.BackendClient;
import dev.mnm.plugin.BackendException;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.PunishmentTexts;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletionException;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
import org.slf4j.Logger;

/**
 * Implementation of {@link AntiCheatApi}. Authorises integrations, rate limits
 * them, forwards reports to the backend (which applies the network's rules)
 * and disconnects the player locally when a kick or ban was issued, so they do
 * not keep playing until the proxy picks the punishment up.
 */
public final class AntiCheatBridge implements AntiCheatApi {
    private static final int MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3;
    private static final Set<String> DISCONNECTING = Set.of("KICK", "TEMP_BAN", "BAN");

    private final Plugin owner;
    private final BackendClient client;
    private final Set<String> integrations;
    private final RateLimiter limiter;
    private final PunishmentTexts texts;
    private final Logger logger;

    public AntiCheatBridge(Plugin owner, BackendClient client, Set<String> integrations, int maxReportsPerMinute, PunishmentTexts texts, Logger logger) {
        this.owner = owner;
        this.client = client;
        this.integrations = integrations;
        this.limiter = new RateLimiter(maxReportsPerMinute, 60_000);
        this.texts = texts;
        this.logger = logger;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAuthorized(Plugin integration) {
        return integration != null && integrations.contains(integration.getName().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
    }

    @Override
    public CompletableFuture<ReportResult> report(Plugin integration, AntiCheatReport report) {
        if (!isAuthorized(integration)) {
            logger.warn("Rejected AntiCheat report from unauthorised plugin {} (add it to anticheat-integrations)", integration == null ? "null" : integration.getName());
            return CompletableFuture.failedFuture(new SecurityException("Plugin is not an authorised AntiCheat integration"));
        }
        return submit(integration.getName(), report.player().toString(), report, false);
    }

    /** Explicit request from /anticheatban (provider = command sender description). */
    public CompletableFuture<ReportResult> command(String provider, String target, String cheatType, String reason) {
        return submit(provider, target, new AntiCheatReport(new UUID(0, 0), cheatType, null, reason, null, Map.of()), true);
    }

    private CompletableFuture<ReportResult> submit(String provider, String target, AntiCheatReport report, boolean explicit) {
        if (!limiter.tryAcquire(provider.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))) {
            logger.warn("AntiCheat report from {} dropped: rate limit exceeded", provider);
            return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(new ReportResult("SKIPPED_RATE_LIMIT", null));
        }
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.addProperty("target", target);
        body.addProperty("provider", provider.replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9 _.-]", "").isBlank() ? "Unknown" : provider.replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9 _.-]", ""));
        body.addProperty("cheatType", report.cheatType());
        if (report.violationLevel() != null) body.addProperty("violationLevel", report.violationLevel());
        if (report.reason() != null && !report.reason().isBlank()) body.addProperty("reason", report.reason());
        if (report.evidence() != null) body.addProperty("evidence", report.evidence());
        if (!report.metadata().isEmpty()) {
            JsonObject meta = new JsonObject();
            report.metadata().forEach((k, v) -> {
                if (v instanceof Number n) meta.addProperty(k, n);
                else if (v instanceof Boolean b) meta.addProperty(k, b);
                else meta.addProperty(k, String.valueOf(v));
            });
            body.add("metadata", meta);
        }
        body.addProperty("explicit", explicit);
        // Same key on every retry: the backend never punishes twice for one report.
        body.addProperty("eventKey", UUID.randomUUID().toString());
        return send(body, 1).thenApply(response -> {
            ReportResult result = new ReportResult(response.get("outcome").getAsString(), response.get("punishmentId").isJsonNull() ? null : response.get("punishmentId").getAsString());
            if (DISCONNECTING.contains(result.outcome())) disconnectLocally(target, report.reason() != null ? report.reason() : "[AntiCheat] " + report.cheatType());
            return result;
        });
    }

    private CompletableFuture<JsonObject> send(JsonObject body, int attempt) {
        return client.post("/api/plugin/v1/anticheat/reports", body).handle((response, error) -> {
            if (error == null) return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(response);
            Throwable cause = error instanceof CompletionException && error.getCause() != null ? error.getCause() : error;
            boolean retryable = !(cause instanceof BackendException be) || be.status() == 0 || be.status() >= 500;
            if (retryable && attempt < MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
                Executor delayed = CompletableFuture.delayedExecutor((long) Math.pow(4, attempt - 1), TimeUnit.SECONDS);
                return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -> body, delayed).thenCompose(b -> send(b, attempt + 1));
            }
            return CompletableFuture.<JsonObject>failedFuture(cause);
        }).thenCompose(f -> f);
    }

    private void disconnectLocally(String target, String reason) {
        if (!owner.isEnabled()) return;
        Bukkit.getScheduler().runTask(owner, () -> {
            Player player;
            try {
                player = Bukkit.getPlayer(UUID.fromString(target));
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException notUuid) {
                player = Bukkit.getPlayerExact(target);
            }
            if (player != null) player.kick(texts.kickScreen(reason));
        });
    }

    /** Fixed-window limiter per integration. */
    static final class RateLimiter {
        private final int limit;
        private final long windowMillis;
        private final Map<String, long[]> windows = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

        RateLimiter(int limit, long windowMillis) {
            this.limit = limit;
            this.windowMillis = windowMillis;
        }

        boolean tryAcquire(String key) {
            long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
            long[] window = windows.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new long[] {now, 0});
            synchronized (window) {
                if (now - window[0] >= windowMillis) {
                    window[0] = now;
                    window[1] = 0;
                }
                if (window[1] >= limit) return false;
                window[1]++;
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.mnm.paper.api;

import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;

/**
 * Public API for AntiCheat plugins. Obtain it from Bukkit's services manager:
 *
 * <pre>{@code
 * AntiCheatApi api = Bukkit.getServicesManager().load(AntiCheatApi.class);
 * if (api != null) {
 *     api.report(this, AntiCheatReport.builder(player.getUniqueId(), "Speed")
 *             .violationLevel(12.5)
 *             .evidence("moved 12.3 blocks/s")
 *             .metadata("ping", 42)
 *             .build());
 * }
 * }</pre>
 *
 * Only plugins listed in {@code anticheat-integrations} (config.properties) may
 * report. The network's rules (configured in the dashboard) decide whether a
 * report is only logged or leads to a warning, kick or ban. Reports are rate
 * limited per integration.
 */
public interface AntiCheatApi {

    /**
     * Submits a report asynchronously. Never blocks the calling thread.
     *
     * @param integration the reporting plugin (must be allow-listed)
     * @param report the violation
     * @return the outcome decided by the network's rules
     */
    CompletableFuture<ReportResult> report(Plugin integration, AntiCheatReport report);

    /** Whether the given plugin is allowed to use {@link #report}. */
    boolean isAuthorized(Plugin integration);
}
```

`apps/paper-plugin/src/main/java/dev/mnm/paper/api/AntiCheatReport.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.paper.api;

import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * A violation reported by an AntiCheat integration.
 *
 * @param player the offending player
 * @param cheatType check name, matched case-insensitively against the network's rules (e.g. "Speed")
 * @param violationLevel the integration's violation level, used for rule thresholds (optional)
 * @param reason punishment reason shown to the player (optional; defaults to "[AntiCheat] cheatType")
 * @param evidence free-text evidence stored with the punishment (optional)
 * @param metadata additional key/value details (strings, numbers, booleans)
 */
public record AntiCheatReport(UUID player, String cheatType, Double violationLevel, String reason, String evidence, Map<String, Object> metadata) {

    public AntiCheatReport {
        Objects.requireNonNull(player, "player");
        Objects.requireNonNull(cheatType, "cheatType");
        metadata = metadata == null ? Map.of() : Collections.unmodifiableMap(new LinkedHashMap<>(metadata));
    }

    public static Builder builder(UUID player, String cheatType) {
        return new Builder(player, cheatType);
    }

    public static final class Builder {
        private final UUID player;
        private final String cheatType;
        private Double violationLevel;
        private String reason;
        private String evidence;
        private final Map<String, Object> metadata = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        private Builder(UUID player, String cheatType) {
            this.player = player;
            this.cheatType = cheatType;
        }

        public Builder violationLevel(double level) {
            this.violationLevel = level;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder reason(String reason) {
            this.reason = reason;
            return this;
        }

        public Builder evidence(String evidence) {
            this.evidence = evidence;
            return this;
        }

        /** Adds a metadata entry. Supported values: String, Number, Boolean. */
        public Builder metadata(String key, Object value) {
            if (value instanceof String || value instanceof Number || value instanceof Boolean) metadata.put(key, value);
            else throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported metadata value type: " + (value == null ? "null" : value.getClass().getName()));
            return this;
        }

        public AntiCheatReport build() {
            return new AntiCheatReport(player, cheatType, violationLevel, reason, evidence, metadata);
        }
    }
}
```

`apps/paper-plugin/src/main/java/dev/mnm/paper/inventory/InventorySync.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.paper.inventory;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import dev.mnm.plugin.BackendClient;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.event.EventHandler;
import org.bukkit.event.EventPriority;
import org.bukkit.event.Listener;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerJoinEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerQuitEvent;
import org.bukkit.inventory.Inventory;
import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
import org.slf4j.Logger;

/**
 * Inventory and Ender Chest synchronisation.
 *
 * <p>Snapshots are sent on join, on quit, periodically and on request. Edits
 * from the dashboard arrive as revisions of per-slot compare-and-set changes:
 * every slot must still hold the expected item (fingerprint) or the whole
 * revision is rejected as a conflict. Validation and application happen in one
 * main-thread task, so the player cannot change the inventory in between –
 * items can neither be duplicated nor lost.
 *
 * <p>Results are reported with retries; a revision that was applied but not yet
 * acknowledged is never applied again (its result is re-sent instead).
 */
public final class InventorySync implements Listener {
    private static final int INVENTORY_SIZE = 41;
    private static final int ENDER_CHEST_SIZE = 27;

    private final Plugin plugin;
    private final BackendClient client;
    private final BooleanSupplier syncInventory;
    private final BooleanSupplier syncEnderChest;
    private final Logger logger;
    private final AtomicBoolean polling = new AtomicBoolean();
    /** Results not yet acknowledged by the backend (revision id → result body). */
    private final Map<String, JsonObject> unacknowledged = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public InventorySync(Plugin plugin, BackendClient client, BooleanSupplier syncInventory, BooleanSupplier syncEnderChest, Logger logger) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
        this.client = client;
        this.syncInventory = syncInventory;
        this.syncEnderChest = syncEnderChest;
        this.logger = logger;
    }

    // ── Snapshots ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /** Main thread. */
    JsonObject snapshot(Player player) {
        JsonObject entry = new JsonObject();
        entry.addProperty("uuid", player.getUniqueId().toString());
        if (syncInventory.getAsBoolean()) entry.add("inventory", ItemCodec.container(player.getInventory(), INVENTORY_SIZE));
        if (syncEnderChest.getAsBoolean()) entry.add("enderChest", ItemCodec.container(player.getEnderChest(), ENDER_CHEST_SIZE));
        return entry;
    }

    /** Main thread: snapshots of all online players (periodic). */
    public void snapshotAll() {
        if (!active()) return;
        List<JsonObject> players = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Player player : Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers()) players.add(snapshot(player));
        send(players);
    }

    private void send(List<JsonObject> players) {
        for (int i = 0; i < players.size(); i += 50) {
            JsonArray chunk = new JsonArray();
            players.subList(i, Math.min(players.size(), i + 50)).forEach(chunk::add);
            JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
            body.addProperty("capturedAt", System.currentTimeMillis());
            body.add("players", chunk);
            client.post("/api/plugin/v1/inventories", body).exceptionally(error -> {
                logger.debug("Inventory snapshot upload failed: {}", error.getMessage());
                return null;
            });
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onJoin(PlayerJoinEvent event) {
        if (!active()) return;
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        // One tick later the inventory is fully loaded.
        Bukkit.getScheduler().runTask(plugin, () -> {
            if (player.isOnline()) send(List.of(snapshot(player)));
        });
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onQuit(PlayerQuitEvent event) {
        if (!active()) return;
        send(List.of(snapshot(event.getPlayer())));
    }

    private boolean active() {
        return syncInventory.getAsBoolean() || syncEnderChest.getAsBoolean();
    }

    // ── Pending edits ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    /** Called every few seconds (any thread). */
    public void poll() {
        if (!client.hasCredentials() || !polling.compareAndSet(false, true)) return;
        // Re-send results the backend has not acknowledged yet before fetching new work.
        unacknowledged.forEach(this::report);
        if (!active()) {
            polling.set(false);
            return;
        }
        client.get("/api/plugin/v1/inventories/pending").whenComplete((body, error) -> {
            polling.set(false);
            if (error != null || !plugin.isEnabled()) return;
            Bukkit.getScheduler().runTask(plugin, () -> handle(body));
        });
    }

    /** Main thread. */
    private void handle(JsonObject body) {
        List<JsonObject> requested = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonElement id : body.getAsJsonArray("snapshotRequests")) {
            Player player = Bukkit.getPlayer(UUID.fromString(id.getAsString()));
            if (player != null) requested.add(snapshot(player));
        }
        if (!requested.isEmpty()) send(requested);
        for (JsonElement revision : body.getAsJsonArray("revisions")) {
            JsonObject r = revision.getAsJsonObject();
            if (unacknowledged.containsKey(r.get("id").getAsString())) continue;
            apply(r);
        }
    }

    /** Main thread: validates every slot, then applies all changes or none. */
    private void apply(JsonObject revision) {
        String id = revision.get("id").getAsString();
        Player player = Bukkit.getPlayer(UUID.fromString(revision.get("playerUuid").getAsString()));
        if (player == null) return; // left meanwhile: stays pending until the next join
        boolean enderChest = "ENDER_CHEST".equals(revision.get("kind").getAsString());
        if (!(enderChest ? syncEnderChest : syncInventory).getAsBoolean()) {
            finish(id, "REJECTED", (enderChest ? "Ender Chest" : "Inventory") + " synchronisation is disabled on this server", null, player, enderChest);
            return;
        }
        Inventory inventory = enderChest ? player.getEnderChest() : player.getInventory();
        int size = enderChest ? ENDER_CHEST_SIZE : INVENTORY_SIZE;

        List<Integer> slots = new ArrayList<>();
        List<ItemStack> targets = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonElement element : revision.getAsJsonArray("changes")) {
            JsonObject change = element.getAsJsonObject();
            int slot = change.get("slot").getAsInt();
            if (slot < 0 || slot >= size) {
                finish(id, "REJECTED", "Slot " + slot + " does not exist", null, player, enderChest);
                return;
            }
            String expected = change.get("before").isJsonNull() ? null : change.get("before").getAsString();
            String actual = ItemCodec.fingerprint(inventory.getItem(slot));
            if (expected == null ? actual != null : !expected.equals(actual)) {
                finish(id, "CONFLICT", "Slot " + slot + " changed in game since the edit was made", null, player, enderChest);
                return;
            }
            try {
                targets.add(change.get("after").isJsonNull() ? null : ItemCodec.decode(change.getAsJsonObject("after")));
            } catch (RuntimeException e) {
                finish(id, "REJECTED", "Slot " + slot + ": " + e.getMessage(), null, player, enderChest);
                return;
            }
            slots.add(slot);
        }

        JsonObject appliedFps = new JsonObject();
        for (int i = 0; i < slots.size(); i++) {
            inventory.setItem(slots.get(i), targets.get(i));
            appliedFps.addProperty(String.valueOf(slots.get(i)), ItemCodec.fingerprint(inventory.getItem(slots.get(i))));
        }
        player.updateInventory();
        logger.info("Applied inventory revision {} for {} ({} slot(s))", id, player.getName(), slots.size());
        finish(id, "APPLIED", null, appliedFps, player, enderChest);
    }

    private void finish(String revisionId, String status, String message, JsonObject appliedFps, Player player, boolean enderChest) {
        JsonObject result = new JsonObject();
        result.addProperty("status", status);
        if (message != null) result.addProperty("message", message.length() > 500 ? message.substring(0, 500) : message);
        if (appliedFps != null) result.add("appliedFps", appliedFps);
        result.add("snapshot", ItemCodec.container(enderChest ? player.getEnderChest() : player.getInventory(), enderChest ? ENDER_CHEST_SIZE : INVENTORY_SIZE));
        if (!"APPLIED".equals(status)) logger.warn("Inventory revision {} for {}: {} ({})", revisionId, player.getName(), status, message);
        unacknowledged.put(revisionId, result);
        report(revisionId, result);
    }

    private void report(String revisionId, JsonObject result) {
        client.post("/api/plugin/v1/inventories/revisions/" + revisionId + "/result", result)
                .thenAccept(ok -> unacknowledged.remove(revisionId))
                .exceptionally(error -> {
                    logger.debug("Reporting inventory revision {} failed, will retry: {}", revisionId, error.getMessage());
                    return null;
                });
    }
}
```

`apps/paper-plugin/src/main/java/dev/mnm/paper/inventory/ItemCodec.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.paper.inventory;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import io.papermc.paper.registry.RegistryAccess;
import io.papermc.paper.registry.RegistryKey;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
import net.kyori.adventure.text.format.TextDecoration;
import net.kyori.adventure.text.serializer.plain.PlainTextComponentSerializer;
import org.bukkit.Material;
import org.bukkit.NamespacedKey;
import org.bukkit.enchantments.Enchantment;
import org.bukkit.inventory.Inventory;
import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
import org.bukkit.inventory.meta.Damageable;
import org.bukkit.inventory.meta.ItemMeta;

/** Converts items to the backend's JSON form and back. Must run on the server thread. */
final class ItemCodec {
    private static final PlainTextComponentSerializer PLAIN = PlainTextComponentSerializer.plainText();
    private static final HexFormat HEX = HexFormat.of();

    private ItemCodec() {}

    static boolean isEmpty(ItemStack item) {
        return item == null || item.isEmpty();
    }

    /** SHA-256 of the item's full serialized form (null for empty slots). */
    static String fingerprint(ItemStack item) {
        return isEmpty(item) ? null : sha256(item.serializeAsBytes());
    }

    static JsonObject container(Inventory inventory, int size) {
        JsonArray items = new JsonArray();
        StringBuilder all = new StringBuilder();
        for (int slot = 0; slot < size; slot++) {
            ItemStack item = inventory.getItem(slot);
            if (isEmpty(item)) continue;
            JsonObject json = encode(slot, item);
            items.add(json);
            all.append(slot).append(':').append(json.get("fp").getAsString()).append(';');
        }
        JsonObject snapshot = new JsonObject();
        snapshot.add("items", items);
        snapshot.addProperty("fp", sha256(all.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
        return snapshot;
    }

    static JsonObject encode(int slot, ItemStack item) {
        byte[] bytes = item.serializeAsBytes();
        JsonObject json = new JsonObject();
        json.addProperty("slot", slot);
        json.addProperty("id", item.getType().getKey().toString());
        json.addProperty("amount", item.getAmount());
        json.addProperty("fp", sha256(bytes));
        json.addProperty("data", Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(bytes));
        ItemMeta meta = item.getItemMeta();
        if (meta != null) {
            Component name = meta.customName();
            if (name != null) json.addProperty("name", truncate(PLAIN.serialize(name), 100));
            List<Component> lore = meta.lore();
            if (lore != null && !lore.isEmpty()) {
                JsonArray lines = new JsonArray();
                lore.stream().limit(20).forEach(line -> lines.add(truncate(PLAIN.serialize(line), 200)));
                json.add("lore", lines);
            }
            if (meta.hasEnchants()) {
                JsonObject enchants = new JsonObject();
                meta.getEnchants().forEach((enchantment, level) -> enchants.addProperty(enchantment.getKey().toString(), Math.min(255, level)));
                json.add("enchantments", enchants);
            }
            if (meta instanceof Damageable damageable && damageable.hasMaxDamage()) {
                json.addProperty("damage", damageable.getDamage());
                json.addProperty("maxDamage", damageable.getMaxDamage());
            }
        }
        return json;
    }

    /**
     * Builds the desired item. Starts from server-provided data when present
     * (keeps all other components), otherwise from the material.
     *
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the description is invalid on this server
     */
    static ItemStack decode(JsonObject after) {
        Material material = Material.matchMaterial(after.get("id").getAsString());
        if (material == null || !material.isItem() || material.isAir()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown item " + after.get("id").getAsString());
        ItemStack item = after.has("data") && !after.get("data").isJsonNull()
                ? ItemStack.deserializeBytes(Base64.getDecoder().decode(after.get("data").getAsString()))
                : ItemStack.of(material);
        if (item.getType() != material) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Item data does not match " + material.getKey());
        int amount = after.get("amount").getAsInt();
        if (amount < 1 || amount > item.getMaxStackSize()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Amount " + amount + " exceeds the stack size of " + material.getKey());
        item.setAmount(amount);

        item.editMeta(meta -> {
            if (after.has("name")) {
                JsonElement name = after.get("name");
                meta.customName(name.isJsonNull() ? null : Component.text(name.getAsString()).decoration(TextDecoration.ITALIC, false));
            }
            if (after.has("lore")) {
                List<Component> lines = new ArrayList<>();
                after.getAsJsonArray("lore").forEach(l -> lines.add(Component.text(l.getAsString()).decoration(TextDecoration.ITALIC, false)));
                meta.lore(lines.isEmpty() ? null : lines);
            }
            if (after.has("enchantments")) {
                for (Enchantment existing : Map.copyOf(meta.getEnchants()).keySet()) meta.removeEnchant(existing);
                for (Map.Entry<String, JsonElement> e : after.getAsJsonObject("enchantments").entrySet()) {
                    NamespacedKey key = NamespacedKey.fromString(e.getKey());
                    Enchantment enchantment = key == null ? null : RegistryAccess.registryAccess().getRegistry(RegistryKey.ENCHANTMENT).get(key);
                    if (enchantment == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown enchantment " + e.getKey());
                    meta.addEnchant(enchantment, e.getValue().getAsInt(), true);
                }
            }
        });
        return item;
    }

    static String sha256(byte[] data) {
        try {
            return HEX.formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(data));
        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(e);
        }
    }

    private static String truncate(String value, int max) {
        return value.length() <= max ? value : value.substring(0, max);
    }
}
```
