`apps/paper-plugin/src/main/java/dev/mnm/paper/stats/ActivityTracker.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.paper.stats;

import io.papermc.paper.event.player.AsyncChatEvent;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.LongAdder;
import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.NamespacedKey;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.event.EventHandler;
import org.bukkit.event.EventPriority;
import org.bukkit.event.Listener;
import org.bukkit.event.block.BlockBreakEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.block.BlockPlaceEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerCommandPreprocessEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerExpChangeEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerInteractEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerJoinEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerMoveEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerQuitEvent;
import org.bukkit.persistence.PersistentDataContainer;
import org.bukkit.persistence.PersistentDataType;
import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;

/**
 * Tracks values Minecraft does not record itself: active vs. AFK time, chat
 * messages and experience gained. Counters accumulate in memory (thread-safe,
 * chat is async) and are flushed into the player's PersistentDataContainer on
 * the main thread, so they survive restarts like vanilla statistics.
 */
public final class ActivityTracker implements Listener {
    private final NamespacedKey activeKey;
    private final NamespacedKey afkKey;
    private final NamespacedKey chatKey;
    private final NamespacedKey xpKey;
    private final long afkTimeoutMillis;

    private final Map<UUID, Long> lastActivity = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<UUID, Pending> pending = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private static final class Pending {
        final LongAdder active = new LongAdder();
        final LongAdder afk = new LongAdder();
        final LongAdder chat = new LongAdder();
        final LongAdder xp = new LongAdder();
    }

    public ActivityTracker(Plugin plugin, int afkTimeoutSeconds) {
        this.activeKey = new NamespacedKey(plugin, "active_time");
        this.afkKey = new NamespacedKey(plugin, "afk_time");
        this.chatKey = new NamespacedKey(plugin, "chat_messages");
        this.xpKey = new NamespacedKey(plugin, "xp_gained");
        this.afkTimeoutMillis = afkTimeoutSeconds * 1000L;
    }

    /** Called once per second on the main thread: adds one second of active or AFK time per online player. */
    public void tick() {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        for (Player player : Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers()) {
            long last = lastActivity.computeIfAbsent(player.getUniqueId(), id -> now);
            Pending p = pending(player.getUniqueId());
            if (now - last > afkTimeoutMillis) p.afk.increment();
            else p.active.increment();
        }
    }

    /** Main thread: moves pending counters into the player's persistent data. */
    public void flush(Player player) {
        Pending p = pending.remove(player.getUniqueId());
        if (p == null) return;
        PersistentDataContainer pdc = player.getPersistentDataContainer();
        add(pdc, activeKey, p.active.sum());
        add(pdc, afkKey, p.afk.sum());
        add(pdc, chatKey, p.chat.sum());
        add(pdc, xpKey, p.xp.sum());
    }

    public long activeSeconds(Player player) {
        return get(player.getPersistentDataContainer(), activeKey);
    }

    public long afkSeconds(Player player) {
        return get(player.getPersistentDataContainer(), afkKey);
    }

    public long chatMessages(Player player) {
        return get(player.getPersistentDataContainer(), chatKey);
    }

    public long xpGained(Player player) {
        return get(player.getPersistentDataContainer(), xpKey);
    }

    private Pending pending(UUID id) {
        return pending.computeIfAbsent(id, k -> new Pending());
    }

    private void touch(Player player) {
        lastActivity.put(player.getUniqueId(), System.currentTimeMillis());
    }

    private static void add(PersistentDataContainer pdc, NamespacedKey key, long delta) {
        if (delta > 0) pdc.set(key, PersistentDataType.LONG, get(pdc, key) + delta);
    }

    private static long get(PersistentDataContainer pdc, NamespacedKey key) {
        Long value = pdc.get(key, PersistentDataType.LONG);
        return value == null ? 0 : value;
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onJoin(PlayerJoinEvent event) {
        touch(event.getPlayer());
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onMove(PlayerMoveEvent event) {
        Location from = event.getFrom();
        Location to = event.getTo();
        // Head rotation or walking counts as activity; being pushed by water alone does not change yaw/pitch.
        if (from.getYaw() != to.getYaw() || from.getPitch() != to.getPitch() || from.distanceSquared(to) > 0.01) touch(event.getPlayer());
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onInteract(PlayerInteractEvent event) {
        touch(event.getPlayer());
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onBreak(BlockBreakEvent event) {
        touch(event.getPlayer());
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onPlace(BlockPlaceEvent event) {
        touch(event.getPlayer());
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onCommand(PlayerCommandPreprocessEvent event) {
        touch(event.getPlayer());
    }

    /** Async event: only thread-safe structures are touched. Muted (cancelled) messages are not counted. */
    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onChat(AsyncChatEvent event) {
        touch(event.getPlayer());
        pending(event.getPlayer().getUniqueId()).chat.increment();
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onExp(PlayerExpChangeEvent event) {
        if (event.getAmount() > 0) pending(event.getPlayer().getUniqueId()).xp.add(event.getAmount());
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onQuit(PlayerQuitEvent event) {
        lastActivity.remove(event.getPlayer().getUniqueId());
    }
}
```

`apps/paper-plugin/src/main/java/dev/mnm/paper/stats/StatisticsCollector.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.paper.stats;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import dev.mnm.plugin.BackendClient;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
import org.bukkit.Material;
import org.bukkit.Statistic;
import org.bukkit.entity.EntityType;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.event.EventHandler;
import org.bukkit.event.EventPriority;
import org.bukkit.event.Listener;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerQuitEvent;
import org.slf4j.Logger;

/**
 * Reads Minecraft's built-in per-player statistics and sends them to the
 * backend as absolute values. Collection runs on the main thread but is spread
 * over ticks ({@link #PLAYERS_PER_TICK} players each), so large servers see no
 * single expensive tick. HTTP calls are asynchronous. Values that are zero are
 * omitted (the backend treats "absent" as "not collected or zero").
 */
public final class StatisticsCollector implements Listener {
    static final int PLAYERS_PER_TICK = 4;
    private static final int PLAYERS_PER_REQUEST = 50;

    private static final List<Statistic> MOVEMENT = List.of(
            Statistic.WALK_ONE_CM, Statistic.SPRINT_ONE_CM, Statistic.CROUCH_ONE_CM, Statistic.SWIM_ONE_CM, Statistic.FLY_ONE_CM,
            Statistic.AVIATE_ONE_CM, Statistic.BOAT_ONE_CM, Statistic.MINECART_ONE_CM, Statistic.HORSE_ONE_CM, Statistic.JUMP);
    private static final List<Statistic> COMBAT = List.of(
            Statistic.PLAYER_KILLS, Statistic.MOB_KILLS, Statistic.DEATHS, Statistic.DAMAGE_DEALT, Statistic.DAMAGE_TAKEN);
    private static final List<Statistic> GENERAL = List.of(Statistic.FISH_CAUGHT, Statistic.PLAY_ONE_MINUTE);

    private final BackendClient client;
    private final ActivityTracker activity;
    private final java.util.function.Supplier<Set<String>> categories;
    private final java.util.function.BooleanSupplier enabled;
    private final Logger logger;
    private final List<Material> blocks;
    private final List<Material> items;
    private final List<EntityType> mobs;

    private final Deque<UUID> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final List<JsonObject> collected = new ArrayList<>();

    public StatisticsCollector(BackendClient client, ActivityTracker activity, java.util.function.Supplier<Set<String>> categories, java.util.function.BooleanSupplier enabled, Logger logger) {
        this.client = client;
        this.activity = activity;
        this.categories = categories;
        this.enabled = enabled;
        this.logger = logger;
        this.blocks = Arrays.stream(Material.values()).filter(m -> !m.isLegacy() && m.isBlock() && !m.isAir()).toList();
        this.items = Arrays.stream(Material.values()).filter(m -> !m.isLegacy() && m.isItem() && !m.isAir()).toList();
        this.mobs = Arrays.stream(EntityType.values()).filter(e -> e.isAlive() && e != EntityType.PLAYER && e.getKey() != null).toList();
    }

    /** Starts a new collection round (main thread). Ignored while a round is still running. */
    public void startRound() {
        if (!enabled.getAsBoolean() || !queue.isEmpty()) return;
        Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers().forEach(p -> queue.add(p.getUniqueId()));
    }

    /** Called every tick on the main thread: collects a few players, sends when the round is complete. */
    public void tick() {
        for (int i = 0; i < PLAYERS_PER_TICK && !queue.isEmpty(); i++) {
            Player player = Bukkit.getPlayer(queue.poll());
            if (player != null && player.isOnline()) collected.add(snapshot(player));
        }
        if (queue.isEmpty() && !collected.isEmpty()) {
            send(new ArrayList<>(collected));
            collected.clear();
        }
    }

    /** Final values when a player leaves this server (main thread). */
    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onQuit(PlayerQuitEvent event) {
        if (!enabled.getAsBoolean()) return;
        send(List.of(snapshot(event.getPlayer())));
    }

    JsonObject snapshot(Player player) {
        activity.flush(player);
        JsonObject stats = new JsonObject();
        Set<String> categories = this.categories.get();
        if (categories.contains("movement")) MOVEMENT.forEach(s -> put(stats, "custom:" + s.getKey(), player.getStatistic(s)));
        if (categories.contains("combat")) {
            COMBAT.forEach(s -> put(stats, "custom:" + s.getKey(), player.getStatistic(s)));
            for (EntityType mob : mobs) put(stats, "killed:" + mob.getKey(), safe(() -> player.getStatistic(Statistic.KILL_ENTITY, mob)));
        }
        if (categories.contains("blocks")) {
            long mined = 0;
            long placed = 0;
            for (Material block : blocks) {
                int m = safe(() -> player.getStatistic(Statistic.MINE_BLOCK, block));
                mined += m;
                put(stats, "mined:" + block.getKey(), m);
                if (block.isItem()) {
                    // Placing a block counts as "using" its item.
                    int p = safe(() -> player.getStatistic(Statistic.USE_ITEM, block));
                    placed += p;
                    put(stats, "placed:" + block.getKey(), p);
                }
            }
            put(stats, "mnm:blocks_mined", mined);
            put(stats, "mnm:blocks_placed", placed);
        }
        if (categories.contains("general")) {
            GENERAL.forEach(s -> put(stats, "custom:" + s.getKey(), player.getStatistic(s)));
            long crafted = 0;
            long used = 0;
            for (Material item : items) {
                crafted += safe(() -> player.getStatistic(Statistic.CRAFT_ITEM, item));
                used += safe(() -> player.getStatistic(Statistic.USE_ITEM, item));
            }
            put(stats, "mnm:items_crafted", crafted);
            put(stats, "mnm:items_used", used);
            put(stats, "mnm:active_time", activity.activeSeconds(player));
            put(stats, "mnm:afk_time", activity.afkSeconds(player));
            put(stats, "mnm:chat_messages", activity.chatMessages(player));
            put(stats, "mnm:xp_gained", activity.xpGained(player));
        }
        JsonObject entry = new JsonObject();
        entry.addProperty("uuid", player.getUniqueId().toString());
        entry.add("stats", stats);
        return entry;
    }

    private void send(List<JsonObject> players) {
        long capturedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        for (int i = 0; i < players.size(); i += PLAYERS_PER_REQUEST) {
            JsonArray chunk = new JsonArray();
            players.subList(i, Math.min(players.size(), i + PLAYERS_PER_REQUEST)).forEach(chunk::add);
            JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
            body.addProperty("capturedAt", capturedAt);
            body.add("players", chunk);
            // Absolute values: a failed upload is simply superseded by the next round.
            client.post("/api/plugin/v1/statistics", body).exceptionally(error -> {
                logger.debug("Statistics upload failed: {}", error.getMessage());
                return null;
            });
        }
    }

    private static void put(JsonObject stats, String key, long value) {
        if (value > 0) stats.addProperty(key, value);
    }

    /** Some statistic/material combinations are rejected by the server (e.g. technical blocks). */
    private static int safe(java.util.function.IntSupplier read) {
        try {
            return read.getAsInt();
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            return 0;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.mnm.paper.anticheat;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

import dev.mnm.paper.api.AntiCheatReport;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class RateLimiterTest {

    @Test
    void limitsEachIntegrationIndependently() {
        AntiCheatBridge.RateLimiter limiter = new AntiCheatBridge.RateLimiter(2, 60_000);
        assertTrue(limiter.tryAcquire("grim"));
        assertTrue(limiter.tryAcquire("grim"));
        assertFalse(limiter.tryAcquire("grim"), "third report in the window is dropped");
        assertTrue(limiter.tryAcquire("vulcan"), "other integrations are unaffected");
    }

    @Test
    void reopensAfterTheWindow() throws InterruptedException {
        AntiCheatBridge.RateLimiter limiter = new AntiCheatBridge.RateLimiter(1, 50);
        assertTrue(limiter.tryAcquire("grim"));
        assertFalse(limiter.tryAcquire("grim"));
        Thread.sleep(60);
        assertTrue(limiter.tryAcquire("grim"));
    }

    @Test
    void reportBuilderRejectsUnsupportedMetadata() {
        AntiCheatReport.Builder builder = AntiCheatReport.builder(UUID.randomUUID(), "Speed").metadata("ping", 42).metadata("lagging", false);
        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> builder.metadata("location", new Object()));
        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals(2, builder.build().metadata().size());
    }
}
```

`apps/plugin-common/src/main/java/dev/mnm/plugin/BackendClient.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParseException;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletionException;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;
import java.util.function.LongSupplier;

/** Asynchronous JSON client for the backend API. Never blocks Minecraft threads. */
public final class BackendClient {
    private static final Duration TIMEOUT = Duration.ofSeconds(10);

    private final URI baseUrl;
    private final String userAgent;
    private final Gson gson;
    private final HttpClient http;
    private final LongSupplier clock;
    private volatile RequestSigner signer;

    public BackendClient(URI baseUrl, String userAgent, Gson gson, Executor executor) {
        this(baseUrl, userAgent, gson, HttpClient.newBuilder().connectTimeout(TIMEOUT).executor(executor).followRedirects(HttpClient.Redirect.NEVER).build(), System::currentTimeMillis);
    }

    BackendClient(URI baseUrl, String userAgent, Gson gson, HttpClient http, LongSupplier clock) {
        this.baseUrl = baseUrl;
        this.userAgent = userAgent;
        this.gson = gson;
        this.http = http;
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    public void useCredentials(Credentials credentials) {
        this.signer = new RequestSigner(credentials.keyId(), credentials.secret());
    }

    public boolean hasCredentials() {
        return signer != null;
    }

    /** Unsigned call (registration only). */
    public CompletableFuture<JsonObject> postUnsigned(String path, Object body) {
        return send("POST", path, body, false);
    }

    public CompletableFuture<JsonObject> get(String path) {
        return send("GET", path, null, true);
    }

    public CompletableFuture<JsonObject> post(String path, Object body) {
        return send("POST", path, body, true);
    }

    private CompletableFuture<JsonObject> send(String method, String path, Object body, boolean signed) {
        byte[] payload = body == null ? new byte[0] : gson.toJson(body).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        HttpRequest.Builder builder = HttpRequest.newBuilder(baseUrl.resolve(path))
                .timeout(TIMEOUT)
                .header("User-Agent", userAgent)
                .header("Accept", "application/json")
                .method(method, payload.length == 0 ? HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.noBody() : HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofByteArray(payload));
        if (payload.length > 0) builder.header("Content-Type", "application/json");
        if (signed) {
            RequestSigner current = signer;
            if (current == null) return CompletableFuture.failedFuture(new BackendException(401, "NOT_REGISTERED", "Plugin is not registered"));
            current.headers(method, path, payload, clock.getAsLong()).forEach(builder::header);
        }

        return http.sendAsync(builder.build(), HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
                .handle((response, error) -> {
                    if (error != null) {
                        Throwable cause = error instanceof CompletionException && error.getCause() != null ? error.getCause() : error;
                        throw new BackendException("Backend unreachable: " + cause.getClass().getSimpleName() + (cause.getMessage() == null ? "" : " " + cause.getMessage()), cause);
                    }
                    JsonObject json = parse(response.body());
                    if (response.statusCode() / 100 != 2) {
                        String code = json.has("code") ? json.get("code").getAsString() : "HTTP_" + response.statusCode();
                        String message = json.has("message") ? json.get("message").getAsString() : "HTTP " + response.statusCode();
                        throw new BackendException(response.statusCode(), code, message);
                    }
                    return json;
                });
    }

    private static JsonObject parse(String body) {
        if (body == null || body.isBlank()) return new JsonObject();
        try {
            JsonElement element = JsonParser.parseString(body);
            return element.isJsonObject() ? element.getAsJsonObject() : new JsonObject();
        } catch (JsonParseException e) {
            return new JsonObject();
        }
    }
}
```

`apps/plugin-common/src/main/java/dev/mnm/plugin/BackendConnector.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import org.slf4j.Logger;

/**
 * Owns the connection to the backend: registration, heartbeats, ordered event
 * delivery with retry/backoff and (on proxies) periodic full syncs. All network
 * I/O runs on its own threads; platform callbacks must be thread-safe or hop to
 * the main thread themselves.
 */
public final class BackendConnector {

    /** Platform-specific data sources. */
    public interface Platform {
        /** "VELOCITY" or "PAPER". */
        String type();

        String platformVersion();

        String minecraftVersion();

        /** Heartbeat body without pluginVersion/platform fields; may complete on another thread. */
        CompletableFuture<JsonObject> heartbeat();

        /** Proxy only: currently connected sessions for /sync. */
        default Optional<JsonArray> sessions() {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
    }

    public record Status(boolean registered, boolean connected, String serverName, Instant lastSuccess, String lastError, int pendingEvents, long droppedEvents) {}

    private static final int BATCH_SIZE = 200;
    private static final long MAX_BACKOFF_MS = 60_000;

    private final Path dataDirectory;
    private final PluginConfig config;
    private final Platform platform;
    private final String pluginVersion;
    private final Logger logger;
    private final ScheduledExecutorService scheduler;
    private final ExecutorService io;
    private final BackendClient client;
    private final EventQueue queue;

    private final AtomicBoolean flushing = new AtomicBoolean();
    private final List<Runnable> periodicTasks = new java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    private volatile ManagedSettings managedSettings;
    private final AtomicBoolean fetchingConfig = new AtomicBoolean();
    private volatile Credentials credentials;
    private volatile boolean connected;
    private volatile boolean syncRequested = true;
    private volatile Instant lastSuccess;
    private volatile String lastError;
    private volatile long nextFlushAt;
    private volatile long backoffMs = 1000;

    public BackendConnector(Path dataDirectory, PluginConfig config, Platform platform, String pluginVersion, Logger logger) {
        this.dataDirectory = dataDirectory;
        this.config = config;
        this.platform = platform;
        this.pluginVersion = pluginVersion;
        this.logger = logger;
        this.scheduler = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(Thread.ofPlatform().name("mnm-scheduler").daemon().factory());
        this.io = Executors.newThreadPerTaskExecutor(Thread.ofVirtual().name("mnm-io-", 0).factory());
        this.client = new BackendClient(config.backendUrl(), "NetworkManager-" + platform.type() + "/" + pluginVersion, new Gson(), io);
        this.queue = new EventQueue(config.maxQueuedEvents());
    }

    public void start() {
        try {
            credentials = Credentials.load(dataDirectory).orElse(null);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            logger.error("Could not read {}: {}", Credentials.FILE_NAME, e.getMessage());
        }
        if (credentials != null) {
            client.useCredentials(credentials);
            logger.info("Using backend credentials for server \"{}\"", credentials.serverName());
            scheduleLoops();
        } else if (!config.registrationToken().isEmpty()) {
            register();
        } else {
            lastError = "Not registered";
            logger.error("Not registered with the backend. Create a registration token in the dashboard (Settings -> Minecraft Integration), set registration-token in {} and restart.", PluginConfig.FILE_NAME);
        }
    }

    private void register() {
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.addProperty("token", config.registrationToken());
        body.addProperty("pluginVersion", pluginVersion);
        body.addProperty("platformVersion", platform.platformVersion());
        if (platform.minecraftVersion() != null) body.addProperty("minecraftVersion", platform.minecraftVersion());

        client.postUnsigned("/api/plugin/v1/register", body).whenComplete((response, error) -> {
            if (error != null) {
                BackendException e = unwrap(error);
                lastError = e.getMessage();
                if (e.status() == 401) {
                    logger.error("Registration token was rejected (invalid, expired or already used). Create a new token in the dashboard.");
                } else {
                    logger.warn("Registration failed ({}), retrying in 30 seconds", e.getMessage());
                    scheduler.schedule(this::register, 30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
                }
                return;
            }
            Credentials issued = new Credentials(
                    response.get("keyId").getAsString(),
                    response.get("secret").getAsString(),
                    response.get("serverId").getAsString(),
                    response.get("serverName").getAsString());
            try {
                issued.save(dataDirectory);
            } catch (IOException ioError) {
                logger.error("Registered as \"{}\" but could not save {}: {}", issued.serverName(), Credentials.FILE_NAME, ioError.getMessage());
            }
            credentials = issued;
            client.useCredentials(issued);
            logger.info("Registered with the backend as \"{}\". The registration token is no longer needed and can be removed from {}.", issued.serverName(), PluginConfig.FILE_NAME);
            scheduleLoops();
        });
    }

    private void scheduleLoops() {
        scheduler.execute(this::heartbeat);
        scheduler.scheduleWithFixedDelay(this::heartbeat, config.heartbeatIntervalSeconds(), config.heartbeatIntervalSeconds(), TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        scheduler.scheduleWithFixedDelay(this::flush, 1, 1, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        if (isProxy()) scheduler.scheduleWithFixedDelay(() -> syncRequested = true, config.syncIntervalSeconds(), config.syncIntervalSeconds(), TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        scheduler.scheduleWithFixedDelay(this::runPeriodicTasks, 0, 3, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
    }

    /** Registers work that runs every 3 seconds once the plugin is registered (e.g. the punishment feed). */
    public void every3Seconds(Runnable task) {
        periodicTasks.add(task);
    }

    /** Receives centrally managed settings whenever their revision changes. */
    public void useManagedSettings(ManagedSettings settings) {
        this.managedSettings = settings;
    }

    /** Shared, signed HTTP client (for feature modules such as moderation). */
    public BackendClient client() {
        return client;
    }

    private void runPeriodicTasks() {
        for (Runnable task : periodicTasks) {
            try {
                task.run();
            } catch (RuntimeException e) {
                logger.warn("Periodic task failed: {}", e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    /** Queues a player event; delivery is asynchronous and ordered. Safe to call from any thread. */
    public void enqueue(JsonObject event) {
        queue.add(event);
    }

    public Status status() {
        return new Status(credentials != null, connected, credentials == null ? null : credentials.serverName(), lastSuccess, lastError, queue.size(), queue.droppedTotal());
    }

    private void heartbeat() {
        if (credentials == null) return;
        platform.heartbeat()
                .thenCompose(body -> {
                    body.addProperty("pluginVersion", pluginVersion);
                    body.addProperty("platformVersion", platform.platformVersion());
                    if (platform.minecraftVersion() != null) body.addProperty("minecraftVersion", platform.minecraftVersion());
                    return client.post("/api/plugin/v1/heartbeat", body);
                })
                .whenComplete((response, error) -> {
                    if (error != null) {
                        onFailure("heartbeat", unwrap(error));
                        return;
                    }
                    onSuccess();
                    if (response != null && response.has("configRevision")) checkConfig(response.get("configRevision").getAsLong());
                });
    }

    /** Fetches managed settings when the backend reports a revision we have not applied. */
    private void checkConfig(long revision) {
        ManagedSettings settings = managedSettings;
        if (settings == null || !settings.enabled() || settings.revision() == revision || !fetchingConfig.compareAndSet(false, true)) return;
        client.get("/api/plugin/v1/config").whenComplete((config, error) -> {
            fetchingConfig.set(false);
            if (error != null) logger.warn("Could not fetch managed settings: {}", unwrap(error).getMessage());
            else settings.apply(config);
        });
    }

    /** Sends the next batch (or a sync) unless one is in flight or we are backing off. */
    private void flush() {
        if (credentials == null || System.currentTimeMillis() < nextFlushAt || !flushing.compareAndSet(false, true)) return;
        try {
            if (queue.consumeOverflow()) {
                logger.warn("Event buffer overflowed ({} events dropped in total); a full sync will repair session state.", queue.droppedTotal());
                syncRequested = true;
            }
            CompletableFuture<?> work;
            if (isProxy() && syncRequested && queue.size() == 0) {
                work = sync();
            } else {
                List<JsonObject> batch = queue.peek(BATCH_SIZE);
                if (batch.isEmpty()) {
                    flushing.set(false);
                    return;
                }
                JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
                JsonArray events = new JsonArray();
                batch.forEach(events::add);
                body.add("events", events);
                work = client.post("/api/plugin/v1/events", body).thenAccept(response -> {
                    queue.acknowledge(batch);
                    if (config.debug()) logger.info("Delivered {} event(s): {}", batch.size(), response);
                }).exceptionally(error -> {
                    BackendException e = unwrap(error);
                    if (e.status() == 400) {
                        // A malformed event would block the queue forever: drop the batch and resync.
                        logger.error("Backend rejected {} event(s) as invalid ({}); dropping them and scheduling a sync.", batch.size(), e.getMessage());
                        queue.acknowledge(batch);
                        syncRequested = true;
                        return null;
                    }
                    throw e;
                });
            }
            work.whenComplete((ok, error) -> {
                flushing.set(false);
                if (error == null) onSuccess();
                else onFailure("event delivery", unwrap(error));
            });
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            flushing.set(false);
            onFailure("event delivery", unwrap(e));
        }
    }

    private CompletableFuture<?> sync() {
        JsonArray sessions = platform.sessions().orElseGet(JsonArray::new);
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("sessions", sessions);
        return client.post("/api/plugin/v1/sync", body).thenAccept(result -> {
            syncRequested = false;
            if (config.debug()) logger.info("Synced {} session(s): {}", sessions.size(), result);
        });
    }

    private void onSuccess() {
        if (!connected) {
            logger.info("Connected to the backend");
            syncRequested = true;
        }
        connected = true;
        lastSuccess = Instant.now();
        lastError = null;
        backoffMs = 1000;
        nextFlushAt = 0;
    }

    private void onFailure(String what, BackendException e) {
        lastError = e.code() + ": " + e.getMessage();
        if (connected) logger.warn("Lost connection to the backend during {}: {}. Events are buffered ({} pending).", what, e.getMessage(), queue.size());
        else if (config.debug()) logger.warn("{} failed: {}", what, e.getMessage());
        if (e.isAuthenticationFailure()) {
            logger.error("The backend rejected this server's credentials ({}). If they were rotated or revoked, delete {} and register again with a new token.", e.code(), Credentials.FILE_NAME);
        } else if (e.status() == 403) {
            logger.error("The backend refused this server: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
        connected = false;
        nextFlushAt = System.currentTimeMillis() + backoffMs;
        backoffMs = Math.min(backoffMs * 2, MAX_BACKOFF_MS);
    }

    /**
     * Graceful shutdown: tries to deliver queued events and tells the backend
     * the server is going offline. Blocks for at most {@code timeout}.
     */
    public void stop(Duration timeout) {
        scheduler.shutdownNow();
        if (credentials != null) {
            long deadline = System.nanoTime() + timeout.toNanos();
            try {
                while (queue.size() > 0 && System.nanoTime() < deadline) {
                    List<JsonObject> batch = queue.peek(BATCH_SIZE);
                    JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
                    JsonArray events = new JsonArray();
                    batch.forEach(events::add);
                    body.add("events", events);
                    client.post("/api/plugin/v1/events", body).get(remaining(deadline), TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS);
                    queue.acknowledge(batch);
                }
                client.post("/api/plugin/v1/shutdown", Map.of()).get(Math.max(remaining(deadline), TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(1)), TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                logger.warn("Could not notify the backend about the shutdown ({} event(s) undelivered): {}", queue.size(), e.getMessage());
            }
        }
        io.shutdownNow();
    }

    private boolean isProxy() {
        return "VELOCITY".equals(platform.type());
    }

    private static long remaining(long deadline) {
        return Math.max(1, deadline - System.nanoTime());
    }

    private static BackendException unwrap(Throwable error) {
        Throwable t = error;
        while (t.getCause() != null && !(t instanceof BackendException)) t = t.getCause();
        return t instanceof BackendException be ? be : new BackendException(t.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + t.getMessage(), t);
    }
}
```

`apps/plugin-common/src/main/java/dev/mnm/plugin/BackendException.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin;

/** Error returned by the backend API (non-2xx) or a transport failure (status 0). */
public final class BackendException extends RuntimeException {
    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;

    private final int status;
    private final String code;

    public BackendException(int status, String code, String message) {
        super(message);
        this.status = status;
        this.code = code;
    }

    public BackendException(String message, Throwable cause) {
        super(message, cause);
        this.status = 0;
        this.code = "TRANSPORT_ERROR";
    }

    public int status() {
        return status;
    }

    public String code() {
        return code;
    }

    /** Errors that will not go away by retrying the same request. */
    public boolean isPermanent() {
        return status == 400 || status == 403 || status == 404 || status == 422;
    }

    public boolean isAuthenticationFailure() {
        return status == 401;
    }
}
```

`apps/plugin-common/src/main/java/dev/mnm/plugin/Credentials.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.Reader;
import java.io.Writer;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.FileSystems;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.nio.file.attribute.PosixFilePermissions;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Properties;

/** Long-lived plugin credential issued by the backend at registration. */
public record Credentials(String keyId, String secret, String serverId, String serverName) {

    public static final String FILE_NAME = "credentials.properties";

    public static Optional<Credentials> load(Path dataDirectory) throws IOException {
        Path file = dataDirectory.resolve(FILE_NAME);
        if (!Files.exists(file)) return Optional.empty();
        Properties p = new Properties();
        try (Reader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(file, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            p.load(reader);
        }
        String keyId = p.getProperty("key-id", "").trim();
        String secret = p.getProperty("secret", "").trim();
        if (keyId.isEmpty() || secret.isEmpty()) return Optional.empty();
        return Optional.of(new Credentials(keyId, secret, p.getProperty("server-id", ""), p.getProperty("server-name", "")));
    }

    /** Writes atomically and restricts the file to the owner where the file system supports it. */
    public void save(Path dataDirectory) throws IOException {
        Files.createDirectories(dataDirectory);
        Path target = dataDirectory.resolve(FILE_NAME);
        Path temp = Files.createTempFile(dataDirectory, "credentials", ".tmp");
        if (FileSystems.getDefault().supportedFileAttributeViews().contains("posix")) {
            Files.setPosixFilePermissions(temp, PosixFilePermissions.fromString("rw-------"));
        }
        Properties p = new Properties();
        p.setProperty("key-id", keyId);
        p.setProperty("secret", secret);
        p.setProperty("server-id", serverId);
        p.setProperty("server-name", serverName);
        try (Writer writer = Files.newBufferedWriter(temp, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            p.store(writer, "Network Manager backend credentials - keep secret, do not share");
        }
        Files.move(temp, target, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "Credentials[keyId=" + keyId + ", serverName=" + serverName + "]";
    }
}
```

`apps/plugin-common/src/main/java/dev/mnm/plugin/EventQueue.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Bounded, ordered in-memory buffer of player events. Events stay queued until
 * the backend acknowledges them, so short outages lose nothing. When the buffer
 * is full the oldest events are dropped and {@link #consumeOverflow()} reports
 * it, so the caller can repair state with a full sync.
 */
public final class EventQueue {
    private final int capacity;
    private final Deque<JsonObject> events = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private boolean overflowed;
    private long dropped;

    public EventQueue(int capacity) {
        if (capacity < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("capacity must be positive");
        this.capacity = capacity;
    }

    public synchronized void add(JsonObject event) {
        if (events.size() >= capacity) {
            events.pollFirst();
            overflowed = true;
            dropped++;
        }
        events.addLast(event);
    }

    /** Oldest events first, without removing them. */
    public synchronized List<JsonObject> peek(int max) {
        List<JsonObject> batch = new ArrayList<>(Math.min(max, events.size()));
        for (JsonObject event : events) {
            if (batch.size() >= max) break;
            batch.add(event);
        }
        return batch;
    }

    /**
     * Removes the given acknowledged events. Compares by identity so events
     * dropped by overflow in the meantime are handled correctly.
     */
    public synchronized void acknowledge(List<JsonObject> sent) {
        for (JsonObject event : sent) {
            if (!events.isEmpty() && events.peekFirst() == event) events.pollFirst();
            else events.removeIf(e -> e == event);
        }
    }

    public synchronized int size() {
        return events.size();
    }

    public synchronized long droppedTotal() {
        return dropped;
    }

    /** True once after events were dropped. */
    public synchronized boolean consumeOverflow() {
        boolean value = overflowed;
        overflowed = false;
        return value;
    }
}
```

`apps/plugin-common/src/main/java/dev/mnm/plugin/ManagedSettings.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin;

import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.TreeSet;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
import org.slf4j.Logger;

/**
 * Effective settings: values managed in the dashboard override the local
 * {@code config.properties}; a missing/null remote value keeps the local one.
 * The last remote document is cached in {@code managed-settings.json} so it
 * also applies when the plugin starts while the backend is unreachable.
 * Thread-safe; listeners run on the thread that applied the update.
 */
public final class ManagedSettings {
    public static final String CACHE_FILE = "managed-settings.json";

    private final PluginConfig local;
    private final Path cacheFile;
    private final Logger logger;
    private final List<Runnable> listeners = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    private volatile JsonObject remote = new JsonObject();
    private volatile long revision = -1;

    public ManagedSettings(PluginConfig local, Path dataDirectory, Logger logger) {
        this.local = local;
        this.cacheFile = dataDirectory.resolve(CACHE_FILE);
        this.logger = logger;
        if (local.managedSettings() && Files.exists(cacheFile)) {
            try {
                JsonObject cached = JsonParser.parseString(Files.readString(cacheFile, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).getAsJsonObject();
                remote = cached;
                revision = cached.has("revision") ? cached.get("revision").getAsLong() : -1;
            } catch (IOException | RuntimeException e) {
                logger.warn("Ignoring unreadable {}: {}", CACHE_FILE, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean enabled() {
        return local.managedSettings();
    }

    /** Revision of the applied remote settings (-1 = none yet). */
    public long revision() {
        return revision;
    }

    public void onChange(Runnable listener) {
        listeners.add(listener);
    }

    /** Applies a document from {@code GET /api/plugin/v1/config}. */
    public void apply(JsonObject config) {
        if (!local.managedSettings()) return;
        long next = config.has("revision") ? config.get("revision").getAsLong() : 0;
        if (next == revision) return;
        remote = config;
        revision = next;
        try {
            Path tmp = cacheFile.resolveSibling(CACHE_FILE + ".tmp");
            Files.writeString(tmp, config.toString(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            Files.move(tmp, cacheFile, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            logger.warn("Could not cache managed settings: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
        logger.info("Applied managed settings revision {} from the dashboard", next);
        for (Runnable listener : listeners) {
            try {
                listener.run();
            } catch (RuntimeException e) {
                logger.warn("Applying managed settings failed: {}", e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }

    /** Keeps plugin messages in sync with the managed language and overrides (applies immediately). */
    public void bind(Messages messages) {
        Runnable update = () -> {
            String locale = language();
            try {
                messages.apply(locale, messageOverrides(locale));
            } catch (IOException e) {
                logger.warn("Could not load messages for {}: {}", locale, e.getMessage());
            }
        };
        update.run();
        onChange(update);
    }

    // ── Effective values ─────────────────────────────────────────

    public String language() {
        String value = string("language");
        return value != null && value.matches("[a-z]{2,3}-[A-Z]{2}") ? value : local.language();
    }

    /** Message overrides for the given locale (empty when none). */
    public Map<String, String> messageOverrides(String locale) {
        JsonElement messages = field("messages");
        if (messages == null || !messages.isJsonObject()) return Map.of();
        JsonElement entries = messages.getAsJsonObject().get(locale);
        if (entries == null || !entries.isJsonObject()) return Map.of();
        Map<String, String> out = new HashMap<>();
        entries.getAsJsonObject().entrySet().forEach(e -> {
            if (e.getValue().isJsonPrimitive()) out.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue().getAsString());
        });
        return Collections.unmodifiableMap(out);
    }

    public boolean statisticsEnabled() {
        return bool("statisticsEnabled", local.statisticsEnabled());
    }

    public Set<String> statisticsCategories() {
        JsonElement value = field("statisticsCategories");
        if (value == null || !value.isJsonArray()) return local.statisticsCategories();
        Set<String> out = new TreeSet<>();
        value.getAsJsonArray().forEach(e -> {
            String c = e.getAsString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (PluginConfig.STATISTIC_CATEGORIES.contains(c)) out.add(c);
        });
        return Collections.unmodifiableSet(out);
    }

    public int statisticsIntervalSeconds() {
        return integer("statisticsIntervalSeconds", local.statisticsIntervalSeconds(), 60, 3600);
    }

    public boolean inventorySync() {
        return bool("inventorySync", local.inventorySync());
    }

    public boolean enderChestSync() {
        return bool("enderChestSync", local.enderChestSync());
    }

    public int inventorySyncIntervalSeconds() {
        return integer("inventorySyncIntervalSeconds", local.inventorySyncIntervalSeconds(), 30, 3600);
    }

    private JsonElement field(String name) {
        if (!local.managedSettings()) return null;
        JsonElement value = remote.get(name);
        return value == null || value.isJsonNull() ? null : value;
    }

    private String string(String name) {
        JsonElement value = field(name);
        return value != null && value.isJsonPrimitive() ? value.getAsString() : null;
    }

    private boolean bool(String name, boolean fallback) {
        JsonElement value = field(name);
        return value != null && value.isJsonPrimitive() && value.getAsJsonPrimitive().isBoolean() ? value.getAsBoolean() : fallback;
    }

    private int integer(String name, int fallback, int min, int max) {
        JsonElement value = field(name);
        if (value == null || !value.isJsonPrimitive() || !value.getAsJsonPrimitive().isNumber()) return fallback;
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value.getAsInt()));
    }
}
```

`apps/plugin-common/src/main/java/dev/mnm/plugin/Messages.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.Reader;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
import net.kyori.adventure.text.minimessage.MiniMessage;
import net.kyori.adventure.text.minimessage.tag.resolver.Placeholder;
import net.kyori.adventure.text.minimessage.tag.resolver.TagResolver;
import org.yaml.snakeyaml.LoaderOptions;
import org.yaml.snakeyaml.Yaml;
import org.yaml.snakeyaml.constructor.SafeConstructor;

/**
 * Translated plugin messages from {@code messages/<locale>.yml} (maintained in
 * packages/translations/minecraft). Missing keys fall back to en-US. Variables
 * use {@code {name}} and are inserted as plain text, so player-controlled values
 * cannot inject formatting.
 */
public final class Messages {
    public static final String DEFAULT_LOCALE = "en-US";
    private static final Pattern VARIABLE = Pattern.compile("\\{([a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*)}");

    private final ClassLoader resources;
    /** Swapped atomically when the dashboard changes the language or message overrides. */
    private volatile State state;

    private record State(String locale, Map<String, String> messages) {}

    private Messages(ClassLoader resources, State state) {
        this.resources = resources;
        this.state = state;
    }

    public static Messages load(ClassLoader resources, String locale) throws IOException {
        return new Messages(resources, build(resources, locale, Map.of()));
    }

    /**
     * Switches language and applies message overrides from the dashboard.
     * Order: en-US, bundled catalogue of {@code locale}, overrides. Unknown keys
     * are ignored; a locale without bundled file or overrides falls back to en-US.
     */
    public void apply(String locale, Map<String, String> overrides) throws IOException {
        state = build(resources, locale, overrides);
    }

    private static State build(ClassLoader resources, String locale, Map<String, String> overrides) throws IOException {
        Map<String, String> base = read(resources, DEFAULT_LOCALE);
        Map<String, String> merged = new HashMap<>(base);
        String effective = DEFAULT_LOCALE;
        if (!DEFAULT_LOCALE.equals(locale)) {
            Map<String, String> localized = read(resources, locale);
            if (!localized.isEmpty()) {
                merged.putAll(localized);
                effective = locale;
            }
        }
        boolean overridden = false;
        for (Map.Entry<String, String> e : overrides.entrySet()) {
            if (base.containsKey(e.getKey()) && e.getValue() != null) {
                merged.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());
                overridden = true;
            }
        }
        if (overridden && locale.matches("[a-z]{2,3}-[A-Z]{2}")) effective = locale;
        return new State(effective, Map.copyOf(merged));
    }

    static Map<String, String> read(ClassLoader resources, String locale) throws IOException {
        if (!locale.matches("[a-z]{2,3}-[A-Z]{2}")) return Map.of();
        try (InputStream in = resources.getResourceAsStream("messages/" + locale + ".yml")) {
            if (in == null) return Map.of();
            try (Reader reader = new InputStreamReader(in, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                Object root = new Yaml(new SafeConstructor(new LoaderOptions())).load(reader);
                Map<String, String> out = new HashMap<>();
                if (root instanceof Map<?, ?> map) {
                    map.forEach((k, v) -> {
                        if (k != null && v != null) out.put(k.toString(), v.toString());
                    });
                }
                return out;
            }
        }
    }

    public String locale() {
        return state.locale();
    }

    /** Raw MiniMessage template, or the key itself when unknown. */
    public String raw(String key) {
        return state.messages().getOrDefault(key, key);
    }

    /** Renders a message with the network prefix. */
    public Component prefixed(String key, Map<String, String> variables) {
        return render("prefix", Map.of()).append(render(key, variables));
    }

    public Component render(String key, Map<String, String> variables) {
        Matcher matcher = VARIABLE.matcher(raw(key));
        StringBuilder template = new StringBuilder();
        TagResolver.Builder resolvers = TagResolver.builder();
        while (matcher.find()) {
            String name = matcher.group(1).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
            matcher.appendReplacement(template, Matcher.quoteReplacement("<" + name + ">"));
            resolvers.resolver(Placeholder.unparsed(name, variables.getOrDefault(matcher.group(1), "")));
        }
        matcher.appendTail(template);
        return MiniMessage.miniMessage().deserialize(template.toString(), resolvers.build());
    }
}
```

`apps/plugin-common/src/main/java/dev/mnm/plugin/PluginConfig.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.Reader;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.URISyntaxException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Properties;

/** {@code config.properties} in the plugin data folder. Created from the bundled default on first start. */
public record PluginConfig(
        URI backendUrl,
        String registrationToken,
        String language,
        boolean collectIpAddresses,
        int heartbeatIntervalSeconds,
        int syncIntervalSeconds,
        int maxQueuedEvents,
        boolean statisticsEnabled,
        int statisticsIntervalSeconds,
        java.util.Set<String> statisticsCategories,
        int afkTimeoutSeconds,
        java.util.Set<String> anticheatIntegrations,
        int anticheatMaxReportsPerMinute,
        boolean inventorySync,
        boolean enderChestSync,
        int inventorySyncIntervalSeconds,
        boolean punishmentsEnabled,
        boolean moderationCommands,
        boolean managedSettings,
        boolean debug) {

    public static final java.util.Set<String> STATISTIC_CATEGORIES = java.util.Set.of("movement", "combat", "blocks", "general");

    public static final String FILE_NAME = "config.properties";

    public static PluginConfig loadOrCreate(Path dataDirectory, ClassLoader resources) throws IOException {
        Files.createDirectories(dataDirectory);
        Path file = dataDirectory.resolve(FILE_NAME);
        if (!Files.exists(file)) {
            try (InputStream in = Objects.requireNonNull(resources.getResourceAsStream(FILE_NAME), "bundled config.properties missing")) {
                Files.copy(in, file);
            }
        }
        Properties p = new Properties();
        try (Reader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(file, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            p.load(reader);
        }
        return fromProperties(p);
    }

    static PluginConfig fromProperties(Properties p) {
        return new PluginConfig(
                parseBackendUrl(p.getProperty("backend-url", "").trim()),
                p.getProperty("registration-token", "").trim(),
                p.getProperty("language", "en-US").trim(),
                bool(p, "collect-ip-addresses", true),
                clamp(integer(p, "heartbeat-interval-seconds", 15), 5, 300),
                clamp(integer(p, "sync-interval-seconds", 60), 15, 3600),
                clamp(integer(p, "max-queued-events", 50_000), 1_000, 1_000_000),
                bool(p, "statistics-enabled", true),
                clamp(integer(p, "statistics-interval-seconds", 300), 60, 3600),
                categories(p.getProperty("statistics-categories", String.join(",", STATISTIC_CATEGORIES))),
                clamp(integer(p, "afk-timeout-seconds", 300), 30, 3600),
                names(p.getProperty("anticheat-integrations", "")),
                clamp(integer(p, "anticheat-max-reports-per-minute", 120), 1, 10_000),
                bool(p, "inventory-sync", true),
                bool(p, "enderchest-sync", true),
                clamp(integer(p, "inventory-sync-interval-seconds", 300), 30, 3600),
                bool(p, "punishments-enabled", true),
                bool(p, "moderation-commands", true),
                bool(p, "managed-settings", true),
                bool(p, "debug", false));
    }

    /** The backend URL is the dashboard address; the API lives under /api. Paths are not supported. */
    static URI parseBackendUrl(String raw) {
        if (raw.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("backend-url is not set in " + FILE_NAME);
        try {
            URI uri = new URI(raw.endsWith("/") ? raw.substring(0, raw.length() - 1) : raw);
            String scheme = uri.getScheme() == null ? "" : uri.getScheme().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (!scheme.equals("http") && !scheme.equals("https")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("backend-url must start with http:// or https://");
            if (uri.getHost() == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("backend-url has no host");
            if (uri.getRawPath() != null && !uri.getRawPath().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("backend-url must not contain a path");
            return uri;
        } catch (URISyntaxException e) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("backend-url is not a valid URL: " + raw, e);
        }
    }

    /** Comma-separated plugin names, compared case-insensitively (stored lower-case). */
    static java.util.Set<String> names(String raw) {
        java.util.Set<String> out = new java.util.TreeSet<>();
        for (String part : raw.split(",")) {
            String name = part.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (!name.isEmpty()) out.add(name);
        }
        return java.util.Collections.unmodifiableSet(out);
    }

    static java.util.Set<String> categories(String raw) {
        java.util.Set<String> out = new java.util.TreeSet<>();
        for (String part : raw.split(",")) {
            String c = part.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (STATISTIC_CATEGORIES.contains(c)) out.add(c);
        }
        return java.util.Collections.unmodifiableSet(out);
    }

    private static boolean bool(Properties p, String key, boolean fallback) {
        String v = p.getProperty(key);
        return v == null || v.isBlank() ? fallback : Boolean.parseBoolean(v.trim());
    }

    private static int integer(Properties p, String key, int fallback) {
        try {
            return Integer.parseInt(p.getProperty(key, String.valueOf(fallback)).trim());
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    private static int clamp(int value, int min, int max) {
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import java.lang.management.ManagementFactory;

/** JVM memory and CPU figures for heartbeats. Values that the JVM cannot provide are omitted, never guessed. */
public final class ProcessMetrics {
    private ProcessMetrics() {}

    public static void addTo(JsonObject body) {
        Runtime runtime = Runtime.getRuntime();
        body.addProperty("memoryUsedBytes", runtime.totalMemory() - runtime.freeMemory());
        body.addProperty("memoryMaxBytes", runtime.maxMemory());
        if (ManagementFactory.getOperatingSystemMXBean() instanceof com.sun.management.OperatingSystemMXBean os) {
            double load = os.getProcessCpuLoad();
            if (load >= 0 && load <= 1) body.addProperty("cpuLoad", load);
        }
    }
}
```

`apps/plugin-common/src/main/java/dev/mnm/plugin/RequestSigner.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.InvalidKeyException;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import javax.crypto.Mac;
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;

/**
 * Signs backend requests. Must stay byte-compatible with
 * {@code apps/backend/src/plugin-api/plugin-signature.ts}:
 *
 * <pre>
 * signingKey = SHA-256(secret)
 * canonical  = METHOD \n PATH \n TIMESTAMP \n NONCE \n hex(SHA-256(body))
 * signature  = hex(HMAC-SHA256(signingKey, canonical))
 * </pre>
 *
 * The secret never leaves the server; every request carries a fresh nonce.
 */
public final class RequestSigner {
    public static final String HEADER_KEY_ID = "X-MNM-Key-Id";
    public static final String HEADER_TIMESTAMP = "X-MNM-Timestamp";
    public static final String HEADER_NONCE = "X-MNM-Nonce";
    public static final String HEADER_SIGNATURE = "X-MNM-Signature";

    private static final HexFormat HEX = HexFormat.of();
    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    private final String keyId;
    private final byte[] signingKey;

    public RequestSigner(String keyId, String secret) {
        this.keyId = keyId;
        this.signingKey = sha256(secret.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }

    /** Headers for one request. A new nonce is generated on every call. */
    public Map<String, String> headers(String method, String path, byte[] body, long timestampMillis) {
        String timestamp = Long.toString(timestampMillis);
        String nonce = newNonce();
        Map<String, String> headers = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        headers.put(HEADER_KEY_ID, keyId);
        headers.put(HEADER_TIMESTAMP, timestamp);
        headers.put(HEADER_NONCE, nonce);
        headers.put(HEADER_SIGNATURE, signature(method, path, timestamp, nonce, body));
        return headers;
    }

    public String signature(String method, String path, String timestamp, String nonce, byte[] body) {
        return hmacHex(signingKey, canonical(method, path, timestamp, nonce, body));
    }

    static String canonical(String method, String path, String timestamp, String nonce, byte[] body) {
        return String.join("\n", method.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT), path, timestamp, nonce, HEX.formatHex(sha256(body)));
    }

    static String newNonce() {
        byte[] bytes = new byte[16];
        RANDOM.nextBytes(bytes);
        return HEX.formatHex(bytes);
    }

    static byte[] sha256(byte[] data) {
        try {
            return MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(data);
        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("SHA-256 unavailable", e);
        }
    }

    private static String hmacHex(byte[] key, String data) {
        try {
            Mac mac = Mac.getInstance("HmacSHA256");
            mac.init(new SecretKeySpec(key, "HmacSHA256"));
            return HEX.formatHex(mac.doFinal(data.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException | InvalidKeyException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("HMAC-SHA256 unavailable", e);
        }
    }
}
```

`apps/plugin-common/src/main/java/dev/mnm/plugin/StatusLines.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;

/** Lines for the in-game {@code /networkmanager} status command. */
public final class StatusLines {
    private StatusLines() {}

    public static List<Component> render(Messages messages, BackendConnector.Status status, String type) {
        List<Component> lines = new ArrayList<>();
        lines.add(messages.prefixed("status.title", Map.of()));
        if (!status.registered()) {
            lines.add(messages.render("status.unregistered", Map.of()));
            return lines;
        }
        lines.add(messages.render("status.server", Map.of("server", String.valueOf(status.serverName()), "type", type)));
        if (status.connected()) {
            lines.add(messages.render("status.connected", Map.of("time", ago(status.lastSuccess()))));
        } else {
            lines.add(messages.render("status.disconnected", Map.of("error", status.lastError() == null ? "-" : status.lastError())));
        }
        lines.add(messages.render("status.queue", Map.of("pending", String.valueOf(status.pendingEvents()), "dropped", String.valueOf(status.droppedEvents()))));
        return lines;
    }

    private static String ago(Instant instant) {
        if (instant == null) return "-";
        long seconds = Math.max(0, Duration.between(instant, Instant.now()).toSeconds());
        return seconds + "s";
    }
}
```

`apps/plugin-common/src/main/java/dev/mnm/plugin/punish/CachedPunishment.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin.punish;

import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import java.util.UUID;

/** Enforceable punishment as delivered by the backend feed. */
public record CachedPunishment(
        String id,
        String type,
        UUID targetUuid,
        String targetName,
        String targetIp,
        String reason,
        String issuerName,
        long createdAt,
        Long expiresAt) {

    public boolean isBan() {
        return type.equals("BAN") || type.equals("TEMP_BAN") || type.equals("BLACKLIST");
    }

    public boolean isMute() {
        return type.equals("MUTE") || type.equals("TEMP_MUTE");
    }

    public boolean isEnforceable() {
        return isBan() || isMute();
    }

    public boolean isPermanent() {
        return expiresAt == null;
    }

    public boolean isActive(long now) {
        return expiresAt == null || expiresAt > now;
    }

    public static CachedPunishment fromJson(JsonObject o) {
        return new CachedPunishment(
                o.get("id").getAsString(),
                o.get("type").getAsString(),
                UUID.fromString(o.get("targetUuid").getAsString()),
                string(o.get("targetName")),
                string(o.get("targetIp")),
                string(o.get("reason")),
                string(o.get("issuerName")),
                o.get("createdAt").getAsLong(),
                o.has("expiresAt") && !o.get("expiresAt").isJsonNull() ? o.get("expiresAt").getAsLong() : null);
    }

    public JsonObject toJson() {
        JsonObject o = new JsonObject();
        o.addProperty("id", id);
        o.addProperty("type", type);
        o.addProperty("targetUuid", targetUuid.toString());
        o.addProperty("targetName", targetName);
        o.addProperty("targetIp", targetIp);
        o.addProperty("reason", reason);
        o.addProperty("issuerName", issuerName);
        o.addProperty("createdAt", createdAt);
        o.addProperty("expiresAt", expiresAt);
        return o;
    }

    private static String string(JsonElement e) {
        return e == null || e.isJsonNull() ? null : e.getAsString();
    }
}
```

`apps/plugin-common/src/main/java/dev/mnm/plugin/punish/Durations.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin.punish;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Command durations such as {@code 30m}, {@code 12h}, {@code 7d}, {@code 2w},
 * {@code 1mo}, {@code 1y} and combinations like {@code 1d12h}.
 * Months count as 30 days and years as 365 days.
 */
public final class Durations {
    private static final Pattern PART = Pattern.compile("(\\d{1,6})(mo|[smhdwy])");
    public static final Duration MIN = Duration.ofMinutes(1);
    public static final Duration MAX = Duration.ofDays(3650);

    private Durations() {}

    public static Optional<Duration> parse(String input) {
        String value = input.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).trim();
        if (value.isEmpty()) return Optional.empty();
        Matcher m = PART.matcher(value);
        Duration total = Duration.ZERO;
        int end = 0;
        while (m.find()) {
            if (m.start() != end) return Optional.empty();
            long n = Long.parseLong(m.group(1));
            total = total.plus(switch (m.group(2)) {
                case "s" -> Duration.ofSeconds(n);
                case "m" -> Duration.ofMinutes(n);
                case "h" -> Duration.ofHours(n);
                case "d" -> Duration.ofDays(n);
                case "w" -> Duration.ofDays(n * 7);
                case "mo" -> Duration.ofDays(n * 30);
                case "y" -> Duration.ofDays(n * 365);
                default -> throw new IllegalStateException();
            });
            end = m.end();
        }
        if (end != value.length() || total.compareTo(MIN) < 0 || total.compareTo(MAX) > 0) return Optional.empty();
        return Optional.of(total);
    }

    /** Compact, language-neutral rendering, e.g. {@code 7d 12h}. */
    public static String format(Duration duration) {
        long seconds = Math.max(0, duration.toSeconds());
        long days = seconds / 86_400;
        long hours = seconds % 86_400 / 3600;
        long minutes = seconds % 3600 / 60;
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        if (days > 0) sb.append(days).append("d ");
        if (hours > 0) sb.append(hours).append("h ");
        if (minutes > 0 || sb.isEmpty()) sb.append(minutes).append("m");
        return sb.toString().trim();
    }
}
```

`apps/plugin-common/src/main/java/dev/mnm/plugin/punish/ModerationClient.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin.punish;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import dev.mnm.plugin.BackendClient;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;

/** Backend calls behind the in-game moderation commands. All methods are asynchronous. */
public final class ModerationClient {
    /** Issuer/revoker of a command; {@code uuid == null} means the console. */
    public record Actor(UUID uuid, String name) {
        public static Actor console() {
            return new Actor(null, "console");
        }

        JsonObject toJson() {
            JsonObject o = new JsonObject();
            if (uuid != null) o.addProperty("uuid", uuid.toString());
            o.addProperty("name", name);
            return o;
        }
    }

    private final BackendClient client;

    public ModerationClient(BackendClient client) {
        this.client = client;
    }

    /**
     * Issues a punishment. A fresh idempotency key per invocation makes the
     * request safe to retry without creating duplicates.
     */
    public CompletableFuture<JsonObject> punish(String type, String target, String reason, Long durationSeconds, Actor issuer) {
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.addProperty("type", type);
        body.addProperty("target", target);
        body.addProperty("reason", reason);
        if (durationSeconds != null) body.addProperty("durationSeconds", durationSeconds);
        body.add("issuer", issuer.toJson());
        body.addProperty("idempotencyKey", UUID.randomUUID().toString());
        return client.post("/api/plugin/v1/punishments", body);
    }

    /** Revokes the target's active ban ({@code BAN}) or mute ({@code MUTE}). */
    public CompletableFuture<JsonObject> revoke(String kind, String target, String reason, Actor revoker) {
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.addProperty("kind", kind);
        body.addProperty("target", target);
        if (reason != null && !reason.isBlank()) body.addProperty("reason", reason);
        body.add("revoker", revoker.toJson());
        return client.post("/api/plugin/v1/punishments/revoke", body);
    }

    public CompletableFuture<JsonObject> lookup(String target, int limit) {
        return client.get("/api/plugin/v1/players/lookup?target=" + URLEncoder.encode(target, StandardCharsets.UTF_8) + "&limit=" + limit);
    }
}
```
