`apps/plugin-common/src/main/java/dev/mnm/plugin/punish/PunishmentCache.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin.punish;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.Reader;
import java.io.Writer;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

/**
 * Thread-safe local copy of all active bans, blacklists and mutes. Login and
 * chat checks read only from here, so they never wait on the network and keep
 * working while the backend is unreachable. The cache is persisted to disk so a
 * restart during an outage still enforces punishments.
 */
public final class PunishmentCache {
    public static final String FILE_NAME = "punishments-cache.json";
    private static final Gson GSON = new GsonBuilder().serializeNulls().create();

    private final Map<String, CachedPunishment> byId = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private volatile String cursor;

    /** Active ban or blacklist matching the account or (blacklist only) the IP address. */
    public Optional<CachedPunishment> findBan(UUID player, String ip, long now) {
        return byId.values().stream()
                .filter(p -> p.isBan() && p.isActive(now))
                .filter(p -> p.targetUuid().equals(player) || (ip != null && "BLACKLIST".equals(p.type()) && ip.equals(p.targetIp())))
                .findFirst();
    }

    public Optional<CachedPunishment> findMute(UUID player, long now) {
        return byId.values().stream().filter(p -> p.isMute() && p.isActive(now) && p.targetUuid().equals(player)).findFirst();
    }

    public void replaceAll(Collection<CachedPunishment> punishments, String newCursor) {
        byId.clear();
        punishments.stream().filter(CachedPunishment::isEnforceable).forEach(p -> byId.put(p.id(), p));
        cursor = newCursor;
    }

    public void put(CachedPunishment punishment) {
        if (punishment.isEnforceable()) byId.put(punishment.id(), punishment);
    }

    public void remove(String id) {
        byId.remove(id);
    }

    /** Drops expired entries (they are not enforced anyway; this keeps the file small). */
    public void prune(long now) {
        byId.values().removeIf(p -> !p.isActive(now));
    }

    public String cursor() {
        return cursor;
    }

    public void setCursor(String cursor) {
        this.cursor = cursor;
    }

    public int size() {
        return byId.size();
    }

    public List<CachedPunishment> all() {
        return List.copyOf(byId.values());
    }

    public void save(Path dataDirectory) throws IOException {
        JsonObject root = new JsonObject();
        root.addProperty("cursor", cursor);
        JsonArray list = new JsonArray();
        byId.values().forEach(p -> list.add(p.toJson()));
        root.add("punishments", list);
        Files.createDirectories(dataDirectory);
        Path temp = Files.createTempFile(dataDirectory, "punishments", ".tmp");
        try (Writer writer = Files.newBufferedWriter(temp, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            GSON.toJson(root, writer);
        }
        Files.move(temp, dataDirectory.resolve(FILE_NAME), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
    }

    /** Loads a previously saved cache; returns false if there is none or it is unreadable. */
    public boolean load(Path dataDirectory) {
        Path file = dataDirectory.resolve(FILE_NAME);
        if (!Files.exists(file)) return false;
        try (Reader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(file, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            JsonObject root = JsonParser.parseReader(reader).getAsJsonObject();
            byId.clear();
            for (JsonElement e : root.getAsJsonArray("punishments")) put(CachedPunishment.fromJson(e.getAsJsonObject()));
            cursor = root.has("cursor") && !root.get("cursor").isJsonNull() ? root.get("cursor").getAsString() : null;
            return true;
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException e) {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

```

`apps/plugin-common/src/main/java/dev/mnm/plugin/punish/PunishmentFeed.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin.punish;

import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import dev.mnm.plugin.BackendClient;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import org.slf4j.Logger;

/**
 * Keeps the {@link PunishmentCache} current by polling the backend's ordered
 * change feed. New punishments are also handed to a {@link Listener} so the
 * platform can kick, disconnect or notify players. Changes older than
 * {@link #ACTION_WINDOW_MS} (e.g. replayed after a long outage) only update the
 * cache and trigger no player-facing action.
 */
public final class PunishmentFeed {
    public static final long ACTION_WINDOW_MS = 120_000;

    public interface Listener {
        void created(CachedPunishment punishment);

        default void revoked(CachedPunishment punishment) {}
    }

    private final BackendClient client;
    private final PunishmentCache cache;
    private final Path dataDirectory;
    private final Listener listener;
    private final Logger logger;
    private final AtomicBoolean running = new AtomicBoolean();
    private volatile boolean synced;

    public PunishmentFeed(BackendClient client, PunishmentCache cache, Path dataDirectory, Listener listener, Logger logger) {
        this.client = client;
        this.cache = cache;
        this.dataDirectory = dataDirectory;
        this.listener = listener;
        this.logger = logger;
        if (cache.load(dataDirectory)) logger.info("Loaded {} cached punishment(s) for offline enforcement", cache.size());
    }

    public boolean isSynced() {
        return synced;
    }

    /** Called periodically by the connector. Overlapping calls are skipped. */
    public CompletableFuture<Void> poll() {
        if (!client.hasCredentials() || !running.compareAndSet(false, true)) return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(null);
        CompletableFuture<Void> work = synced ? pollChanges() : loadSnapshot();
        // Failures are retried on the next poll; the cache keeps enforcing meanwhile.
        return work.whenComplete((ok, error) -> running.set(false));
    }

    /** Full snapshot on startup (replaces the disk cache). */
    private CompletableFuture<Void> loadSnapshot() {
        return client.get("/api/plugin/v1/punishments/active").thenAccept(body -> {
            List<CachedPunishment> list = new ArrayList<>();
            for (JsonElement e : body.getAsJsonArray("punishments")) list.add(CachedPunishment.fromJson(e.getAsJsonObject()));
            cache.replaceAll(list, body.get("cursor").getAsString());
            synced = true;
            persist();
            logger.info("Punishment cache synchronised ({} active)", list.size());
        });
    }

    private CompletableFuture<Void> pollChanges() {
        return client.get("/api/plugin/v1/punishments/changes?after=" + cache.cursor()).thenCompose(body -> {
            var changes = body.getAsJsonArray("changes");
            long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
            for (JsonElement e : changes) {
                JsonObject change = e.getAsJsonObject();
                CachedPunishment p = CachedPunishment.fromJson(change.getAsJsonObject("punishment"));
                boolean recent = now - change.get("at").getAsLong() <= ACTION_WINDOW_MS;
                if ("REVOKED".equals(change.get("kind").getAsString())) {
                    cache.remove(p.id());
                    if (recent) safely(() -> listener.revoked(p));
                } else {
                    cache.put(p);
                    if (recent) safely(() -> listener.created(p));
                }
            }
            cache.setCursor(body.get("cursor").getAsString());
            if (!changes.isEmpty()) {
                cache.prune(now);
                persist();
            }
            return body.get("hasMore").getAsBoolean() ? pollChanges() : CompletableFuture.completedFuture(null);
        });
    }

    private void safely(Runnable action) {
        try {
            action.run();
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            logger.warn("Punishment action failed: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private void persist() {
        try {
            cache.save(dataDirectory);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            logger.warn("Could not persist the punishment cache: {}", e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}

```

`apps/plugin-common/src/main/java/dev/mnm/plugin/punish/PunishmentTexts.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin.punish;

import dev.mnm.plugin.Messages;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.time.format.FormatStyle;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;

/** Player-facing texts for punishments, rendered in the configured network language. */
public final class PunishmentTexts {
    private final Messages messages;
    private final DateTimeFormatter dateTime;

    public PunishmentTexts(Messages messages) {
        this.messages = messages;
        this.dateTime = DateTimeFormatter.ofLocalizedDateTime(FormatStyle.MEDIUM, FormatStyle.SHORT)
                .withLocale(Locale.forLanguageTag(messages.locale()))
                .withZone(ZoneId.systemDefault());
    }

    public Messages messages() {
        return messages;
    }

    public String formatInstant(Long epochMillis) {
        return epochMillis == null ? messages.raw("time.permanent") : dateTime.format(Instant.ofEpochMilli(epochMillis));
    }

    /** Disconnect screen for a ban or blacklist. */
    public Component banScreen(CachedPunishment p) {
        String key = p.isPermanent() ? "punishment.ban.screen" : "punishment.tempban.screen";
        return messages.render(key, Map.of("reason", p.reason(), "id", p.id(), "expires", formatInstant(p.expiresAt())));
    }

    public Component kickScreen(String reason) {
        return messages.render("punishment.kick.screen", Map.of("reason", reason));
    }

    public Component muteNotice(CachedPunishment p) {
        String key = p.isPermanent() ? "punishment.mute.notice" : "punishment.tempmute.notice";
        return messages.prefixed(key, Map.of("reason", p.reason(), "expires", formatInstant(p.expiresAt())));
    }

    public Component warnNotice(String reason) {
        return messages.prefixed("punishment.warn.notice", Map.of("reason", reason));
    }

    /** Localized punishment type, e.g. TEMP_BAN → "Temporary ban". */
    public String typeName(String type) {
        return messages.raw("type." + type.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).replace('_', '-'));
    }

    public String stateName(String status) {
        return messages.raw("state." + status.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
    }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Network Manager plugin configuration
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

# Address of the Network Manager dashboard (the API is served under /api).
# Example: https://admin.example.net  or  http://10.0.0.5:3000
backend-url=http://localhost:3000

# Single-use registration token from Dashboard -> Settings -> Minecraft Integration.
# It is exchanged for credentials (stored in credentials.properties) on the next start.
# After a successful registration this value is no longer used and can be removed.
registration-token=

# Language of plugin messages (files in the plugin jar: messages/<locale>.yml).
language=en-US

# Store player IP addresses with connection records (Velocity only).
# IP addresses are personal data; only dashboard users with players.view.ip can see them.
collect-ip-addresses=true

# How often the server reports its status (5-300 seconds).
heartbeat-interval-seconds=15

# How often the proxy sends its full list of connected players (15-3600 seconds, Velocity only).
sync-interval-seconds=60

# Events kept in memory while the backend is unreachable. When full, the oldest are dropped
# and a full sync repairs the session state once the backend is back.
max-queued-events=50000

# --- Moderation ------------------------------------------------------
# Enforce network punishments: bans/kicks on the proxy, mutes on Paper. The local
# punishment cache (punishments-cache.json) keeps working during backend outages.
punishments-enabled=true
# Register /ban, /tempban, /unban, /mute, /tempmute, /unmute, /kick, /warn, /history, /check
# (Velocity only; requires punishments-enabled).
moderation-commands=true

# --- Paper only: statistics -------------------------------------------
# Collect Minecraft statistics (movement, combat, blocks, general) for the dashboard.
statistics-enabled=true
# How often statistics are sent (60-3600 seconds). Collection is spread over several ticks.
statistics-interval-seconds=300
# Comma-separated categories to collect: movement, combat, blocks, general
statistics-categories=movement,combat,blocks,general
# Seconds without movement or interaction before a player counts as AFK (30-3600).
afk-timeout-seconds=300

# --- Paper only: AntiCheat integration -------------------------------
# Plugins allowed to report violations through the Java API (comma-separated plugin names,
# e.g. Grim,Vulcan). Empty = no plugin may use the API. /anticheatban needs the
# networkmanager.anticheat.command permission (console always has it).
anticheat-integrations=
# Reports accepted per integration and minute; excess reports are dropped and logged.
anticheat-max-reports-per-minute=120

# --- Paper only: inventories ------------------------------------------
# Send inventory / Ender Chest snapshots to the dashboard and accept edits made there.
inventory-sync=true
enderchest-sync=true
# Periodic snapshots of online players (30-3600 seconds); snapshots are also sent on join and quit.
inventory-sync-interval-seconds=300

# --- Central management ------------------------------------------------
# Let the dashboard (Settings -> Plugin settings) override language, plugin messages,
# statistics and inventory options. Changes apply within one heartbeat, no restart needed.
# Set to false to use only the values in this file.
managed-settings=true

debug=false

`apps/plugin-common/src/test/java/dev/mnm/plugin/BackendClientTest.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertInstanceOf;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

/** Round-trips against an in-process HTTP server that verifies signatures like the backend does. */
class BackendClientTest {
    private static final String SECRET = "mnm_sk_client-test";
    private HttpServer server;
    private BackendClient client;
    private final AtomicReference<String> lastSignatureCheck = new AtomicReference<>();

    @BeforeEach
    void start() throws IOException {
        server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 0), 0);
        RequestSigner verifier = new RequestSigner("unused", SECRET);
        server.createContext("/api/plugin/v1/heartbeat", exchange -> {
            byte[] body = exchange.getRequestBody().readAllBytes();
            var h = exchange.getRequestHeaders();
            String expected = verifier.signature(exchange.getRequestMethod(), exchange.getRequestURI().getRawPath(), h.getFirst(RequestSigner.HEADER_TIMESTAMP), h.getFirst(RequestSigner.HEADER_NONCE), body);
            boolean valid = expected.equals(h.getFirst(RequestSigner.HEADER_SIGNATURE)) && "mnm_key_test".equals(h.getFirst(RequestSigner.HEADER_KEY_ID));
            lastSignatureCheck.set(valid ? "valid" : "invalid");
            respond(exchange, valid ? 200 : 401, valid ? "{\"heartbeatIntervalSeconds\":15}" : "{\"code\":\"PLUGIN_AUTH_BAD_SIGNATURE\",\"message\":\"Plugin authentication failed\"}");
        });
        server.createContext("/api/plugin/v1/events", exchange -> respond(exchange, 400, "{\"code\":\"VALIDATION_FAILED\",\"message\":\"bad\"}"));
        server.start();
        URI base = URI.create("http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort());
        client = new BackendClient(base, "test", new Gson(), HttpClient.newHttpClient(), System::currentTimeMillis);
        client.useCredentials(new Credentials("mnm_key_test", SECRET, "id", "lobby"));
    }

    @AfterEach
    void stop() {
        server.stop(0);
    }

    private static void respond(com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpExchange exchange, int status, String json) throws IOException {
        byte[] bytes = json.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        exchange.getResponseHeaders().add("Content-Type", "application/json");
        exchange.sendResponseHeaders(status, bytes.length);
        try (OutputStream out = exchange.getResponseBody()) {
            out.write(bytes);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void signsRequestsThatTheServerCanVerify() throws Exception {
        JsonObject response = client.post("/api/plugin/v1/heartbeat", Map.of("onlinePlayers", 2)).get();
        assertEquals("valid", lastSignatureCheck.get());
        assertEquals(15, response.get("heartbeatIntervalSeconds").getAsInt());
    }

    @Test
    void mapsErrorResponsesToBackendExceptions() {
        ExecutionException e = assertThrows(ExecutionException.class, () -> client.post("/api/plugin/v1/events", Map.of()).get());
        BackendException be = assertInstanceOf(BackendException.class, e.getCause());
        assertEquals(400, be.status());
        assertEquals("VALIDATION_FAILED", be.code());
    }

    @Test
    void reportsTransportErrors() {
        server.stop(0);
        ExecutionException e = assertThrows(ExecutionException.class, () -> client.get("/api/plugin/v1/ping").get());
        assertEquals(0, assertInstanceOf(BackendException.class, e.getCause()).status());
    }
}

`apps/plugin-common/src/test/java/dev/mnm/plugin/EventQueueTest.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertSame;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class EventQueueTest {
    private static JsonObject event(int n) {
        JsonObject o = new JsonObject();
        o.addProperty("n", n);
        return o;
    }

    @Test
    void keepsOrderAndOnlyRemovesAcknowledgedEvents() {
        EventQueue queue = new EventQueue(10);
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) queue.add(event(i));
        List<JsonObject> batch = queue.peek(3);
        assertEquals(3, batch.size());
        assertEquals(5, queue.size(), "peek must not remove");
        queue.acknowledge(batch);
        assertEquals(2, queue.size());
        assertEquals(3, queue.peek(1).get(0).get("n").getAsInt());
    }

    @Test
    void dropsOldestWhenFullAndReportsOverflowOnce() {
        EventQueue queue = new EventQueue(3);
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) queue.add(event(i));
        assertEquals(3, queue.size());
        assertEquals(2, queue.peek(1).get(0).get("n").getAsInt());
        assertEquals(2, queue.droppedTotal());
        assertTrue(queue.consumeOverflow());
        assertFalse(queue.consumeOverflow());
    }

    @Test
    void acknowledgeToleratesEventsDroppedInFlight() {
        EventQueue queue = new EventQueue(2);
        JsonObject first = event(1);
        queue.add(first);
        queue.add(event(2));
        List<JsonObject> batch = queue.peek(2);
        JsonObject third = event(3);
        queue.add(third); // overflow drops "first" while the batch is in flight
        queue.acknowledge(batch);
        assertEquals(1, queue.size());
        assertSame(third, queue.peek(1).get(0));
    }
}

`apps/plugin-common/src/test/java/dev/mnm/plugin/ManagedSettingsTest.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Properties;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

class ManagedSettingsTest {
    private static final String REMOTE = """
            {"revision":3,"language":"de-DE","statisticsEnabled":false,"statisticsCategories":["combat","flying"],
             "statisticsIntervalSeconds":5,"inventorySync":null,"enderChestSync":false,"inventorySyncIntervalSeconds":120,
             "messages":{"de-DE":{"command.kick.success":"{player} ist weg."}}}""";

    private static PluginConfig config(boolean managed) {
        Properties p = new Properties();
        p.setProperty("backend-url", "http://x.test");
        p.setProperty("managed-settings", String.valueOf(managed));
        p.setProperty("statistics-interval-seconds", "600");
        return PluginConfig.fromProperties(p);
    }

    @Test
    void remoteValuesOverrideLocalOnesAndNullKeepsLocal(@TempDir Path dir) {
        ManagedSettings settings = new ManagedSettings(config(true), dir, LoggerFactory.getLogger("test"));
        assertEquals(-1, settings.revision());
        assertEquals("en-US", settings.language());
        AtomicInteger changes = new AtomicInteger();
        settings.onChange(changes::incrementAndGet);

        settings.apply(JsonParser.parseString(REMOTE).getAsJsonObject());
        assertEquals(3, settings.revision());
        assertEquals("de-DE", settings.language());
        assertFalse(settings.statisticsEnabled());
        assertEquals(Set.of("combat"), settings.statisticsCategories());
        assertEquals(60, settings.statisticsIntervalSeconds(), "clamped to the allowed range");
        assertTrue(settings.inventorySync(), "null keeps the local value");
        assertFalse(settings.enderChestSync());
        assertEquals(120, settings.inventorySyncIntervalSeconds());
        assertEquals(Map.of("command.kick.success", "{player} ist weg."), settings.messageOverrides("de-DE"));
        assertEquals(Map.of(), settings.messageOverrides("en-US"));
        assertEquals(1, changes.get());

        // Same revision again: nothing happens.
        settings.apply(JsonParser.parseString(REMOTE).getAsJsonObject());
        assertEquals(1, changes.get());
    }

    @Test
    void cachesTheLastDocumentForTheNextStart(@TempDir Path dir) {
        new ManagedSettings(config(true), dir, LoggerFactory.getLogger("test")).apply(JsonParser.parseString(REMOTE).getAsJsonObject());
        assertTrue(Files.exists(dir.resolve(ManagedSettings.CACHE_FILE)));
        ManagedSettings restarted = new ManagedSettings(config(true), dir, LoggerFactory.getLogger("test"));
        assertEquals(3, restarted.revision());
        assertEquals("de-DE", restarted.language());
    }

    @Test
    void ignoresRemoteValuesWhenDisabledLocally(@TempDir Path dir) {
        ManagedSettings settings = new ManagedSettings(config(false), dir, LoggerFactory.getLogger("test"));
        settings.apply(JsonParser.parseString(REMOTE).getAsJsonObject());
        assertEquals("en-US", settings.language());
        assertTrue(settings.statisticsEnabled());
        assertEquals(600, settings.statisticsIntervalSeconds());
        assertFalse(Files.exists(dir.resolve(ManagedSettings.CACHE_FILE)));
    }
}

package dev.mnm.plugin;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

import java.util.Map;
import net.kyori.adventure.text.serializer.plain.PlainTextComponentSerializer;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class MessagesTest {
    private static final PlainTextComponentSerializer PLAIN = PlainTextComponentSerializer.plainText();

    @Test
    void loadsEnglishByDefaultAndFallsBackForUnknownLocales() throws Exception {
        Messages messages = Messages.load(getClass().getClassLoader(), "xx-XX");
        assertEquals("en-US", messages.locale());
        assertTrue(messages.raw("command.kick.success").contains("{player}"));
    }

    @Test
    void loadsGerman() throws Exception {
        Messages messages = Messages.load(getClass().getClassLoader(), "de-DE");
        assertEquals("de-DE", messages.locale());
        assertEquals("Ungültige Dauer \"5x\". Beispiele: 30m, 12h, 7d, 1w.", PLAIN.serialize(messages.render("error.invalid-duration", Map.of("input", "5x"))));
    }

    @Test
    void insertsVariablesAsPlainText() throws Exception {
        Messages messages = Messages.load(getClass().getClassLoader(), "en-US");
        String text = PLAIN.serialize(messages.render("command.kick.success", Map.of("player", "<red>Evil</red>")));
        assertEquals("<red>Evil</red> was kicked.", text, "player-controlled values must not be parsed as formatting");
    }

    @Test
    void appliesLanguageAndOverridesLive() throws Exception {
        Messages messages = Messages.load(getClass().getClassLoader(), "en-US");
        messages.apply("de-DE", Map.of("command.kick.success", "<green>{player} ist weg.", "not.a.key", "ignored"));
        assertEquals("de-DE", messages.locale());
        assertEquals("Steve ist weg.", PLAIN.serialize(messages.render("command.kick.success", Map.of("player", "Steve"))));
        assertEquals("not.a.key", messages.raw("not.a.key"));
        // A language without bundled file uses English plus its overrides.
        messages.apply("fr-FR", Map.of("command.kick.success", "{player} a été expulsé."));
        assertEquals("fr-FR", messages.locale());
        assertTrue(messages.raw("command.ban.success").contains("was banned"));
        messages.apply("en-US", Map.of());
        assertEquals("Steve was kicked.", PLAIN.serialize(messages.render("command.kick.success", Map.of("player", "Steve"))));
    }

    @Test
    void unknownKeysRenderAsKey() throws Exception {
        Messages messages = Messages.load(getClass().getClassLoader(), "en-US");
        assertEquals("does.not.exist", messages.raw("does.not.exist"));
        assertFalse(PLAIN.serialize(messages.prefixed("status.title", Map.of())).isEmpty());
    }
}

`apps/plugin-common/src/test/java/dev/mnm/plugin/RequestSignerTest.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class RequestSignerTest {
    // Shared test vector - identical values are asserted in apps/backend/test/plugin.spec.ts.
    private static final String SECRET = "mnm_sk_test-vector-secret";
    private static final String SIGNING_KEY_HEX = "2d82f41db33f1785036be6980f75ca56279ad6c7a3a2de9dad2374e2d1ea85ca"; // gitleaks:allow (test vector)
    private static final String EXPECTED = "abbe9d82b6527986e5434b4df02b8ff6d6ce279d6cffebd9a722221ac561bb03";
    private static final byte[] BODY = "{\"onlinePlayers\":3}".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

    @Test
    void signingKeyIsSha256OfSecret() {
        assertEquals(SIGNING_KEY_HEX, HexFormat.of().formatHex(RequestSigner.sha256(SECRET.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))));
    }

    @Test
    void matchesBackendTestVector() {
        RequestSigner signer = new RequestSigner("key", SECRET);
        assertEquals(EXPECTED, signer.signature("POST", "/api/plugin/v1/heartbeat", "1795400000000", "nonce-0123456789abcdef", BODY));
    }

    @Test
    void methodIsCaseInsensitive() {
        RequestSigner signer = new RequestSigner("key", SECRET);
        assertEquals(EXPECTED, signer.signature("post", "/api/plugin/v1/heartbeat", "1795400000000", "nonce-0123456789abcdef", BODY));
    }

    @Test
    void headersUseFreshNonces() {
        RequestSigner signer = new RequestSigner("mnm_key_abc", SECRET);
        Map<String, String> a = signer.headers("GET", "/api/plugin/v1/ping", new byte[0], 1L);
        Map<String, String> b = signer.headers("GET", "/api/plugin/v1/ping", new byte[0], 1L);
        assertEquals("mnm_key_abc", a.get(RequestSigner.HEADER_KEY_ID));
        assertNotEquals(a.get(RequestSigner.HEADER_NONCE), b.get(RequestSigner.HEADER_NONCE));
        assertNotEquals(a.get(RequestSigner.HEADER_SIGNATURE), b.get(RequestSigner.HEADER_SIGNATURE));
        assertTrue(a.get(RequestSigner.HEADER_NONCE).matches("[0-9a-f]{32}"));
    }
}

`apps/plugin-common/src/test/java/dev/mnm/plugin/punish/PunishmentCacheTest.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.plugin.punish;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

class PunishmentCacheTest {
    private static final UUID STEVE = UUID.fromString("069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5");
    private static final UUID ALEX = UUID.fromString("ec561538-f3fd-461d-aff5-086b22154bce");
    private static final long NOW = 1_800_000_000_000L;

    private static CachedPunishment p(String id, String type, UUID target, String ip, Long expiresAt) {
        return new CachedPunishment(id, type, target, "name", ip, "reason", "mod", NOW - 1000, expiresAt);
    }

    @Test
    void findsActiveBansAndMutesOnly() {
        PunishmentCache cache = new PunishmentCache();
        cache.replaceAll(List.of(p("1", "TEMP_BAN", STEVE, null, NOW + 60_000), p("2", "MUTE", ALEX, null, null), p("3", "KICK", ALEX, null, null)), "10");
        assertEquals(2, cache.size(), "kicks are never cached");
        assertTrue(cache.findBan(STEVE, null, NOW).isPresent());
        assertFalse(cache.findBan(STEVE, null, NOW + 120_000).isPresent(), "expired bans are not enforced");
        assertTrue(cache.findMute(ALEX, NOW).isPresent());
        assertFalse(cache.findBan(ALEX, null, NOW).isPresent());
    }

    @Test
    void blacklistAlsoMatchesTheIpAddress() {
        PunishmentCache cache = new PunishmentCache();
        cache.put(p("4", "BLACKLIST", STEVE, "203.0.113.7", null));
        UUID altAccount = UUID.randomUUID();
        assertTrue(cache.findBan(altAccount, "203.0.113.7", NOW).isPresent());
        assertFalse(cache.findBan(altAccount, "198.51.100.1", NOW).isPresent());
        cache.put(p("5", "BAN", ALEX, "198.51.100.1", null));
        assertFalse(cache.findBan(altAccount, "198.51.100.1", NOW).isPresent(), "regular bans never match by IP");
    }

    @Test
    void persistsAndRestoresForOfflineEnforcement(@TempDir Path dir) throws Exception {
        PunishmentCache cache = new PunishmentCache();
        cache.replaceAll(List.of(p("1", "BAN", STEVE, null, null)), "42");
        cache.save(dir);
        PunishmentCache restored = new PunishmentCache();
        assertTrue(restored.load(dir));
        assertEquals("42", restored.cursor());
        assertTrue(restored.findBan(STEVE, null, NOW).isPresent());
        restored.remove("1");
        assertFalse(restored.findBan(STEVE, null, NOW).isPresent());
    }

    @Test
    void parsesCommandDurations() {
        assertEquals(Duration.ofMinutes(30), Durations.parse("30m").orElseThrow());
        assertEquals(Duration.ofHours(36), Durations.parse("1d12h").orElseThrow());
        assertEquals(Duration.ofDays(14), Durations.parse("2W").orElseThrow());
        assertEquals(Duration.ofDays(30), Durations.parse("1mo").orElseThrow());
        assertTrue(Durations.parse("10s").isEmpty(), "below the minimum");
        assertTrue(Durations.parse("abc").isEmpty());
        assertTrue(Durations.parse("5x").isEmpty());
        assertTrue(Durations.parse("11y").isEmpty(), "above the maximum");
        assertEquals("1d 12h", Durations.format(Duration.ofHours(36)));
        assertEquals("30m", Durations.format(Duration.ofMinutes(30)));
    }
}

plugins {

`apps/velocity-plugin/src/main/java/dev/mnm/velocity/Enforcer.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.velocity;

import com.velocitypowered.api.event.ResultedEvent;
import com.velocitypowered.api.event.Subscribe;
import com.velocitypowered.api.event.connection.LoginEvent;
import com.velocitypowered.api.proxy.Player;
import com.velocitypowered.api.proxy.ProxyServer;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.CachedPunishment;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.PunishmentCache;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.PunishmentFeed;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.PunishmentTexts;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import org.slf4j.Logger;

/**
 * Enforces punishments on the proxy: denies banned/blacklisted logins from the
 * local cache (no network round-trip on login) and applies new punishments to
 * online players as soon as they appear in the feed or a command succeeds.
 */
final class Enforcer implements PunishmentFeed.Listener {
    static final String NOTIFY_PERMISSION = "networkmanager.notify";

    private final ProxyServer proxy;
    private final PunishmentCache cache;
    private final PunishmentTexts texts;
    private final Logger logger;
    /** Punishments already acted on (command path and feed path must not double-apply). */
    private final Set<String> handled = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();

    Enforcer(ProxyServer proxy, PunishmentCache cache, PunishmentTexts texts, Logger logger) {
        this.proxy = proxy;
        this.cache = cache;
        this.texts = texts;
        this.logger = logger;
    }

    @Subscribe(priority = Short.MAX_VALUE)
    public void onLogin(LoginEvent event) {
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        InetSocketAddress remote = player.getRemoteAddress();
        String ip = remote == null || remote.getAddress() == null ? null : remote.getAddress().getHostAddress();
        cache.findBan(player.getUniqueId(), ip, System.currentTimeMillis()).ifPresent(ban -> {
            event.setResult(ResultedEvent.ComponentResult.denied(texts.banScreen(ban)));
            logger.info("Denied login of {} ({}): {} {}", player.getUsername(), player.getUniqueId(), ban.type(), ban.id());
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void created(CachedPunishment p) {
        apply(p);
    }

    /** Applies a punishment to online players once and notifies staff. */
    void apply(CachedPunishment p) {
        if (!handled.add(p.id())) return;
        if (handled.size() > 10_000) handled.clear();

        Optional<Player> target = proxy.getPlayer(p.targetUuid());
        switch (p.type()) {
            case "BAN", "TEMP_BAN" -> target.ifPresent(player -> player.disconnect(texts.banScreen(p)));
            case "BLACKLIST" -> proxy.getAllPlayers().stream()
                    .filter(player -> player.getUniqueId().equals(p.targetUuid()) || (p.targetIp() != null && p.targetIp().equals(ipOf(player))))
                    .forEach(player -> player.disconnect(texts.banScreen(p)));
            case "KICK" -> target.ifPresent(player -> player.disconnect(texts.kickScreen(p.reason())));
            case "WARNING" -> target.ifPresent(player -> player.sendMessage(texts.warnNotice(p.reason())));
            case "MUTE", "TEMP_MUTE" -> target.ifPresent(player -> player.sendMessage(texts.muteNotice(p)));
            default -> {
                return;
            }
        }
        var notice = texts.messages().render("notify.staff.punishment", Map.of(
                "issuer", String.valueOf(p.issuerName()),
                "type", texts.typeName(p.type()),
                "player", String.valueOf(p.targetName()),
                "reason", p.reason()));
        proxy.getAllPlayers().stream().filter(player -> player.hasPermission(NOTIFY_PERMISSION)).forEach(player -> player.sendMessage(notice));
        logger.info("{} issued {} to {}: {}", p.issuerName(), p.type(), p.targetName(), p.reason());
    }

    private static String ipOf(Player player) {
        InetSocketAddress remote = player.getRemoteAddress();
        return remote == null || remote.getAddress() == null ? null : remote.getAddress().getHostAddress();
    }
}

`apps/velocity-plugin/src/main/java/dev/mnm/velocity/ModerationCommand.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.velocity;

import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.velocitypowered.api.command.CommandSource;
import com.velocitypowered.api.command.SimpleCommand;
import com.velocitypowered.api.proxy.Player;
import com.velocitypowered.api.proxy.ProxyServer;
import dev.mnm.plugin.BackendException;
import dev.mnm.plugin.Messages;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.CachedPunishment;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.Durations;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.ModerationClient;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.PunishmentTexts;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletionException;

/**
 * Network-wide moderation commands. Every punishment goes through the backend
 * (single source of truth); on success it is applied locally right away.
 * Permission: {@code networkmanager.command.<name>}.
 */
final class ModerationCommand implements SimpleCommand {
    enum Kind {
        BAN("<player> <reason>", 2),
        TEMPBAN("<player> <duration> <reason>", 3),
        UNBAN("<player> [reason]", 1),
        MUTE("<player> <reason>", 2),
        TEMPMUTE("<player> <duration> <reason>", 3),
        UNMUTE("<player> [reason]", 1),
        KICK("<player> <reason>", 2),
        WARN("<player> <reason>", 2),
        HISTORY("<player>", 1),
        CHECK("<player>", 1);

        final String usage;
        final int minArgs;

        Kind(String usage, int minArgs) {
            this.usage = usage;
            this.minArgs = minArgs;
        }

        String command() {
            return name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        }
    }

    private static final int HISTORY_LIMIT = 10;

    private final Kind kind;
    private final ProxyServer proxy;
    private final ModerationClient client;
    private final PunishmentTexts texts;
    private final Messages messages;
    private final Enforcer enforcer;

    ModerationCommand(Kind kind, ProxyServer proxy, ModerationClient client, PunishmentTexts texts, Enforcer enforcer) {
        this.kind = kind;
        this.proxy = proxy;
        this.client = client;
        this.texts = texts;
        this.messages = texts.messages();
        this.enforcer = enforcer;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasPermission(Invocation invocation) {
        return invocation.source().hasPermission("networkmanager.command." + kind.command());
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> suggest(Invocation invocation) {
        String[] args = invocation.arguments();
        if (args.length > 1) return List.of();
        String prefix = args.length == 0 ? "" : args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return proxy.getAllPlayers().stream().map(Player::getUsername).filter(n -> n.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith(prefix)).sorted().limit(50).toList();
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(Invocation invocation) {
        CommandSource source = invocation.source();
        String[] args = invocation.arguments();
        if (args.length < kind.minArgs) {
            source.sendMessage(messages.prefixed("error.usage", Map.of("usage", "/" + invocation.alias() + " " + kind.usage)));
            return;
        }
        String target = args[0];
        ModerationClient.Actor actor = source instanceof Player p ? new ModerationClient.Actor(p.getUniqueId(), p.getUsername()) : ModerationClient.Actor.console();

        switch (kind) {
            case BAN -> punish(source, "BAN", target, join(args, 1), null);
            case MUTE -> punish(source, "MUTE", target, join(args, 1), null);
            case KICK -> punish(source, "KICK", target, join(args, 1), null);
            case WARN -> punish(source, "WARNING", target, join(args, 1), null);
            case TEMPBAN, TEMPMUTE -> {
                Optional<Duration> duration = Durations.parse(args[1]);
                if (duration.isEmpty()) {
                    source.sendMessage(messages.prefixed("error.invalid-duration", Map.of("input", args[1])));
                    return;
                }
                punish(source, kind == Kind.TEMPBAN ? "TEMP_BAN" : "TEMP_MUTE", target, join(args, 2), duration.get());
            }
            case UNBAN, UNMUTE -> {
                String revokeKind = kind == Kind.UNBAN ? "BAN" : "MUTE";
                handle(source, target, client.revoke(revokeKind, target, join(args, 1), actor), response -> source.sendMessage(
                        messages.prefixed(kind == Kind.UNBAN ? "command.unban.success" : "command.unmute.success", Map.of("player", targetName(response, target)))));
            }
            case HISTORY -> handle(source, target, client.lookup(target, HISTORY_LIMIT), response -> history(source, response));
            case CHECK -> handle(source, target, client.lookup(target, 1), response -> check(source, response));
        }
    }

    private void punish(CommandSource source, String type, String target, String reason, Duration duration) {
        ModerationClient.Actor actor = source instanceof Player p ? new ModerationClient.Actor(p.getUniqueId(), p.getUsername()) : ModerationClient.Actor.console();
        CompletableFuture<JsonObject> request = client.punish(type, target, reason, duration == null ? null : duration.toSeconds(), actor);
        handle(source, target, request, response -> {
            enforcer.apply(toCached(response));
            String key = switch (type) {
                case "BAN" -> "command.ban.success";
                case "TEMP_BAN" -> "command.tempban.success";
                case "MUTE" -> "command.mute.success";
                case "TEMP_MUTE" -> "command.tempmute.success";
                case "KICK" -> "command.kick.success";
                default -> "command.warn.success";
            };
            source.sendMessage(messages.prefixed(key, Map.of(
                    "player", targetName(response, target),
                    "id", response.get("id").getAsString(),
                    "duration", duration == null ? "" : Durations.format(duration))));
        });
    }

    private void history(CommandSource source, JsonObject response) {
        String name = response.getAsJsonObject("player").get("username").getAsString();
        int total = response.get("total").getAsInt();
        if (total == 0) {
            source.sendMessage(messages.prefixed("command.history.empty", Map.of("player", name)));
            return;
        }
        source.sendMessage(messages.prefixed("command.history.header", Map.of("player", name, "count", String.valueOf(total))));
        for (JsonElement e : response.getAsJsonArray("history")) {
            JsonObject p = e.getAsJsonObject();
            source.sendMessage(messages.render("command.history.entry", Map.of(
                    "id", p.get("id").getAsString(),
                    "type", texts.typeName(p.get("type").getAsString()),
                    "reason", p.get("reason").getAsString(),
                    "date", texts.formatInstant(Instant.parse(p.get("createdAt").getAsString()).toEpochMilli()),
                    "issuer", p.getAsJsonObject("issuer").get("name").getAsString(),
                    "status", texts.stateName(p.get("status").getAsString()))));
        }
        if (total > HISTORY_LIMIT) source.sendMessage(messages.render("command.history.more", Map.of("count", String.valueOf(total - HISTORY_LIMIT))));
    }

    private void check(CommandSource source, JsonObject response) {
        String name = response.getAsJsonObject("player").get("username").getAsString();
        source.sendMessage(messages.prefixed("command.check.header", Map.of("player", name)));
        JsonObject active = response.getAsJsonObject("active");
        boolean any = false;
        for (String slot : List.of("ban", "mute")) {
            if (active.get(slot).isJsonNull()) continue;
            any = true;
            JsonObject p = active.getAsJsonObject(slot);
            Long expires = p.get("expiresAt").isJsonNull() ? null : Instant.parse(p.get("expiresAt").getAsString()).toEpochMilli();
            source.sendMessage(messages.render(slot.equals("ban") ? "command.check.banned" : "command.check.muted",
                    Map.of("reason", p.get("reason").getAsString(), "expires", texts.formatInstant(expires))));
        }
        if (!any) source.sendMessage(messages.render("command.check.clean", Map.of()));
    }

    /** Runs the request and translates backend errors into player-facing messages. */
    private void handle(CommandSource source, String target, CompletableFuture<JsonObject> request, java.util.function.Consumer<JsonObject> onSuccess) {
        request.whenComplete((response, error) -> {
            if (error == null) {
                onSuccess.accept(response);
                return;
            }
            Throwable cause = error instanceof CompletionException && error.getCause() != null ? error.getCause() : error;
            if (!(cause instanceof BackendException e) || e.status() == 0) {
                source.sendMessage(messages.prefixed("error.backend-unavailable", Map.of()));
                return;
            }
            Map<String, String> vars = Map.of("player", target, "reason", e.getMessage(), "input", "");
            String key = switch (e.code()) {
                case "PLAYER_NOT_FOUND" -> "error.player-not-found";
                case "ALREADY_BANNED" -> "error.already-banned";
                case "ALREADY_MUTED" -> "error.already-muted";
                case "PLAYER_OFFLINE" -> "error.player-offline";
                case "NOT_BANNED", "NOT_MUTED" -> "command.not-punished";
                default -> "error.request-failed";
            };
            source.sendMessage(messages.prefixed(key, vars));
        });
    }

    private static CachedPunishment toCached(JsonObject r) {
        JsonObject target = r.getAsJsonObject("target");
        return new CachedPunishment(
                r.get("id").getAsString(),
                r.get("type").getAsString(),
                UUID.fromString(target.get("uuid").getAsString()),
                target.get("username").getAsString(),
                null,
                r.get("reason").getAsString(),
                r.getAsJsonObject("issuer").get("name").getAsString(),
                Instant.parse(r.get("createdAt").getAsString()).toEpochMilli(),
                r.get("expiresAt").isJsonNull() ? null : Instant.parse(r.get("expiresAt").getAsString()).toEpochMilli());
    }

    private static String targetName(JsonObject response, String fallback) {
        if (response.has("target")) return response.getAsJsonObject("target").get("username").getAsString();
        return fallback;
    }

    private static String join(String[] args, int from) {
        return String.join(" ", Arrays.copyOfRange(args, Math.min(from, args.length), args.length)).trim();
    }
}

```java
package dev.mnm.velocity;

import com.google.inject.Inject;
import com.velocitypowered.api.event.Subscribe;
import com.velocitypowered.api.event.proxy.ProxyInitializeEvent;
import com.velocitypowered.api.event.proxy.ProxyShutdownEvent;
import com.velocitypowered.api.plugin.Plugin;
import com.velocitypowered.api.plugin.annotation.DataDirectory;
import com.velocitypowered.api.proxy.ProxyServer;
import dev.mnm.plugin.BackendConnector;
import dev.mnm.plugin.ManagedSettings;
import dev.mnm.plugin.Messages;
import dev.mnm.plugin.PluginConfig;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.ModerationClient;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.PunishmentCache;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.PunishmentFeed;
import dev.mnm.plugin.punish.PunishmentTexts;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import org.slf4j.Logger;

/** Velocity proxy plugin: player sessions, server switches and proxy heartbeats. */
@Plugin(
        id = "networkmanager",
        name = "Network Manager",
        version = BuildInfo.VERSION,
        description = "Connects the Velocity proxy to the Network Manager platform",
        authors = {"Network Manager contributors"})
public final class NetworkManagerVelocity {
    private final ProxyServer proxy;
    private final Logger logger;
    private final Path dataDirectory;
    private BackendConnector connector;

    @Inject
    public NetworkManagerVelocity(ProxyServer proxy, Logger logger, @DataDirectory Path dataDirectory) {
        this.proxy = proxy;
        this.logger = logger;
        this.dataDirectory = dataDirectory;
    }

    @Subscribe
    public void onProxyInitialize(ProxyInitializeEvent event) {
        ClassLoader resources = getClass().getClassLoader();
        PluginConfig config;
        Messages messages;
        try {
            config = PluginConfig.loadOrCreate(dataDirectory, resources);
            messages = Messages.load(resources, config.language());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            logger.error("Network Manager is disabled: {}", e.getMessage());
            return;
        }

        ManagedSettings managed = new ManagedSettings(config, dataDirectory, logger);
        managed.bind(messages);
        SessionRegistry sessions = new SessionRegistry();
        connector = new BackendConnector(dataDirectory, config, new VelocityPlatform(proxy, sessions), BuildInfo.VERSION, logger);
        connector.useManagedSettings(managed);
        proxy.getEventManager().register(this, new PlayerListener(connector, sessions, config.collectIpAddresses()));
        proxy.getCommandManager().register(
                proxy.getCommandManager().metaBuilder("networkmanager").aliases("nm").plugin(this).build(),
                new StatusCommand(connector, messages, "VELOCITY"));
        // Punishments: local cache (login checks), change feed (actions), commands.
        if (config.punishmentsEnabled()) {
            PunishmentCache cache = new PunishmentCache();
            PunishmentTexts texts = new PunishmentTexts(messages);
            Enforcer enforcer = new Enforcer(proxy, cache, texts, logger);
            PunishmentFeed feed = new PunishmentFeed(connector.client(), cache, dataDirectory, enforcer, logger);
            connector.every3Seconds(feed::poll);
            proxy.getEventManager().register(this, enforcer);
            if (config.moderationCommands()) {
                ModerationClient moderation = new ModerationClient(connector.client());
                for (ModerationCommand.Kind kind : ModerationCommand.Kind.values()) {
                    proxy.getCommandManager().register(
                            proxy.getCommandManager().metaBuilder(kind.command()).plugin(this).build(),
                            new ModerationCommand(kind, proxy, moderation, texts, enforcer));
                }
            }
        } else {
            logger.warn("punishments-enabled=false: network bans and mutes are NOT enforced on this proxy.");
        }

        connector.start();
    }

    @Subscribe(priority = Short.MIN_VALUE)
    public void onProxyShutdown(ProxyShutdownEvent event) {
        if (connector != null) connector.stop(Duration.ofSeconds(5));
    }
}

`apps/velocity-plugin/src/main/java/dev/mnm/velocity/PlayerListener.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.velocity;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.velocitypowered.api.event.Subscribe;
import com.velocitypowered.api.event.connection.DisconnectEvent;
import com.velocitypowered.api.event.connection.PostLoginEvent;
import com.velocitypowered.api.event.player.PlayerClientBrandEvent;
import com.velocitypowered.api.event.player.ServerConnectedEvent;
import com.velocitypowered.api.proxy.Player;
import dev.mnm.plugin.BackendConnector;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.util.UUID;

/**
 * Translates proxy events into backend events. Handlers only enqueue work, so
 * they never block Velocity's event threads on network I/O.
 */
final class PlayerListener {
    private final BackendConnector connector;
    private final SessionRegistry sessions;
    private final boolean collectIp;

    PlayerListener(BackendConnector connector, SessionRegistry sessions, boolean collectIp) {
        this.connector = connector;
        this.sessions = sessions;
        this.collectIp = collectIp;
    }

    @Subscribe(priority = Short.MIN_VALUE)
    public void onPostLogin(PostLoginEvent event) {
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        UUID sessionKey = sessions.open(player.getUniqueId());
        JsonObject e = base("player.join", sessionKey, player);
        e.addProperty("username", player.getUsername());
        e.addProperty("at", System.currentTimeMillis());
        if (collectIp) {
            InetSocketAddress remote = player.getRemoteAddress();
            if (remote != null && remote.getAddress() != null) e.addProperty("ip", remote.getAddress().getHostAddress());
        }
        player.getVirtualHost().ifPresent(host -> e.addProperty("virtualHost", host.getHostString()));
        e.addProperty("protocol", player.getProtocolVersion().getProtocol());
        e.addProperty("clientVersion", player.getProtocolVersion().getMostRecentSupportedVersion());
        // Skin texture (base64 JSON from the game profile); the backend only accepts textures.minecraft.net URLs.
        player.getGameProfileProperties().stream()
                .filter(p -> "textures".equals(p.getName()) && p.getValue() != null && p.getValue().length() <= 8192)
                .findFirst()
                .ifPresent(p -> e.addProperty("textures", p.getValue()));
        connector.enqueue(e);
    }

    @Subscribe(priority = Short.MIN_VALUE)
    public void onServerConnected(ServerConnectedEvent event) {
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        sessions.get(player.getUniqueId()).ifPresent(sessionKey -> {
            JsonObject e = base("player.switch", sessionKey, player);
            e.addProperty("server", event.getServer().getServerInfo().getName());
            e.addProperty("at", System.currentTimeMillis());
            connector.enqueue(e);
        });
    }

    @Subscribe(priority = Short.MIN_VALUE)
    public void onClientBrand(PlayerClientBrandEvent event) {
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        sessions.get(player.getUniqueId()).ifPresent(sessionKey -> {
            JsonObject e = base("player.brand", sessionKey, player);
            String brand = event.getBrand();
            e.addProperty("brand", brand.length() > 128 ? brand.substring(0, 128) : brand);
            connector.enqueue(e);
        });
    }

    @Subscribe(priority = Short.MIN_VALUE)
    public void onDisconnect(DisconnectEvent event) {
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        // Only players that completed login have a session.
        sessions.close(player.getUniqueId()).ifPresent(sessionKey -> {
            JsonObject e = base("player.leave", sessionKey, player);
            e.addProperty("at", System.currentTimeMillis());
            connector.enqueue(e);
        });
    }

    private static JsonObject base(String type, UUID sessionKey, Player player) {
        JsonObject e = new JsonObject();
        e.addProperty("type", type);
        e.addProperty("sessionKey", sessionKey.toString());
        e.addProperty("uuid", player.getUniqueId().toString());
        return e;
    }
}

`apps/velocity-plugin/src/main/java/dev/mnm/velocity/SessionRegistry.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.velocity;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

/**
 * Maps connected players to the session key sent to the backend. The key makes
 * join/leave events idempotent and lets the backend match a sync to sessions.
 */
final class SessionRegistry {
    private final Map<UUID, UUID> sessions = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    UUID open(UUID player) {
        UUID key = UUID.randomUUID();
        sessions.put(player, key);
        return key;
    }

    Optional<UUID> get(UUID player) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(sessions.get(player));
    }

    Optional<UUID> close(UUID player) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(sessions.remove(player));
    }
}

package dev.mnm.velocity;

import com.velocitypowered.api.command.SimpleCommand;
import dev.mnm.plugin.BackendConnector;
import dev.mnm.plugin.Messages;
import dev.mnm.plugin.StatusLines;

/** {@code /networkmanager} (alias {@code /nm}): shows the backend connection status. */
final class StatusCommand implements SimpleCommand {
    static final String PERMISSION = "networkmanager.admin";

    private final BackendConnector connector;
    private final Messages messages;
    private final String type;

    StatusCommand(BackendConnector connector, Messages messages, String type) {
        this.connector = connector;
        this.messages = messages;
        this.type = type;
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(Invocation invocation) {
        StatusLines.render(messages, connector.status(), type).forEach(invocation.source()::sendMessage);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasPermission(Invocation invocation) {
        return invocation.source().hasPermission(PERMISSION);
    }
}

`apps/velocity-plugin/src/main/java/dev/mnm/velocity/VelocityPlatform.java`:

```java
package dev.mnm.velocity;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.velocitypowered.api.proxy.Player;
import com.velocitypowered.api.proxy.ProxyServer;
import dev.mnm.plugin.BackendConnector;
import dev.mnm.plugin.ProcessMetrics;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;

final class VelocityPlatform implements BackendConnector.Platform {
    private final ProxyServer proxy;
    private final SessionRegistry sessions;

    VelocityPlatform(ProxyServer proxy, SessionRegistry sessions) {
        this.proxy = proxy;
        this.sessions = sessions;
    }

    @Override
    public String type() {
        return "VELOCITY";
    }

    @Override
    public String platformVersion() {
        return proxy.getVersion().getName() + " " + proxy.getVersion().getVersion();
    }

    @Override
    public String minecraftVersion() {
        return null;
    }

    /** Velocity APIs used here are thread-safe, so no thread hop is needed. */
    @Override
    public CompletableFuture<JsonObject> heartbeat() {
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.addProperty("onlinePlayers", proxy.getPlayerCount());
        body.addProperty("maxPlayers", proxy.getConfiguration().getShowMaxPlayers());
        ProcessMetrics.addTo(body);
        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(body);
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<JsonArray> sessions() {
        JsonArray list = new JsonArray();
        for (Player player : proxy.getAllPlayers()) {
            sessions.get(player.getUniqueId()).ifPresent(sessionKey -> {
                JsonObject s = new JsonObject();
                s.addProperty("sessionKey", sessionKey.toString());
                s.addProperty("uuid", player.getUniqueId().toString());
                s.addProperty("username", player.getUsername());
                player.getCurrentServer().ifPresent(server -> s.addProperty("server", server.getServerInfo().getName()));
                list.add(s);
            });
        }
        return Optional.of(list);
    }
}

```

`docs/api/README.md`:

# API

The backend exposes a REST API under `/api`. Interactive OpenAPI documentation is served at `/api/docs` (JSON: `/api/docs/openapi.json`) when `API_DOCS_ENABLED=true`.

## Conventions

- JSON request and response bodies; timestamps in ISO 8601 UTC; 64-bit ids as strings.
- Dashboard authentication via `mnm_access` cookie (or `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`).
- State-changing requests require the header `X-MNM-CSRF: 1` (except plugin endpoints).
- Errors: `{ "statusCode": 403, "code": "FORBIDDEN", "message": "...", "issues"?: [{ "path", "message" }] }`.
- Rate limits answer `429`.

## Endpoints (v0.6.0)

| Method & path | Auth | Permission | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /api/health/live` | – | – | Liveness |
| `GET /api/health/ready` | – | – | Readiness (DB + Redis), `503` otherwise |
| `GET /api/setup/status` | – | – | Initialisation and service status |
| `POST /api/setup/initialize` | setup code | – | Create Owner + network settings (once) |
| `POST /api/auth/login` | – | – | Sign in (sets cookies) |
| `POST /api/auth/refresh` | refresh cookie | – | Rotate session tokens |
| `POST /api/auth/logout` | session | – | Revoke the current session |
| `GET /api/auth/me` | session | – | Current user, role and permissions |
| `PATCH /api/auth/me` | session | – | Language, theme, time zone preferences |
| `POST /api/auth/me/password` | session | – | Change password (revokes other sessions) |
| `GET /api/dashboard/summary` | session | – (sections by permission) | Home page figures |
| `GET /api/users` · `POST /api/users` · `PATCH /api/users/:id` | session | `users.view` / `users.manage` | Dashboard users |
| `GET /api/roles` · `GET /api/permissions` | session | `users.view` | Roles and permission catalogue |

| `POST /api/plugin/v1/statistics` | request signature (Paper) | – | Statistics upload |
| `GET /api/plugin/v1/punishments/active` · `…/changes?after=` · `POST …/punishments` · `…/punishments/revoke` · `GET …/players/lookup` | request signature | – | Punishment feed and in-game moderation ([punishments](../architecture/punishments.md)) |

## Plugin registration

```http
POST /api/plugin/v1/register
Content-Type: application/json

{ "token": "mnm_reg_…", "pluginVersion": "0.2.0", "platformVersion": "Velocity 3.4.0", "minecraftVersion": "1.21.10" }
```

Response `201`:

```json
{ "serverId": "…", "serverName": "proxy", "serverType": "VELOCITY", "keyId": "mnm_key_…", "secret": "mnm_sk_…" }
```

The secret is returned once. Invalid, expired or reused tokens return `401`.

`docs/architecture/anticheat.md`:

```md
# AntiCheat integration

The Network Manager does not detect cheats itself. It connects existing AntiCheat plugins (Grim, Vulcan, …) to the network-wide punishment system: integrations **report** violations, and the network's **rules** — configured in the dashboard — decide what happens.

```
AntiCheat plugin ──Java API / /anticheatban──▶ Paper plugin ──signed report──▶ backend rule engine
                                                  │ (allow-list, rate limit)          │
                                                  └─ kicks locally on KICK/BAN        ├─ anticheat_events (every report + outcome)
                                                                                      └─ punishment (source ANTICHEAT, evidence)
                                                                                             └─▶ punishment feed ─▶ proxy enforces
```

## Safe defaults

- Automatic reports for checks **without a rule are only logged**. Nothing is punished until you add rules.
- `/anticheatban` without a matching rule uses the *command fallback* (default: 30-day temporary ban).
- The example rules from the specification (Speed → 30 days, Fly → 14 days, KillAura → permanent) are **not active**; the dashboard offers them as a template ("Insert example rules") to review and save.

## Rules (Dashboard → AntiCheat → Rules)

| Setting | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Check | Name reported by the integration, matched case-insensitively |
| Action | Log only, warning, kick, temporary ban (with duration), permanent ban |
| Min. VL | Automatic reports below this violation level are only logged (explicit `/anticheatban` ignores it) |
| Cooldown | No further automatic punishment for the same player and check within this window |
| AntiCheat punishments enabled | Global switch; reports are still recorded when off |
| Store evidence and metadata | Keep evidence text and details with events and punishments |
| Max. automatic punishments per server and minute | Protects against misbehaving integrations |

Changes apply to the next report; no plugin reload is needed. Every change is audit-logged (`anticheat.settings_updated`). Viewing requires `anticheat.view`, editing `anticheat.manage`.

## Outcomes

Each report is stored with one outcome: `WARNING`, `KICK`, `TEMP_BAN`, `BAN` (punishment issued) or `LOGGED`, `DISABLED`, `SKIPPED_THRESHOLD`, `SKIPPED_COOLDOWN`, `SKIPPED_RATE_LIMIT`, `SKIPPED_DUPLICATE` (player already banned), `SKIPPED_OFFLINE` (kick of an offline player).

Punishments are issued through the regular punishment service (source `ANTICHEAT`, issuer `AntiCheat (<integration>)`) with the evidence attached, appear in the moderation views, and are enforced network-wide by the proxy within seconds. The Paper server additionally disconnects the player immediately on kick or ban.

## For AntiCheat plugin developers

Add the Paper plugin jar as a `compileOnly` dependency and declare a soft dependency on `NetworkManager` in your `plugin.yml`.

```java
AntiCheatApi api = Bukkit.getServicesManager().load(AntiCheatApi.class);
if (api != null && api.isAuthorized(this)) {
    api.report(this, AntiCheatReport.builder(player.getUniqueId(), "Speed")
            .violationLevel(vl)
            .evidence("moved " + speed + " blocks/s")
            .metadata("ping", player.getPing())
            .build())
       .thenAccept(result -> getLogger().info("Outcome: " + result.outcome()));
}
```

- `report` is asynchronous and never blocks the calling thread.
- The server owner must allow-list your plugin: `anticheat-integrations=YourPlugin` in `plugins/NetworkManager/config.properties`.
- Reports are rate limited per integration (`anticheat-max-reports-per-minute`, default 120).
- Retries after network errors reuse the same event key, so a report never causes two punishments.

## `/anticheatban <player> <cheatType> <reason>`

For integrations that can only run commands. Requires `networkmanager.anticheat.command` (default **false**; the console always has it), so regular players and moderators cannot use it unless explicitly granted.

## API

| Endpoint | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /api/plugin/v1/anticheat/reports` | Signed report from a Paper server |
| `GET /api/anticheat/events` · `GET /api/players/:uuid/anticheat` | Event history (`anticheat.view`) |
| `GET /api/anticheat/summary` | Today's counters, top checks, integrations |
| `GET/PUT /api/anticheat/settings` | Rules (`PUT` requires `anticheat.manage`) |

```

`docs/architecture/configuration.md`:

```md
# Configuration management

Configuration lives in three places, each with a clear owner:

| Where | Owner | Examples | Applies |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.env` (Docker host) | Operator | Secrets, ports, cookies, proxies, GeoIP | Restart of the stack |
| Dashboard → **Settings** (database) | Administrators | Network, plugin settings, punishment templates, languages, privacy, AntiCheat rules, roles | Immediately |
| `config.properties` on each Minecraft server | Server owner | Backend URL, AntiCheat allow-list, IP collection, intervals, moderation switches | Restart of that server |

Every dashboard change is audit-logged (`settings.*`, `i18n.*`, `anticheat.*`, `roles.*`).

## Settings sections

| Section | Permission | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| General | – / `settings.manage` | Personal preferences; network name, description, Minecraft domain, dashboard URL |
| Minecraft integration | `servers.manage` | Add-server workflow, plugin config generator, unused registration tokens |
| Plugin settings | `settings.manage` | Settings pushed live to plugins, plugin message overrides |
| Moderation | `settings.manage` | Punishment templates (type, reason, duration) |
| Languages | `translations.manage` | Enable/disable, default language, add languages, import/export catalogues |
| Privacy | `settings.manage` | IP address retention |

AntiCheat rules (thresholds, durations, cooldowns, evidence) are configured on the AntiCheat page, roles and permissions under User Management.

## Adding a server (registration workflow)

Settings → **Minecraft integration** → *Add a server*:

1. **Server** – type (Velocity or Paper) and name. Paper servers must use exactly the name from `velocity.toml`.
2. **Options** – the generator shows every plugin option with its allowed range and a live preview of `config.properties`. "Connection mode" switches between HTTPS and plain HTTP; plain HTTP to a public address is flagged (requests are signed but not encrypted).
3. **Install & connect** – *Create token & configuration* creates a single-use registration token (valid `REGISTRATION_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES`, default 30) and inserts it into the configuration. Download it as `config.properties` or as a ZIP package (`plugins/<folder>/config.properties` + `INSTALL.md`). The page then follows the registration live: plugin registered → first heartbeat received.

Downloads are generated in the browser; the token never appears in a URL. *Download without token* produces a configuration for reinstalling an already registered server. Rotating or revoking credentials and the connection status of registered servers are on the server's page (Servers → server).

## Plugin settings (central, live)

Plugins with `managed-settings=true` (default) take these values from the dashboard. Each field can be left at **Server setting**, which keeps the value from the server's own `config.properties`.

| Setting | Platform |
| --- | --- |
| Plugin language | Velocity, Paper |
| Plugin message overrides (per language) | Velocity, Paper |
| Statistics on/off, categories, interval | Paper |
| Inventory / Ender Chest synchronisation, snapshot interval | Paper |

How it reaches the servers:

1. Saving increments a **revision** (optimistic locking: a concurrent save by someone else is rejected with "changed in the meantime").
2. Every heartbeat response contains `configRevision`. A plugin whose applied revision differs fetches `GET /api/plugin/v1/config` and applies it **without a restart** (within one heartbeat interval, 15 s by default).
3. The plugin caches the last document in `managed-settings.json`, so it also applies when the server starts while the backend is unreachable.

Message overrides are validated: only known keys, no click/insertion/data MiniMessage tags (they could run commands), only placeholders the original text uses. Languages without a bundled plugin file use English plus their overrides.

### Requires a restart of the Minecraft server

`backend-url`, `registration-token`, `collect-ip-addresses`, `heartbeat-interval-seconds`, `sync-interval-seconds`, `max-queued-events`, `afk-timeout-seconds`, `anticheat-integrations`, `anticheat-max-reports-per-minute`, `punishments-enabled`, `moderation-commands`, `managed-settings`, `debug`. These are security- or infrastructure-relevant and deliberately stay under the server owner's control.

## Punishment templates

Settings → **Moderation** defines up to 50 templates (name, type, reason, duration for temporary types). The punishment dialog offers the templates matching the user's permissions and fills type, duration and reason; everything stays editable before issuing.

## Translation management

Settings → **Languages**:

- **Export** downloads the effective catalogue of a language (bundled + imported) as JSON.
- **Add language** registers a new locale (`ll-RR`). It starts disabled.
- **Import** uploads a JSON catalogue for any language. It is validated like the bundled files: no markup or scripts, balanced placeholders, only keys that exist in en-US. Missing keys fall back to English; the number of missing keys is shown. For bundled languages an import overrides the shipped texts (*Reset* returns to them).
- **Enable** makes the language selectable; the dashboard picks up imported texts within 30 seconds without a rebuild.
- **Delete** (added languages only) removes it; users who selected it fall back to the network default.

Workflow for a new language: export `en-US`, translate the values (keep keys and `{placeholders}`), add the language, import the file, enable it.

Plugin messages are translated separately under Plugin settings → Plugin messages (bundled files: `packages/translations/minecraft/<locale>.yml`).

```

`docs/architecture/database.md`:

```md
# Database decision: MySQL 8.4 LTS

**Decision:** MySQL 8.4 LTS with Prisma 7 (via the `@prisma/adapter-mariadb` driver adapter).

**Considered:** PostgreSQL 17.

**Why MySQL:**

- The workload is relational and transactional (players, sessions, punishments, RBAC, audit log). Both engines fit; nothing in the requirements needs PostgreSQL-specific features (no full-text ranking, GIS or advanced JSON indexing).
- MySQL is what most Minecraft hosting providers and existing plugins (LiteBans, LuckPerms, CoreProtect) already use, so operators are familiar with backup and tuning.
- 8.4 is an LTS release with long support.
- Prisma supports both, so switching later is possible but would need a fresh migration history.

## Conventions

- Table and column names in `snake_case`; Prisma models in `PascalCase`.
- Timestamps are `DATETIME(3)` stored in **UTC** (the connection uses `timezone: 'Z'`). Display conversion happens in the dashboard.
- Minecraft UUID (`CHAR(36)`, lowercase, dashed) is the stable player identity and the primary key of `players`.
- Character set `utf8mb4` / `utf8mb4_unicode_ci`.
- High-volume tables (`player_sessions`, `player_connections`, `player_statistic_snapshots`, `audit_logs`) use `BIGINT` auto-increment keys; other entities use CUIDs.
- Secrets are never stored in plaintext: refresh tokens, registration tokens and plugin secrets are stored as SHA-256 hashes; passwords use Argon2id.

## Models

| Area | Tables |
| --- | --- |
| Players | `players`, `player_names`, `player_sessions`, `player_connections`, `player_server_visits`, `player_notes` |
| Statistics | `player_statistics` (current values; a missing row means *never collected*), `player_statistic_snapshots` (history for charts) |
| Inventories | `player_inventories` (latest snapshot + revision number), `inventory_revisions` (diffs, status: pending/applied/conflict/rolled back) |
| Punishments | `punishments` (with idempotency key), `punishment_evidence`, `anticheat_events` |
| Servers | `servers`, `server_credentials` (hashed), `registration_tokens` (hashed, single-use, expiring) |
| Dashboard | `dashboard_users`, `dashboard_roles`, `dashboard_permissions`, `dashboard_role_permissions`, `dashboard_sessions` |
| System | `audit_logs`, `system_settings`, `language_settings` |

Tables for later phases are created now so the schema evolves additively; they stay empty until the corresponding feature ships.

## Migrations

- Located in `apps/backend/prisma/migrations`, applied by `prisma migrate deploy` when the backend container starts.
- CI applies all migrations to an empty MySQL 8.4 and checks that the result matches `schema.prisma` (`prisma migrate diff --exit-code`).
- Migrations are **forward-only**. Never assume a migration can be rolled back automatically – back up before upgrading.
- Create a new migration during development with `npm run prisma:migrate:dev -w @mnm/backend -- --name <change>` (requires a local MySQL).

## Privacy & retention

IP addresses (`player_connections.ip_address`, `dashboard_sessions.ip_address`, `audit_logs.ip_address`) are personal data. Access to player IPs will require `players.view.ip`; geolocation fields are approximate and labelled as such. Configurable retention and anonymisation jobs are planned together with connection tracking (Phase 2/4).

```

`docs/architecture/i18n.md`:

```md
# Internationalization

English (`en-US`) is the default language of the whole system. Every user-facing string is a translation key.

## Dashboard

- Catalogues: `packages/translations/locales/<locale>.json` (nested keys, ICU message syntax).
- Library: `next-intl` without locale-prefixed routes. The locale is resolved per request from the `NEXT_LOCALE` cookie, otherwise `en-US` (the browser language is deliberately not used).
- Signed-in users: the saved preference (`dashboard_users.locale`) is applied on load; changing the language saves it and re-renders immediately (`router.refresh()`), no reload or restart.
- Missing keys fall back to English (`getMessages()` deep-merges each catalogue over `en-US`).
- Type safety: `src/global.d.ts` types messages against `en-US.json`, so using an unknown key fails `tsc`.
- Pluralization and variables: ICU, e.g. `"{count, plural, =0 {No players} one {# player} other {# players}}"`.
- Numbers, dates and relative times use `useFormatter()` with the active locale and the user's time zone (`mnm_tz` cookie, from the account preference or the browser).

## Adding a language

1. Copy `packages/translations/locales/en-US.json` to e.g. `fr-FR.json`, set `meta.locale`, translate.
2. Register it in `packages/translations/src/index.ts` (`bundledCatalogs`) and `packages/shared-types/src/locales.ts` (`BUNDLED_LOCALES`).
3. Copy `packages/translations/minecraft/en-US.yml` to `fr-FR.yml` for plugin messages.
4. Run `npm run translations:validate`. It fails on unsafe content, unknown keys or broken placeholders and reports missing keys.
5. After deployment the language appears in *Settings → Languages*, where it can be enabled, disabled or made the default.

Administrators can see missing-key counts and export catalogues (`GET /api/i18n/catalogs/:locale`). Languages can be added and catalogues imported at runtime (table `translation_catalogs`, validated like bundled files); the dashboard merges imported texts over the bundled catalogue and picks up changes within 30 seconds. See [Configuration management](configuration.md#translation-management).

## Minecraft plugins

`packages/translations/minecraft/<locale>.yml` holds flat, dot-separated keys with `{placeholder}` variables and MiniMessage formatting. The plugins (Phase 2) will ship these files, use the network language by default and optionally each player's client locale.
